examples.zh: 李得到324票。

examples.zh: 我感觉自己肯定通过这次测验了。

examples.zh: 我当然从未期望自己成为一名作家。

examples.zh: 几乎可以肯定，这个女孩是被人谋杀的。

words.definition: something that is definitely true or that will definitely happen; very like a whale, inerrability
words.translation: 必然,肯定;必然的事；必然；确实；确实的事情

examples.zh: 通常他都做得相当好，但也并不一定。

examples.zh: 唯一能够确定的事就是需要重大的变革。

words.definition: an official document that states that a fact or facts are true; license, letter, patent, permit
words.translation: 证(明)书,执照；[管理]证书；执照，文凭

examples.zh: 学位证书

examples.zh: 这些账目经审计员核实过。

words.definition: a performance given by musicians or singers; accordance, unity, agreement, identity, keeping; coordinate with, attune; cooperate, sort

examples.zh: 镜子和毛巾架等浴室配件

examples.zh: 将肉中多余的肥肉切掉。

examples.zh: 两杯啤酒要15美元，似乎有点过分。

words.translation: 前辈，前任；前任，前辈

examples.zh: 肯尼迪总统的前任是战争英雄德怀特·艾森豪威尔。

words.definition: a series of actions that are done in order to achieve a particular result; to make food, materials, or goods ready to be used or sold, for example by preserving or improving them in some way; manufacture, cope with; going on, course, system, method, approach

examples.zh: 以－埃和平进程

examples.zh: 他们列队向国会大厦行进。

examples.zh: 她连续四次夺得冠军。

examples.zh: 历届政府都试图解决这个问题。

examples.zh: “那是唯一可行的解决办法。”“对，我想是。”查尔斯承认道。

examples.zh: 午餐开始之前主席会发表一段简短的讲话。

words.translation: 在前的,在先的；在前的；前述的

examples.zh: 如我们在前一章所见，团组可以是社会化的有力动因。

examples.zh: 游泳有助于肌肉的血液循环。

examples.zh: 吊扇使暖空气在房间里循环。

examples.zh: …一位正在计算地球周长的科学家。

examples.zh: 苏联为形势所迫同纳粹德国签订了一项条约。

examples.zh: 我无法想象我在什么情况下会愿意去偷东西。

examples.zh: 我真正的理想是去马戏团工作。

examples.zh: 该目标是循环使用98%的生活垃圾。

examples.zh: 我把窗户关上你不介意吧？

examples.zh: 她拉上了窗帘。

examples.zh: 我来修一下车门，它关不紧。

examples.zh: 等到调查结束后，结果会被送到联邦检察官办公室。

examples.zh: 弗朗西斯完成了和詹姆斯的买卖后就去了迈阿密。

examples.zh: 法官裁决不接纳以不正当手段获取的证据。

examples.zh: 这个价格包含邮费吗？

examples.zh: 他的职责包括照管21岁以下球队。

examples.zh: …国会大厦的穹顶。

words.definition: an area of activity, interest, or knowledge, especially one that a particular person, organization etc deals with; province, territory, world, industry, kingdom, universe, field
words.translation: (活动,思想等)领域,范围;领地；领域；域名；产业；地产

examples.en: Looking after the house was viewed as a woman’s domain.
examples.zh: 料理家务被认为是女性的份内之事。

words.definition: relating to or happening in one particular country and not involving any other countries; internal, household, home, family; servant
words.translation: 家里的;本国的;驯养的；国内的；家庭的；驯养的；一心只管家务的；国货；佣人

examples.en: Unfortunately his domestic life wasn’t very happy.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，他的家庭生活并不幸福。

words.definition: more powerful, important, or noticeable than other people or things; ruling, predominant
words.translation: 支配的,统治的,占优势的；显性的；[生物]占优势的；[数]支配的，统治的

examples.en: The dominant male gorilla is the largest in the group.
examples.zh: 领头的公猩猩是这群大猩猩中体形最大的一个。

examples.en: Japan became dominant in the mass market during the 1980s.
examples.zh: 20世纪80年代日本在大众市场上开始占据优势。

examples.en: its dominant position within the group
examples.zh: 它在该组织中的突出地位

words.definition: to control someone or something or to have more importance than other people or things; possess, contain, regulate, bit, bottle; advantage over, prevail over
words.translation: 支配,统治,控制;占优势；控制；支配；占优势；在…中占主要地位；处于支配地位

examples.en: The industry is dominated by five multinational companies.
examples.zh: 这个行业受五家跨国公司控制。

examples.en: New Orleans dominated throughout the game.
examples.zh: 新奥尔良队自始至终都控制着这场比赛。

examples.en: Her loud voice totally dominated the conversation.
examples.zh: 她的大嗓门完全主导着这场谈话。

words.definition: more powerful, more common, or more easily noticed than others; remarkable, excellent, primary, major, prominent
words.translation: (over)占优势的;主要的,突出的；主要的；卓越的；[计]支配的；有力的；有影响的

examples.en: the predominant group in society
examples.zh: 社会中的主导群体

examples.en: In this painting, the predominant colour is black.
examples.zh: 这幅画的主色调是黑色。

words.definition: something very bad that is going to happen, or the fact that it is going to happen; to make someone or something certain to fail, die, be destroyed etc; death, sentence, end, award; fate, determine
words.translation: 厄运,劫数；注定,命定；厄运；死亡；判决；世界末日；注定；使失败

examples.en: A sense of impending doom (= coming very soon ) gripped her.
examples.zh: 她心头被一种大难临头的感觉所笼罩。

examples.en: Thousands of soldiers met their doom (= died ) on this very field.
examples.zh: 数千名士兵就是在这个战场上丧生的。

words.definition: a  dormitory; lodging house, lodging quarters
words.translation: (itory)［美］［口］宿舍；宿舍（等于dormitory）

examples.en: But I had no food in my dorm, so I had to go to canteen.
examples.zh: 但是我在宿舍没有东西可吃，所以我只能去餐厅了。

examples.en: So, some can stay in the dorm for an entire month without talking at all with anyone.
examples.zh: 因此，有些学生能待在宿舍里整整一个月不与任何人讲话。

examples.en: If you have a phone in your dorm or apartment, a cell phone, and any other phone numbers, consolidate them into one number with Google Voice.
examples.zh: 如果你有宿舍或公寓的号码、手机号码，还有其他什么电话号码，可以通过谷歌声音把它们集成为一个号码。

words.definition: a system of government in which every citizen in the country can vote to elect its government officials
words.translation: 民主,民主制,民主国家

examples.en: a return to democracy after 16 years of military rule
examples.zh: 16年军人统治后民主制度的恢复

words.definition: controlled by representatives who are elected by the people of a country; popular
words.translation: 民主的；民主政治的；大众的

examples.en: a democratic government
examples.zh: 民主政府

examples.en: the role of the media in the democratic process
examples.zh: 民主进程中媒体的作用

words.definition: the same in size, number, amount, value etc as something else; competent, adequate, equivalent, even; be equivalent to, bear comparison with; comparative, opponent, rival, match, adversary
words.translation: 相等的;胜任的n.相等的事务;对手v.等于；[数]平等的；相等的；胜任的；等于；比得上；对手；匹敌；同辈；[数]相等的事物

examples.en: Our constitution states that all men are equal.
examples.zh: 我们的宪法规定人人平等。

words.definition: enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose; suitable, competent, appropriate, proper, becoming
words.translation: 充足的，足够的；适当的，胜任的；充足的；适当的；胜任的

examples.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
examples.zh: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

examples.en: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
examples.zh: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

examples.en: The standard of his work is barely adequate .
examples.zh: 他的工作水准勉强合格。

words.definition: a situation in which people have the same rights, advantages etc; equivalence, egality
words.translation: 同等;平等;相等;等式;等同性；平等；相等；[数]等式

examples.en: ...equality of the sexes.
examples.zh: …性别平等。

words.definition: a statement in mathematics that shows that two amounts or totals are equal; eqs, equivalence
words.translation: (数学)等式,方程式;(with)相等;均衡；[数]方程式，等式；相等；[化学]反应式

examples.en: In the equation 2x + 1 = 7, what is x?
examples.zh: 在方程式2x+1=7中，x的值为多少？

words.definition: an imaginary line drawn around the middle of the Earth that is exactly the same distance from the North Pole and the South Pole; equinoctial
words.translation: 赤道；[天][地理]赤道

examples.en: The United States is north of the equator.
examples.zh: 美国位于赤道以北。

examples.en: In the hot zone near the equator the sun heats the air continually; hence the air there ascends.
examples.zh: 在靠近赤道的热带地区，太阳不断地加热那里的空气，于是那里的热空气就上升。

words.definition: to provide a person or place with the things that are needed for a particular kind of activity or work; prepare, provide
words.translation: (with)装备,配备;训练；装备，配备

examples.en: They try to equip their vehicles with gadgets to deal with every possible contingency.
examples.zh: 他们尽量给他们的车辆配备各种小装置以应付任何可能的突发状况。

words.definition: the tools, machines etc that you need to do a particular job or activity; furniture, facility, plant, arm, fixture
words.translation: 设备,器材,装置;才能；[机]设备，装备；器材

examples.en: a shop selling camping equipment
examples.zh: 出售露营装备的商店

examples.en: some brand new computer equipment
examples.zh: 一些全新的计算机设备

examples.en: a very useful piece of equipment
examples.zh: 一件非常有用的设备

words.definition: to have an argument; an angry argument or disagreement; debate, exchange words; falling-out, earful
words.translation: 争吵,争论；争吵,争吵的原因；吵架；争论；挑剔；反目；怨言；争吵的原因；方头凿

examples.en: I wish you two would stop quarreling.
examples.zh: 我希望你们两个别再吵了。

words.definition: a piece of information that is known to be true; truth, reality, actuality
words.translation: 事实,实际；事实；实际；真相

examples.en: Our decision to build the museum in Hartlepool was influenced by the fact that there were no national museums in the North East.
examples.zh: 我们之所以决定在哈特尔浦建造博物馆，是因为东北地区没有国家级的博物馆。

words.definition: one of several things that influence or cause a situation; element, deputy, agent, basic, essential
words.translation: 因素,要素；因素；[经]要素；[物]因数；代理人

examples.en: The rise in crime is mainly due to social and economic factors.
examples.zh: 犯罪率上升主要由社会和经济因素造成。

words.definition: a building or group of buildings in which goods are produced in large quantities, using machines; plant, mill, work, manufactory
words.translation: 工厂；[工经]工厂；制造厂；代理店

examples.en: a car factory
examples.zh: 汽车制造厂

examples.en: factory workers
examples.zh: 工厂工人

words.definition: a feeling of happiness or pleasure because you have achieved something or got what you wanted; content, fill, satisfied with, Lays
words.translation: 满足,满意;乐事,愉快；满意，满足；赔偿；乐事；赎罪

examples.en: She got great satisfaction from helping people to learn.
examples.zh: 她在帮助人们学习的过程中得到很大的满足。

examples.en: ‘I’ve passed all my exams’, he announced with satisfaction.
examples.zh: “我通过了所有的考试。”他满意地宣布。

words.definition: something that is satisfactory seems good enough for you, or good enough for a particular situation or purpose; content, well-pleasing
words.translation: 令人满意的,圆满的,良好的,符合要求的；满意的；符合要求的；赎罪的

examples.en: His progress this term has been satisfactory.
examples.zh: 他这学期的进步令人满意。

words.definition: to do something that produces an effect or change in something or in someone’s situation; influence, impact of, impact on, catch, contract; tend, prefer; emotion, will, sensibility
words.translation: 影响；(疾病)侵袭；感动；情感，感情；感染；假装；倾向；喜欢；情感；引起感情的因素

examples.en: the areas affected by the hurricane
examples.zh: 受飓风影响的地区

examples.en: a disease that affects the central nervous system
examples.zh: 影响中枢神经系统的疾病

examples.en: decisions which affect our lives
examples.zh: 影响我们生活的决定

words.definition: a feeling of liking or love and caring; infection, impression, favor, effect, influence
words.translation: 爱，喜爱；爱慕之情；感情；疾病，不适；喜爱，[心理]感情；影响；感染

examples.en: She looked back on those days with affection .
examples.zh: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

examples.en: Their father never showed them much affection .
examples.zh: 他们的父亲对他们从来没有表现出多少慈爱。

examples.en: The church was held in great affection (=  loved and cared about a lot  ) by the local residents.
examples.zh: 教会深受当地民众爱戴。

words.definition: a fault or a lack of something that means that something or someone is not perfect; deficiency, disadvantage, vice, fault, shortcoming; apostatize, rise up
words.translation: 过失;缺点;不足；缺点，[晶体][材]缺陷；不足之处；变节；叛变

examples.en: All the cars are tested for defects before they leave the factory.
examples.zh: 所有汽车在出厂前都经过品质检验。

examples.en: a genetic defect
examples.zh: 遗传缺陷

words.definition: not having any mistakes, faults, or damage; to make something as good as you are able to; greatest, ideal, prime, best, full; round off, polish up
words.translation: 完善的;完全的;(语法)完成的；使完美；完美的；最好的；精通的；使熟练

examples.en: His English was perfect.
examples.zh: 他的英语很地道。

examples.en: The car was in perfect condition.
examples.zh: 这辆车的车况极佳。

examples.en: You’re very lucky to have perfect teeth.
examples.zh: 你能拥有一口完美的牙齿太幸运了。

words.definition: the state of being perfect; finish, fare-thee-well
words.translation: 尽善尽美,完美；完善；完美

examples.en: My father expected perfection from all of us.
examples.zh: 父亲期望我们都尽善尽美。

examples.en: the search for technical perfection
examples.zh: 对技术的精益求精

words.definition: a change that is caused by an event, action etc; If you effect something that you are trying to achieve, you succeed in causing it to happen; impression, influence, infection, affection, impact; form, inspire
words.translation: 结果;效果;影响;印象；招致;实现;达到；影响；效果；作用；产生；达到目的

examples.en: the long-term effects of the drug
examples.zh: 这种毒品的长期影响

examples.en: I could feel the effects of the thin mountain air.
examples.zh: 我能感觉到山上稀薄空气产生的影响。

examples.en: This ingredient also has the effect of making your skin look younger.
examples.zh: 这种成分还有使皮肤看上去更年轻的效果。

words.definition: successful, and working in the way that was intended; valid, available, virtual, practical, telling, actual, honest
words.translation: 有效的,生效的;被实施的;给人深刻印象；[数]有效的，起作用的；实际的，实在的；给人深刻印象

examples.en: The cheaper drugs are just as effective in treating arthritis.
examples.zh: 较便宜的药品对治疗关节炎同样有效。

examples.en: the painting’s highly effective use of colour
examples.zh: 绘画中得心应手的色彩运用

examples.en: Training is often much less effective than expected.
examples.zh: 训练的效果往往远低于预期。

words.definition: the quality of doing something well and effectively, without wasting time, money, or energy; virtue, potency
words.translation: 效率;功效；效率；效能；功效

examples.en: considerable advancements in energy efficiency
examples.zh: 能源效率的显著提高

words.definition: if someone or something is efficient, they work well without wasting time, money, or energy; able, competent
words.translation: 有效的,效率高的;有能力的,能胜任的；有效率的；有能力的；生效的

examples.en: a very efficient secretary
examples.zh: 效率高的秘书

examples.en: an efficient use of land
examples.zh: 土地的有效使用

examples.en: Lighting is now more energy efficient.
examples.zh: 如今的照明设备更加节能。

words.definition: to give someone a disease; affect, contract, catch, disease, communicate
words.translation: 传染，感染；影响(思想等)；[医]感染，传染

examples.en: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
examples.zh: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

words.definition: an infectious illness can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air you breathe; catching, epidemic
words.translation: 传染的,传染性的,有感染力的；[内科]传染的；传染性的；易传染的

examples.en: infectious diseases
examples.zh: 传染性疾病

examples.en: Flu is highly infectious.
examples.zh: 流感传染性很强。

words.definition: having a good effect; helpful, useful, favorable, advantageous, conducive
words.translation: (to)有利的,有益的；有益的，有利的；可享利益的

examples.en: a drug that has a beneficial effect on the immune system
examples.zh: 有益于免疫系统的一种药物

examples.en: an arrangement that is mutually beneficial
examples.zh: 一项互惠互利的协定

words.definition: an advantage, improvement, or help that you get from something; if you benefit from something, or it benefits you, it gives you an advantage, improves your life, or helps you in some way; behalf, sake, profit, advantage, plus; profit, be good for
words.translation: 利益,好处,恩惠；有益于;(from,by)受益；利益，好处；救济金；有益于，对…有益

examples.en: I never had the benefit of a university education.
examples.zh: 我从未受过大学教育。

examples.en: The new credit cards will be of great benefit to our customers.
examples.zh: 新信用卡将大大方便我们的客户。

examples.en: I hope that the decision taken today will be to the benefit of the whole nation.
examples.zh: 我希望今天所作的决定将惠及我们整个国家。

words.definition: a process in which you put something into the group or class it belongs to; category, degree, grade, rate, rank
words.translation: 分类,分级；[生物][图情]分类；类别，等级

examples.en: the classification of wines according to quality
examples.zh: 葡萄酒按品质的分类

examples.en: There are five job classifications.
examples.zh: 有五种工作类别。

words.definition: to decide what group something belongs to; categorize, sort through
words.translation: 分类,分等(级)；分类；分等

examples.en: We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
examples.zh: 我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。

examples.en: Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
examples.zh: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

words.definition: a lack of something that is necessary; defect, shortage, vice, need, fault
words.translation: 缺乏,不足;缺点,缺陷；缺陷，缺点；缺乏；不足的数额

examples.en: They did blood tests on him for signs of vitamin deficiency.
examples.zh: 他们给他做了血检看是否有缺乏维生素的迹象。

words.definition: the difference between the amount of something that you have and the higher amount that you need; red ink
words.translation: 赤字,逆差;亏损,亏空;不足,缺乏；[财政]赤字；不足额

examples.en: the country’s widening budget deficit
examples.zh: 这个国家日益严重的预算赤字

examples.en: the US’s foreign trade deficit
examples.zh: 美国的对外贸易逆差

words.definition: hard to do, understand, or deal with; hard, tough
words.translation: 困难的,艰难的；困难的；不随和的；执拗的

examples.en: a difficult question
examples.zh: 难解的问题

examples.en: an immensely difficult task
examples.zh: 极为艰巨的任务

examples.en: Was the exam very difficult?
examples.zh: 这次考试很难吗？

words.definition: if you have difficulty doing something, it is difficult for you to do; poverty, corner, hardness, dilemma, fix
words.translation: 困难,困境,难题；困难，困境

examples.en: If you have any difficulties, give me a call.
examples.zh: 如果你遇到困难，就给我打电话。

words.definition: books and stories about imaginary people and events; invention, novel
words.translation: 虚构,编造;小说；小说；虚构，编造；谎言

examples.en: romantic fiction
examples.zh: 爱情小说

examples.en: historical fiction
examples.zh: 历史小说

words.definition: when someone says officially that they know who someone else is, especially a criminal or a dead person; authentication, recognition
words.translation: 识别,鉴别;证件;认同；鉴定，[计]识别；认同；身份证明

examples.en: His body was taken to Brighton mortuary for identification.
examples.zh: 他的尸体被送到布赖顿停尸所确认身份。

words.definition: to recognize and correctly name someone or something; confirm, recognize, ascertain; cotton, square
words.translation: 识别,鉴别;(with)把…和…看成一样；确定；[计]识别；使参与；把…看成一样；认同；一致

examples.en: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
examples.zh: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

examples.en: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
examples.zh: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

words.definition: very good or beautiful, and very impressive; grand, noble, brave
words.translation: 华丽的,高尚的,宏伟的；高尚的；壮丽的；华丽的；宏伟的

examples.en: a magnificent performance
examples.zh: 气势恢宏的演出

examples.en: The twelve-mile coastline has magnificent sce-nery.
examples.zh: 这12英里的海岸线景色壮观。

examples.en: She looked magnificent in a long red dress.
examples.zh: 她穿着红色长裙，看起来美极了。

words.definition: to make something seem bigger or louder, especially using special equipment; praise, celebrate, bless; enlarge, zoom up
words.translation: 放大,扩大,夸大,夸张；放大；赞美；夸大；有放大能力

examples.en: At the Sheffield arena, the speakers were magnified ten times on a giant screen.
examples.zh: 在谢菲尔德体育馆，演讲者在一个巨大的屏幕上被放大了十倍。

examples.en: A public address system magnifies all the little noises and coughs.
examples.zh: 扩音系统会放大任何细小的噪音和咳嗽声。

words.definition: a building that belongs to a company or organization, with rooms where people can work at desks; bureaux, government agency
words.translation: 办公室,办事处;职务,公职;部,局,处；[管理]办公室；政府机关；官职；营业处

examples.en: The department occupies an office just a mile from the White House.
examples.zh: 该部门就在离白宫一英里远的地方有个办公楼。

examples.en: Did you go to the office (= the office where you work ) today?
examples.zh: 今天你去办公室了吗？

examples.en: the increased demand for office space
examples.zh: 对办公室空间日益增长的需求

words.definition: someone who is in a position of authority in the army, navy etc; wardroom, Irvine; captain, boss, lead, to command
words.translation: 官员,办事员;工作人员;军官；军官，警官；公务员，政府官员；船长；指挥

examples.en: a commanding officer of the SAS
examples.zh: 英国空军特种部队的一名指挥官

words.definition: formal, state; nazir, office holder
words.translation: 官员,行政官员；官方的,官方的,正式的；官方的；正式的；公务的；官员；公务员

words.definition: a good standard of ability and skill; proficient in, conversancy
words.translation: (in)熟练,精通；精通，熟练

examples.en: I brought her proficiency up to the required level.
examples.zh: 我把她的熟练程度提高到所规定的水平。

examples.en: With study and practice, almost anyone can do it with some level of proficiency, but most people don't learn how to think critically or analytically—nor are they even aware of its value.
examples.zh: 通过学习和实践，几乎任何人都能以不同的熟练程度来掌握它，但是大多数人都不会去学习如何进行批判性或分析性思维，或者说，他们根本意识不到其价值。

examples.en: How do you think of your proficiency in written and spoken English?
examples.zh: 你认为你的书面 英语和 口语熟练程度如何？

words.definition: The significance of something is the importance that it has, usually because it will have an effect on a situation or shows something about a situation; meaning, stress, weight, consequence

examples.zh: 她给自己煮了杯咖啡。

examples.zh: 每笔生意本身都有风险。

examples.zh: 继承的财富

words.definition: someone whose job is to take care of sheep; guide, coach, supervise; minister, priest

examples.zh: 所有该协会的成员都遵守严格的业务守则。

examples.en: The three years of the course are planned as a coherent whole.
examples.zh: 这三年的课程是作为连贯的整体来安排的。

examples.zh: 对该事件条理分明的陈述

words.definition: connected or related in a reasonable way to form a whole; combinative
words.translation: 粘合性的，有结合力的；有结合力的；紧密结合的；有粘着力的

examples.zh: 团结的社区

words.definition: vacillate, stand at; stand at, hang back

examples.zh: 我犹豫。

examples.zh: 两个发动机突然熄火，飞机在下降的同时开始喷出燃料。

words.definition: to put liquid, especially a drug, into someone’s body by using a special needle; breathe into, inflood
words.translation: 注射(药液等)；注入；注射

examples.zh: 他的儿子被注射了强效的药。

words.definition: a solid thing that you can hold, touch, or see but that is not alive; to feel or say that you oppose or disapprove of something; target, goal, end, cause, aim; refuse, sit down on
words.translation: 物体;客体,对象;目标;宾语；(to)反对；目标；物体；客体；[语]宾语；反对；拒绝

examples.zh: 一个小金属物件

examples.zh: 研究植物、动物或无生命物体的科学家

words.definition: a reason that you have for opposing or disapproving of something, or something you say that expresses this; opposition, exception, intervention, prevention, deficiency

examples.en: Her objection was that he was too young.
examples.zh: 她反对的理由是他太小。

words.definition: something that you are trying hard to achieve, especially in business or politics; based on facts, or making a decision that is based on facts rather than on your feelings or beliefs; impersonal, accusatival; intention, purpose, sake, target, goal

examples.zh: 该计划旨在对儿童情绪作出分析。

examples.zh: 一项为期三年的研究计划

examples.en: The scheme will now be extended after a successful pilot project (= a small trial to test if an idea will be successful ) .
examples.zh: 试行成功后，该方案现在将得到推广。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that makes a film or picture appear on a screen or flat surface; projection apparatus, diascope

examples.zh: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

examples.zh: 德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。

examples.zh: 他的建议被彻底否决了。

examples.zh: 保罗在大多数问题上观点激烈。

examples.zh: 本章涵盖的主题是运动和营养。

examples.zh: 她搜集了25年食谱，把它们编成一本烹饪书。

examples.zh: 这家公司搜集有关消费者趋向的信息。

examples.zh: 我们出去为我们的请愿征集签名。

examples.zh: 他要确保他在参与集体企业的所有决策。

words.definition: an intelligent, well-educated person who spends time thinking about complicated ideas and discussing them; relating to the ability to understand things and think intelligently; wise, bright, clever, smart, understanding; clerisy

examples.zh: 整个房子，目之所及不停带来惊奇和欣喜。

examples.zh: 一支蜡烛照亮了他的脸。

examples.zh: 晚上运河灯火辉煌，美景毕现。

examples.zh: 她用图表来说明她的论述。

examples.zh: 他在澳大利亚过着豪华舒适的生活。

examples.zh: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

examples.zh: 来自几个不同地区的天气报告

words.translation: (about,on)评语,意见；(on)评论;注意到；注意；言辞；评论；觉察；谈论

examples.en: Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
examples.zh: 不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

words.definition: unusual or surprising and therefore deserving attention or praise; excellent, prominent, extraordinary, significant, wonder
words.translation: 值得注意的;显著的,异常的,非凡的；卓越的；非凡的；值得注意的

examples.en: She has made remarkable progress.
examples.zh: 她取得了显著的进步。

examples.en: a remarkable coincidence
examples.zh: 不寻常的巧合

examples.en: He’s a remarkable man .
examples.zh: 他是个了不起的人。

words.definition: the rules by which words change their forms and are combined into sentences, or the study or use of these rules; syntax, phraseology
words.translation: 语法,语法书；语法；语法书

examples.zh: 检查你的拼写和语法。

examples.en: All the victims still suffered nightmares.
examples.zh: 所有的受害者仍为恶梦所扰。

words.definition: a ship, especially a military one, that can stay under water; growing or used under the sea; sub, pigboat; benthonic, undersea
words.translation: 潜水艇；水底的,海底的；海底生物；[海洋]海底的；水下的

examples.en: a nuclear submarine
examples.zh: 核潜艇

words.definition: a very large shop that sells food, drinks, and things that people need regularly in their homes
words.translation: 超级市场

examples.en: Most of us do our food shopping in the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我们大多数人在这家超市采购食品。

words.definition: a special name, sign, or word that is marked on a product to show that it is made by a particular company, that cannot be used by any other company; brand, logo, label
words.translation: 商标；特征；注册的…商标；[贸易]商标

examples.en: The striped T-shirt became the comedian’s trademark.
examples.zh: 条纹T恤衫成了这位喜剧演员的标记。

words.definition: to make a short statement giving only the main information and not the details of a plan, event, report etc; sum up, outline
words.translation: (summarise)概括,总结；总结；概述

examples.en: The authors summarize their views in the introduction.
examples.zh: 作者在序言里概述了他们的观点。

words.definition: a short statement that gives the main information about something, without giving all the details; a summary report, statement etc gives the main facts in a report etc without any of the details or explanations; condensed, terse; abstract, brief, resume
words.translation: 摘要,概要；概括的,简略的；简易的；扼要的；概要，[图情]摘要

examples.en: A brief summary is given on a separate sheet.
examples.zh: 摘要另写一页。

words.definition: to respect and like someone because they have done something that you think is good; praise, celebrate, bless; speak well of, think the world of
words.translation: 钦佩,赞赏,羡慕；称赞,夸奖；钦佩；赞美；称赞

examples.en: I really admire the way she brings up those kids all on her own.
examples.zh: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

words.definition: something very lucky or very good that happens which you did not expect to happen or did not think was possible; phenomenon, wonder
words.translation: 奇迹,令人惊奇的人(或事)；奇迹，奇迹般的人或物；惊人的事例

examples.en: It’s a miracle you weren’t killed!
examples.zh: 你没有死真是奇迹！

examples.zh: 我们奇迹般地赶上了飞机。

examples.en: the economic miracle of the 1950s
examples.zh: 20世纪50年代的经济奇迹

words.definition: a piece of special glass that you can look at and see yourself in; if one thing mirrors another, it is very similar to it and may seem to copy or represent it; example, lead; glass, image, echo
words.translation: 镜子;反映,反射；反映,反射；[轻]镜子；真实的写照；榜样；[光]反射；反映

examples.en: He spends hours in front of the mirror !
examples.zh: 他老是照镜子！

examples.en: When I looked in the mirror I couldn’t believe it. I looked fantastic!
examples.zh: 我看着镜子简直不敢相信，我看上去棒极了！

words.definition: the buying and selling of goods and services; trade, traffic
words.translation: 商业，贸易；交际，交往；贸易，[贸易]商业

examples.zh: 促进地方工商业发展的措施

words.definition: related to business and the buying and selling of goods and services; an advertisement on television or radio; merchant
words.translation: 商业的；商务的；可获利的；广告节目；[贸易]商业的；营利的；靠广告收入的

examples.en: Our top priorities must be profit and commercial growth.
examples.zh: 我们必须把利润和贸易增长作为我们的第一要务。

words.definition: to appear or come out from somewhere; ray, cast off
words.translation: 显现,浮现;暴露;形成;；浮现；摆脱；暴露

examples.en: The flowers emerge in the spring.
examples.zh: 花儿在春天开放。

words.definition: an unexpected and dangerous situation that must be dealt with immediately; critical situation, bombshell; urgent, instant
words.translation: 紧急情况,突然事件,非常时刻；紧急情况；突发事件；非常时刻；紧急的；备用的

examples.en: Lifeguards are trained to deal with emergencies.
examples.zh: 救生员接受过应对紧急情况的训练。

examples.en: (= In case of emergency ), press the alarm button.
examples.zh: 遇到紧急情况，请按报警按钮。

examples.en: The plane had to make an emergency landing.
examples.zh: 那架飞机不得不紧急着陆。

words.definition: to put someone or something deep into a liquid so that they are completely covered; let sb in for, entrap
words.translation: 使沉浸在;使浸没；沉浸；使陷入

examples.zh: 电极被浸没在液体中。

words.definition: goods that are being sold; goods, cargo; promote, sell, handle, trade in; do business
words.translation: 商品,货物；商品；[贸易]货物；买卖；推销；经商

examples.en: A range of official Disney merchandise was on sale.
examples.zh: 一系列正版的迪士尼商品在出售。

examples.en: They inspected the merchandise carefully.
examples.zh: 他们仔细地检查了商品。

words.definition: someone who buys and sells goods in large quantities; trader, dealer; commercial, shoppy
words.translation: 商人,零售商；[贸易]商人，批发商；店主；商业的，[贸易]商人的

examples.en: the son of a wealthy merchant
examples.zh: 一名富商的儿子

words.definition: if someone shows mercy, they choose to forgive or to be kind to someone who they have the power to hurt or punish; humanity, tolerance, kindness, charity, good
words.translation: 仁慈,怜悯,宽恕；仁慈，宽容；怜悯；幸运；善行

examples.zh: 他对敌人毫不仁慈。

examples.zh: 愿上帝宽恕他的灵魂。

words.translation: 纯粹的;仅仅,只不过；小湖；池塘

examples.zh: 她仅仅以20票之差落选。

examples.en: He’s a mere child.
examples.zh: 他只是个孩子。

examples.en: It can’t be a mere coincidence that they left at the same time.
examples.zh: 他们同时离开不可能仅仅是巧合。

words.definition: used to emphasize how small or unimportant something or someone is; simply, just, only, but, barely
words.translation: 仅仅，只不过；只是

examples.en: He’s merely a boy – you can’t expect him to understand.
examples.zh: 他只是个孩子——你不要指望他能理解。

words.definition: to combine, or to join things together to form one thing; conflate, incorporate with; incorporate with, coalesce
words.translation: (使)结合，(使)合并，(使)合为一体；合并；使合并；吞没；融合

examples.en: The company plans to merge its subsidiaries in the US.
examples.zh: 该公司计划合并其在美国的几家子公司。

words.definition: an advantage or good feature of something; to be good, important, or serious enough for praise or attention; asset, importance, virtue, price, value; to be worth, be deserving of
words.translation: 优点,价值,功绩；值得,应得；优点，价值；功绩；功过；值得

examples.zh: 这份报告的优点就是它对所要求的变动进行了实事求是的评估。

examples.zh: 该项目最大的优点是它的灵活性和低成本。

examples.en: Each of these approaches to teaching has its merits .
examples.zh: 这些教学方法每一种都有其优点。

words.definition: used to say that you hope someone will have a happy time at Christmas; good, bright, fragrant, cheerful; sweet cherry
words.translation: 欢乐的,愉快的；愉快的；微醉的；嬉戏作乐的；甜樱桃

examples.en: He marched off, whistling a merry tune.
examples.zh: 他吹着一首欢快的曲子大步走了。

words.definition: to cover something completely with water or another liquid; flood, flow; drown out, swallow up

examples.zh: 隧道入口被涨起的海水淹没。

examples.zh: 每年夏天我们都驾车出外旅行。

examples.zh: 食物在夏天必须加以冷藏。

examples.zh: 经过一个夏天， 连最差的牛羊在这里也长得又肥又壮了。

examples.zh: 我发给他一个通知，提醒他开会的事。

examples.zh: 庆祝该镇建立200周年的游行

words.translation: 成员,会员；成员；会员；议员

examples.zh: 大多数工会成员投票赞成罢工。

words.translation: 会员资格,成员资格；资格；成员资格；会员身分

examples.zh: 你应该随身携带会员卡。

examples.zh: 会费今年提高了。

examples.zh: 一场为她举行的纪念仪式正在圣保罗教堂举行。

examples.zh: 他对在日本逗留的那段时光有许多美好的回忆。

examples.zh: 你记得罗莎·戴维斯吗？

examples.zh: 我记不得她的原话了。

examples.en: I remember it well ; I’d never seen my mother so angry.
examples.zh: 这件事我记得很清楚；我从未见过母亲这么生气。

examples.zh: 她正在这儿跑1500米。

words.translation: 算术，四则运算；[数]算术，算法

examples.zh: …教授读、写、算的基本知识。

words.translation: 坟墓，墓地，坟场；墓地；公墓

words.translation: (centimeter)厘米

examples.zh: …一块小小的植物化石，只有几厘米高。

words.translation: 直径

examples.en: ...a tube less than a fifth of the diameter of a human hair.
examples.zh: …一根直径不到头发五分之一的微管。

words.translation: 几何(学)

examples.zh: …数学和几何学描述自然的条理性。

examples.zh: 剑劈开了骑士的头盔并致命地刺进他。

examples.zh: 没有基督，我们无力防御魔鬼的攻击；但有救恩的头盔，我们的心思便有神的保护。

words.definition: a unit for measuring distance, equal to 1,000 metres; klick, klik
words.translation: (kilometer) 公里，千米(略作km)；[计量]公里；千米

examples.zh: …距离边境只有1公里。

words.definition: a hard, usually shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel; alloy
words.translation: 金属,金属制品；[材]金属；合金

examples.zh: 这扇大门是用金属做成的。

examples.zh: 一个黑色的金属小盒子

examples.zh: 他们做黄金和其他贵金属的交易。

words.translation: 隐喻，暗喻；暗喻，隐喻；比喻说法

examples.zh: 她在作品中用了一些绝妙的比喻和暗喻。

examples.zh: 隐喻的独到运用

words.translation: 方法,办法；方法；条理；类函数

examples.zh: 传统的教学法

examples.zh: 我想我们应该用不同的方法再试一次。

examples.en: effective methods for the storage and retrieval of information
examples.zh: 信息存储和检索的有效方法

words.definition: using or connected with the  metric system  of weights and measures
words.translation: 米制的,公制的

examples.en: a metric tonne
examples.zh: 一公吨

examples.zh: 现在配件都采用公制规格。

words.definition: relating or belonging to a very large city; suzerain; archbishop

examples.zh: 南澳大利亚的一个都市区

words.translation: (millimetre)毫米；[计量]毫米

examples.zh: 一微米是一毫米的千分之一。

examples.zh: 平均来说，这些苔藓以每年大约1毫米的极慢速度生长，而某些草皮有数米厚。

words.definition: Parameters are factors or limits that affect the way something can be done or made; coefficient, arguments, modulus
words.translation: 参数,参量；参数；系数；[数]参量

examples.en: ...some of the parameters that determine the taste of a wine.
examples.zh: …一些决定葡萄酒味道的参数。

words.definition: the quality of being symmetrical; balance, regularity
words.translation: 对称(性);匀称,整齐；对称（性）；整齐，匀称

examples.en: ...the incredible beauty and symmetry of a snowflake.
examples.zh: …雪花令人难以置信的美丽和对称。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that measures the temperature of the air, of your body etc; temperature gauge, temperature meter
words.translation: 温度计；[仪]温度计；[医]体温计

examples.zh: 温度计显示高于100摄氏度。

examples.zh: 在售的小房子很多，大房子也有不少，但是不大不小的很少。

words.translation: 在…中间，在…之中，被…围绕；在其中，在其间

examples.zh: 他坐在树丛中。

words.translation: 湿的,湿气重的；[气象][物]潮湿的；湿润的；多湿气的

examples.zh: 仲夏的东京十分潮湿。

words.translation: 湿气,湿度；[气象]湿度；湿气

examples.zh: 房间的温度保持在72度，相对湿度50%。

words.translation: 中间,当中；当中，中间；在…中间（等于amidst）

examples.zh: 我担心我们中间有内奸。

words.translation: 金字塔；渐增；上涨；[建]成金字塔状

examples.zh: 金字塔式管理体系中的不同层次

words.translation: 喜剧;喜剧性事件

examples.zh: 单口喜剧表演职业

examples.zh: 我们对攻击的第一反应就是非常惊恐。

examples.zh: 他们承诺立即采取行动帮助失业者。

examples.zh: 大多数学生选择一个特定领域进行研究。

examples.en: a particular type of food
examples.zh: 某一类食品

words.definition: to some degree, but not completely; half
words.translation: 部分地,不完全地,在一定程度上；部分地；在一定程度上

examples.en: The poor weather was partly responsible for the crash.
examples.zh: 天气不好是造成坠机事故的部分原因。

examples.en: The company’s problems are partly due to bad management.
examples.zh: 那家公司的问题部分是由于管理不善造成的。

examples.en: It is partly because of her sick mother that she hasn’t taken the job abroad.
examples.zh: 她没有接受那份去国外的工作，部分原因是母亲病了。

words.definition: one of two people who are married, or who live together and have a sexual relationship; comrade, associate; joint stock, tie up; team
words.translation: 合作者,合伙人,合股人,伙伴,舞伴,配偶；伙伴；[法]合伙人；配偶；[法]合伙；合股；成为搭档；使合作；与…合伙

examples.en: Discuss your worries with your partner.
examples.zh: 和伴侣谈谈你的忧虑。

examples.zh: 只有29%的单身家长得到他们前配偶的经济资助。

examples.en: a sexual partner
examples.zh: 性伴侣

words.definition: a social event when a lot of people meet together to enjoy themselves by eating, drinking, dancing etc; principal, get-together
words.translation: 聚会,政党,当事人；举行(参加)社交聚会；政党，党派；聚会，派对；[法]当事人

examples.en: We’re having a small party this evening to celebrate our wedding anniversary.
examples.zh: 我们今晚有个小聚会，庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。

examples.en: the party spirit
examples.zh: 参加社交聚会的乐趣

words.definition: a piece of equipment fastened to the back of people who jump out of planes, which makes them fall slowly and safely to the ground; to jump from a plane using a parachute; chute; to bail out
words.translation: 降落伞；跳伞；[航]降落伞

examples.en: a parachute jump
examples.zh: 跳伞

words.definition: a public celebration when musical bands, brightly decorated vehicles etc move down the street; display, pageant; show off, brag about; file, show off
words.translation: 游行,夸耀n.检阅,阅兵式v.使列队行进；游行；阅兵；炫耀；行进；阅兵场；列队行进

examples.en: a victory parade
examples.zh: 胜利游行

examples.en: the St Patrick’s Day parade
examples.zh: 圣帕特里克节庆祝游行

words.definition: a very clear or typical example of something; exemplification
words.translation: 典范; 范例; 示例；范例；词形变化表

examples.en: ...a new paradigm of production.
examples.zh: …一种新的生产范例。

words.definition: a situation that seems strange because it involves two ideas or qualities that are very different
words.translation: 似非而是的话,自相矛盾的话,反论

examples.en: It’s a paradox that in such a rich country there can be so much poverty.
examples.zh: 在如此富有的国家却有这么多的贫穷现象，真是矛盾。

words.definition: two lines, paths etc that are parallel to each other are the same distance apart along their whole length; contrast; same, uniform
words.translation: 平行的,相同的,类似的n.平行线,类似,对比；[天][数]平行线；对比；[天][数]平行的；类似的，相同的

examples.en: Lines AB and CD are parallel. AB
examples.zh: 线与CD线平行。

examples.en: two parallel roads
examples.zh: 两条平行的道路

examples.en: Take the road running parallel to the main road just after the village.
examples.zh: 过那个村子后走与主干道平行的路。

words.definition: anesthetize
words.translation: (paralyse)使瘫痪(麻痹);使丧失作用；使麻痹；使瘫痪

words.definition: a plant or animal that lives on or in another plant or animal and gets food from it; helminth, vermin
words.translation: 寄生虫,食客；[生物][基医]寄生虫；食客

examples.en: Kangaroos harbour a vast range of parasites.
examples.zh: 袋鼠身上有各种各样的寄生虫。

words.definition: the set of tools and machines that you use for a particular scientific, medical, or technical purpose; device, equipment, installation, furniture, facility, unit, organ
words.translation: 器械，器具，仪器；机构，组织；装置，[机]设备；[仪]仪器；器官

examples.en: Astronauts have special breathing apparatus.
examples.zh: 航天员有专门的呼吸装装备。

words.definition: easy to notice; transparent, decided, patent
words.translation: 表面上的,貌似真实的；显然的,明明白白的；显然的；表面上的

examples.en: The difference in quality was immediately apparent .
examples.zh: 质量的差异显而易见。

examples.en: He left suddenly, for no apparent reason .
examples.zh: 不知什么原因，他突然离开了。

words.definition: similar to something else in size, number, quality etc, so that you can make a comparison
words.translation: (with,to)可比较的,比得上的

examples.en: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.
examples.zh: 同样大小的汽车在国外要贵得多。

words.definition: the comparative form of an adjective or adverb shows an increase in size, quality, degree etc when it is considered in relation to something else. For example, ‘bigger’ is the comparative form of ‘big’, and ‘more slowly’ is the comparative form of ‘slowly’.; corresponding, condign; equal, opponent, match, rival
words.translation: 比较的,相当的；比较的；相当的；比较级；对手

examples.en: After a lifetime of poverty, his last few years were spent in comparable comfort.
examples.zh: 他穷了一辈子，最后几年还算过得比较舒适。

words.definition: to consider two or more things or people, in order to show how they are similar or different; contradistinguish, be confronted with; match; parabole
words.translation: (to，with)比较；(to)把…比作vi.相比；比较；对照；比喻为；相比

examples.en: The report compares the different types of home computer available.
examples.zh: 这份报告比较了市场上不同类型的家用计算机。

words.definition: the process of comparing two or more people or things; parabole, imagery
words.translation: 比较,对比,比喻,比拟；比较；对照；比喻；比较关系

examples.en: Her paintings invite comparison with those of the early Impressionists (= they remind you of them ) .
examples.zh: 她的画作让人想起早期的印象派作品。

words.definition: an object that has been wrapped in paper or put in a special envelope, especially so that it can be sent by post; package, bindle; package, enlace
words.translation: 包裹,邮包,部分；打包,捆扎,分配；[邮]包裹，小包；打包；捆扎

examples.en: The parcel was delivered last week.
examples.zh: 那个邮包上周送到了。

examples.en: He sends regular food parcels to his family in Libya.
examples.zh: 他定期给在利比亚的家人邮寄食品包裹。

words.definition: used when you want someone to repeat something because you did not hear it; to officially allow someone who has been found guilty of a crime to go free without being punished; forgiveness, absolution; forgive, tolerate
words.translation: 原谅,宽恕;请再说一遍；原谅,饶恕,赦免；原谅；[法]赦免；宽恕

examples.en: ‘Hurry up Jonathan!’ ‘Pardon?’ ‘I said hurry up!’
examples.zh: “快点，乔纳森！”“你说什么啊？”“我说快点！”

words.definition: the father or mother of a person or animal; father, principle, root
words.translation: 父母,母亲;(pl.)双亲;父母；父亲（或母亲）；父母亲；根源

examples.en: Children under 14 should be accompanied by a parent.
examples.zh: 14 岁以下儿童须由一位家长陪同。

examples.en: The eggs are guarded by both parents.
examples.zh: 那些蛋由两只亲鸟共同守护着。

examples.en: Melissa’s spending the weekend at her parents’ house.
examples.zh: 梅利莎正在父母家度周末。

words.definition: the group of people who are elected to make a country’s laws and discuss important national affairs; congress, house
words.translation: 国会,议会；议会，国会

examples.en: They demanded a free parliament and press.
examples.zh: 他们要求议会自由和新闻自由。

words.definition: the process of preparing something or preparing for something; arrangement, preliminary, provision
words.translation: 准备,预备;制剂,制备品；预备；准备

examples.en: This dish is good for dinner parties because much of the preparation can be done ahead of time.
examples.zh: 这道菜适合宴会，因为很多准备工作可以事先做好。

examples.en: Plans for the new school are now in preparation .
examples.zh: 新学校的设计图正在绘制中。

examples.en: a course in food service and food preparation
examples.zh: 餐饮服务和备菜课程

words.definition: to make plans or arrangements for something that will happen in the future; provide, make, fix
words.translation: 准备,预备；准备；使适合；装备；起草

examples.en: The prosecution wanted more time to prepare their case.
examples.zh: 原告想要有更多的时间来准备诉讼。

words.definition: not joined to or touching something else; split, divorce; come between, to break; alone, independent, divided, isolated, sole; partition, fall-away
words.translation: (from)分离的,分开的；使分离；使分开；使分居；分开；隔开；分居；单独的；分开的；抽印本

examples.en: The gym and the sauna are in separate buildings.
examples.zh: 健身房和桑拿浴室在不同的大楼里。

words.definition: if something is transparent, you can see through it; apparent, honest, decided, crystal, open
words.translation: 透明的，透光的；易理解的；明显的；透明的；显然的；坦率的；易懂的

examples.en: a transparent plastic container
examples.zh: 透明的塑料容器

words.definition: a British unit of money or coin used until 1971. There were 12 pennies in one  shilling; cent, minute
words.translation: 便士,美分；（美）分；便士

examples.en: Unleaded petrol rose more than a penny a gallon.
examples.zh: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了一个多便士。

words.definition: an amount of money paid regularly by the government or company to someone who does not work any more, for example because they have reached the age when people stop working or because they are ill; retirement pay, subsidy
words.translation: 养老金,年金；退休金，[劳经]抚恤金；津贴；膳宿费

examples.en: At what age can you start drawing your pension ?
examples.zh: 从多少岁可以开始领取养老金？

examples.en: If you are self-employed, you should think about taking out a private pension .
examples.zh: 如果你是自由职业者，应该考虑办理私人养老金事宜。

examples.en: Many people find it hard to live on a basic state pension .
examples.zh: 许多人发现仅凭国家基本养老金不能养活自己。

words.definition: to replace or balance the effect of something bad; make good, to make up for
words.translation: (for)补偿,赔偿；补偿，赔偿；抵消；付报酬

examples.en: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
examples.zh: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

words.definition: money paid to someone because they have suffered injury or loss, or because something they own has been damaged; payment, consideration, insurance, reward, offset
words.translation: 补偿(或赔偿)的款物；补偿，赔偿；[会计]补偿；报酬；[保险]赔偿金

examples.en: People who are wrongly arrested may be paid compensation .
examples.zh: 被误抓的人有可能得到补偿费。

words.definition: the amount of money that you spend on something; consumption, losing, price, cost, disadvantage
words.translation: 花费,消费,消耗；损失，代价；消费；开支

examples.en: He borrowed £150,000 and used the money for legal expenses.
examples.zh: 他借了15万英镑用于支付律师费。

examples.en: Conference rooms were equipped at great expense.
examples.zh: 装备会议室花费巨大。

words.definition: costing a lot of money; rich, dear, costly
words.translation: 花费的,昂贵的；昂贵的；花钱的

examples.en: the most expensive restaurant in town
examples.zh: 城里最贵的餐馆

examples.zh: 汽油越来越贵了。

examples.en: Photography is an expensive hobby.
examples.zh: 摄影是一项很花钱的业余爱好。

words.definition: someone or something that is indispensable is so important or useful that it is impossible to manage without them; obbligato
words.translation: (to,for)必不可少的,必需的；不可缺少的；绝对必要的；责无旁贷的

examples.en: Mobile phones have become an indispensable part of our lives.
examples.zh: 移动电话已经成为我们生活中的必需品。

words.definition: an animal such as a cat or a dog which you keep and care for at home; Someone's pet theory, project, or subject is one that they particularly support or like; vitality, animation; dote on, cosset; take offense, take offence; favorite, fond

examples.en: They have two pets – a cat and a dog.
examples.zh: 他们有两只宠物，一只猫和一只狗。

examples.en: We weren’t allowed to keep pets at school.
examples.zh: 学校里不许我们养宠物。

examples.en: Rabbits make good pets .
examples.zh: 兔子是很好的宠物。

words.definition: a desire for food; weakness, habit, hobby
words.translation: 食欲，胃口；欲望，性欲；爱好，趣味；[生理]食欲；嗜好

examples.en: Her husband always had a huge appetite.
examples.zh: 她丈夫向来胃口极大。

examples.en: Symptoms include tiredness and loss of appetite.
examples.zh: 症状包括疲倦和食欲不振。

words.definition: if one company or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its goods or servicesrather than those available from another company or country; contest, war, cope
words.translation: 比赛；竞争；对抗

examples.zh: 他将参加100米比赛。

words.definition: having enough skill or knowledge to do something to a satisfactory standard; able, capable, efficient, sufficient, adequate
words.translation: 有能力的，能胜任的；足够的；胜任的；有能力的；能干的

examples.en: A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 一名合格的机修工应该能够解决这个问题。

words.definition: a situation in which people or organizations try to be more successful than other people or organizations; game, war, match, tournament, struggle
words.translation: 竞争，比赛；角逐，较量；竞争者；[生态]竞争；比赛，竞赛

examples.en: Going to trade fairs is an ideal opportunity to size up the competition .
examples.zh: 参加商品交易会是估量竞争规模的理想机会。

words.definition: determined or trying very hard to be more successful than other people or businesses; played, rival
words.translation: 竞争的；好竞争的；有竞争力的；比赛的；求胜心切的

examples.zh: 美国有些行业不如以前有竞争力了。

examples.en: The team seems to have lost its competitive edge recently (= its ability to compete well ) .
examples.zh: 这支球队近来好像丧失了竞争优势。

words.definition: an influence that makes something happen or makes it happen more quickly; momentum, promotion, acceleration
words.translation: 推动(力),促进；动力；促进；冲力

examples.zh: 这个发现为研究带来新动力。

words.definition: permanent; permanent, ceaseless, loud
words.translation: 永久的,永恒的,长期的；永久的；不断的；四季开花的；无期限的

examples.en: the perpetual snows of the mountaintops
examples.zh: 山顶的终年积雪

words.definition: a written request signed by a lot of people, asking someone in authority to do something or change something; to ask the government or an organization to do something by sending them a petition; imprecation; demand, apply for; apply for, pray for
words.translation: 请愿书,申请书；(向…)请愿,正式请求；请愿；[法][专利]请愿书；祈求；诉状；[专利]请求；恳求

examples.en: Local residents have drawn up a petition to protest the hospital closure.
examples.zh: 当地居民已草拟了一份请愿书，抗议关闭医院。

examples.en: {"GEO":["AmE"],"GLOSS":["an attempt to get a lot of people to sign a petition"],"COLLOINEXA":["petition drive"]}
examples.zh: 发动民众签名的〕请愿运动

words.definition: a petty problem, detail etc is small and unimportant; cheap, trivial
words.translation: 小(器、规模)的,不重要的,细微的,卑鄙的；琐碎的；小气的；小规模的

examples.en: petty squabbles
examples.zh: 小口角

examples.en: petty restrictions
examples.zh: 小限制

words.definition: a model of a person or animal that you move by pulling wires or strings, or by putting your hand inside it; cipher in algorism, fantoccini
words.translation: 木偶,傀儡；木偶；傀儡；受他人操纵的人

examples.zh: 他趁入侵之时夺取了政权，作为占领者的傀儡统治着这个国家。

words.definition: doing or saying the same thing many times; reiteration, iterance
words.translation: 重复,反复；重复；背诵；副本

examples.en: Children used to learn by repetition.
examples.zh: 过去小孩子是通过背诵来学习的。

words.definition: a musical instrument that you blow into, which consists of a curved metal tube that is wide at the end, and three buttons you press to change the notes; horn, loudspeaker; crow about, brag about; blow job
words.translation: 喇叭,小号；喇叭；喇叭声；吹喇叭；吹嘘；发出喇叭般的声音

examples.en: I played the trumpet in the school orchestra.
examples.zh: 我在学校管弦乐队吹小号。

words.definition: the process of finding out what people think about something by asking many people the same question, or the record of the result; to get a particular number of votes in an election; vote, referendums; crop, cast one's vote; cast one's vote, ballot; hummel, hornless
words.translation: 民意测验;(pl.)政治选举；获得…选票；投票；民意测验；投票数；投票所；剪短；对…进行民意测验；获得选票；无角的；剪过毛的；修过枝的

examples.zh: 最近的一项民意调查发现80%的加利福尼亚人支持州长。

examples.en: Polls indicate that education is the top issue with voters.
examples.zh: 民意调查显示，教育是选民心中的头等大事。

examples.en: Labour is ahead in the polls.
examples.zh: 工党在民意调查中处于领先地位。

words.definition: the people who work for an official organization whose job is to catch criminals and make sure that people obey the law; to keep control over a particular area in order to make sure that laws are obeyed and that people and property are protected, using a police or military force; pig, copper, bobby, finest; oversee, to monitor; constabulary
words.translation: 警察,警察机关；警察的；管辖；警察，警方；治安；监督；维持治安；为…配备警察；有关警察的

examples.en: Police surrounded the courthouse.
examples.zh: 警察围在法院大楼四周。

words.definition: a way of doing something that has been officially agreed and chosen by a political party, a business, or another organization; deal, programm
words.translation: 政策,方针；政策，方针；[保险]保险单

examples.en: ...plans that include changes in foreign policy and economic reforms.
examples.zh: …包括外交政策调整和经济改革的计划。

words.definition: behaving or speaking in a way that is correct for the social situation you are in, and showing that you are careful to consider other people’s needs and feelings; civil, elegant, gentle, mild, courteous
words.translation: 有礼貌的,客气的;有教养的,文雅的；有礼貌的，客气的；文雅的；上流的；优雅的

examples.en: She’s always very polite.
examples.zh: 她总是很有礼貌。

examples.en: polite, well-behaved children
examples.zh: 懂礼貌、守规矩的孩子

examples.en: a clear but polite request
examples.zh: 明确但客气的请求

words.definition: Political means relating to the way power is achieved and used in a country or society; governmental, clannish
words.translation: 政治的；党派的

examples.en: All other political parties there have been completely banned.
examples.zh: 那里的其他所有政党都已经完全被取缔了。

examples.en: The government is facing another political crisis.
examples.zh: 该政府正面临着另一场政治危机。

words.definition: someone who works in politics, especially an elected member of the government; statesman
words.translation: 政治家,政客；政治家，政客

examples.en: politicians who are trying to get the minority vote
examples.zh: 努力争取少数族群选票的政治家

examples.en: a British Labour politician
examples.zh: 英国工党政治家

words.definition: ideas and activities relating to gaining and using power in a country, city etc; department of political science
words.translation: 政治,政治学;政纲,政见；政治，政治学；政治活动；政纲

examples.en: a good understanding of politics in China
examples.zh: 对中国政治很好的了解

examples.en: modern American politics
examples.zh: 现代美国政治

examples.en: Politics have always interested Anita.
examples.zh: 阿妮塔一直对政治感兴趣。

words.definition: square oneself, apologize for, make an apology
words.translation: (to,for)道歉，认错；道歉（等于apologize）

examples.zh: 奈杰尔收到信后，愿意向俱乐部道歉，并修正他的评论，但俱乐部拒绝了这个服软的表示。

examples.en: But it has been on my mind for so long, and I apologise if it is irrelevant to some readers.
examples.zh: 但是它占据我的内心很久了。 如果它与一些读者没有关系，我向你们道歉。

words.definition: something that you say or write to show that you are sorry for doing something wrong; justification, advocacy
words.translation: 道歉，认错，辩解，辩护；道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物

examples.en: Edward can’t be here today, but he sends his apologies .
examples.zh: 爱德华今天来不了，他向大家表示歉意。

words.definition: a very large city that is the most important city in a country or area; bigalopolis

examples.zh: 在此类情况下需要的是对形势的冷静估计。

words.definition: words that you say when praying to God or gods; suit, blessing
words.translation: 祈祷,祷告,祷文；祈祷，祷告；恳求；祈祷文

examples.en: Our thoughts and prayers are with you at this difficult time.
examples.zh: 在这艰难时期我们时刻思念你，为你祈祷。

examples.en: The children said their prayers and got into bed.
examples.zh: 孩子们做完祷告后上床睡觉了。

examples.en: God has answered your prayer .
examples.zh: 上帝应许了你的祷告。

words.definition: the amount of money you have to pay for something; to decide the price of something that is for sale; importance, value, expense, rate, figure
words.translation: 价格,价钱;代价；标价；[物价]价格；价值；[贸易]代价

examples.en: They may pay a high price for their few years of glory.
examples.zh: 为了短短几年的辉煌，他们也许要付出高昂的代价。

words.definition: correct or suitable for a particular time, situation, or purpose; suitable, proper, adequate, becoming; engage, take up to
words.translation: 适当的恰当的特有的vt.拨给,挪用,盗用；适当的；占用；拨出

examples.en: The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
examples.zh: 通告发布的时机很合适。

examples.en: Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
examples.zh: 只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。

examples.en: Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
examples.zh: 把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。

words.definition: to consist of particular parts, groups etc; involve, contain
words.translation: 包含，包括，由...组成；构成，组成；包含；由…组成

examples.en: The house comprises two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a living room.
examples.zh: 这座房子有两间卧室、一间厨房和一间起居室。

words.definition: a large and complicated project, especially one that is done with a group of other people; career, cause, undertaking, project, push
words.translation: 事业,企(事)业单位;事业心,进取心；[经]企业；事业；进取心；事业心

examples.en: The programme is a joint enterprise with the London Business School.
examples.zh: 这一计划是与伦敦商学院的合作项目。

words.definition: a feeling that you are proud of something that you or someone connected with you has achieved; to be especially proud of something that you do well, or of a good quality that you have; selfrespect, pretension; exalt; glory, be proud of
words.translation: 自豪;自满；引以自豪的东西；使自豪；自豪；骄傲；自尊心；使得意，以…自豪

examples.en: He wore his medals with pride.
examples.zh: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

examples.en: The people have a sense of pride in their community.
examples.zh: 人们对自己的社区有一种自豪感。

examples.en: His heart swelled with pride when his daughter came in.
examples.zh: 女儿进来时他的内心充满了自豪感。

words.definition: someone who is specially trained to perform religious duties and ceremonies in the Christian church; minister, father, preacher
words.translation: 教士,神父；牧师；神父；教士

examples.en: He had trained to be a Catholic priest.
examples.zh: 他接受培训成了一名天主教神父。

words.definition: most important; elementary, major, central, main, leading; original color, fundamental colour
words.translation: 最初的,初级的;首要的,主要的,基本的；主要的；[数]初级的；基本的；原色；最主要者

examples.en: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
examples.zh: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

examples.en: Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
examples.zh: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

examples.en: Personal safety is of primary importance .
examples.zh: 人身安全至关重要。

words.definition: most important; If someone or something is in their prime, they are at the stage in their existence when they are at their strongest, most active, or most successful; greatest, major, elementary, central, main; excellently, famously; youth, morning, essence, elite, flower; ready; provide
words.translation: 首要的;最好的,第一流的；青春,全盛期；主要的；最好的；基本的；极好地；初期；青年；精华；全盛时期；使准备好；填装；作准备

examples.en: Smoking is the prime cause of lung disease.
examples.zh: 抽烟是引发肺部疾病的首要原因。

examples.en: Our prime concern is providing jobs for all young school leavers.
examples.zh: 我们的头等大事是为所有的年轻毕业生提供工作。

examples.en: He was named as the prime suspect in the murder investigation.
examples.zh: 在那宗谋杀案的调查中他被定为主要嫌疑人。

words.definition: belonging to a simple way of life that existed in the past and does not have modern industries and machines; original, simple, crude, plain, rough; Euroman
words.translation: 原始的,远古的,早期的;粗糙的,简单的；[数][生物][地质]原始的，远古的；简单的，粗糙的；[数][生物][地质]原始人

examples.en: a primitive society
examples.zh: 原始社会

examples.en: a primitive nomadic tribe
examples.zh: 原始的游牧部落

examples.en: the tools used by primitive man
examples.zh: 原始人所用的工具

words.definition: the son of a king, queen, or prince; noble, infante
words.translation: 王子,亲王；王子，国君；亲王；贵族

examples.en: Prince William
examples.zh: 威廉王子

words.definition: a close female relation of a king and queen, especially a daughter; infanta, rani
words.translation: 公主,王妃；公主；王妃；女巨头

examples.en: Princess Anne
examples.zh: 安妮公主

words.definition: a person’s right to something which is considered more important than another person’s right to the same thing; preferred, underlying; before, antecedently
words.translation: 优先的,在前的;(to)在…之前；[数]优先的；在先的，在前的；在前，居先

examples.en: His own children have a prior claim to the business.
examples.zh: 他自己的孩子可以优先获得这家企业。

words.definition: the thing that you think is most important and that needs attention before anything else; precedence, preference to sth
words.translation: 先,前;优先,重点,优先权；[通信][计]优先；优先权；[数]优先次序；优先考虑的事

examples.en: The club’s priority is to win the League.
examples.zh: 该俱乐部首先考虑的是要赢得联赛。

examples.en: After several burglaries in the area, security is now a high priority (= very important and needing attention soon ) .
examples.zh: 该地区发生了几宗入室盗窃案以后，治安成了当务之急。

examples.en: With so little money available, repairs must remain a low priority (= not important and not needing attention soon ) .
examples.zh: 可用的钱这么少，只好暂时放下维修事宜了。

words.definition: a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime, or while they are waiting to go to court for their  trial; jail, big house; imprison, jail
words.translation: 监狱；[法]监狱；监禁；拘留所；监禁，关押

examples.en: He visits his dad in prison every week.
examples.zh: 他每周都去探望狱中的父亲。

examples.en: Ricky has been out of prison for three years now.
examples.zh: 里基现已出狱三年。

examples.en: They’ll probably put him in prison for a long time.
examples.zh: 他们很可能会让他在监狱里待很长时间。

words.definition: someone who is kept in a prison as a legal punishment for a crime or while they are waiting for their  trial; capture, galley slave
words.translation: 囚犯；囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告

examples.en: Relationships between the staff and the prisoners are good.
examples.zh: 狱警和犯人相处良好。

examples.en: Prisoners here only serve short sentences.
examples.zh: 这里的犯人只是短期服刑。

examples.en: The organization is arguing for the release of political prisoners (= people in prison because of their political opinions ) .
examples.zh: 该组织正在争取释放政治犯。

words.definition: the state of being able to be alone, and not seen or heard by other people; secret, confidence, mystery
words.translation: (不受干扰的)独处，自由，隐私；私生活；隐私；秘密；隐居；隐居处

examples.en: With seven people squashed in one house, you don’t get much privacy.
examples.zh: 七个人挤在一间房子里，想要独处不大可能。

words.definition: for use by one person or group, not for everyone; chamber, cabinet; seaman second class
words.translation: 私人的,个人的,秘密的,私下的；私人的；私有的；私下的；列兵；二等兵

examples.en: Morris has a private jet.
examples.zh: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

examples.en: He made some notes for his private use.
examples.zh: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

examples.en: They objected to any form of private property .
examples.zh: 他们反对任何形式的私有财产。

words.definition: a special advantage that is given only to one person or group of people; to treat some people or things better than others; franchise, peculiar
words.translation: 特权,优惠,特许；给予优惠,给予特权；[计]特权；优待；基本权利

examples.en: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
examples.zh: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

words.definition: something that is given to someone who is successful in a competition, race, game of chance etc; to think that someone or something is very important or valuable; award, capture; assess, acquire, evaluate, value, rate
words.translation: 奖赏,奖金,奖品；珍视,珍惜；[劳经]奖品；奖赏；战利品；珍视；捕获；估价

examples.en: In this month’s competition you could win a prize worth £3,000.
examples.zh: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000英镑的奖品。

examples.en: The first prize has gone to Dr John Gentle.
examples.zh: 获得一等奖的是约翰·金特尔博士。

examples.en: The prizes are awarded (= given ) every year to students who have shown original thinking in their work.
examples.zh: 这些奖项每年颁发给在学习中表现出创造性思维的学生。

words.definition: to make someone feel surprised; the feeling you have when something unexpected or unusual happens; wonder, marvelousness; coup de main; astonishing, portentous
words.translation: 使诧异,使惊异;奇袭；诧异,惊异;奇袭；惊奇，诧异；突然袭击；使惊奇；奇袭；令人惊讶的

examples.en: His strange question surprised her.
examples.zh: 他那奇怪的问题令她感到意外。

examples.en: I didn’t know you two knew each other. Mind you, it doesn’t surprise me .
examples.zh: 我不知道你们俩认识。 尽管如此，我并不感到意外。

examples.en: What surprised me most was that she didn’t seem to care.
examples.zh: 最令我感到意外的是，她好像毫不在乎。

words.definition: used to thank someone in a polite way or to say that you are grateful for something they have done; enjoy, see, grasp; value added, rise in price
words.translation: 为...表示感激，感谢；欣赏，赏识，评价；欣赏；感激；领会；鉴别；增值；涨价

examples.en: Thanks ever so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
examples.zh: 多谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

examples.en: I appreciate your concern , but honestly, I’m fine.
examples.zh: 谢谢你关心，不过说真的，我很好。

examples.en: I’d appreciate it if you let me get on with my job.
examples.zh: 如果你能让我继续工作，我会非常感激。

words.definition: something that is precious is valuable and important and should not be wasted or used without care; golden, valued
words.translation: 珍贵的,贵重的；宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的

examples.en: planes delivering precious supplies of medicine and food
examples.zh: 运送药品、食品等宝贵物资的飞机

examples.en: our planet’s precious resources
examples.zh: 我们星球上的宝贵资源

words.definition: precise information, details etc are exact, clear, and correct; accurate, strict, mathematical, rigid, decided
words.translation: 精确的,准确的；精确的；明确的；严格的

examples.en: precise sales figures
examples.zh: 准确的销售数据

examples.en: It was difficult to get precise information.
examples.zh: 很难得到确切的消息。

examples.en: ‘She’s a lot older than you, isn’t she?’ ‘Fifteen years, to be precise .’
examples.zh: “她比你大很多，是不是？”“准确地说，大了15岁。”

words.definition: the quality of being very exact or correct; fidelity, rigor; nice, accurate, mathematical, strict, rigid
words.translation: 精确,精确度；[数]精度，精密度；精确；[数]精密的，精确的

words.definition: to show that something is true by providing facts, information etc; demonstrate, reveal, make clear, argue
words.translation: 证明,证实;检验;考验;鉴定;结果是,表明是；证明；检验；显示

examples.en: You’re wrong, and I can prove it.
examples.zh: 你错了，我可以证明。

examples.en: To prove his point (= show that he was right ) , he mentioned several other experiments which had produced similar results.
examples.zh: 为了证明自己的观点，他提到了另外几个结果相似的实验。

words.definition: when a plan, decision, or person is officially accepted; confirmation, authorization, validation, ratification
words.translation: 批准，通过；赞成，同意；批准；认可；赞成

examples.en: The president has already given his approval to the plan.
examples.zh: 总统已经批准了这个计划。

examples.en: It is just three months since we received official approval to go ahead with the project.
examples.zh: 三个月前我们刚刚得到正式批准进行这个项目。

examples.en: A company cannot be sold without the approval of the shareholders.
examples.zh: 没有股东的同意不能出售公司。

words.definition: to officially accept a plan, proposal etc; confirm, agree, uphold, authorize; to ratify, give someone the green light
words.translation: (of)赞成，赞许，同意；批准，审议，通过；批准；赞成；为…提供证据；满意

examples.en: The conference approved a proposal for a referendum.
examples.zh: 会议通过了举行全民公决的提议。

words.definition: to make something better, or to become better; further, build up; gain, accelerate, grow in
words.translation: 改善,改进,增进;好转,进步；改善，增进；提高…的价值；增加；变得更好

examples.en: a course for students wishing to improve their English
examples.zh: 为想提高英语水平的学生开设的一门课

examples.en: The doctors say she is improving (= after being ill ).
examples.zh: 医生说她正在康复。

examples.en: You could use the money for improving your home.
examples.zh: 你可以用这笔钱改善家居。

words.definition: the act of improving something or the state of being improved; reforming, amendment, enrichment, amelioration
words.translation: 改进,进步,增进;改进措施；改进，改善

examples.en: Our results have shown some improvement this month.
examples.zh: 我们的成绩这个月有所提高。

words.definition: not allowing water to enter; splashproof, hose-proof; rainproof
words.translation: 防水的,耐水的；防水的，[建]不透水的；使防水

examples.en: a waterproof jacket
examples.zh: 防水上衣

examples.en: waterproof adhesive
examples.zh: 防水黏合剂

examples.en: Rub the wax in to make the shoe waterproof.
examples.zh: 在鞋子上抹点蜡使其防水。

words.definition: facts, information, documents etc that prove something is true; authentication, certification, demonstration, confirmation, witness; try out, put to test
words.translation: 证据,证明;校样,样张；证明；证据；校样；考验；验证；试验；校对；使不被穿透

examples.en: There is no proof that the document is authentic.
examples.zh: 没有证据证明这份文件是真的。

words.definition: having no mistakes; to make something right or to make it work the way it should; rectify, admonish; adjust, adapt for; right, true, just
words.translation: 正确的,恰当的,端正的；改正,纠正,矫正；改正；告诫；调整；纠正错误；正确的；恰当的；端正的

examples.en: If my calculations are correct, we’re about ten miles from Exeter.
examples.zh: 如果我计算得没错的话，我们离埃克塞特大约十英里。

examples.en: Score one point for each correct answer .
examples.zh: 答对一题得一分。

examples.en: You are absolutely correct, the Missouri is the longest river in the US.
examples.zh: 你说的完全正确，密苏里河是美国最长的河流。

words.definition: to be in charge of something or control it; immediate, right; manage, conduct, run, officer, control; supervise, to command; immediately, straight, just, fair
words.translation: 径直的(地)；管理,指导;(at,to)指向；直接的；直系的；亲身的；恰好的；管理；指挥；导演；指向；指导；直接地；正好；按直系关系

examples.en: All genuine knowledge originates in direct experience.
examples.zh: 一切真知都是从直接经验发源的。

examples.en: The workers' movement poses a direct threat to their interests.
examples.zh: 工人运动对他们的利益造成了直接威胁。

words.definition: orientation, guidance, aspect, tendency, instruction
words.translation: 方向,方位;指令,说明；方向；指导；趋势；用法说明

words.definition: with no other person, action, process etc between; rapidly, straight, fair; immediately, than
words.translation: 直接地,径直地;马上,立即；直接地；立即；马上；正好地；坦率地；一…就

examples.en: The new property tax law won’t directly affect us.
examples.zh: 新的财产税法不会直接影响到我们。

examples.en: We hope to bring together the countries directly involved in the conflict.
examples.zh: 我们希望让直接卷入冲突的各国重归于好。

words.definition: the person who gives instructions to the actors and other people working on a film or play; co-director, boss-man
words.translation: 指导者,主任,导演；主任，[管理]主管；[电影]导演；人事助理

examples.en: "Cut!" the director yelled. "That was perfect."
examples.zh: “停！”导演叫道。“太好了！”

words.definition: a book or list of names, facts etc, usually arranged in alphabetical order; content, list, catalogue; consulting, advisory
words.translation: 人名地址录,(电话)号码簿；[计]目录；工商名录；姓名地址录；指导的；咨询的

examples.en: I couldn’t find your number in the telephone directory.
examples.zh: 我在电话簿上找不到你的电话号码。

examples.en: a new business directory
examples.zh: 新的商业名录

words.definition: to build something such as a building or wall; in a straight upright position; construct, fit, fix, structure, frame; straight, upright; to stand on end, get it up
words.translation: 树立,建立,使竖立；直立的,垂直的；使竖立；建造；安装；竖立的；笔直的；因性刺激而勃起的；直立；勃起

examples.en: an imposing town hall, erected in 1892
examples.zh: 一座气势宏伟的市政厅，建于1892年

examples.en: Police have erected barriers across the main roads into the town.
examples.zh: 警察在进城的主要道路上设立了路障。

words.definition: a shape that has four straight sides, two of which are usually longer than the other two, and four 90˚ angles at the corners; orthogon
words.translation: [数]矩形, 长方形；[数]矩形；长方形

examples.en: Suppose the width of a rectangle is x metres.
examples.zh: 设长方形的宽是 x 米。

words.definition: to correct something that is wrong; correct, straighten up
words.translation: 纠正,整顿, [化]精馏；改正；精馏；整流

examples.en: I did my best to rectify the situation, but the damage was already done.
examples.zh: 我竭尽全力去挽回局面，但损害已经造成了。

words.definition: used to say that a particular person or thing does not change; used to say that two or more people or things are exactly like each other; in the same way; said, uniform, self, identical, parallel; equally, similarly, as, likewise, homogeneously
words.translation: 相同的；相同的人(或物)；同样地；同一的；上述的（通常与the连用）；无变化的；同样地（通常与the连用）

examples.en: Her perfume has always had the same effect on me.
examples.zh: 她身上的香水给我的感觉一如既往。

examples.en: He’s the same old Peter – moody and irritable.
examples.zh: 他还是以前那个彼得——喜怒无常且爱发火。

words.definition: a small part or amount of something that is examined in order to find out something about the whole; essay, have a try; example, pattern
words.translation: 样品,实例,标本,抽样检查；取样,采样；取样；尝试；抽样检查；样品；[图情]样本；例子

examples.en: They took a blood sample to test for hepatitis.
examples.zh: 他们取了血样做肝炎化验。

words.definition: the meeting together of a group of people for a particular purpose; concentration, convergence, fishing, set, gathering
words.translation: 集合；会议；装配；(美)洲议会的众议院；[机]装配；集会，集合

examples.en: Police have imposed conditions on public assemblies.
examples.zh: 警方给公共集会设置了条件。

examples.en: Restrictions on freedom of assembly have gradually been relaxed.
examples.zh: 对集会自由的限制渐渐放宽了。

examples.en: an assembly point
examples.zh: 集合地点

words.definition: if there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar, especially in the way they look; image, conformity, likeness
words.translation: 相似,相似性[点,物]；相似；相似之处；相似物；肖像

examples.en: There was a remarkable resemblance between him and Pete.
examples.zh: 他和皮特有一个惊人的相似之处。

words.definition: to look like or be similar to someone or something; favor
words.translation: 像,类似；类似，像

examples.en: It’s amazing how closely Brian and Steve resemble each other.
examples.zh: 布赖恩和史蒂夫真是惊人地相像。

examples.en: He grew up to resemble his father.
examples.zh: 他长大了，很像他父亲。

words.definition: not difficult or complicated to do or understand; plain, primitive; turkey, put, idiot, stupid
words.translation: 简单的;单纯的,直率的;迟钝的,头脑简单的；[生物]简单的；单纯的；天真的；笨蛋；愚蠢的行为；出身低微者

examples.en: a simple but effective solution to the problem
examples.zh: 对这个问题简单而有效的解决办法

examples.en: There is no simple answer to this question.
examples.zh: 这个问题没有简单的答案。

examples.en: I’m sure there’s a perfectly simple explanation.
examples.zh: 我相信一定有一个很简单的解释。

words.definition: the quality of being simple and not complicated, especially when this is attractive or useful; homeliness, austerity
words.translation: 简单,简易;朴素;直率,单纯；朴素；简易；天真；愚蠢

examples.zh: 莫娜的文笔朴实优美。

examples.zh: 为简明起见，税单分成三个部分。

examples.en: James’ solution to this problem was simplicity itself (= very simple ) .
examples.zh: 詹姆斯对这个问题的解决办法十分简单。

words.definition: to make something easier or less complicated; predigest, deformalize
words.translation: 简化,使单纯；简化；使单纯；使简易

examples.en: an attempt to simplify the tax system
examples.zh: 简化税制的尝试

examples.en: The law needs to be simplified.
examples.zh: 这部法律需要简化。

examples.en: a simplified version of the game
examples.zh: 这个游戏的简化版

examples.en: Some students lose marks simply because they don’t read the question properly.
examples.zh: 有些学生丢分只是因为没有好好读题目。

examples.en: It’s not simply a question of money.
examples.zh: 这不仅仅是钱的问题。

examples.en: What we need is not simply a smaller organization, but a more efficient one.
examples.zh: 我们需要的不仅仅是一个精简的机构，而是一个更有效率的机构。

words.definition: expecting that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result; world-weary, futilitarian
words.translation: 悲观(主义)的；悲观的，厌世的；悲观主义的

examples.en: a pessimistic view of life
examples.zh: 对人生的悲观看法

words.definition: almost the same; alike, like; analog
words.translation: (to)相似的,类似的；相似的；类似物

examples.en: We have similar tastes in music.
examples.zh: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

examples.en: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
examples.zh: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

examples.en: A number of his friends had been affected in a similar way .
examples.zh: 他的一些朋友也受到了类似的影响。

words.definition: to make or produce something that is not real but has the appearance or feeling of being real; pattern, come, imitate; affected, assumed
words.translation: 模仿,模拟;假装,冒充；模仿；假装；冒充；模仿的；假装的

examples.zh: 一台模拟太空环境的机器

examples.zh: 可以在教室里模拟面试。

words.definition: things that are simultaneous happen at exactly the same time; synchronous, coinstantaneous
words.translation: 同时的,同时存在的；同时的；联立的；同时发生的

examples.en: They grabbed each other’s hands in simultaneous panic.
examples.zh: 他们俩同时惊慌起来，相互抓住对方的手。

examples.en: Up to twenty users can have simultaneous access to the system.
examples.zh: 最多可有20名用户同时登该系统。

examples.en: The speeches will be broadcast live, with simultaneous translation (= immediate translation, as the person is speaking ) into English.
examples.zh: 这些演讲将作现场直播，并配有英语同声传译。

words.definition: to be close to a particular number; close to, border on; near, broad, round
words.translation: 近似的；(to)接近；sim；接近于；[数]近似于；[数]近似的；大概的

examples.en: For each approximate solution of a parameterized problem, the app also displays the margin of error.
examples.zh: 对于每一个参数化问题的近似结果，这个程序也会显示误差的边界。

words.definition: to completely understand and begin to use new ideas, information etc; if people assimilate, or are assimilated into a country or group, they become part of that group and are accepted by the people in that group; absorb, drink in; drink in, suck up
words.translation: 吸收，消化；使同化；被吸收；被同化；吸收；把…比作；使相似；同化

examples.en: It will take time to assimilate all these facts.
examples.zh: 充分掌握所有这些情况需要时间。

words.definition: a short written account of your education and your previous jobs that you send to an employer when you are looking for a new job; to start doing something again after stopping or being interrupted; bio, abstract, brief, summary, record; recover, start over

examples.zh: 这个时候不要急着想得到面试，而是解释为你只是想让他们知道你对他们招聘的职位有兴趣，放下你的简历，然后有可能的话填完一份申请表就离开吧。

words.definition: to think that something is true, although you do not have definite proof; undertake, adopt, accept, shoulder, sustain; attitudinize, put on the dog
words.translation: 假装；假定，设想；承担；呈现，采取；假定；采取；呈现；装腔作势；多管闲事

examples.en: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
examples.zh: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

examples.zh: 到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

words.definition: something that you think is true although you have no definite proof; conception, perhaps, if
words.translation: 假定，设想；采取；承担；推测；假装；假定；设想；担任

examples.en: You would be making an assumption that's not based on any fact that you could report.
examples.zh: 你会做出不以你能报道的任何事实为依据的一种假设。

words.definition: to use time, energy, goods etc; waste, to use up; peter, spend

examples.zh: 我们消耗的纸张只有 27% 得到回收利用。

examples.en: A smaller vehicle will consume less fuel.
examples.zh: 汽车小耗费燃料也少。

words.definition: the amount of energy, oil, electricity etc that is used; expense, depletion
words.translation: 消费(量),消耗；[经]消费；消耗；肺痨

examples.zh: 剧烈运动增加氧的消耗。

words.definition: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain; guess, spell; depend, be satisfied of

examples.zh: 我想你是来这儿出差的吧。

examples.zh: “他整个星期都在家吗？”—“我想是。”

words.definition: caring and feeling sorry about someone’s problems; harmonious, balanced, acceptable; vagus nerve

examples.zh: 一个有同情心的朋友

examples.zh: 一种同情的态度

examples.zh: 我们希望总能做到友善地倾听。

words.translation: (sympathise)(with)同情;共鸣,同感;赞成；同情，怜悯；支持

examples.zh: 我很同情，但不知道如何帮忙。

words.translation: 同情，同情心；赞同，同感；慰问；同情；赞同

examples.en: Our sympathies are with the families of the victims.
examples.zh: 我们向受害者家庭表示慰问。

words.definition: a long piece of music usually in four parts, written for an  orchestra; harmonic, sinfonia
words.translation: 交响乐,交响曲；交响乐；谐声，和声

examples.zh: 布鲁克纳的《第五交响曲》

words.definition: something wrong with your body or mind which shows that you have a particular illness; premonitor, prefiguration
words.translation: (疾病的)症状；(不好事情的)征兆,表征；[临床]症状；征兆

examples.zh: 精神分裂症最常见的症状之一是幻听。

words.translation: 批准,同意,支持,认可；处罚,制裁；制裁，处罚；认可；支持；批准；鼓励

examples.zh: 这名助理的所作所为显然未经过白宫的批准。

examples.zh: 在我看来他神志完全正常。

examples.zh: 神志正常的人不会去杀一个婴儿。

words.translation: 综合病征；并存特性

examples.zh: 患有肠道过敏综合征的人

words.translation: (pl.syntheses)综合,合成；综合，[化学]合成；综合体

examples.zh: 语音合成软件

words.translation: 合成的,人造的;综合的；综合的；合成的，人造的；合成物

examples.zh: 合成化学品

examples.zh: 他们所有的剧本都是自己写的。

examples.zh: 电影剧本

examples.zh: 这本小册子对每一个地方都作了简短的介绍。

examples.zh: 从你的描述来看，柏林是个迷人的城市。

words.translation: 药方,处方；[医]药方；指示；惯例

examples.zh: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

examples.zh: 重复处方

words.translation: 描述,形容；描述，形容；描绘

examples.zh: 警察叫她描述一下那名男子。

examples.zh: 这个问题的另一种解决方法在第三章有所阐述。

examples.zh: 我个人从未持有过一种性别比另一种性别优越的观点。

words.translation: 指示,规定;处(方),开(药)；规定；开药方；开处方

examples.zh: 法律规定这种罪行应受何处罚？

examples.zh: 二年级学生

examples.zh: 雨接连下了四天。

examples.zh: 他们能连续第三个赛季赢得冠军称号吗？

examples.zh: 清教徒离开了英国以躲避迫害。

examples.zh: 控方律师林恩·史密斯夫人称案件发生于1月27日。

words.definition: not as important as something else; medium, supporting, middle, minor, moderate; deputy, agent, factor, proxy

examples.zh: 这本小说中的次要人物

examples.zh: 现在我觉得这事一点都无所谓了。

words.translation: 结果，因此，所以；因此；结果；所以

examples.zh: 大多数的电脑使用者都没有经过正规的键盘操作训练，因此他们的键盘技巧不够熟练。

examples.zh: 这些分子被吸收到血液里，从而影响到器官。

examples.zh: 注意要按正确的顺序来完成动作。

words.translation: 随后的,后来的；[地质]后来的，随后的

examples.zh: 这些技能代代相传。

examples.zh: 接下去的书页

words.definition: a feeling about something; if you sense something, you feel that it exists or is true, without being told or having proof; concept, consciousness, perception, feel, mind

examples.zh: 猫的听觉非常敏锐。

words.definition: when you are not in the place where people expect you to be, or the time that you are away; shortage, deficiency, need, short of, drought
words.translation: 缺乏，不存在；缺席，不在；缺席的时间；没有；缺乏；[法]缺席；不注意

examples.zh: 警察没有证据，只好把迈尔斯放了。

words.translation: 缺席的；缺乏的,不存在的;心不在焉的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的

examples.zh: 她脸上呆滞、茫然的神情说明她觉得无聊了。

words.definition: an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with or accepts; accordance, unity, agreement, identity, keeping
words.translation: (意见等的)一致，一致同意，共识；一致；舆论；合意

examples.zh: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

examples.zh: 目前观点上的一致

examples.zh: 大家都认为科技是好东西。

words.definition: agreement about something; grant, comply, engage; agreement, accordance, unity, identity, yes
words.translation: (to)同意,赞成,答应；同意；赞成；答应；（意见等的）一致

examples.zh: 主席是大家一致推选出来的。

examples.zh: 双方均同意的离婚

words.translation: 本质,实质；本质，实质；精华；[化工]香精

examples.zh: 实质上他想表达的意思很简单。

examples.zh: 我和萨姆的根本区别在于我是认真对待生活的。

examples.zh: 接力赛跑的基本要点是讲究团队配合。

words.definition: when someone or something is present in a particular place; existence, being, entity, is
words.translation: 出席,到场,存在,在；[植]存在；出席；参加；风度；仪态

examples.zh: 敬请出席于周五举行的俱乐部会议。

words.definition: in a particular place; something you give someone on a special occasion or to thank them for something; to give something to someone, for example at a formal or official occasion; prefer, file, advance, recommend, assume; current, now; gift, giving, aiming, training, tribute
words.translation: 出席的,现在的；现在,礼物；赠送,提出；提出；介绍；呈现；赠送；现在的；出席的；现在；礼物；瞄准

examples.zh: 遭受贫困和疾病折磨的数百万人民的现状

words.translation: 一会儿,不久;现在,目前；（美）目前；不久

examples.zh: 医生一会儿就到。

examples.zh: 一会儿我就睡着了。

examples.zh: 小林先生被选中代表公司出席会议。

words.definition: someone who has been chosen to speak, vote, or make decisions for someone else; typical of a particular group or thing; typical, characteristic; deputy, model, behalf of, ambassador

examples.zh: 工会代表

examples.zh: 保罗非常气愤，因为卡萝尔不信任他。

words.translation: 加很多香料的；(口味)浓郁的；辛辣的；香的，多香料的；下流的

examples.en: a spicy tomato sauce
examples.zh: 辣番茄酱

words.definition: doubt, challenge; dispute, wonder, question, suspect of, to doubt
words.translation: 怀疑，猜疑；一点儿，少量；怀疑；嫌疑；疑心；一点儿

words.translation: (of)可疑的,多疑的,疑心的；可疑的；怀疑的；多疑的

examples.zh: 他不愿回答我的问题，这引起我的怀疑。

examples.zh: 她向他投去怀疑的一瞥。
