examples.zh: 你真是疑心太重！

words.definition: the qualities that make someone live the way they do, and make them different from other people; mood, emotion, energy, soul, mind; heart, stimulate, lift, uphold, inspire
words.translation: 精神;志气;(pl.)情绪,心情;(pl.)酒精；精神；心灵；情绪；志气；烈酒；鼓励；鼓舞；诱拐

examples.en: His spirits were so low (= he was so sad ) that he refused to answer his phone.
examples.zh: 他情绪非常低落，连电话也不愿接。

words.definition: to desire and work towards achieving something important; rare, long for
words.translation: (to，after)渴望，追求，有志于；渴望；立志；追求

examples.en: ...people who aspire to public office.
examples.zh: …志在获得公职的人们。

words.definition: a secret plan made by two or more people to do something that is harmful or illegal; designing, plot
words.translation: 阴谋，密谋，共谋；阴谋；共谋；阴谋集团

examples.en: There were many conspiracy theories (= beliefs that something is the result of a conspiracy ) surrounding Princess Diana’s death.
examples.zh: 围绕戴安娜王妃之死有许多阴谋论。

words.definition: a good idea about what you should do, write, say etc, especially one which you get suddenly; stimulation, afflatus
words.translation: 灵感;鼓舞,激励；灵感；鼓舞；[生理]吸气；妙计

examples.en: The Malvern Hills have provided inspiration for many artists and musicians over the decades.
examples.zh: 几十年来，莫尔文丘陵为很多艺术家和音乐家提供了灵感。

examples.en: He raised his eyes to the altar as if seeking inspiration.
examples.zh: 他抬头看看祭坛，似乎在寻求灵感。

examples.en: He draws inspiration from ordinary scenes.
examples.zh: 他从日常生活中得到灵感。

words.definition: to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something; stimulate, lift, wake, spirit, effect
words.translation: 鼓舞,激起;使产生灵感；激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感

examples.en: We need someone who can inspire the team.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个能鼓舞团队士气的人。

examples.en: Inspired by the sunny weather, I decided to explore the woods.
examples.zh: 阳光明媚的天气令人振奋，我决定到森林里寻幽探胜。

words.definition: Spiral is also an adjective; a line in the form of a curve that winds around a central point, moving further away from the centre all the time; to move in a continuous curve that gets nearer to or further from its central point as it goes round; screw, helix; helical, gyroidal
words.translation: 螺旋形的；螺旋，螺线；螺旋上升；盘旋；[机]螺旋；旋涡；螺旋形之物；盘旋的

examples.en: ...a spiral staircase.
examples.zh: …一段旋梯。

words.definition: relating to your spirit rather than to your body or mind; motet, canticle; mental, inner

examples.en: Painting helps fill a spiritual need for beauty.
examples.zh: 绘画可以满足对美的精神需求。

examples.en: spiritual values
examples.zh: 精神价值

words.definition: willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger; venturous, devil-may-care

examples.en: I had no money left and was desperate.
examples.zh: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

examples.en: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
examples.zh: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

examples.en: the missing teenager’s desperate parents
examples.zh: 失踪少年绝望的父母

words.definition: if a group of people disperse or are dispersed, they go away in different directions; transmit, spread around; spread around, spread about; scattered, decentralized
words.translation: (使)分散;(使)散开;疏散；分散；使散开；传播；分散的

examples.zh: 警察用催泪瓦斯驱散人群。

words.definition: If people or businesses prosper, they are successful and do well; arrive, flower, win, thrive
words.translation: 成功,兴隆,昌盛,使成功,使昌隆,繁荣；繁荣，昌盛；成功

examples.en: His business continued to prosper.
examples.zh: 他的生意持续兴隆。

words.definition: when people have money and everything that is needed for a good life; success, victory, winning, up, hit
words.translation: 繁荣,兴旺；繁荣，成功

examples.en: a time of economic prosperity
examples.zh: 经济繁荣时期

words.definition: rich and successful; flourishing, booming
words.translation: 繁荣的,兴旺的,茂盛的,顺利的；繁荣的；兴旺的

examples.en: a prosperous landowner
examples.zh: 富裕的土地拥有者

words.definition: communication with a person, organization, country etc; touch, link; meet, to link
words.translation: (使)接触,联系,交往；[电][电子]接触，联系；联系，[电][电子]接触

examples.en: The town is cut off from contact with the outside world.
examples.zh: 小镇与外界的联系被切断了。

words.definition: not broken, damaged, or spoiled; whole, complete, integrated, full
words.translation: 完整无缺的,未经触动的,未受损伤的；完整的；原封不动的；未受损伤的

examples.en: Only the medieval tower had remained intact.
examples.zh: 只有这座中世纪塔楼保存完好。

examples.en: His reputation survived intact.
examples.zh: 他的声望丝毫未受影响。

words.definition: strategy, device
words.translation: (s)策略,战术；策略，战略

examples.zh: 你以前也可能听说过这个策略。

examples.zh: 我用了我能想到的每一种武器和战术。

examples.zh: 然而在接下去的几个月这个策略将很难维持下去。

words.translation: 建筑师；设计师；缔造者；创造者

examples.zh: 蒂诺科是政府经济改革的设计师之一。

words.definition: the style and design of a building or buildings; architectural style

examples.zh: 他在大学里读的是建筑学。

words.translation: 分开, 分离, 分遣, 派遣(军队)；分离；派遣；使超然

examples.zh: 请撕下申请表并填好。

words.definition: to notice or discover something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear etc; explore, perceive
words.translation: 察觉,发觉,侦察,探测；察觉；发现；探测

examples.en: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
examples.zh: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

words.definition: a police officer whose job is to discover information about crimes and catch criminals; tec, hawkshaw
words.translation: 侦探

examples.en: She hired a detective to find out if her husband was having an affair.
examples.zh: 她雇了一个私人侦探调查她丈夫是否有外遇。

words.definition: a machine or piece of equipment that finds or measures something; finder, discoverer
words.translation: 发现者,侦察器,探测器,检波器,检电器；[自][电子]检测器；发现者；侦察器

examples.en: a smoke detector
examples.zh: 烟雾探测器

examples.en: a metal detector
examples.zh: 金属探测器

words.definition: to keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or illness; secure, watch, preserve
words.translation: (from)保护,保卫；保护，防卫；警戒

examples.zh: 我们在保护环境方面做得够吗？

words.definition: connected with knowledge of how machines work; specialized, express
words.translation: 技术(性)的，工艺的；专门性的，专业性的；工艺的，科技的；技术上的；专门的

examples.zh: 有我们的员工向你提供技术支持。

examples.zh: 我一点技术知识都没有。

examples.zh: 技术培训

words.translation: 技术员,技师,技工；[劳经]技师，技术员；技巧纯熟的人

examples.zh: 实验室技术人员

examples.en: a hospital technician
examples.zh: 医院技术人员

words.translation: 技巧，手艺，技能；技术，工艺；技巧，技术；手法

examples.zh: 他是个伟大的球员，球技十分精湛。

examples.zh: 爱因斯坦改变了我们的时空概念。

examples.zh: 长期建立起来的亲密关系

examples.zh: 顾客只有有限的时间可以检查商品。

examples.zh: 毕加索的一个密友

examples.zh: 她与政府官员关系密切。

examples.zh: 恐吓她的企图失败了。

words.translation: 白天,日间；日间，白天

examples.zh: 你能把你的日间电话号码给我吗？

examples.zh: 日间电视节目

words.definition: a calculation of the value, size, amount etc of something made using the information that you have, which may not be complete; evaluate, guess at; computation, appraisal, calculation, assessment, judgment, evaluation, viewpoint; measure, value, score

examples.zh: 我们只需估算一下有多少人会来。

words.translation: 超时的,加班的；加班；[劳经]加班时间；延长时间

examples.en: The firm wanted to chisel him out of his overtime pay.
examples.zh: 公司想要剥夺他的超时加班费。

examples.zh: 在类似的比赛中，你即使只超时一秒，也会自动输掉比赛。

examples.zh: 销售数据要到下个月的某个时候才会公布。

words.translation: 不时，有时，间或；有时，间或

examples.zh: 我有时得工作到很晚。

examples.zh: 有时候，祖母会跟我们讲讲她儿时在意大利的经历。

examples.zh: “你有没有想过希望回到日本？”“有时候吧，但不经常这么想。”

words.translation: 及时的,适时的；及时的；适时的；及时地；早

examples.zh: 幸亏警察及时赶到，打斗总算停止。

examples.zh: 一项既无胆识又不完善的政策

words.translation: 低估，看轻；低估；看轻

examples.zh: 我们谁都不应低估妇女在职业发展中所面临的困难程度。

examples.zh: 天气状况使他们无法尝试跳伞。

examples.zh: 他甚至想过自杀。

examples.zh: 公众受到了节目主持人的轻蔑对待。

examples.zh: 她怎么会爱上一个明显看不起她的男人呢？

examples.zh: 她那种脾气早晚会让她惹麻烦的。

examples.zh: 据内森讲，罗宾脾气很大。

examples.en: Theo needs to learn to control his temper .
examples.zh: 西奥应该学会控制他的脾气。

words.definition: the emotional part of someone’s character, especially how likely they are to be happy, angry etc; character, disposition, make
words.translation: 气质，性格，性情；资质；气质，性情，[心理]性格；急躁

examples.zh: 他容易冲动的性格经常使他陷入困境。

words.definition: a measure of how hot or cold a place or thing is
words.translation: 温度，体温；热度，发烧

examples.en: The temperature of the water was just right for swimming.
examples.zh: 这水温游泳正好。

examples.en: Water boils at a temperature of 100˚C.
examples.zh: 水在100摄氏度沸腾。

words.definition: a building where people go to  worship  , in the Jewish, Hindu, Buddhist, Sikh, and Mormon religions; vihara, fane
words.translation: 庙宇,神殿,寺;太阳穴；庙宇；寺院；神殿；太阳穴

words.definition: the speed at which music is played or should be played; speed, rate, beat
words.translation: 节奏,行进速度;(音乐的)速度；速度，发展速度；拍子

examples.zh: 岛上生活的轻松节奏

examples.zh: 如果把贵重物品留在车上，会招来小偷的。

words.definition: a strong desire to have or do something even though you know you should not; invitation, allurement
words.translation: 引诱，诱惑；诱惑物；引诱

examples.en: Resist the temptation to buy the item until you’re certain you need it.
examples.zh: 要抵挡住购买的诱惑，除非你确有需要。

examples.en: I finally gave in to the temptation and had a cigarette.
examples.zh: 我最终还是屈从诱惑，抽了一支烟。

words.definition: to find out the facts about something; condition, conclude; identify, drop, finish, judge
words.translation: 决心,决定;确定,限定；决定；判决；使…下定决心；确定；判决，终止

examples.zh: 调查人员仍在设法弄清失火的原因。

words.definition: a word or expression with a particular meaning, especially one that is used for a specific subject or type of language; technology, item, session, provision, article
words.translation: 学期;期限,期间;(pl.)条件,条款;术语；术语；学期；期限；条款

examples.zh: 教师在学期内经常觉得工作担子过重。

words.translation: 晚期的;终点的;期末的；终点(站);终端；末端；[交]终点；[计]终端机；极限；[动]末端的；[交]终点的；晚期的

examples.zh: 晚期癌症

words.definition: if something terminates, or if you terminate it, it ends; fulfill, drop, kill; result, drop, determine, pass, set; ended, closing, over, past, concluding
words.translation: (使)结束，(使)停止；使终止；使结束；解雇；结束，终止；结果；结束的

examples.zh: 法庭裁决该合同必须终止。

examples.zh: 女子关于是否终止妊娠的决定

words.translation: 罐头；锡；锡制的；镀锡于；[化学]锡；罐头，罐；[材]马口铁

examples.zh: 旧的锡浴缸

examples.zh: 下午3:30发布了公告，宣布总统暂时脱离了危险。

words.definition: a large mass of land surrounded by sea; mainland, earth, land; self-regulating, restrained
words.translation: 大陆,洲；[地理]大陆，洲，陆地；自制的，克制的

examples.en: the continents of Asia and Africa
examples.zh: 亚洲及非洲大陆

words.definition: continuing for a long time without stopping; frequent
words.translation: 不断的,连续的,频繁的；持续不断的；频繁的

examples.en: five weeks of continual rain
examples.zh: 持续了五个星期的降雨

examples.zh: 日本人精益求精的经营哲学

words.translation: 继续,连续,延伸；继续，延续；仍旧，连续

examples.en: He will be continuing his education in the US.
examples.zh: 他将在美国继续求学。

examples.en: I felt too sick to continue.
examples.zh: 我感觉很难受，无法继续下去了。

words.definition: continuing to happen or exist without stopping
words.translation: 连续的,持续的

examples.en: continuous economic growth
examples.zh: 持续的经济增长

examples.en: a continuous flow of information
examples.zh: 源源不断的信息

words.definition: extremely small; micro, few, little, minute
words.translation: 极小的,微小的；微小的；很少的

examples.en: a tiny community in the Midwest
examples.zh: 中西部地区一个极小的社区

examples.en: The earrings were tiny.
examples.zh: 耳环很小。

examples.en: a tiny little baby
examples.zh: 丁点大的婴儿

words.definition: if something such as a bag, box, or place contains something, that thing is inside it; involve, possess, regulate, manage, accept; restrain oneself, abstain
words.translation: 包含，容纳；容忍，抑制；可被...除尽；包含；控制；容纳；牵制（敌军）；含有；自制

examples.en: The thieves stole a purse containing bank-notes.
examples.zh: 小偷们偷到了一个里面有钞票的钱包。

examples.en: The museum contains a number of original artworks.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆藏有一些原创艺术品。

words.definition: something such as a box or bowl that you use to keep things in; vessel, pocket
words.translation: 容器;集装箱；[交]集装箱；[包装]容器

examples.en: ice cream in plastic containers
examples.zh: 塑料容器里的冰激凌

words.definition: to officially prevent someone from leaving a place; hold, delay
words.translation: 耽搁;扣押,拘留；拘留；留住；耽搁

examples.en: Two suspects have been detained by the police for questioning .
examples.zh: 两名嫌疑人被警方拘留审问。

examples.en: She was detained in hospital with a suspected broken leg.
examples.zh: 她因腿部疑似骨折而被留医。

words.definition: to invite people to your home for a meal, party etc, or to take your company’s customers somewhere to have a meal, drinks etc; serve, invite, attend, contain, accept; welcome in
words.translation: 招待,款待;使娱乐;使欢乐;容纳,接受；娱乐；招待；怀抱；容纳；款待

examples.en: Mark usually does the cooking when we entertain.
examples.zh: 我们招待客人时通常都是马克下厨。

examples.en: Do you get an allowance for entertaining clients?
examples.zh: 你招待客户有补助吗？

words.definition: when you entertain someone at home, or for business; recreation, pleasure, sport, occupation, amusement
words.translation: 招待,款待;表演文娱节目；娱乐；消遣；款待

examples.en: the entertainment of friends
examples.zh: 招待朋友

words.definition: to get something that you want, especially through your own effort, skill, or work; pick up, get access to; acquire, earn, score, buy, find
words.translation: 获得,得到；获得；流行

examples.en: Evans was trying to obtain a false passport and other documents.
examples.zh: 埃文斯当时正试图获取假护照和其他文件。

words.definition: to keep something or continue to have something; keep up, to keep
words.translation: 保持,保留；保持；雇；记住

examples.en: You have the right to retain possession of the goods.
examples.zh: 你有权保留这些物品。

examples.en: The state wants to retain control of food imports.
examples.zh: 政府想保留对食品进口的控制权。

words.definition: to succeed in achieving something after trying for a long time; accomplish, carry out, earn, acquire, come true; go, take, land, arrive at; achievement, effort, success, accomplishment, Vostro
words.translation: 达到；完成；获得；达到，实现；到达；成就

examples.en: More women are attaining positions of power.
examples.zh: 越来越多的女性获得要职。

words.definition: a stone structure above or below the ground where a dead person is buried; death, end; bury, entomb
words.translation: 坟,冢；坟墓；死亡；埋葬

examples.en: the family tomb
examples.zh: 家族坟墓

words.definition: usual; usual, used, particular, common, exclusive
words.translation: 惯常的；习惯的，适应的(一般作表语)；习惯的；通常的；独有的

examples.en: The pans were in their accustomed places.
examples.zh: 那些锅在老地方。

words.definition: the smallest part of an  element  that can exist alone or can combine with other substances to form a  molecule
words.translation: 原子；微粒，微量

examples.en: carbon atoms
examples.zh: 碳原子

words.definition: the flat surface on the lowest side of an object; basis, terminal, base, extreme
words.translation: 底(部);基础,根基;海底,湖底,河床；底部；末端；臀部；尽头

examples.en: The drugs had been hidden in a suitcase with a false bottom.
examples.zh: 毒品藏在一个带假底板的行李箱里。

words.definition: something that is done by people in a particular society because it is traditional; manner, habit, way; made-to-order, tailored
words.translation: 习惯,风俗,惯例;(pl.)海关,关税；习惯；风俗；海关；定制的，定做的

examples.en: He awoke early, as was his custom.
examples.zh: 他很早醒来，这是他的习惯。

words.definition: something that is customary is normal because it is the way something is usually done; usual, used, common, accustomed
words.translation: 习惯的,惯例的；习惯的；通常的

examples.en: Barbara answered with her customary enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 芭芭拉以惯有的热情作了回答。

words.definition: someone who buys goods or services from a shop, company etc; client, apple, consumer, fellow, egg
words.translation: 顾客,主顾；[贸易]顾客；家伙

examples.en: We aim to offer good value and service to all our customers.
examples.zh: 我们力求为所有的客户提供物有所值的商品和服务。

examples.en: We’ve had several letters from satisfied customers.
examples.zh: 我们收到了几封顾客表示满意的来信。

examples.en: He’s one of our regular customers .
examples.zh: 他是我们的一个老主顾。

words.definition: a round soft red fruit eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable; tamarillo
words.translation: 西红柿；[园艺]番茄，西红柿

examples.en: He staked his tomato vines with bamboo.
examples.zh: 他用竹竿支撑起西红柿秧。

examples.en: The salmon was brought to the table whole, garnished with parsley and slices of tomato and cucumber.
examples.zh: 整条大麻哈鱼被端上了桌，并用欧芹、西红柿片和黄瓜片作为花色配菜。

words.definition: used to say where someone or something goes; forth, ahead, along, forwards, front; unto, towards, at, out
words.translation: (表示方向)到；向；(表示间接关系)给；向前；（门等）关上；到；（表示时间、方向）朝…方向

examples.en: She stood up and walked to the window.
examples.zh: 她站起来走到窗前。

examples.en: the road to London
examples.zh: 通往伦敦的路

examples.en: our weekly trip to the supermarket
examples.zh: 我们每周一次的超级市场之行

words.definition: based on general ideas or principles rather than specific examples or real events; a short written statement containing only the most important ideas in a speech, article etc; to remove something from somewhere; brief, summary, resume; deep, nonobjective; extract, brief
words.translation: 抽象的；摘要，梗概；提取；摘录要点；[图情]摘要；抽象；抽象的概念；深奥的；使……抽象化

examples.en: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
examples.zh: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

examples.en: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
examples.zh: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

words.definition: to make someone interested in something, or make them want to take part in something; engage, absorb, produce, cause, operate; appeal, turn one on
words.translation: 引起的注意(或兴趣等),吸引；引起；激起；吸引；有吸引力

examples.en: I’m not usually attracted to blondes.
examples.zh: 我一般不喜欢金发女子。

words.definition: pleasant to look at; dramatic, absorbing
words.translation: 吸引人的，引人注意的；漂亮的，迷人的；吸引人的；有魅力的；引人注目的

examples.en: Kitchen utensils should be attractive as well as functional.
examples.zh: 厨房用具应该既美观又实用。

words.definition: an official agreement between two or more people, stating what each will do; to sign a contract in which you agree formally that you will do something or someone will do something for you; communicate, shrink; affect, catch, communicate; compact, engagement
words.translation: (承包)合同/契约；订合同/契约；使缩小；收缩；感染；订约；使缩短；[经]合同；婚约

examples.en: Employees who refuse to relocate are in breach of contract (= have done something not allowed by their contracts ) .
examples.zh: 员工拒绝调动岗位是违反合约的。

words.definition: to take someone’s attention away from something by making them look at or listen to something else; shift, divert from
words.translation: 分散;使分心;打扰;使心情烦乱；转移；分心

examples.en: Try not to distract the other students.
examples.zh: 尽量不要让其他学生分心。

words.definition: to remove an object from somewhere, especially with difficulty; abstract, milk, pop; juice, succus
words.translation: 拔出,抽出;摘录；抽取物;精华;选集；提取；取出；[图情]摘录；榨取；汁；[化学][药][化工]榨出物；选粹

examples.en: You’ll have to have that tooth extracted.
examples.zh: 你得把那颗牙拔掉。

words.definition: a strong vehicle with large wheels, used for pulling farm machinery; traction engine, hauling machine
words.translation: 拖拉机,牵引车；[农机]拖拉机；[车辆]牵引机

examples.en: Iron-ox is another name for tractor.
examples.zh: 铁牛是拖拉机的别名。

examples.en: The tractor hauled the fertilizer away.
examples.zh: 拖拉机把肥料拉走了。

examples.en: In addition to the tractor, we have acquired a new rice transplanter.
examples.zh: 除了拖拉机， 我们又添了一台插秧机。

words.definition: to take a number or an amount from a larger number or amount; substract, subduce
words.translation: (from)减(去)；减去；扣掉

examples.en: Mandy subtracted the date of birth from the date of death.
examples.zh: 曼迪从死亡的日期减去了出生的日期。

words.definition: a vacant seat, building, room or piece of land is empty and available for someone to use; available, empty, blank, leisure, hollow
words.translation: 空的,未占用的;空缺的;神情茫然的；空虚的；空的；空缺的；空闲的；茫然的

examples.en: Only a few apartments were still vacant.
examples.zh: 只有几套公寓仍然空着。

examples.en: There was only a vacant lot (= empty unused area of land in a city ) where her house used to be.
examples.zh: 她以前房子所在的地方只剩下一块空地了。

words.definition: a holiday, or time spent not working; hols; have a holiday, take time off from sth.
words.translation: 休假,假期；假期；（房屋）搬出；休假，度假

examples.en: We’re planning a vacation in Europe.
examples.zh: 我们正计划去欧洲度假。

examples.en: We’re planning to go on vacation soon.
examples.zh: 我们在计划近期去度假。

words.definition: a space that is completely empty of all gas, especially one from which all the air has been taken away; room, gamma space
words.translation: 真空,真空吸尘器；[真空]真空；空间；真空吸尘器

examples.zh: 他的出现应该能填补过去几天中形成的权力空缺。

words.definition: to send people away from a dangerous place to a safe place; withdraw, beat a retreat
words.translation: 撤离，疏散，排泄，剥夺；疏散，撤退；排泄；疏散；撤退

examples.en: Police evacuated the area.
examples.zh: 警方将该地区人员全部疏散。

words.definition: unclear because someone does not give enough detailed information or does not say exactly what they mean; fuzzy, dark, uncertain
words.translation: 不明确的,含糊的,暧昧的；模糊的；含糊的；不明确的；暧昧的

examples.en: The governor gave only a vague outline of his tax plan.
examples.zh: 州长只是含糊地大致说了一下他的税务计划。

words.definition: spending or costing a lot of money, especially more than is necessary or more than you can afford; luxury, unreasonable
words.translation: 奢侈的;过分的;(言行等)放肆的；奢侈的；浪费的；过度的；放纵的

examples.en: Would it be too extravagant to buy both?
examples.zh: 把两个都买下会不会太奢侈了？

examples.en: an extravagant lifestyle
examples.zh: 奢侈的生活方式

words.definition: having the same value, purpose, job etc as a person or thing of a different kind; something that has the same value, purpose, job etc as something else; equal, even; countertype, quid pro quo
words.translation: (to)相等的,等价的；相等物,等价物；[物价][化学][数]等价的，相等的；同意义的；[物价][化学]等价物，相等物

examples.en: I had no dollars, but offered him an equivalent amount of sterling.
examples.zh: 我没有美金，但给了他等值的英镑。

words.definition: to judge how good, useful, or successful something is; value, score, rate, prize; to assess, to appraise
words.translation: 估价,评价;求…的值；评价；估价；求…的值

examples.en: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
examples.zh: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

examples.en: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
examples.zh: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

examples.en: It can be difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments.
examples.zh: 要对各种治疗方法的效果作出评估会很难。

words.definition: the period of time between two events, activities etc; separation, distance
words.translation: 间隔,间歇;(幕间或工间)休息；间隔；间距；幕间休息

examples.en: He left the room, returning after a short interval with a message.
examples.zh: 他离开房间，过了一会儿就带回来一条消息。

words.definition: someone who cannot look after themselves because of illness, old age, or injury; a contract, ticket, claim etc that is invalid is not legally or officially acceptable; useless, disabled, ineffective; sick, patient
words.translation: 病人,伤残人；有病的,伤残的;无效的；无效的；有病的；残废的；病人；[医]残废者

examples.en: I resented being treated as an invalid.
examples.zh: 我讨厌别人把我当病人看待。

words.definition: If you describe something as invaluable, you mean that it is extremely useful; inestimable, impayable
words.translation: 非常宝贵的,无价的；无价的；非常贵重的

examples.en: I was able to gain invaluable experience over that year.
examples.zh: 在那一年里我获得了十分宝贵的经验。

words.definition: common at a particular time, in a particular place, or among a particular group of people; popular, widespread, universal, fashionable, going
words.translation: 流行的,普遍的；流行的；普遍的，广传的

examples.en: the prevalent belief in astrology
examples.zh: 对占星术的普遍相信

words.definition: a valid ticket, document, or agreement is legally or officially acceptable; available, effective, virtual, telling, significant
words.translation: 有效的;有根据的;正当的；有效的，有根据的；正当的

examples.en: a valid credit card
examples.zh: 有效信用卡

examples.en: Your return ticket is valid for three months.
examples.zh: 你的往返票有效期为三个月。

words.definition: hollow, hill and dale
words.translation: (山)谷;流域；[地理]山谷；流域；溪谷

examples.en: the San Fernando Valley
examples.zh: 圣费尔南多山谷

words.definition: worth a lot of money; worthy, of value; preciosity
words.translation: 贵重的,有价值的；(pl.)贵重物品,财宝；[经]有价值的；贵重的；可估价的；贵重物品

examples.en: a valuable painting
examples.zh: 一幅名贵的画

examples.en: Their most valuable belongings were locked in a safe in the bedroom.
examples.zh: 他们最值钱的财物锁在卧室保险箱里。

words.definition: the amount of money that something is worth; to think that someone or something is important; importance, significance, price, stress, weight; score, rate, prize
words.translation: 价格;价值;实用性；评价,估价;尊重；[数]值；[经]价值；价格；重要性；确切涵义；评价；重视；估价

examples.en: the nutritional value of cereal
examples.zh: 谷类食物的营养价值

words.definition: arrival, occurrence, emergence, appearance, rise
words.translation: (重要事件等的)到来，来临；到来；出现；基督降临；基督降临节

examples.en: the advent of the computer
examples.zh: 计算机的问世

words.definition: an exciting experience in which dangerous or unusual things happen; risk, throw, venture; take a chance, run a risk; take a risk, run a risk, stick one's neck out, take chances
words.translation: 冒险，冒险活动，奇遇；大胆进行；冒险；冒险精神；投机活动；大胆说出

examples.en: a great adventure
examples.zh: 一大奇遇

examples.en: Ahab’s adventures at sea
examples.zh: 亚哈的海上历险

examples.en: an adventure story
examples.zh: 一个历险故事

words.definition: used in the names of streets in a town or city; main street, high street
words.translation: 林荫路，大街；(比喻)途径，渠道，方法；[公路]大街；[建]林荫大道

examples.en: Fifth Avenue
examples.zh: 第五大街

examples.en: Shaftesbury Avenue
examples.zh: 沙夫茨伯里街

words.definition: the quality of being suitable or useful for a particular purpose, especially by making something easier or saving you time; john, bathroom, toilet
words.translation: 便利,方便;(pl.)便利设备；便利；厕所；便利的事物

examples.en: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.
examples.zh: 即食餐因为方便销路好。

words.definition: useful to you because it saves you time, or does not spoil your plans or cause you problems; commodious, expedient
words.translation: (to)便利的,方便的；方便的

examples.en: Mail-order catalogs are a convenient way to shop.
examples.zh: 使用邮购目录是一种方便的购物方式。

examples.en: My secretary will call you to arrange a convenient time to meet.
examples.zh: 我的秘书会打电话给你安排一个方便的时间见面。

words.definition: a large formal meeting for people who belong to the same profession or organization or who have the same interests; tradition, usage, institution, appointment, bond
words.translation: 大会,会议;惯例,常规,习俗;公约,协定；大会；[法]惯例；[计]约定；协定；习俗

examples.en: a teachers’ convention
examples.zh: 教师大会

examples.en: the city’s new convention center
examples.zh: 该市新建的会议中心

examples.en: a convention for science fiction fans
examples.zh: 科幻小说迷的集会

words.definition: a conventional method, product, practice etc has been used for a long time and is considered the usual type; traditional, usual, familiar, classical
words.translation: 惯例的,常规的；符合习俗的，传统的；常见的；惯例的

examples.en: Internet connections through conventional phone lines are fairly slow.
examples.zh: 通过传统的电话线来连接因特网速度很慢。

examples.en: Bake for 20 minutes in a conventional oven; 8 in a microwave.
examples.zh: 在传统的烤炉中烘烤20分钟，在微波炉里则烤8分钟。

words.definition: something that happens, especially something important, interesting or unusual; incident, occurrence, circumstance, outcome, item, scene, product
words.translation: 事件,事情；[计][物][数]事件，大事；项目；结果

examples.en: one of the most important events in the history of mankind
examples.zh: 人类历史上最重大的事件之一

words.definition: after a long time, or after a lot of things have happened; finally, ultimately, lastly
words.translation: 终于,最后；最后，终于

examples.en: He eventually escaped and made his way back to England.
examples.zh: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

examples.en: Eventually, she got a job and moved to London.
examples.zh: 最终，她找到了工作并移居伦敦。

words.definition: to become involved in an argument, fight, or other difficult situation in order to change what happens; influence in, meddle in
words.translation: (in)干涉,干预;插入,介入；干涉；调停；插入

examples.en: The army will have to intervene to prevent further fighting.
examples.zh: 军队将不得不干预以阻止进一步的战斗。

words.definition: something you do in order to punish someone who has harmed or offended you; to punish someone who has done something to harm you or someone else; vengeance, retaliation, revanche; get back on, get even with; right a wrong
words.translation: 报复,复仇；替…报仇；报复；复仇；洗雪；报仇；雪耻

examples.en: The attackers were said to be taking revenge on the 14-year-old, claiming he was a school bully.
examples.zh: 攻击者被称是在报复一名14岁男孩，称他是学校一霸。

words.definition: to make, design, or think of a new type of thing; father, coin
words.translation: 发明,创造;捏造,虚构；发明；创造；虚构

examples.en: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.
examples.zh: 亚历山大 · 格雷厄姆 · 贝尔于1876年发明了电话。

words.definition: a useful machine, tool, instrument etc that has been invented; fiction, contrivance
words.translation: 发明,创造,发明物；[专利]发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能

examples.en: The dishwasher is a wonderful invention.
examples.zh: 洗碗机是一项奇妙的发明。

words.definition: a list of all the things in a place; goods in stock, stock-sheet
words.translation: 详细目录,存货,财产清册,总量；[贸易]存货，存货清单；详细目录；[会计]财产清册

examples.en: ...one inventory of twelve sails for each yacht.
examples.zh: …为每艘游艇配备12张帆的存货。

words.definition: to stop something from happening, or stop someone from doing something; dispute, stem, block; stem, hinder from
words.translation: (from)预防,防止,阻止,制止,妨碍；预防，防止；阻止；妨碍，阻止

examples.en: The rules are intended to prevent accidents.
examples.zh: 这些规定旨在预防事故。

examples.en: We were prevented from entering the site.
examples.zh: 我们被阻止进入现场。

examples.en: Wrap small ornaments in paper to prevent them being damaged.
examples.zh: 把小饰品用纸包上以免损坏。

words.definition: money that a business or organization receives over a period of time, especially from selling goods or services; taxes, income, proceeds, yield
words.translation: 财政收入,税收；税收，国家的收入；[会计]收益

examples.en: advertising revenue
examples.zh: 广告收入

examples.en: Strikes have cost £20 million in lost revenues .
examples.zh: 罢工造成的收入损失达到2,000万英镑。

words.definition: to let fresh air into a room, building etc; air, bill
words.translation: 使通风;给…装通风设备；使通风；给…装通风设备；宣布

examples.en: Both patients are sedated and ventilated.
examples.zh: 两位病人都用了镇静剂和呼吸机。

words.definition: to go somewhere that could be dangerous; a new business activity that involves taking risks; dare to, be bold to; adventure, take a risk; enterprise, risk, undertaking, throw
words.translation: 冒险,拼;大胆表示；冒险事业,拼,闯；敢于；冒险；投机；企业；风险

examples.en: When darkness fell, he would venture out.
examples.zh: 天黑以后，他就会壮着胆子出去。

examples.en: She paused before venturing up the steps to the door.
examples.zh: 她犹豫了一下，大着胆子迈上台阶，走向门口。

examples.en: children who lack the confidence to venture into libraries
examples.zh: 缺乏自信、不敢进图书馆的儿童

words.definition: before something happens or is expected to happen; to move towards someone or something, especially in a slow and determined way – used especially to talk about soldiers; development, growth, making, progress, increase; introduce, present, prefer, file, put in; go ahead, move ahead; up-front, prevenient
words.translation: 前进，预付；前进，进展；促进，推进；发展；前进；增长；[会计]预付款；提出；预付；使……前进；将……提前；进展；上涨；预先的；先行的

examples.en: I should warn you in advance that I’m not a very good dancer.
examples.zh: 我要先提醒你，我跳舞不是很好。

examples.en: Many thanks, in advance, for your help.
examples.zh: 对你的帮助预先表示万分感谢。

examples.en: Could you distribute copies well in advance of the meeting?
examples.zh: 开会前把复印件早早分发下去，好吗？

words.definition: something that helps you to be more successful than others, or the state of having this; behalf, superiority, asset, benefit, edge; gain, make a profit; favor of, be conducive to
words.translation: 优点，长处，有利条件；利益，好处；优势；[经]利益；有利条件；获利；有利于；使处于优势

examples.en: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (=  have an advantage  ) when applying for jobs.
examples.zh: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

examples.en: It might be to your advantage (=  it might help you  ) to take a computer course of some kind.
examples.zh: 上一门计算机课程可能对你有利。

words.definition: a vehicle used especially for carrying goods, which is smaller than a truck and has a roof and usually no windows at the sides; vanguard, pioneer
words.translation: 有篷汽车;有篷货运车厢；先锋；厢式货车；增值网

examples.en: a delivery van
examples.zh: 运货车

examples.en: a van driver
examples.zh: 小型货车司机

words.definition: to disappear suddenly, especially in a way that cannot be easily explained; disappear, blank; unmake
words.translation: 突然不见;消失；[数]消失；突然不见；成为零；使不见，[数]使消失

examples.en: My keys were here a minute ago but now they’ve vanished.
examples.zh: 我的钥匙刚刚还在这里，现在却不翼而飞了。

examples.en: The bird vanished from sight.
examples.zh: 那只鸟从视线中消失了。

examples.en: She seemed to have just vanished into thin air (= suddenly disappeared in a very mysterious way ).
examples.zh: 她好像就蒸发了似的。

words.definition: too much pride in yourself, so that you are always thinking about yourself and your appearance; blank, mud
words.translation: 虚荣心,浮华；虚荣心；空虚；浮华；无价值的东西

examples.en: Sabrina had none of the vanity so often associated with beautiful women.
examples.zh: 萨布里娜没有一点漂亮女人经常会有的那种虚荣。

words.definition: to avoid talking about something, especially because you are trying to hide something; get out of, elude; escape, get out of
words.translation: 逃避，回避；避开，躲避；逃避；规避；逃脱

examples.en: I could tell that he was trying to evade the issue.
examples.zh: 我看得出他在极力回避这个问题。

examples.en: The minister evaded the question.
examples.zh: 部长回避了那个问题。

words.definition: to enter a country, town, or area using military force, in order to take control of it; strike, make inroads into; make inroads into, intrude upon
words.translation: 入侵,侵略,侵袭,侵扰；侵略；侵袭；侵扰；涌入；侵入；侵犯

examples.en: The Romans invaded Britain 2,000 years ago.
examples.zh: 2,000年前古罗马人入侵了英国。

words.definition: when the army of one country enters another country by force, in order to take control of it; violence, aggression, infringement
words.translation: 入侵,侵略,侵犯；入侵，侵略；[医]侵袭；侵犯

examples.en: ...seven years after the Roman invasion of Britain.
examples.zh: …罗马人入侵大不列颠岛之后的7年。

words.definition: a set of lines that forms one part of a song, poem, or a book such as the Bible or the Koran; poetry, poem
words.translation: 韵文,诗;诗节,诗句；诗，诗篇；韵文；诗节

examples.en: Let’s sing the last verse again.
examples.zh: 我们把最后一节再唱一遍吧。

examples.en: Learn the first two verses of the poem by heart.
examples.zh: 把这首诗的头两节背下来。

examples.en: Genesis chapter 3, verse 13
examples.zh: 《创世记》第3章第13节

words.definition: a word that adds to the meaning of a verb, an adjective, another adverb, or a whole sentence, such as ‘slowly’ in ‘He ran slowly’, ‘very’ in ‘It’s very hot’, or ‘naturally’ in ‘Naturally, we want you to come.’
words.translation: 副词；副词的

examples.en: Will you please compare the adverb “well”?
examples.zh: 请你说出副词“well”的原级、比较级和最高级好吗?

examples.en: In the class, the professor taught the students how to use an adverb in the sentence.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，教授教学生们如何在一个句子里用副词。

examples.en: For our purposes, we get the definition of a word as well as its pronunciation and type (for example, adjective, noun, verb, adverb).
examples.zh: 我们这里只涉及到词汇的定义、音标和词性（如形容词、名词、动词、副词等）。

words.definition: not good or favourable; against, contrary, opposite, counter, cross
words.translation: 逆的，相反的；敌对的；不利的；有害的；相反的；[植]敌对的（名词adverseness，副词adversely）

examples.en: They fear it could have an adverse effect on global financial markets.
examples.zh: 他们担心这会对全球金融市场产生不利影响。

examples.en: Miller’s campaign has received a good deal of adverse publicity .
examples.zh: 米勒的竞选活动招来许多负面报道。

words.definition: to tell the public about a product or service in order to persuade them to buy it; message, instruct
words.translation: 公告，公布；为...做广告；登广告；通知；为…做广告；使突出

examples.en: They no longer advertise alcohol or cigarettes at sporting events.
examples.zh: 他们不再在体育赛事上做烟酒广告了。

examples.en: Colleges and universities have found that it pays to advertise (=  advertising brings good results  ) .
examples.zh: 大专院校发现做广告效果很好。

words.definition: a date on which something special or important happened in a previous year
words.translation: 周年，周年纪念日

examples.en: Jack and Kim celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary in January.
examples.zh: 1月，杰克和金庆祝了他们的结婚20周年纪念日。

words.definition: the amount calculated by adding together several quantities, and then dividing this amount by the total number of quantities; the average amount is the amount you get when you add together several quantities and divide this by the total number of quantities; to usually do something or usually happen a particular number of times, or to usually be a particular size or amount; evenness, typical value; mean, ordinary, general
words.translation: 平均,平均数；平均的；普通的；平均；[数]平均数；[保险]海损；[数]平均的

examples.en: The December figures brought the annual average for 2001 up to 10.6 per cent.
examples.zh: 12月的数据将2001年的年平均水平提升到10.6%。

words.definition: to prevent something unpleasant from happening; escape, shift, shun
words.translation: 防止，避免；转移(目光、注意力等)；避免，防止；转移

examples.en: The tragedy could have been averted if the crew had followed safety procedures.
examples.zh: 如果乘务人员按照安全规则操作，这场悲剧是可以避免的。

words.definition: drink, belly-wash, bevvy
words.translation: (水，酒等之外的)饮料；饮料

examples.en: Beer is a beverage of the remotest time.
examples.zh: 啤酒是一种最古老的饮料。

examples.en: And not only food: frequently there must be a beverage.
examples.zh: 而且不仅仅为了食物，还常常必须有饮料。

examples.en: In this case, you want to provide the user with a way to say the desired beverage.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，您想为用户提供一种方法，让他们说出自己想要的饮料。

words.definition: causing a lot of disagreement, because many people have strong opinions about the subject being discussed; disputed, questioned
words.translation: 引起争论的,有争议的；有争议的；有争论的

examples.en: the controversial issue of welfare reform
examples.zh: 福利改革这一有争议的话题

examples.en: a highly controversial (= very controversial ) plan to flood the valley in order to build a dam
examples.zh: 一个把山谷淹掉来建造水坝的极具争议的计划

examples.en: He is a controversial figure (= person who does controversial things ) in the art world.
examples.zh: 他是艺术界极具争议的人物。

words.definition: a serious argument about something that involves many people and continues for a long time; combat, debate, dispute
words.translation: 争论，辩论，争吵；争论；论战；辩论

examples.en: a political controversy
examples.zh: 政治争议

examples.en: the controversy surrounding Skinner’s theories
examples.zh: 围绕斯金纳的理论的争议

examples.en: (= began ) over the use of the chemicals on crops.
examples.zh: 对庄稼施用化学品的做法引起了争论。

words.definition: an informal talk in which people exchange news, feelings, and thoughts; congress, dialog
words.translation: 会话,谈话；交谈；会话；社交

examples.en: a telephone conversation
examples.zh: 电话交谈

examples.en: Children quickly get bored by adult conversation.
examples.zh: 儿童对成年人的谈话很快就会厌倦。

examples.en: They had a short conversation in German and seemed to be disagreeing about something.
examples.zh: 他们用德语说了一会儿，好像对什么事有分歧。

words.definition: used when one situation is the opposite of another; contrary, counter, backward, inversely
words.translation: 相反地

examples.en: American consumers prefer white eggs; conversely, British buyers like brown eggs.
examples.zh: 美国的消费者喜欢白色的鸡蛋，而英国的消费者却相反，他们喜欢棕色的鸡蛋。

words.definition: when you change something from one form, purpose, or system to a different one; transformation, reforming, switching, exchange, changing
words.translation: 转变，转换；信仰的改变；转换；变换；[金融]兑换；改变信仰

examples.en: ...the conversion of disused rail lines into cycle routes.
examples.zh: …把废弃的铁路改变成自行车道。

words.definition: to change to a different set of ideas, principles, or ways of doing something; transform, shift; idolater, proselytizer
words.translation: 变换,转换；改变（信仰等）；兑换（钱）；转变，变换；皈依；改变信仰；皈依者；改变宗教信仰者

examples.en: The signal will be converted into digital code.
examples.zh: 信号将被转变成数字编码。

words.definition: very different from each other; different, unlike, varying, another, dissimilar
words.translation: 多种多样的,(from)不同的；不同的；多种多样的；变化多的

examples.en: subjects as diverse as pop music and archaeology
examples.zh: 像流行音乐和考古学这样各不相同的学科

words.definition: a change in the direction or use of something, or the act of changing it; entertainment, transfer, occupation, recreation, metastasis
words.translation: 转向,转移;牵制;解闷;娱乐；转移；消遣；分散注意力

examples.zh: …销售秘密武器所得收益的非法转移。

words.definition: to change the direction in which something travels; shift, distract from; transfer, metastasize
words.translation: 使转向，使改道；转移(注意力)；使娱乐；转移；使…欢娱；使…转向

examples.en: The high street is closed and traffic is being diverted .
examples.zh: 大街封闭，车辆正改道而行。

words.definition: if there is an inverse relationship between two amounts, one gets bigger at the same rate as the other gets smaller; the complete opposite of something; contrary, backdraft; contrary, opposite, adverse, counter, cross; topsy-turvy
words.translation: 相反的,倒转的,反转的；相反之物；倒转；相反；[电]相反的；倒转的；使倒转；使颠倒

examples.en: Clearly, the amount of money people save increases in inverse proportion to the amount they spend.
examples.zh: 显然，人们储蓄的增加与消费成反比。

examples.en: the inverse relationship between prices and interest rates
examples.zh: 价格和利率之间的反比关系

words.definition: to put something in the opposite position to the one it was in before, especially by turning it upside down (= the bottom is on the top and the top is on the bottom ); coup
words.translation: 倒置,倒转,颠倒；使…转化；使…颠倒；使…反转；使…前后倒置

examples.zh: 把蛋糕倒扣过来放到一个盘子上。

words.definition: the exact opposite of what has just been mentioned; the opposite order etc to what is usual or to what has just been stated; if a vehicle or its driver reverses, they go backwards; failure, loss, contrary, losing, defeat; bottom up, head over heels; upside-down, perversive; retrogress, step backward
words.translation: 相反;背面；相反的；颠倒,倒转；相反；背面；倒退；失败；颠倒；倒转；反面的；颠倒的；逆叫

examples.en: I owe you nothing. If anything, the reverse is true (= you owe me ) .
examples.zh: 我不欠你什么。 如果说欠的话，是你欠我才对。

words.definition: to shake slightly because you are cold or frightened; chip, debris; quake, judder; quaver, to break up
words.translation: 战栗,发抖；颤抖，战栗；碎片；颤抖；哆嗦；打碎

examples.zh: 大冷天里，杰克站着冻得瑟瑟发抖。

words.definition: plata, argentum; lunar, argentic
words.translation: 银;银器;银币；镀银；[化学]银；银器；银币；银质奖章；餐具；银灰色；银的；含银的；有银色光泽的；口才流利的；第二十五周年的婚姻

examples.en: The silver spoon tarnished.
examples.zh: 银匙失去光泽了。

examples.en: Her teeth were capped with silver.
examples.zh: 她的牙齿是包了银的。

examples.en: The workers parted gold from silver in the workshop.
examples.zh: 在车间里工人们把金子从银子中提炼出来。

words.definition: involving everyone in the world or in a particular group; widespread, entire, corporate, worldwide, current; general concept
words.translation: 普遍的,全体的,通用的;宇宙的,世界的；普遍的；通用的；[天]宇宙的；全世界的；全体的；一般概念；普通性

examples.en: free universal healthcare
examples.zh: 免费的全民保健制度

examples.en: These stories have universal appeal.
examples.zh: 这些故事人人都喜欢。

examples.en: a topic of universal interest
examples.zh: 人们普遍感兴趣的一个话题

words.definition: all space, including all the stars and planets; world, domain, province, territory, kingdom
words.translation: 宇宙,万物；[天]宇宙；世界；领域

examples.en: Einstein's equations showed the universe to be expanding.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦的方程式表明宇宙正在扩大。

words.definition: an educational institution at the highest level, where you study for a degree; college, campus
words.translation: (综合)大学；大学；综合性大学；大学校舍

examples.en: He teaches Esperanto at that university.
examples.zh: 他在那所大学教世界语。

examples.en: She buddied up with a student from another university.
examples.zh: 她与来自另一大学的一名学生交朋友。

examples.en: The student left the university to go out into the world and find himself.
examples.zh: 这个学生离开了大学进入社会去发现自己的才能所在。

words.definition: a word or group of words that describes an action, experience, or state, such as ‘come’, ‘see’, and ‘put on’; rhematic
words.translation: 动词；[语]动词的；有动词性质的；起动词作用的

examples.en: The German verb is postponed.
examples.zh: 德语动词放在句末。

examples.en: The word is compounded of a preposition and a verb.
examples.zh: 这个词是由一个介词和一个动词复合而成的。

examples.en: The verb agrees with its subject in number and person.
examples.zh: 动词的数和人称与主语一致。

words.definition: spoken rather than written; oral, spoken
words.translation: 用言辞的,用文字的;口头的;动词的；口头的；言语的；动词的；照字面的

examples.en: verbal skills
examples.zh: 语言技能

words.definition: the edge of a road, path etc; to be near (to); go on for, come close to; margin, brink, suburb, beaded edge
words.translation: 边,边缘；濒临；濒临，接近；处在边缘；边缘

examples.en: The car skidded across the road and came to a stop on the grass verge.
examples.zh: 汽车滑过路面，在路缘草带上停了下来。

examples.en: to verge on chaos

words.definition: to state that something is true; touch bottom, check on
words.translation: 证实,查证;证明；核实；查证

examples.en: His statement was verified by several witnesses.
examples.zh: 他的说法得到了几位证人的证实。

words.definition: someone who is versatile has many different skills; universal, current, utility
words.translation: 通用的;多才多艺的,多方面的；多才多艺的；通用的，万能的；多面手的

examples.en: a very versatile performer
examples.zh: 多才多艺的表演者

examples.en: a more versatile workforce
examples.zh: 技术更全面的劳动力

words.definition: a copy of something that has been changed so that it is slightly different; edition, translation
words.translation: 版本;译本,译文;说法；[计]版本；[图情]译文；倒转术

examples.en: the human version of mad cow disease
examples.zh: 疯牛病的人类变体

words.definition: used to show that two people or teams are competing against each other in a game or court case; in the teeth of
words.translation: (vs.)…对…(在诉讼,比赛等);与…相对；对；与...相对；对抗

examples.en: the New York Knicks versus the LA Lakers
examples.zh: 纽约尼克斯队对洛杉矶湖人队

examples.en: the Supreme Court decision in Roe vs. Wade
examples.zh: 最高法院关于罗诉韦德案的判决

words.definition: pointing up in a line that forms an angle of 90˚ with a flat surface; the direction of something that is vertical; standing, perpendicular; perpendicular plane, perpendicular line
words.translation: 垂直的,竖的；垂线；[测]垂直的，直立的；[解剖][天]头顶的，顶点的；[数]垂直线，垂直面

examples.en: a vertical line
examples.zh: 垂直线

examples.en: the vertical axis of a graph
examples.zh: 图的纵轴

examples.en: vertical window blinds
examples.zh: 垂直百叶窗

words.definition: used to emphasize an adjective, adverb, or phrase; used to emphasize that you are talking exactly about one particular thing or person; typical, characteristic, proper, own; badly, extremely, greatly, highly, too
words.translation: 很，非常；完全；正是的；真正，真实的；恰好是，正是；甚至；十足的；特有的；非常，很

examples.en: It feels very cold today.
examples.zh: 今天很冷。

examples.en: The fishing industry is very important to the area.
examples.zh: 捕鱼业对于该地区非常重要。

examples.en: The traffic’s moving very slowly this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上车流非常缓慢。

words.definition: a mountain with a large hole at the top, through which lava(= very hot liquid rock ) is sometimes forced out
words.translation: 火山

examples.en: Pompeii was destroyed when the volcano erupted in 79 AD.
examples.zh: 庞贝城于公元79年在火山爆发中毁灭。

words.definition: the amount of sound produced by a television, radio etc; lots of, wealth, ocean, sea, bulk; massive, extensive, substantial, macro, much
words.translation: 容积,体积;卷,册;音量；量；[物]体积；[计]卷；音量；大量；[图情]册；大量的

examples.en: The volume of the container measures 10,000 cubic metres.
examples.zh: 这个容器的容量是1万立方米。

words.definition: done willingly and without being forced; autonomous, willing, studied, designed, intended
words.translation: 自愿的,志愿的；自愿的；志愿的；自发的；故意的

examples.en: Workers are being encouraged to take voluntary redundancy.
examples.zh: 工人被鼓励主动离职。

words.definition: If you volunteer information, you tell someone something without being asked
words.translation: 自愿(者,兵);自愿(提供)

examples.en: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information.
examples.zh: 房间里很安静；没有人主动提供更多的信息。

examples.en: "They were both great supporters of Franco," Ryle volunteered.
examples.zh: “他们俩都是佛朗哥的坚定支持者，”赖尔主动说道。

words.definition: the scientific idea that plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time; unfolding, Monkey to Man
words.translation: 进化,演变,发展,进展；演变；[进化]进化论；进展

examples.en: the theory of evolution
examples.zh: 进化论

words.definition: if an animal or plant evolves, it changes gradually over a long period of time; go way, to develop; grow, expand, advance
words.translation: (使)发展;(使)进化;(使)进展；发展，进化；进化；使逐步形成；推断出；发展，进展；逐步形成

examples.en: Animals have evolved camouflage to protect themselves from predators.
examples.zh: 动物进化形成了伪装，以保护自身不被捕食性动物所捕食。

words.definition: if an activity or situation involves something, that thing is part of it or a result of it; contain, comprise
words.translation: 卷入,陷入,连累;包含,含有,涉及；包含；牵涉；使陷于；潜心于

examples.en: What will the job involve?
examples.zh: 这份工作包括什么？

examples.en: I didn’t realize putting on a play involved so much work.
examples.zh: 我没想到上演一出戏剧需要做这么多的工作。

words.definition: a refusal to accept someone’s authority or obey rules or laws; strive against, come out against; sicken; resistance, hate, rebellion
words.translation: 反抗,起义；反抗；反叛；反感，厌恶；使反感；使恶心；叛乱；反感

examples.en: The prime minister is now facing a revolt by members of his own party.
examples.zh: 首相现在面临着党内倒戈。

words.definition: a complete change in ways of thinking, methods of working etc; circulation, rotation, rolling, turning, cycle
words.translation: 革命;旋转,转数；革命；[物]旋转；运行；循环

examples.en: the French Revolution of 1789
examples.zh: 1789年法国大革命

words.definition: completely new and different, especially in a way that leads to great improvements; someone who joins in or supports a political or social revolution; rotary, rolling
words.translation: 革命的,革新的；革命者；革命的；旋转的；大变革的

examples.en: The new cancer drug is a revolutionary breakthrough.
examples.zh: 这种抗癌新药是一个革命性突破。

examples.en: a revolutionary new drug
examples.zh: 一种革命性的新药

words.definition: to move around like a wheel, or to make something move around like a wheel; wheel, circle, spin; turn over; rotation, rolling, circulation, turning, cycle
words.translation: (使)旋转;考虑;【天】公转,循环；[物]旋转；循环出现；反复考虑；使…旋转；使…循环；循环；旋转舞台

examples.en: The wheel began to revolve.
examples.zh: 轮子开始旋转。

examples.en: The restaurant slowly revolves, giving excellent views of the city.
examples.zh: 餐厅缓缓旋转，城市美景尽收眼底。

examples.en: Using graphics software, you can revolve the image on the screen.
examples.zh: 使用绘图软件可以旋转屏幕上的图像。

words.definition: the ability to see; sight, imagination, eye, seeing, eyesight; image, envision
words.translation: 视力,视觉;远见;洞察力;幻想,幻影;想象力；[生理][眼科]视力；美景；眼力；幻象；想象力；想象；显现；梦见

examples.en: She suffered temporary loss of vision after being struck on the head.
examples.zh: 她头部受撞击以后出现暂时性失明。

examples.en: Tears blurred her vision (= made it difficult for her to see ).
examples.zh: 泪水模糊了她的视线。

words.definition: something that is advisable should be done in order to avoid problems or risks; suitable, wise, adequate, appropriate, proper
words.translation: 可取的，适当的，明智的；明智的，可取的，适当的

examples.en: Regular medical check-ups are advisable.
examples.zh: 定期检查身体是明智的。

examples.en: It is advisable to write a career objective at the start of your resume.
examples.zh: 简历开头最好写上职业目标。

words.definition: to tell someone what you think they should do, especially when you know more than they do about something; alarm, message; agree to sb, make suggestions
words.translation: 忠告，劝告，建议；通知，告知；建议；劝告，忠告；通知；警告；与…商量

examples.en: She needed someone to advise her.
examples.zh: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

examples.en: ‘Make sure that you keep the documents in a safe place,’ Otley advised him.
examples.zh: “一定要把文件放在安全的地方。”奥特利向他建议道。

words.definition: an opinion you give someone about what they should do; suggestion, proposal, information, instance, notice
words.translation: 劝告，忠告，(医生等的)意见；建议；忠告；劝告；通知

examples.en: You should have followed my advice.
examples.zh: 你真该听我的建议。

words.definition: apparatus, installation, strategy, unit, gear
words.translation: 装置,设备,仪表;方法,设计；[机]装置；策略；图案

words.definition: to plan or invent a new way of doing something; design, engineer, style, project, frame; legacy, bequest
words.translation: 设计;发明;图谋;作出(计划);想出(办法)；设计；想出；发明；图谋；遗赠给；遗赠

examples.en: She devised a method for quicker communications between offices.
examples.zh: 她想出一种加快办公室之间通信联络的方法。

words.definition: the act of separating something into two or more different parts, or the way these parts are separated or shared; ministry, department, sector, segmentation, dom
words.translation: 分,分割;部门,科,处;除法;分界线；师（军队）；[管理]部门；分割；[数]除法

examples.en: the traditional division of labour (= the way that particular tasks are shared ) between husband and wife
examples.zh: 夫妻之间传统的分工

words.definition: to think that something is likely to happen in the future; imagine, picture, think of
words.translation: 想象，设想，展望，正视；正视，面对；想像

examples.en: The scheme cost a lot more than we had originally envisaged.
examples.zh: 该计划的花费大大超出了我们最初所预想的数额。

words.definition: something that is invisible cannot be seen; intangible, discarnate, aeriform
words.translation: 看不见的,无形的；无形的，看不见的；无形的；不显眼的，暗藏的

examples.en: The house was surrounded by trees, and invisible from the road.
examples.zh: 这所房子树木环绕，从路上是看不见的。

words.definition: when you provide something that someone needs now or in the future; item, preparation, arrangement, preliminary, do
words.translation: 供应,供应品;预备;条款;(pl.)给养；规定；条款；准备；[经]供应品

examples.en: He made provisions for his wife and his children in his will.
examples.zh: 在遗嘱里他为妻子和孩子都做好了安排。

words.definition: to change something because of new information or ideas; update, edit; to amend; recension, emendation
words.translation: 修订,校订;修正,修改；修正；复习；[印刷]校订；[图情]修订；复习功课

examples.en: The college has revised its plans because of local objections.
examples.zh: 由于地方上的反对，学院已经修改了计划。

examples.en: We have revised our estimates of population growth.
examples.zh: 我们已修正了对人口增长的估计。

words.definition: to be in charge of an activity or person, and make sure that things are done in the correct way; manage, police, conduct, run, direct; direct, charge of
words.translation: 管理,监督；监督，管理；指导

examples.en: Griffiths closely supervised the research.
examples.zh: 格里菲思密切指导该项研究。

words.definition: an official mark put on your passport that gives you permission to temporarily enter or leave a foreign country; vise
words.translation: (护照等的)签证;维萨信用卡；签证

examples.en: I was still in New York, trying to get a visa to visit Russia.
examples.zh: 我仍在纽约，正在办理去俄罗斯的签证。

words.definition: something that is visible can be seen; obvious, distinct, seen, evident
words.translation: 看得见的, 明显的, 显著的；明显的；看得见的；现有的；可得到的

examples.en: The comet is visible to the naked eye (= can be seen without using special equipment ).
examples.zh: 这颗彗星肉眼看得见。

examples.en: Check the plant for any visible signs of disease.
examples.zh: 检查一下植物是否有患病的迹象。

words.definition: an occasion when someone goes to spend time in a place or goes to see a person; to go and spend time in a place or with someone, especially for pleasure or interest; stay, call, stop, addressing; inspect, pay a call; stay, pay a call
words.translation: 访问,参观；访问,参观;视察;降临;闲谈；访问；参观；逗留；视察；暂住；闲谈

examples.en: We’re just here on a short visit.
examples.zh: 我们只在这儿作短暂逗留。

examples.en: Why don’t you come for a visit this summer?
examples.zh: 你们何不今年夏天来这里做客呢？

examples.en: I decided to pay him a visit at his office.
examples.zh: 我决定去他的办公室拜访他。

words.definition: someone who comes to visit a place or a person; transient, fetcher
words.translation: 访问者,客人,来宾,参观者；访问者，参观者；视察者；候鸟

examples.en: Times Square attracts more than 30 million visitors annually.
examples.zh: 时代广场每年吸引三千多万游客。

words.definition: relating to seeing; optical, Life-like
words.translation: 看的,看得见的;视觉的；[眼科][生理]视觉的，视力的；栩栩如生的

examples.en: Artists translate their ideas into visual images.
examples.zh: 画家把自己的思想转换成视觉画面。

examples.en: The tall tower adds to the visual impact of the building.
examples.zh: 高高的塔楼增强了这幢大楼的视觉效果。

words.definition: certain to happen and impossible to avoid; certain, necessary, automatic
words.translation: 不可避免的,必然发生的；必然的，不可避免的

examples.en: A further escalation of the crisis now seems inevitable.
examples.zh: 危机的进一步升级现在看来已不可避免。

words.definition: a written or spoken request to someone, inviting them to go somewhere or do something; calling, temptation
words.translation: 邀请,招待;请柬；邀请；引诱

examples.en: They were always dropping by, usually without invitation.
examples.zh: 他们常常来串门，通常不请自来。

words.definition: to ask someone to come to a party, wedding, meal etc; serve, attend, ask, court, guest; calling, invitation to
words.translation: 邀请,招待；邀请，招待；招致；邀请

examples.en: I’m afraid I wasn’t invited.
examples.zh: 恐怕我没有受到邀请。

words.definition: the signs that show someone is alive, for example breathing and body temperature; dynamic, life-or-death
words.translation: 生死攸关的,重大的;生命的,生机的；至关重要的；生死攸关的；有活力的

examples.en: The work she does is absolutely vital.
examples.zh: 她所做的工作至关重要。

words.definition: if something divides, or if you divide it, it separates into two or more parts; distribute, part; differ, come between; shed, watershed
words.translation: 分,划分,分开;分配;(by)除；划分；除；分开；使产生分歧；意见分歧；[地理]分水岭，分水线

examples.zh: 锻炼对身体的好处可以分成3个方面。

words.definition: a part of a company’s profit that is divided among the people with  share s  in the company; bonus, stake
words.translation: 红利，股息；回报，效益；被除数；股息；[数]被除数；奖金

examples.en: Good eating habits will pay dividends later on in life.
examples.zh: 保持良好的饮食习惯，将来会受益的。

words.definition: facts or signs that show clearly that something exists or is true; authentication, certification, demonstration, proof, breath; demonstrate, prove, argue, bear witness to
words.translation: 明显;显著;根据;证据;迹象；[法]证据，证明；迹象；明显；证明

examples.en: Murrow’s evidence was enough to convict Hayes of murder.
examples.zh: 默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

words.definition: easy to see, notice, or understand; obvious, distinct, visible
words.translation: 明显的,明白的；明显的；明白的

examples.en: Bob ate his lunch with evident enjoyment.
examples.zh: 显然鲍勃吃午饭吃得津津有味。

words.definition: considered separately from other people or things in the same group; a person, considered separately from the rest of the group or society that they live in; personal, different, subjective, distinct, unique; unity, private person
words.translation: 个人的,单独的;独特的；个人,个体；[经]个人的；个别的；独特的；[经]个人，[生物]个体

examples.en: Each individual leaf on the tree is different.
examples.zh: 树上每片叶子都不相同。

examples.en: the needs of the individual customer
examples.zh: 每位顾客的需求

words.definition: to give something to someone or make it available to them, because they need it or want it; afford, define, regulate, tender, state; take care of, prime
words.translation: 供应,供给,准备,预防,规定；提供；规定；准备；装备；抚养；作准备

examples.en: Tea and biscuits will be provided.
examples.zh: 有茶水和饼干供应。
