words.translation: 倘若,只要,假如；假如；倘若；提供；给予（provide的过去式）

examples.en: He can come with us, provided he pays for his own meals.
examples.zh: 只要他付自己的饭钱，就可以跟我们一起来。

words.definition: a copy of a film or television programme, or a series of events, recorded on videotape; relating to or used in the process of recording and showing pictures on television; television, Vedio; televisual; to produce
words.translation: 电视,视频;录像；电视的,视频的;录像的；[电子]视频；录像，录像机；[电视]电视；[电子][电视]视频的；录像的；电视的；录制

examples.en: Let’s stay at home and watch a video.
examples.zh: 我们待在家里看录像吧。

examples.en: Rewind the video right to the beginning.
examples.zh: 把录像倒退到开头部分。

examples.en: The school will be making a video of the play.
examples.zh: 学校将把这出戏拍摄成录像。

words.definition: vivid memories, dreams, descriptions etc are so clear that they seem real; telling, live, bright
words.translation: 鲜艳的;生动的,栩栩如生的；生动的；鲜明的；鲜艳的

examples.en: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
examples.zh: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

examples.en: He had a vivid picture of her in his mind.
examples.zh: 他的脑海中清晰地留着她的形象。

words.definition: to look again at something you have studied, such as notes, reports etc; an article in a newspaper or magazine that gives an opinion about a new book, play, film etc; comment, retrospection; examine, inspect; look back to, look back on
words.translation: 回顾,复习；回顾,复习;评论；回顾；复习；评论；检讨；检阅；检查；复审；复习功课；写评论

examples.en: a journalist who will review the events of the past six months
examples.zh: 将对过去六个月里所发生的事件进行回顾的记者

words.definition: what you are able to see or whether you can see it; to watch a television programme, film etc; observation, opinion, scenery, scope, comment; watch, study, regard, think of, think about
words.translation: 视野;风景;观察;见解;照片；观察;认为；观察；视野；意见；风景；考虑；查看

examples.en: Fran hit him in full view of all the guests (= where they could see it clearly ).
examples.zh: 弗兰当着所有宾客的面打了他。

examples.en: During an eclipse, the moon blocks our view of the sun (= stop us from seeing it ).
examples.zh: 日蚀的时候，月亮遮挡住了太阳。

words.definition: a particular way of thinking about a problem or subject; perspective, outlook, eye, perception, sentiment
words.translation: 观点；[计]观点，看法；视角

examples.en: Different viewpoints produce different images.
examples.zh: 角度不同，产生的画面也不同。

words.definition: to become healthy and strong again, or to make someone or something healthy and strong again; come back to life again, resurge; recall, reinvigorate
words.translation: 恢复;(使)复苏；复兴；复活；苏醒；恢复精神；使复兴；使苏醒；回想起；重演，重播

examples.en: The economy is beginning to revive.
examples.zh: 经济开始复苏。

examples.en: an attempt to revive the steel industry
examples.zh: 复苏钢铁工业的努力

examples.en: The doctors revived her with injections of glucose.
examples.zh: 医生给她注射葡萄糖，使她苏醒过来。

words.definition: the state of continuing to live or exist; remanet, leavings
words.translation: 幸存,生存;幸存者,残存物；幸存，残存；幸存者，残存物

examples.en: The doctors gave him a one in ten chance of survival .
examples.zh: 医生说他有十分之一的生存希望。

examples.en: A lot of small companies are having to fight for survival (= work hard in order to continue to exist ) .
examples.zh: 很多小公司不得不挣扎求生。

words.definition: If a person or living thing survives in a dangerous situation such as an accident or an illness, they do not die
words.translation: 幸免于,幸存;比…长命

examples.en: ...the sequence of events that left the eight pupils battling to survive in icy seas for over four hours.
examples.zh: …使4名小学生在冰冷的海洋中挣扎求生超过4个小时的一连串事件。

examples.en: Those organisms that are most suited to the environment will be those that will survive.
examples.zh: 那些最适应环境的生物将是那些存活下来的。

examples.en: He had survived heart bypass surgery.
examples.zh: 他在心脏搭桥手术中活了下来。

words.definition: strong and healthy; male, live, energetic, mighty
words.translation: 朝气蓬勃的,精力旺盛的；有力的；精力充沛的

examples.en: a vigorous young man
examples.zh: 精力充沛的年轻男子

words.definition: the sounds that you make when you speak, or the ability to make these sounds; organ, sound, dream, throat; put, to express
words.translation: 声音;嗓音;发音能力;意见,发言权;语态；[声]声音；嗓音；发言权；愿望；表达；吐露

examples.en: He recognized her voice instantly.
examples.zh: 他立刻听出了她的声音。

examples.en: I could hear angry voices.
examples.zh: 我听到了愤怒的声音。

words.definition: a contract or official agreement that is void is not legal and has no effect; empty, hollow, useless, bare, vacant; vacuum, room, clearance, blank, emptiness; invalidate, nullify
words.translation: 空虚的;没有的;无效的；空的；无效的；无人的；空虚；空间；空隙；使无效；排放

examples.en: Her eyes were void of all expression.
examples.zh: 她的眼神一片茫然。

words.definition: to prevent something bad from happening; eliminate, escape, shun
words.translation: 防止，避免；逃避，避开；避免；避开，躲避；消除

examples.en: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
examples.zh: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

examples.en: It is important to take measures to avoid the risk of fire.
examples.zh: 采取措施避免火灾风险很重要。

examples.en: Alan narrowly avoided an accident.
examples.zh: 艾伦险出事故。

words.definition: a situation in which you win a battle, game, election, or dispute; success, prosperity, win, hit
words.translation: 胜利；成功；克服

examples.en: Union leaders are heading for victory in their battle over workplace rights.
examples.zh: 工会领袖们在争取工作场所权利的斗争中正迈向胜利。

words.definition: to prove or officially announce that someone is guilty of a crime after a  trial  in a law court; someone who has been proved to be guilty of a crime and sent to prison; criminal offender, culprit
words.translation: (经审讯)证明…有罪,宣判…有罪；囚犯；罪犯

examples.en: a convicted murderer
examples.zh: 已定罪的谋杀犯

words.definition: the feeling of being sure about something and having no doubts; assurance, damningness
words.translation: 深信,确信；定罪，判罪；定罪；确信；证明有罪

examples.en: It was a reasonable explanation, but his voice lacked conviction .
examples.zh: 这解释合情合理，只是他的语气不坚定。

examples.en: It took her so much effort to speak that what she said carried great conviction (= showed she felt sure of what she said ) .
examples.zh: 她费了很大的劲在说，因此说出来的话显得很确定。

words.definition: someone who publicly supports someone or something; to publicly support a particular way of doing something; maintain, submit; prophet, supporter
words.translation: 辩护者，拥护者，鼓吹者；拥护，提倡；提倡，主张，拥护；提倡者；支持者；律师

examples.en: Extremists were openly advocating violence.
examples.zh: 极端主义者公开鼓吹使用暴力。

words.definition: all the words that someone knows or uses; lexis
words.translation: 词汇,词汇量;词汇表；[语]词汇；词表

examples.en: Teachers were impressed by his vocabulary.
examples.zh: 他的词汇量给老师们留下了深刻的印象。

words.definition: relating to the voice or to singing; audio, sonic; vowel
words.translation: 声音的;有声的;歌唱的；元音;声乐作品；歌唱的；声音的，有声的；声乐作品；元音

examples.en: vocal music
examples.zh: 声乐

examples.en: Allison’s vocal style is influenced by country and blues music.
examples.zh: 艾利森的演唱风格受到乡村音乐和布鲁斯音乐的影响。

examples.en: a female vocal group
examples.zh: 女子歌唱组合

words.definition: a strong belief that you have been chosen by God to be a priest or a nun; profession, employment, career, calling, pursuit, occupation
words.translation: 职业;召唤;天命;天职;才能；[劳经]职业；天职；天命；神召

examples.en: Her vocation is her work as an actress.
examples.zh: 她适合的职业就是当演员。

words.definition: to produce a strong feeling or memory in someone; earn, attract, cause, produce, occasion
words.translation: 唤起(回忆、感情等)；引起；引起，唤起；博得

examples.en: The photographs evoked strong memories of our holidays in France.
examples.zh: 那些照片勾起了我们到法国度假的深刻回忆。

examples.en: His appearance is bound to evoke sympathy.
examples.zh: 他的外表肯定会引起人们的同情。

examples.en: Her speech evoked a hostile response.
examples.zh: 她的讲话引起了敌对的反应。

words.definition: fan, egg, anger
words.translation: 挑动;激发;招惹；驱使；激怒；煽动；惹起

examples.en: The dog would not have attacked if it hadn’t been provoked.
examples.zh: 如果不是被惹恼了，那狗原本不会攻击的。

words.definition: part of a piece of writing which starts on a new line and contains at least one sentence
words.translation: 段落；短评；段落符号；将…分段

examples.en: the opening paragraphs of the novel
examples.zh: 小说开篇的几个段落

words.definition: the power to affect the way someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks, without using direct force or orders; to affect the way someone or something develops, behaves, thinks etc without directly forcing or ordering them; effect, infection, impression, affection, incidence; affect, impact of, impact on, reach, fashion
words.translation: 影响；势力；感化；有影响的人或事；改变

examples.en: As a scientist, his influence was immense.
examples.zh: 身为一名科学家，他的影响力极大。

words.definition: knowledge about the world, especially based on examining, testing, and proving facts; technology, mechanics, skill, knowledge, discipline
words.translation: 科学；技术；学科；理科

examples.en: Many leading scientists do not consider that science can give absolutely reliable knowledge.
examples.zh: 许多杰出科学家都不认为科学能够提供绝对可靠的知识。

examples.en: the founder of modern science, Isaac Newton
examples.zh: 现代科学创始人艾萨克·牛顿

examples.en: developments in science and technology
examples.zh: 科学技术的发展

words.definition: one of the 100-year periods measured from before or after the year of Christ’s birth
words.translation: 世纪，百年；（板球）一百分

examples.en: the story of life on a small farm at the turn of the century
examples.zh: 讲述世纪初一个小农场生活的故事

words.definition: continuous feelings of worry about your work or personal life, that prevent you from relaxing; to emphasize a statement, fact, or idea; pressure, significance, intensity, heat, tension; emphasize, tension, highlight
words.translation: 压力；强调；紧张；重要性；重读；使紧张；加压力于；用重音读

examples.en: Your headaches are due to stress.
examples.zh: 你的头痛是压力造成的。

examples.en: Janet’s been under a lot of stress since her mother’s illness.
examples.zh: 珍妮特自从母亲生病以来承受了很大的压力。

examples.en: all the stresses of public life
examples.zh: 公众生活的所有压力

words.definition: the ability or right to control people or events; to supply power to a vehicle or machine; clothes which you wear at work to make you look important or confident; strength, ability, competence, regime, force; stimulate, bestir; make good time
words.translation: 力量，能力；电力，功率；政权，势力；[数] 幂；激励；供以动力；使…有力量；借影响有权势人物以操纵权力的；[物]功率；力量；能力；政权；势力；[数]幂；快速前进

examples.en: They seized power in a military coup.
examples.zh: 他们在一场军事政变中夺取了政权。

words.definition: related to a whole nation as opposed to any of its parts; someone who is a citizen of a particular country but is living in another country; state, natl; subject
words.translation: 国家的；国民的；民族的；国立的；国民

examples.en: Religion matters very much at a national level.
examples.zh: 宗教事务在全国都非常重要。

examples.en: Between 1929 and 1933 America’s national income fell by more than half.
examples.zh: 1929至1933年间，美国的国民收入下降过半。

examples.en: There are strong indications that the Prime Minister will call national elections in May.
examples.zh: 有明显迹象预示首相将于5月召集全国大选。

words.definition: an illegal substance such as  marijuana  or  cocaine  , which some people take in order to feel happy, relaxed, or excited; to give a person or animal a drug, especially in order to make them feel tired or go to sleep, or to make them perform well in a race; medicine, pharmacon; hit the pipe, hop up
words.translation: 药；毒品；麻醉药；滞销货；使服麻醉药；使服毒品；掺麻醉药于；[药]药；吸毒

examples.en: A lot of young people start taking drugs at school.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人上学时开始吸毒。

examples.en: She always looks as though she’s on drugs (= taking drugs ) .
examples.zh: 她总是看上去一副吸过毒的样子。

examples.en: Jimi Hendrix died of a drug overdose.
examples.zh: 吉米·亨德里克斯死于吸毒过量。

words.definition: several people or things that are all together in the same place; organization, community, team, body, suit; converge, polymerise
words.translation: 组；团体；群的；团体的；聚合

examples.en: A group of us are going to London.
examples.zh: 我们有一群人要去伦敦。

words.definition: a part of an area of activity, especially of business, trade etc; ministry, division, department
words.translation: 部门；扇形，扇区；象限仪；函数尺；把…分成扇形

examples.en: ...the nation's manufacturing sector.
examples.zh: …该国的制造部门。

words.definition: the official system for providing something, especially something that everyone in a country needs to have, or the official organization that provides it; if someone services a machine or vehicle, they examine it and do what is needed to keep it working well; ceremony, waiting; durable, wearproof; maintain, unkeep
words.translation: 服务，服侍；服役；仪式；服务性的；耐用的；服现役的；维修，检修；保养；维修，[计]检修

examples.en: the health service
examples.zh: 医疗保健服务

examples.en: the postal service
examples.zh: 邮政服务

examples.en: the police service
examples.zh: 警察部门

words.definition: to try to find someone or something by looking very carefully; an attempt to find someone or something; probe, examine, research; seek, examine, survey, research, fish; inquiry, exploration
words.translation: 搜寻；调查；探求；探究，查究；[计][航][水运]搜索；搜查

examples.en: It was too dark to search further.
examples.zh: 天太暗，无法继续寻找。

examples.en: The area was thoroughly searched .
examples.zh: 这一地区已被彻底搜查过。

examples.en: I’ve searched high and low (= everywhere ) for my glasses.
examples.zh: 我到处找我的眼镜。

words.definition: knowledge or skill that you gain from doing a job or activity, or the process of doing this; if you experience a problem, event, or situation, it happens to you or affects you; areer; suffer, live, undergo
words.translation: 经验；经历；体验

examples.en: The advice in the booklet reflects the practical experience we have gained (= experience gained by actually doing something, rather than knowledge from books etc ).
examples.zh: 小册子中的建议反映了我们所获得的实践经验。

examples.en: I had some experience in fashion design.
examples.zh: 我有一些时装设计方面的经验。

examples.en: She was turned down on the grounds of lack of experience.
examples.zh: 她因缺乏经验而被拒绝。

words.definition: to need something; lack, exact, desire, order, command
words.translation: 需要；要求；命令

examples.en: Campbell’s broken leg will probably require surgery.
examples.zh: 坎贝尔的一条腿骨折，可能需要手术。

examples.en: What’s required is a complete reorganization of the system.
examples.zh: 需要做的是彻底整顿整个系统。

examples.en: Most house plants require regular watering.
examples.zh: 大多数室内盆栽植物需要定期浇水。

words.definition: about or related to science, or using its methods; systematic
words.translation: 科学的，系统的

examples.en: We believe in investing in scientific research.
examples.zh: 我们相信科学研究的投资价值。

examples.en: the limits of scientific knowledge
examples.zh: 科学知识的极限

examples.en: decisions based on scientific evidence
examples.zh: 根据科学证据作出的决定

words.definition: when you carefully listen to, look at, or think about someone or something; consideration, thought
words.translation: 注意力；关心；立正！（口令）

examples.en: My attention wasn’t really on the game.
examples.zh: 我的注意力其实不在比赛上。

examples.en: She tried to pay attention to what he was saying.
examples.zh: 她尽量注意听他说话。

examples.en: If you paid more attention in class, you might actually learn something!
examples.zh: 要是你上课更认真些，也许能实实在在地学到些东西！

words.definition: having a lot of influence and therefore changing the way people think and behave; mighty, predominant
words.translation: 有影响的；有势力的；有影响力的人物

examples.en: He had influential friends.
examples.zh: 他有一些有影响力的朋友。

examples.en: a highly influential art magazine
examples.zh: 一本极有影响力的艺术杂志

words.definition: the place where a trial is held, or the people there, especially the judge and the  jury  who examine the evidence and decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty; playfield, banc; invite, secure, spell, incur; woo
words.translation: 法院；球场；朝廷；奉承；招致（失败、危险等）；向…献殷勤；设法获得；[法]法院；求爱

examples.en: It could not be proved in a court of law.
examples.zh: 这无法在法庭上证实。

examples.en: The court case lasted six weeks.
examples.zh: 这场诉讼持续了六个星期。

examples.en: Four people will appear in court today, charged with fraud.
examples.zh: 今天将有四个人因被指控犯有欺诈罪出庭受审。

words.definition: a federal country or system of government consists of a group of states which control their own affairs, but which are also controlled by a single national government which makes decisions on foreign affairs, defence etc; confederal, fed.
words.translation: 联邦的；同盟的；联邦政府的；联邦制的；联邦政府地；(Federal)人名；(英)费德勒尔

examples.en: Switzerland is a federal republic.
examples.zh: 瑞士是一个联邦共和国。

words.definition: used to say that an unpleasant experience has ended and can be forgotten; done, used, or experienced before now; later than a particular time; up to and beyond a person or place, without stopping; old days, foretime; ended, closing, ago, over, back; beyond, over, behind; by
words.translation: 过去；往事；过去的；结束的；越过；晚于；过；经过

examples.en: You mustn’t think about it. It’s all in the past now.
examples.zh: 你千万不要再想那件事，现在一切都过去了。

words.definition: to give playing cards to each of the players in a game; treatment of a particular type that is given or received; afford, allow, extend, deliver, part; manage, debate, cope with; policy, business, trade, truck
words.translation: 处理；给予；分配；发牌；交易；（美）政策；待遇；份量；讨论；对待；做生意；[贸易]交易

examples.en: Whose turn is it to deal?
examples.zh: 轮到谁发牌了？

words.definition: to increase in number, amount, or value; an increase in number, amount, or value; raise, arise, tower, go up, climb; height, occurrence, appearance, emergence, enhancement
words.translation: 上升；增强；起立；高耸；高地；增加；出现

examples.en: The police seem unable to cope with the rising tide of (= large increase in ) car crime.
examples.zh: 面对日益增多的汽车罪案，警方似乎无能为力。

words.definition: your peers are the people who are the same age as you, or who have the same type of job, social class etc; to look very carefully at something, especially because you are having difficulty seeing it; pore, stare at; prince, noble, nobility
words.translation: 贵族；同等的人；同龄人；凝视，盯着看；窥视

examples.en: American children did less well in math than their peers in Japan.
examples.zh: 美国儿童的数学成绩不如日本的同龄儿童。

examples.en: Staff members are trained by their peers.
examples.zh: 员工由同事培训。

words.definition: someone who works or is trained in science
words.translation: 科学家

examples.en: Scientists say they've already collected more data than had been expected.
examples.zh: 科学家们说他们已经搜集到比预期更多的数据。

words.definition: a subject or problem that is often discussed or argued about, especially a social or political matter that affects the interests of a lot of people; if an organization or someone in an official position issues something such as documents or equipment, they give these things to people who need them; question, flux; discharge, exhaust; discharge, shed
words.translation: 问题；流出；期号；发行物；发行，发布；发给；放出，排出；[会计]发行物；[会计]发行，发布；[会计]发行；造成…结果；传下

examples.en: Abortion is a highly controversial issue.
examples.zh: 堕胎是个很有争议的话题。

examples.en: We should raise the issue of discrimination with the council.
examples.zh: 我们应提请市政会讨论歧视的问题。

examples.en: The key issue is whether workers should be classified as ‘employees’.
examples.zh: 关键问题是工人是否应该界定为“雇员”。

words.definition: the possibility that something bad, unpleasant, or dangerous may happen; to put something in a situation in which it could be lost, destroyed, or harmed; venture, throw; hazard
words.translation: 风险；危险；冒险；冒…的危险；[保险]危险

examples.en: It was a risk, sending a letter to my house.
examples.zh: 将信寄到我家是冒险。

words.definition: to arrange for a book, magazine etc to be written, printed, and sold; deliver, post; print, bring out
words.translation: 出版；发表；公布；发行；刊印

examples.en: The first edition was published in 1765.
examples.zh: 第一版于1765年出版。

examples.en: They are publishing the dictionary on CD-ROM.
examples.zh: 那部词典他们将以光盘版的形式推出。

words.definition: when you do a particular thing, often regularly, in order to improve your skill at it; tradition, convention, usage, exercise; exercise, bring to pass; execute, exercise
words.translation: 实践；练习；惯例；实习；实行；[劳经]实习

examples.en: It takes hours of practice to learn to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 学习弹吉他需要长时间的练习。

examples.en: With a little more practice you should be able to pass your test.
examples.zh: 稍微再练一练，你应该能通过考试了。

examples.en: We have choir practice on Tuesday evening.
examples.zh: 星期二晚上我们要练习合唱。

words.definition: what someone or something will do or what will happen to them in the future; likely to happen or exist at a time after the present; tomorrow, prospect; prospective, ulterior
words.translation: 未来；前途；期货；将来时；将来的，未来的

examples.en: The islands should have the right to decide their own future.
examples.zh: 这些岛屿应当有权决定自己的未来。

examples.en: a leader who will shape the organization’s future
examples.zh: 将决定该组织未来的一位领导者

words.definition: the purpose that something has, or the job that someone or something does; If a machine or system is functioning, it is working or operating; action, obligation, fn; exercise one's activity
words.translation: 功能；[数] 函数；职责；盛大的集会；运行；活动；行使职责；[计]功能；[数]函数；[管理]职责

examples.en: The nervous system regulates our bodily functions (= eating, breathing, going to the toilet etc ) .
examples.zh: 神经系统控制着我们身体的功能。

examples.en: Bauhaus architects thought that function was more important than form.
examples.zh: 包豪斯学派的建筑师认为功能重于形式。

examples.en: The authorities say the prison is now functioning normally.
examples.zh: 当局称该监狱现在在正常运转。

words.definition: an attempt to persuade someone by using influence, arguments, or threats; heat, compression force; reduce to, compel
words.translation: 压力；压迫，[物] 压强；迫使；密封；使……增压；[力]压力；压迫，[物]压强

examples.en: They are putting pressure on people to vote yes.
examples.zh: 他们正在向民众施加压力，要求他们投赞成票。

examples.en: You must never give in to pressure .
examples.zh: 你绝不能屈从压力。

words.definition: to move your body so that you are looking in a different direction; a sudden or unexpected change that makes a situation develop in a different way; wheel, roll; shift, roll, screw; variation, shift, change, diversification, mutation
words.translation: 转动，使旋转；转弯；翻过来；兑换；变化；(损害或有益于别人的)行为，举动，举止；转向；转变；转动

examples.en: Ricky turned and walked away.
examples.zh: 里基转身走了。

examples.en: She turned her head in surprise.
examples.zh: 她惊讶地转过头来。

examples.en: Brigitte glared at him, turned on her heel (= turned away suddenly because of anger ) , and stomped out of the room.
examples.zh: 布丽吉特瞪了他一眼，猛地一转身，噔噔噔地走出了房间。

words.definition: to disagree with someone in words, often in an angry way; debate, dispute about; debate, discuss, demonstrate, prove, satisfy
words.translation: 争论，辩论；提出理由；(Argue)人名；(英、法)阿格；辩论，争论；证明；说服

examples.en: We could hear the neighbours arguing.
examples.zh: 我们听到邻居在争吵。

words.definition: to ask someone if they would like to have something, or to hold something out to them so that they can take it; a statement saying that you are willing to do something for someone or give them something; afford, undertake, try, tender, lend; proposal, intention, meaning, will, bid; occur, figure, come out
words.translation: 提供；出价；试图；提议；意图；录取通知书；出现；献祭；求婚

examples.en: A number of groups offer their services free of charge.
examples.zh: 一些团体免费提供服务。

words.definition: to know the meaning of what someone is telling you, or the language that they speak; see, absorb, read, seize, conclude; know, cotton on
words.translation: 理解；懂；获悉；推断；省略；懂得；熟悉

examples.en: She doesn’t understand English.
examples.zh: 她不懂英语。

examples.en: I’m sorry, I don’t understand. Can yon explain that again?
examples.zh: 对不起，我不明白。你能再解释一遍吗？

examples.en: The woman had a strong accent, and I couldn’t understand what she was saying.
examples.zh: 那女人口音很重，我听不懂她在说些什么。

words.definition: all the things that happened in the past, especially the political, social, or economic development of a nation; story, herstory
words.translation: 历史，历史学；历史记录；来历

examples.en: Throughout history the achievements of women have been largely ignored.
examples.zh: 从古至今，妇女的成就都被大大地忽视了。

examples.en: No man in recent history has done more to rebuild the Democratic Party.
examples.zh: 他对重建民主党的贡献在近代史上无人能及。

examples.en: the early history of Scotland
examples.zh: 苏格兰的早期历史

words.definition: if something brings people to a place, it makes them go there; attract, produce, force, cause, operate
words.translation: 带来；促使；引起；使某人处于某种情况或境地；(Bring)人名；(英、瑞典)布林

examples.en: The discovery of gold brought thousands of people to the Transvaal.
examples.zh: 黄金的发现把成千上万的人引到了德兰士瓦。

words.definition: the information, skills, and understanding that you have gained through learning or experience; information, awareness, science, learning, discipline
words.translation: 知识，学问；知道，认识；学科

examples.en: He did not have much knowledge of American history.
examples.zh: 他对美国历史所知不多。

words.definition: the number of times something happens, or the number of examples of something within a certain period; if you rate someone or something, you think they are very good; degree, classification, coefficient, price, value; assess, count, find, guess, feel; hop on, tell someone off
words.translation: 比率，率；速度；价格；等级；认为；估价；责骂；[数]比率，率；[力]速度；被评价

examples.en: Immediately his heart rate (= the number of beats per minute ) increased.
examples.zh: 他的心率立即加快了。

words.definition: someone who is studying at a university, school etc; scholar, academic, pupil
words.translation: 学生；学者

examples.en: Warren's eldest son is an art student.
examples.zh: 沃伦的长子是一名学艺术的学生。

words.definition: to notice or recognize a particular smell; the quality that people and animals recognize by using their nose; snuff at, sniff at; nose, snuff at; nose, wind, odor
words.translation: 嗅，闻；有…气味；气味，嗅觉；臭味；[生理]嗅，闻；察觉到；发出…的气味；气味，[生理]嗅觉

examples.en: I can smell burning.
examples.zh: 我闻到烧焦的气味。

examples.en: Can you smell something?
examples.zh: 你闻到什么气味了吗？

words.definition: only one; a game, especially in tennis, in which one person plays on their own against another person; unitary, onefold; yin, one-way ticket
words.translation: 单一的；单身的；单程的；一个；单打；单程票；选出

examples.en: A single tree gave shade from the sun.
examples.zh: 唯有一棵树遮阴。

examples.en: They won the game by a single point.
examples.zh: 他们仅以一分的优势赢得比赛。

examples.en: the highest price ever paid for a single work of art
examples.zh: 为单件艺术品所支付的最高价格

words.definition: the fact of no longer having something, or of having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens; reduction, failure, decrease, losing, reverse
words.translation: 减少；亏损；失败；遗失

examples.en: The company is closing down two of its factories, leading to 430 job losses .
examples.zh: 公司要关闭其中的两家工厂，这将造成430人失业。

examples.en: Weight loss should be gradual.
examples.zh: 减肥应该循序渐进。

examples.en: a type of hearing loss that affects language development
examples.zh: 一种会影响语言能力发展的听力丧失

words.definition: an emotion that you feel, such as anger, sadness, or happiness; mood, consciousness, emotion, affection, spirit; caring; sensing, handling
words.translation: 感觉，触觉；感情，情绪；同情；有感觉的；有同情心的；富于感情的；感觉；认为（feel的现在分词）；触摸；[生理]感觉，触觉；[心理]感情，情绪；[生理]感觉

examples.en: Knowing we’d won was a wonderful feeling.
examples.zh: 得知我们赢了，感觉真好。

words.definition: to risk money or possessions on the result of something such as a game or a race, when you do not know for certain what the result will be; an action or plan that involves a risk but that you hope will succeed; game, venture, lay; put all one's eggs in one basket, shoot the works; risk, throw, gaming, venture, adventure
words.translation: 赌博；孤注一掷；投机；打赌；冒险；冒险假设

examples.en: Their religion forbids them to drink or gamble.
examples.zh: 他们的宗教禁止饮酒和赌博。

words.definition: words that have been written or printed; works, production, literature, calligraphy
words.translation: 书写；作品；著作；[法] 笔迹；书写（write的ing形式）；[图情]著作；[法]笔迹

examples.en: What does the writing on the back say?
examples.zh: 背面的文字说什么？

examples.en: a T-shirt with Japanese writing on it
examples.zh: 一件印有日语的T恤衫

words.definition: to let someone have or use something that belongs to you; one of the equal parts into which the  ownership  of a company is divided; participate in, portion; partake; stock, lot
words.translation: 分享，分担；分配；份额；股份；[计]共享；分担；[金融]股份

examples.en: As a kid he’d never share his toys.
examples.zh: 他小时候从不肯与人分享他的玩具。

words.definition: to receive a particular amount of money for the work that you do; acquire, buy, find, make, score
words.translation: 赚，赚得；获得，挣得；使得到；博得；(Earn)人名；(泰)炎

examples.en: He earns nearly £20,000 a year.
examples.zh: 他每年挣近20,000英镑。

examples.en: You don’t earn much money being a nurse.
examples.zh: 当护士挣钱并不多。

examples.en: He did all sorts of jobs to earn a living.
examples.zh: 他为谋生什么活都干。

words.definition: a spoken or written piece of information that you send to another person or leave for them; news, prediction, word; inform of, report to; give notice, instruct, advise of
words.translation: 消息；差使；启示；预言；广告词；报信，报告；[通信] 报文；[通信]报文；通知

examples.en: He left a message saying he would probably be a little late.
examples.zh: 他留言说可能会晚一点来。

words.definition: the level that is considered to be acceptable, or the level that someone or something has achieved; accepted as normal or usual; criterion, norms, level, prototype, Canon; normal, par
words.translation: 标准；水准；旗；度量衡标准；标准的；合规格的；公认为优秀的；[标准]标准；[标准]标准的

examples.en: Students have to reach a certain standard or they won’t pass.
examples.zh: 学生必须达到某一标准，否则无法通过。

examples.en: The airline has rigorous safety standards.
examples.zh: 这家航空公司有严格的安全标准。

words.definition: to leave a job, school etc, especially without finishing it completely; yield, desert, split, get out; split, get out; leaving, Gone away
words.translation: 离开；放弃；停止；使…解除；[计] 退出；摆脱了…的；已经了结的；[劳经]辞职；[计]退出

examples.en: He quit his job after an argument with a colleague.
examples.zh: 他和一个同事争吵后就辞职了。

examples.en: I quit school at 16.
examples.zh: 我十六岁辍学。

examples.en: She has decided to quit show business.
examples.zh: 她已决定退出娱乐圈。

words.definition: a railway or the railway; Eisenbahn
words.translation: 由铁道运输；铺设铁路；以捏造不实之罪使入狱；铁路；铁路公司

examples.en: The supplies were sent on the railroad.
examples.zh: 补给经由铁路运送。

examples.en: a railroad station
examples.zh: 火车站

words.definition: a group of people, animals, or things that are considered together because they are similar in some way; to consider people, things etc as belonging to a particular group, using an official system; category, variety, manner, nature, kind; grade, categorize; wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great
words.translation: 阶级；班级；种类；班；等级；分类；把…分等级；把…归入某等级，把…看作（或分类、归类）；把…编入某一班级；极好的；很好的，优秀的，出色的

examples.en: He had to spend about six months in a class with younger students.
examples.zh: 他不得不在一个比他小的学生的班上呆了大约六个月。

words.definition: a way in which two or more people or things are not like each other; diversity, conflict, disparity, deviations
words.translation: 差异；不同；争执

examples.en: (= there’s a very big difference ) between us.
examples.zh: 我们之间有着天壤之别。

words.definition: a serious magazine produced for professional people or those with a particular interest; magazine, diary
words.translation: 日报，杂志；日记；分类账；日报，[图情]杂志

examples.en: the British Medical Journal
examples.zh: 《英国医学杂志》

words.definition: someone who is owned by another person and works for them for no money; to work very hard with little time to rest; bondman, mameluke; labor, work like a dog
words.translation: 奴隶；从动装置；苦干；拼命工作

examples.en: a slave to fashion
examples.zh: 时尚的奴隶

words.definition: the organ inside your head that controls how you think, feel, and move; to hit someone very hard on the head – used humorously; intelligence, mind, mentality
words.translation: 头脑，智力；脑袋；猛击…的头部

examples.en: Messages from the brain are carried by the central nervous system.
examples.zh: 大脑发出的信息是通过中枢神经系统传递的。

examples.en: the chemistry of the brain
examples.zh: 大脑的化学性质

examples.en: the human brain
examples.zh: 人脑

words.definition: something that is done as a reaction to something that has happened or been said; reaction, behavior, reception, reply, answer
words.translation: 响应；反应；回答

examples.en: His immediate response was one of disbelief.
examples.zh: 他的第一反应是不相信。

examples.en: Emmett’s new exhibition has met with a favourable response from critics.
examples.zh: 埃米特的新展览得到评论家的好评。

words.definition: the possibility that something will develop in a particular way, or have a particular effect; likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future; possibility, probability, feasibility, maybe, chance; feasible, possible, underlying, latent
words.translation: 潜能；可能性；[电] 电势；潜在的；可能的；势的；[电]电势

examples.en: The boy has great potential.
examples.zh: 这个男孩有很大的潜力。

words.definition: a place where something important or interesting happened; to place or build something in a particular place; location, spot, situation, where, lie; intercalate, instal
words.translation: 地点；位置；场所；设置；为…选址；[自]位置

examples.en: an archaeological site
examples.zh: 考古现场

words.definition: to become known about or used by more and more people; when something affects or is known about by more people or involves a larger area; extend, push; distribute, string, transmit; circulation, extension, propagation, diffusion; extense, patulous
words.translation: 传播；伸展；伸展的；传播，散布；展开；铺开

examples.en: News of the explosion spread swiftly.
examples.zh: 发生爆炸的消息迅速传播开来。

examples.en: The news spread like wildfire
examples.zh: 消息如野火般迅速传开。

examples.en: Word spread quickly that she was leaving.
examples.zh: 她要离开的消息迅速传开。

words.definition: the opinions and feelings that you usually have about something, especially when this is shown in your behaviour; opinion, viewpoint, behavior, comment, mind
words.translation: 态度；看法；意见；姿势

examples.en: As soon as they found out I was a doctor, their whole attitude changed.
examples.zh: 他们一听说我是医生，态度就完全改变了。

words.definition: alive now; the way that you earn money or the money that you earn; realistic, existing, active, excited, going; life, existence, livelihood, keep, subsistence; spending, dwelling
words.translation: 活的；现存的；活跃的；逼真的；生活；生存；生计；居住（live的ing形式）；度过

examples.en: He’s one of the greatest living composers.
examples.zh: 他是仍然健在的最伟大的作曲家之一。

examples.en: The sun affects all living things (= people, animals, and plants ).
examples.zh: 太阳与一切生物息息相关。

examples.en: a living language
examples.zh: 活语言，仍在使用的语言

words.definition: an organization formed by workers to protect their rights; alliance, league, unity, combination, combined with
words.translation: 联盟，协会；工会；联合

examples.en: Are you planning to join the union?
examples.zh: 你打算加入工会吗？

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["union members"]}
examples.zh: 工会会员

words.definition: when a person or animal is born, they come out of their mother’s body or out of an egg; someone who has a strong natural ability to lead, play music etc; natural, inborn
words.translation: 出世（bear的过去分词）；天生的；(Born)人名；(柬)邦；(英、西、俄、捷、德、瑞典、匈)博恩

examples.en: Forty lambs were born this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天有40头小羊羔出生。

examples.en: I was born and raised (=  was born and grew up  ) in Alabama.
examples.zh: 我是土生土长的亚拉巴马人。

examples.en: a newly-born baby
examples.zh: 新生儿，初生婴儿

words.definition: a large organization that has a particular kind of work or purpose; system, convention
words.translation: 制度；建立；（社会或宗教等）公共机构；习俗；[管理]制度

examples.en: powerful institutions such as world banks
examples.zh: 诸如世界银行之类的强大机构

examples.en: the Institution of Electrical Engineers
examples.zh: 电机工程师学会

words.definition: to try using various ideas, methods etc to find out how good or effective they are; a scientific test done to find out how something reacts under certain conditions, or to find out if a particular idea is true; have a try, try one's hand; stroke, proof, try, go
words.translation: 尝试；进行实验；实验，试验；[试验]实验，试验

examples.en: The teacher provided some different materials and left the children to experiment.
examples.zh: 老师提供了几种不同的材料让孩子们试验。

words.definition: fully grown or developed; a fully-grown person, or one who is considered to be legally responsible for their actions; developed, grown, mature; major, grown-up
words.translation: 成年的；成熟的；成年人

examples.en: an adult lion
examples.zh: 一头成年的狮子

examples.en: the adult population
examples.zh: 成年人口

examples.en: He lived most of his adult life in Scotland.
examples.zh: 他成年后大部分时间住在苏格兰。

words.definition: how good or bad something is; very good – used especially by people who are trying to sell something; talent, capability, ability, identity, character
words.translation: 质量，[统计] 品质；特性；才能；优质的；高品质的；<英俚>棒极了；质量，[统计]品质

examples.en: Much of the land was of poor quality.
examples.zh: 很多地的土质很差。

examples.en: Use only high quality ingredients.
examples.zh: 只使用上等的材料。

words.definition: to continue to be in the same state or condition; Theremainsof something are the parts of it that are left after most of it has been taken away or destroyed; stop, keep up; debris, relic
words.translation: 保持；依然；留下；剩余；逗留；残存；遗迹；剩余物，残骸

examples.en: Please remain seated until all the lights are on.
examples.zh: 请留在座位上，直到灯全都亮起。

examples.en: We remained friends.
examples.zh: 我们依然是朋友。

examples.en: The boy remained silent .
examples.zh: 男孩依然默不作声。

words.definition: a country, considered especially in relation to its people and its social or economic structure; country, state, folk, people, soil
words.translation: 国家；民族；国民

examples.en: the President’s radio broadcast to the nation
examples.zh: 总统对全国的广播讲话

examples.en: an independent nation
examples.zh: 独立的国家

examples.en: the world’s leading industrial nations
examples.zh: 世界上的主要工业国

words.definition: to form an opinion that something is probably true because of information that you have; understand, conclude, reason; conclude, deduce from
words.translation: 推断；推论；作出推论

examples.en: I inferred from what she said that you have not been well.
examples.zh: 我从她的话里推断出你身体一直不大好。

words.definition: having feelings of pleasure, for example because something good has happened to you or you are very satisfied with your life; pleased, glad, blessed, smart
words.translation: 幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的；(Happy)人名；(英、瑞典、喀)哈皮

examples.en: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
examples.zh: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

examples.en: I’ve never felt happier in my life.
examples.zh: 我一生从未感到如此快乐。

examples.en: He was a happy child who rarely cried.
examples.zh: 他是一个快乐的孩子，很少哭鼻子。

words.definition: The publication of a book or magazine is the act of printing it and sending it to stores to be sold; announcement
words.translation: 出版；出版物；发表

examples.en: The guide is being translated into several languages for publication near Christmas.
examples.zh: 这本指南正被翻译成好几种语言，准备在圣诞节前后出版。

words.definition: to divide something into parts that are different from each other; a part of something that is different from or affected differently from the whole in some way; to cut up, divide up; dan, proportion, part, portion, percent; to cut up, deleave
words.translation: 分割；段；部分；[计]段

examples.en: ...the poorer segments of society.
examples.zh: …社会中的较贫困阶层。

words.definition: to try to achieve or get something; explore, try to find; explore, cast about for
words.translation: 寻求；寻找；探索；搜索

examples.en: Do you think the President will seek re-election ?
examples.zh: 你认为总统会谋求连任吗？

words.definition: the situation in which people live or work, especially the physical things that affect the quality of their lives; to make a person or an animal think or behave in a certain way by influencing or training them over a period of time; circumstance, situation, context, qualification, thing; adapt, suit, season, conclude
words.translation: 条件；情况；环境；身份；决定；使适应；使健康；以…为条件；[数]条件；身分

examples.en: Conditions in the prison were atrocious.
examples.zh: 这座监狱的条件糟透了。

examples.en: In May, staff went on strike, demanding better pay and conditions .
examples.zh: 五月份员工举行了罢工，要求提高工资和改善工作条件。

words.translation: 因特网

words.definition: an amount of money that is collected and kept for a particular purpose; to provide money for an activity, organization, event etc; capital, deposit, saving; invent money in, to invest
words.translation: 基金；资金；存款；投资；资助；[金融]基金

examples.en: The fund was set up to try to save the cathedral.
examples.zh: 设立基金以挽救大教堂。

words.definition: the way in which the parts of something are connected with each other and form a whole, or the thing that these parts make up; to arrange the different parts of something into a pattern or system in which each part is connected to the others; configuration, mechanics, formation, framework, texture, construction, fabric; organize, constitute, form, frame
words.translation: 结构；构造；建筑物；组织；构成；建造；[建]建筑物

examples.en: challenges to the existing power structure
examples.zh: 对现有权力结构的挑战

examples.en: A new management structure has been introduced.
examples.zh: 已推行一种新的管理结构。

examples.en: molecular structures
examples.zh: 分子结构

words.definition: a set of large folded sheets of printed paper containing news, articles, pictures, advertisements etc which is sold daily or weekly; paper, courant
words.translation: 报纸

examples.en: She had read about it in the newspapers.
examples.zh: 关于这件事她已经在报纸上看到了。

examples.en: a series of newspaper articles about life in Cuba
examples.zh: 刊登在报纸上的一系列关于古巴生活的文章

words.definition: a learned person has a lot of knowledge because they have read and studied a lot; knowing, wise, accomplished, read, scholarly
words.translation: 博学的；有学问的；学术上的；(Learned)人名；(英)勒尼德

examples.en: a learned professor
examples.zh: 一位博学的教授

words.definition: a flat piece of wood, plastic, card etc that you use for a particular purpose such as cutting things on, or for playing indoor games; to get on a bus, plane, train etc in order to travel somewhere; meal, directorate; attend; guest, stay over
words.translation: 董事会；木板；甲板；膳食；上（飞机、车、船等）；用板盖上；给提供膳宿；寄宿

examples.en: Martha was chopping vegetables on a wooden board.
examples.zh: 玛莎正在用一块木砧板切蔬菜。

examples.en: a chess board
examples.zh: 棋盘

words.definition: several events or actions of a similar type that happen one after the other; succession, progression
words.translation: 系列，连续；[电] 串联；级数；丛书；[电]串联；[数]级数

examples.en: the series of events that led to the outbreak of war
examples.zh: 导致战争爆发的一系列事件

examples.en: The police are investigating a series of attacks in the area.
examples.zh: 警方在调查该地区发生的一连串袭击事件。

examples.en: There’s been a whole series of accidents on this road.
examples.zh: 这条路上发生了一连串的交通事故。

words.definition: to write information down or store it in a computer or on film so that it can be looked at in the future; information about something that is written down or stored on computer, film etc so that it can be looked at in the future; You use record to say that something is higher, lower, better, or worse than has ever been achieved before; register, keep track of; keep track of, make notes of; disk, file, resume, disc
words.translation: 记录，记载；标明；将录音；档案，履历；唱片；最高纪录；创纪录的；将...录音；记录；录音；[电子]唱片

examples.en: Her husband made her record every penny she spent.
examples.zh: 她丈夫要她把花的每分钱都记下来。

examples.en: The coroner recorded a verdict of accidental death.
examples.zh: 验尸官作出了意外死亡的结论。

examples.en: Profits were at record levels.
examples.zh: 利润水平是创纪录的。

words.definition: relating to the principles of what is right and wrong behaviour, and with the difference between good and evil; principles or standards of good behaviour, especially in matters of sex; psychological, ethical; overtone
words.translation: 道德的；精神上的；品性端正的；道德；寓意
