examples.zh: 对于判谋杀犯死刑这种涉及伦理道德的问题，有个观点并非难事。

examples.en: If we accept that certain babies should be allowed to die, we place doctors in a moral dilemma .
examples.zh: 如果我们同意应该允许某些婴儿死去，那就是让医生在道德上处于两难境地了。

examples.en: Man is gifted with a moral sense by which he distinguishes good from evil.
examples.zh: 人类天生有道德意识，能区分善与恶。

words.definition: the number of people living in a particular area, country etc; syngen, species group
words.translation: 人口；[生物] 种群，[生物] 群体；全体居民；种群，[生物]群体

examples.en: Nearly 70 percent of the population still live in the countryside.
examples.zh: 人口中差不多有70%仍住在乡村。

words.definition: to draw a line under a word to show that it is important; emphasize, stress, highlight
words.translation: 强调；在…下面划线；预告；下划线；下期节目预告

examples.en: This tragic incident underlines the need for immediate action.
examples.zh: 这一悲剧事件突显了立即采取行动的必要性。

words.definition: someone who enters another country to live there permanently; emigratory; migration, transplantation
words.translation: 移民的；迁入的；移民，侨民

examples.en: But “the hostile part can be mobilized from time to time,” by what he calls “anti-immigrant entrepreneurs.
examples.zh: 但是“敌对的那部分可能会不时地动员”，以他称之为“反移民企业家”的名义。

examples.en: That such a woman would want more for her daughter than someone who was a failed boxer, a doorman, and an illegal immigrant seemed to him perfectly reasonable.
examples.zh: 在他看来，这样一个女人想要给自己的女儿找一个比失败的拳击手、看门人和非法移民更好的男人，是完全合理的。

words.definition: If you observe an important day such as a holiday or anniversary, you do something special in order to honour or celebrate it; watch, quo, tell, talk, respect; look into, take stock of
words.translation: 庆祝；观察；遵守；说；注意到；评论

examples.en: ...where he will observe Thanksgiving with family members.
examples.zh: …在那里他将与家人一起庆祝感恩节。

words.definition: to remain in a place rather than leave; a limited time of living in a place; visit, abide; tough, control, restrain; leg, visit, stop, backbone, stand
words.translation: 停留；坚持；暂住；停下；逗留；停止；支柱；抑制；[建]支柱

examples.en: They stayed all afternoon chatting.
examples.zh: 他们待了整个下午聊天。

examples.en: She stayed late to finish the report.
examples.zh: 为了完成报告，她工作到很晚。

words.definition: to make known something that was previously secret or unknown; make clear, prove, disclose, expose; uncovery, exposure to sth
words.translation: 显示；透露；揭露；泄露；暴露；门侧，窗侧；门侧，[建]窗侧

examples.en: He may be prosecuted for revealing secrets about the security agency.
examples.zh: 他可能因泄露安全部门的机密而被起诉。

examples.en: a test that can reveal a teacher’s hidden skills
examples.zh: 能够展现老师潜在技能的测试

words.definition: an attempt to do something, especially when this involves a lot of hard work or determination; achievement, success, pain, struggle, trial
words.translation: 努力；成就

examples.en: please make an effort to be polite.
examples.zh: 请尽量礼貌些。

examples.en: Church leaders are prepared to meet the terrorists in an effort to (= in order to try to ) find peace.
examples.zh: 为寻求和平，教会领袖准备与恐怖分子会面。

words.definition: a period of 10 years; decennium, dix
words.translation: 十年，十年期；十

examples.en: ...the last decade of the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: …19世纪的最后10年。

words.definition: someone whose job is to teach, especially in a school; professor, master
words.translation: 教师；导师

examples.en: a primary school teacher
examples.zh: 小学教师

words.definition: to make someone feel worried or upset; something that is important to you or that involves you; deal with, to relate to; relationship, connection, attention, consideration, bearing
words.translation: 涉及，关系到；使担心；关系；关心；关心的事；忧虑

examples.en: Issues like food additives do concern me.
examples.zh: 食品添加剂这类事情确实使我很担心。

words.definition: a written or printed copy of a piece of music, especially for a large group of performers, or the music itself; to win a point in a sport, game, competition, or test; marks, twenty; acquire, earn, buy, find, value; bull point
words.translation: 分数；二十；配乐；刻痕；获得；评价；划线，刻划；把…记下；[木]刻痕；得分；记分

examples.en: a musical score
examples.zh: 乐谱

examples.en: Who wrote the score for the movie?
examples.zh: 这部电影的配乐是谁谱写的？

words.definition: the differences within a group, set of actions etc that make it interesting; category, manner, nature, kind, sort
words.translation: 多样；种类；杂耍；变化，多样化

examples.en: I really like the variety the store has to offer.
examples.zh: 我很喜欢这家商店商品的丰富多样。

words.definition: being the only one of its kind; distinct, individual, one, sole, picturesque
words.translation: 独特的，稀罕的；[数] 唯一的，独一无二的；独一无二的人或物；[数]唯一的，独一无二的

examples.en: Each person’s fingerprints are unique.
examples.zh: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。

words.definition: If you depend on someone or something, you need them in order to be able to survive physically, financially, or emotionally; hope, tie to
words.translation: 依赖，依靠；取决于；相信，信赖

examples.en: He depended on his writing for his income.
examples.zh: 他靠写作谋生。

words.definition: relating to or involving the nucleus (= central part ) of an atom, or the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is either split or joined with the nucleus of another atom; central, atomic
words.translation: 原子能的；[细胞] 细胞核的；中心的；原子核的；[细胞]细胞核的

examples.en: France’s reliance on nuclear energy
examples.zh: 法国对核能的依赖

examples.en: a nuclear power station
examples.zh: 核电站

examples.en: a nuclear-powered submarine
examples.zh: 核动力潜艇

words.definition: the feeling that something is definitely true or definitely exists; faith, teaching, trust, doctrine
words.translation: 相信，信赖；信仰；教义

examples.en: When you get something wrong, it can shake your belief in yourself.
examples.zh: 如果有什么事情没做好，就会动摇你对自己的信心。

words.definition: to use your money to pay for goods or services; invested, lose, cost, last; peter, consume; budget
words.translation: 度过，消磨（时光）；花费；浪费；用尽；预算；花钱；用尽，耗尽

examples.en: I can’t afford to spend any more money this week.
examples.zh: 这星期我没有能力花更多的钱了。

examples.en: The repairs cost a lot, but it’s money well spent (= a sensible way of spending money ) .
examples.zh: 修理费很高，但这是该花的钱。

words.definition: something that is necessary is what you need to have or need to do; things such as food or basic clothes that you need in order to live; inevitable, required, essential, certain, automatic; requirement, want
words.translation: 必要的；必需的；必然的；必需品；[数]必要的

examples.en: The booklet provides all the necessary information about the college.
examples.zh: 这本小册子提供了关于那所学院的所有必需信息。

examples.en: No further changes were considered necessary.
examples.zh: 没有必要作出进一步改变。

examples.en: The doctor says it may be necessary for me to have an operation.
examples.zh: 医生说我可能需要做手术。

words.definition: a system of lines, tubes, wires, roads etc that cross each other and are connected to each other; net, meshwork
words.translation: 网络；广播网；网状物；[计][通信]网络

examples.en: Hungary’s telephone network
examples.zh: 匈牙利的电话网

examples.en: a high-speed European rail network
examples.zh: 欧洲的高速铁路网

words.definition: a group such as a club or business that has formed for a particular purpose; fabric, machinery, system, community, body
words.translation: 组织；机构；体制；团体

examples.en: The public expect high standards from any large organization.
examples.zh: 公众对任何大型机构都期望很高。

examples.en: the World Trade Organization
examples.zh: 世界贸易组织

examples.en: a voluntary organization which helps disabled people with their transport needs
examples.zh: 帮助残疾人士满足其交通需求的一个志愿组织

words.definition: when someone tries to get, achieve, or find something in a determined way; profession, employment, career, calling, job
words.translation: 追赶，追求；职业，工作

examples.en: The quarterback sprinted toward the end zone with Jansen in hot pursuit (= following closely behind ) .
examples.zh: 那名四分卫快速冲向底线区，詹森穷追不舍。

words.definition: a living thing that has leaves and roots and grows in earth, especially one that is smaller than a tree; to put plants or seeds in the ground to grow; factory, equipment, furniture, facility, mill; cultivate, crop, establish, rear, station; put in, to raise
words.translation: 工厂，车间；植物；设备；庄稼；种植；培养；栽培；安置；[工经]工厂，车间；[植]植物

examples.en: Don’t forget to water the plants.
examples.zh: 别忘记给植物浇水。

words.definition: a combination of all the things that are happening and all the conditions that exist at a particular time in a particular place; circumstance, case, location, thing, aspect
words.translation: 情况；形势；处境；位置

examples.en: I explained the situation to everyone.
examples.zh: 我向大家介绍了一下情况。

words.definition: existing in nature and not caused, made, or controlled by people; a musical note that has been changed from a flat to be a semitone higher, or from a sharp to be a semitone lower; material, physical, born, spontaneous; idiot, baichi
words.translation: 自然的；物质的；天生的；不做作的；自然的事情；白痴；本位音

examples.en: the study of the natural world
examples.zh: 对自然界的研究

examples.en: an area of spectacular natural beauty
examples.zh: 自然风景秀丽的地区

examples.en: death from natural causes
examples.zh: 自然死亡

words.definition: to use your voice to produce words; tongue, fack; take the floor, to address
words.translation: 说话；演讲；表明；陈述；讲话；发言；讲演

examples.en: I was so shocked I couldn’t speak.
examples.zh: 我震惊得说不出话来。

examples.en: He spoke very softly (= quietly ) .
examples.zh: 他说话声音非常轻柔。

words.definition: a part of something that you notice because it seems important, interesting, or typical; person, characteristic; star
words.translation: 特色，特征；容貌；特写或专题节目；起重要作用；特写；以…为特色；由…主演

examples.en: Air bags are a standard feature in most new cars.
examples.zh: 气囊是大多数新车的标准配置。

examples.en: Striped tails are a common feature of many animals.
examples.zh: 尾巴上有条纹是许多动物的共同特征。

examples.en: The hotel’s only redeeming features (= things that make it acceptable ) were that it was cheap and near the city centre.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆仅有的可取之处就是价格低廉并且靠近市中心。

words.definition: when you translate something, or something that has been translated; interpretation, version
words.translation: 翻译；译文；转化；调任；[语][计]翻译

examples.en: She read the letter and gave us a rough translation (= she did not translate everything exactly ) .
examples.zh: 她看了信，给我们大概翻译了一下。

examples.en: I’ve only read ‘Madame Bovary’ in translation (= not in its original language ) .
examples.zh: 我只读过《包法利夫人》的翻译本。

examples.en: Much of the book’s humour has been lost in translation (= is no longer effective when translated ) .
examples.zh: 本书的许多幽默元素已在翻译过程中丢失。

words.definition: a large crowd; involving or intended for a very large number of people; to come together, or to make people or things come together, in a large group; piece, block, lots of, wealth, ocean, sea; concentrated, intensive, wholesale; concentrate, collect, crowd
words.translation: 块，团；群众，民众；大量，众多；质量；群众的，民众的；大规模的，集中的；聚集起来，聚集

examples.en: The road was blocked by a solid mass of protesters.
examples.zh: 道路被密密麻麻的抗议者阻塞了。

words.definition: to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard; accomplish, carry out, perform, complete, fulfil; gain one's ends, Make it.
words.translation: 取得；获得；实现；成功；达到；完成；达到目的；如愿以偿

examples.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
examples.zh: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

examples.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
examples.zh: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

examples.en: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
examples.zh: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

words.definition: to have or express the same opinion about something as someone else; undertake, accept, recognize, side, grant; accept, grant
words.translation: 同意，赞成；承认；约定，商定；同意；赞成；意见一致

examples.en: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
examples.zh: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

words.definition: a general tendency in the way a situation is changing or developing; tendency, tide, direction, liability, set; verge on, tend towards
words.translation: 趋势，倾向；走向；趋向，伸向；[统计]趋势，倾向；[地质]走向

examples.en: The current trend is towards more part-time employment.
examples.zh: 当前的趋势是雇用更多的兼职人员。

examples.en: the general trend towards the centralization of political power
examples.zh: 政治权力集中化的普遍趋势

examples.en: A disturbing trend is that victims of violence are getting younger.
examples.zh: 一个令人担心的趋势是，暴力行为的受害者越来越年轻。

words.definition: one of the large areas into which some countries are divided, and which usually has its own local government; domain, territory, world, universe, kingdom
words.translation: 省；领域；职权

examples.en: a Chinese province
examples.zh: 中国的一个省

words.definition: a sport played by two teams of 11 players, who try to kick a round ball into their opponents’  goal; association football, center forward
words.translation: 英式足球，足球

examples.en: It must be one of those soccer scarfs from England.
examples.zh: 那一定是某个英国足球队的围巾。

words.definition: to give someone the courage or confidence to do something; heart, stimulate, power, hand, second
words.translation: 鼓励，怂恿；激励；支持

examples.en: I want to thank everyone who has encouraged and supported me.
examples.zh: 我要感谢每一位鼓励和支持过我的人。

words.definition: A promise is a statement that you make to a person in which you say that you will definitely do something or give them something; If you promise that you will do something, you say to someone that you will definitely do it; wish, hope, pleasure; pledge, vouchsafe
words.translation: 许诺，允诺；希望；允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望

examples.en: If you make a promise, you should keep it.
examples.zh: 如果你许下一个诺言，你就应该遵守它。

examples.en: The post office has promised to resume first class mail delivery to the area on Friday.
examples.zh: 邮局已承诺在星期五恢复该地区第一类邮件的递送。

examples.en: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment.
examples.zh: 他已承诺富人和特权阶层将不会再得到优待。

words.definition: a process in which a doctor makes someone talk about their past experiences, relationships etc in order to help them with mental or emotional problems; decomposition, dissolution
words.translation: 分析；分解；验定；[化学][数]分析

examples.en: She’s been in analysis for three years.
examples.zh: 她接受精神分析治疗已经三年了。

words.definition: to change written or spoken words into another language; remove, expound; interpret
words.translation: 翻译；转化；解释；转变为；调动

examples.en: Poetry doesn’t usually translate well.
examples.zh: 诗歌通常都译不好。

words.definition: having a special skill or special knowledge of a subject; someone who has a special skill or special knowledge of a subject, gained as a result of training or experience; skilled, accomplished, clever, diplomatic, practiced; operator, specialist
words.translation: 熟练的；内行的；老练的；专家；行家；能手；当专家；在…中当行家

examples.en: He cast his expert eye on the gardener’s work.
examples.zh: 他用内行的眼光看了看园丁干的活。

words.definition: the system by which people are judged in courts of law and criminals are punished; judge, right, judicature
words.translation: 司法，法律制裁；正义；法官，审判员；法官，[法]审判员

examples.en: a book on the criminal justice system
examples.zh: 一本有关刑事审判制度的书

examples.en: The killers will be brought to justice(= caught and punished ).
examples.zh: 这些杀人犯将被绳之以法。

examples.en: Acts of terrorism must not escape justice.
examples.zh: 恐怖主义行为必定难逃法律制裁。

words.definition: to make a formal request, usually written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something; put in for, enter one's name for; demand, put in for
words.translation: 申请；涂，敷；应用；适用；请求

examples.en: We need to apply for planning permission to build a garage.
examples.zh: 我们建车库需要申请规划许可。

words.definition: a thing, place, activity etc that you get something from; provenience, authorship
words.translation: 来源；水源；原始资料

examples.en: They get their money from various sources.
examples.zh: 他们从各种途径弄到钱。

words.definition: the thing, person, situation etc that people pay special attention to; to give special attention to one particular person or thing, or to make people do this; center, hub, fairness; centralize; concentrate, band
words.translation: 焦点；中心；清晰；焦距；使集中；使聚焦；[光][数]焦点；[光][摄]使聚焦；集中；[光][摄]聚焦；调节焦距

examples.en: The focus of recent research has been on environmental issues.
examples.zh: 近期的研究重点是环境问题。

examples.en: Eggs became the focus for the food poisoning scare.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋成了食物中毒恐慌的焦点。

words.definition: to rest your mind and body, usually at night when you are lying in bed with your eyes closed; the natural state of resting your mind and body, usually at night; sack out, to go to bed; morpheus, shut-eye
words.translation: 睡，睡觉；睡眠；[生理]睡眠

examples.en: I usually sleep on my back.
examples.zh: 我一般仰卧着睡觉。

examples.en: Did you sleep well?
examples.zh: 你睡得好吗？

examples.en: He’s lucky because at least he has somewhere to sleep.
examples.zh: 他算是幸运的，至少还有个睡觉的地方。

words.definition: what actually happens or is true, not what is imagined or thought; fact, actuality, sincerity, true
words.translation: 现实；实际；真实

examples.en: the distinction between fantasy and reality
examples.zh: 幻想和现实之间的区别

examples.en: TV is used as an escape from reality .
examples.zh: 电视成了逃避现实的一种方式。

examples.en: I think the government has lost touch with reality (= no longer understands what is real or true ) .
examples.zh: 我认为政府已经脱离了现实。

words.definition: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it; an amount of liquid that you drink, or the act of drinking something; eat, absorb; wine, liquor; wine, liquor, beverage
words.translation: 喝，饮；吸收；举杯庆贺；酒，饮料；喝酒；饮水；干杯

examples.en: You should drink plenty of water.
examples.zh: 你应该大量喝水。

examples.en: What would you like to drink?
examples.zh: 你想喝点什么？

examples.en: Take a seat while I get you something to drink .
examples.zh: 请坐，我去给你倒杯喝的。

words.definition: the information that someone has discovered as a result of their study, work etc; discovery, occurrence, detection
words.translation: 发现；裁决；发现物；找到；感到（find的ing形式）；遇到

examples.en: Surveys conducted in other countries reported similar findings.
examples.zh: 在其他国家进行的调查也报告说有类似的结果。

words.definition: the material that everything in the universe is made of, including solids, liquids, and gases; to be important, especially to be important to you, or to have an effect on what happens; substance, event, consideration, circumstance, occurrence, scene; to be related, make a difference
words.translation: 物质；事件；有关系；要紧；[物]物质；原因

examples.en: particles of matter
examples.zh: 物质的微粒

words.definition: related to someone’s body rather than their mind or emotions; a thorough examination of someone’s body by a doctor, in order to discover whether they are healthy or have any illnesses or medical problems; personal, material, natural; medical examination, check-up
words.translation: [物] 物理的；身体的；物质的；根据自然规律的，符合自然法则的；体格检查；[物]物理的

examples.en: She was in constant physical pain.
examples.zh: 她一直感到身上疼痛。

examples.en: the physical and emotional needs of young adults
examples.zh: 青年人的身心需求

examples.en: people with severe physical disabilities
examples.zh: 身体重度残疾的人

words.definition: belonging to a traditional style or set of ideas; traditional, conventional, royal; classic music
words.translation: 古典的；经典的；传统的；第一流的；古典音乐

examples.en: the classical theory of relativity
examples.zh: 经典相对论

words.definition: an increase in amount, number, or size; development, making, advance, increase, progress
words.translation: 增长；发展；生长；种植；[生理]生长

examples.en: measures to stimulate economic growth
examples.zh: 刺激经济增长的措施

words.definition: the activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods within a country or between countries; to buy and sell goods, services etc as your job or business; commerce, profession, employment, career, pursuit; traffic, exchange, truck
words.translation: 贸易，交易；行业；职业；交易，买卖；以物易物；贸易，[贸易]交易；[劳经]行业；[贸易]交易，买卖

examples.en: international trade agreements
examples.zh: 国际贸易协定

examples.en: unfair trade practices
examples.zh: 不公平的贸易行为

words.definition: a narrow path or road with a rough uneven surface, especially one made by people or animals frequently moving through the same place; to search for a person or animal by following the marks they leave behind them on the ground, their smell etc; path, railway, tail, trajectory, orbit; clear, trail; go, walk, step
words.translation: 轨道；足迹，踪迹；小道；追踪；通过；循路而行；用纤拉；[铁路]轨道；[古生]足迹，踪迹；走；留下足迹

examples.en: The road leading to the farm was little more than a dirt track .
examples.zh: 只有一条烂泥小路通往农场。

examples.en: The track led through dense forest.
examples.zh: 小径穿过茂密的森林。

examples.en: a steep mountain track
examples.zh: 陡峭的山路

words.definition: to support yourself on your feet or be in an upright position; a position or opinion that you state firmly and publicly; sit, lie on; stomach, go, tough, abide, sustain; stop, stay
words.translation: 站立；位于；停滞；立场；看台；停止；使站立；忍受；抵抗

examples.en: It looks like we’ll have to stand – there are no seats left.
examples.zh: 看来我们只能站着——没有座位了。

examples.en: She stood in the doorway.
examples.zh: 她站在门口。

examples.en: (= do not move ) and listen to me.
examples.zh: 站好别动，听我说。

words.definition: someone who writes news reports for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio; newspaperman, jounalist
words.translation: 新闻工作者；报人；记日志者

examples.en: a well-known journalist and broadcaster
examples.zh: 一位著名的新闻记者兼播音员

words.definition: the place where something is or where something happens, and the general environment; context, circumstance, installation, arrangement, surrounding; putting, positioning, laying
words.translation: 环境；安装；布置；[天] 沉落；放置；沉没；使…处于某位置（set的ing形式）；[天]沉落

examples.en: I’ve worked with children in various settings, mainly in secondary school.
examples.zh: 我在许多地方教过孩子，主要是在中学。

words.definition: to go or come back to a place where you were before; the act of returning from somewhere, or your arrival back in a place; used or paid for a journey from one place to another and back again; replace, restore; payment, reward, restoration; head back to, come (or go) back; rewarding
words.translation: 返回；报答；归还；回球；报答的；回程的；返回的；[计]返回；[计]返回的；[交]回程的

examples.en: It was forty five minutes before she returned.
examples.zh: 过了45分钟她才回来。

examples.en: Alison decided to return home.
examples.zh: 艾利森决定回家。

examples.en: He left his country, never to return.
examples.zh: 他离开了祖国，一去不复返。

words.definition: the way in which two people or two groups feel about each other and behave towards each other; connection, correlation, bearing, concern, link
words.translation: 关系；关联

examples.en: He’s never had a sexual relationship before.
examples.zh: 他以前从未与人有过性关系。

words.definition: the regular way in which something happens, develops, or is done; to be designed or made in a way that is copied from something else; mode, device, design, schema, specimen; simulate, imitate
words.translation: 模式；图案；样品；模仿；以图案装饰

examples.en: Weather patterns have changed in recent years.
examples.zh: 气候模式近年已经发生了变化。

examples.en: A general pattern began to emerge .
examples.zh: 一个总体模式开始显现。

examples.en: Their descriptions seemed to follow a set pattern (= always develop in the same way ) .
examples.zh: 他们的描述似乎依据固定的模式。

words.definition: to deliberately pay no attention to something that you have been told or that you know about; neglect, pass sb by
words.translation: 驳回诉讼；忽视；不理睬

examples.en: You can’t ignore the fact that many criminals never go to prison.
examples.zh: 你不能无视很多罪犯从未获刑的事实。

examples.en: problems which we can’t afford to ignore
examples.zh: 我们不能置之不理的问题

words.definition: when a liquid, gas, or electricity flows, it moves in a steady continuous stream; a smooth steady movement of liquid, gas, or electricity; stream, dance; flood, drown out; stream, flux, fresh, flood, quantity of
words.translation: 流动，涌流；川流不息；飘扬；流动；流量；涨潮，泛滥；[流]流动，涌流；淹没，溢过；[流]流动

examples.en: Money has been flowing into the country from Western aid agencies.
examples.zh: 资金源源不断地从西方援助机构流入该国。

words.definition: having the right qualities for a particular person, purpose, or situation; appropriate, proper, adequate, becoming, matching
words.translation: 适当的；相配的

examples.en: We are hoping to find a suitable school.
examples.zh: 我们希望能找到一所合适的学校。

words.definition: the air, water, and land on Earth, which is affected by man’s activities; context, circumstance, setting, surrounding, condition
words.translation: 环境，外界；[环境]环境，外界

examples.en: Some of these chemicals are very damaging to the environment.
examples.zh: 这些化学品中有些对环境非常有害。

examples.en: legislation to protect the environment
examples.zh: 保护环境的法规

examples.en: the effects of acid rain on the environment
examples.zh: 酸雨对环境的影响

words.definition: physical activities that you do in order to stay healthy and become stronger; to use a power, right, or quality that you have; movement, sport, ceremony, campaign, practice; make use of, fashion, occupy, alarm, employ; motion, do sport
words.translation: 运动；练习；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼；锻炼；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐

examples.en: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
examples.zh: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

examples.en: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
examples.zh: 由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

words.definition: military action used as a way of achieving your aims; to make someone do something they do not want to do; strength, might, army, sword, muscle; bring, drive
words.translation: 力量；武力；军队；魄力；促使，推动；强迫；强加

examples.en: Peace cannot be imposed by force .
examples.zh: 和平不能通过武力来实现。

examples.en: The UN will allow the use of force against aircraft violating the zone.
examples.zh: 联合国将允许对侵犯这一地区的飞机采取军事行动。

words.definition: belonging or relating to one particular person, rather than to other people or to people in general; individual, subjective, physical
words.translation: 个人的；身体的；亲自的；人事消息栏；人称代名词

examples.en: My personal view is that we shouldn’t offer him the job.
examples.zh: 我个人认为我们不该给他这份工作。

examples.en: Style and colour are a matter of personal taste .
examples.zh: 款式和颜色是个人爱好问题。

examples.en: She took full personal responsibility for all the arrangements.
examples.zh: 她个人对所有的安排承担全部责任。

words.definition: considering only the bad qualities of a situation, person etc and not the good ones; an image on a photographic film that shows dark areas as light and light areas as dark, from which the final picture is printed; to refuse to accept a proposal or request; passive, destructive; infirmation, disaffirmation; deny, refuse
words.translation: [数] 负的；消极的；否定的；阴性的；否定；负数；[摄] 底片；拒绝；[数]负的；[语]否定的；[语]否定；[摄]底片

examples.en: students with a negative attitude to school
examples.zh: 对上学抱消极态度的学生

examples.en: They have a uniformly negative image of the police.
examples.zh: 他们都对警察印象不好。

examples.en: Jean rarely sounded so negative about her mother.
examples.zh: 琼很少这么说她母亲不好。

words.definition: your native country, town etc is the place where you were born; someone who lives in a place all the time or has lived there a long time; crude, inherent; indigen, local product
words.translation: 本国的；土著的；天然的；与生俱来的；天赋的；本地人；土产；当地居民；[生物]土著的

examples.en: They never saw their native land again.
examples.zh: 他们再也没见到故土。

examples.en: He spent most of his professional life outside his native Poland.
examples.zh: 他大部分的职业生涯都没在祖国波兰度过。

words.definition: the use of money to get a profit or to make a business activity successful, or the money that is used; input, introjection
words.translation: 投资；投入；封锁；[经]投资

examples.en: We plan to buy some property as an investment.
examples.zh: 我们打算买些房地产作为投资。

words.definition: the act of giving someone something and receiving something else from them; to replace one thing with another; communication, conversion; turn, truck; trade, traffic
words.translation: 交换；交流；交易所；兑换；交易；[通信][计]交换；[金融]兑换

examples.en: Four of my cassettes for your Madonna CD is a fair exchange.
examples.zh: 我用四盒磁带换你的麦当娜激光唱片很公平。

words.definition: the limits within which amounts, quantities, ages etc vary; to move around in an area without aiming for a particular place; extent, boundary, region, scope, spectrum, territory, area; reach, parallel with; feed, grass
words.translation: 范围；幅度；排；山脉；（在内）变动；平行，列为一行；延伸；漫游；射程达到；[地理]山脉；放牧；使并列；归类于；来回走动

examples.en: a temperature range of 72-85˚
examples.zh: 72 度到85度之间的温度范围

examples.en: Even the cheapest property was out of our price range (= too expensive for us ) .
examples.zh: 即使是最便宜的房子也超出了我们能承受的价格范围。

words.definition: showing that someone has been well trained and is good at their work; someone who earns money by doing a job, sport, or activity that many other people do just for fun; vocational, specialized, occupational; career man
words.translation: 专业的；职业的；职业性的；专业人员；职业运动员；[管理]专业人员

examples.en: This business plan looks very professional.
examples.zh: 这个商业计划看上去很有专业水平。

examples.en: a more professional approach to work
examples.zh: 更专业的工作方法

words.definition: having a lot of physical power so that you can lift heavy things, do hard physical work etc; tough, firm, stable, steel; heavily, hard
words.translation: 坚强的；强壮的；牢固的；擅长的；强劲地；猛烈地；(Strong)人名；(英)斯特朗

examples.en: He was a big strong man.
examples.zh: 他高大健壮。

examples.en: Jack was tall and strong.
examples.zh: 杰克又高又壮。

examples.en: I’m not strong enough to fight him.
examples.zh: 和他打我还不够强壮。

words.definition: in addition to the usual things or the usual amount; an amount of something, especially money, in addition to the usual, basic, or necessary amount; more of something, in addition to the usual or standard amount or number; specifically, particularly, badly, highly, greatly, too; walker-on, special edition; additional, added, excess
words.translation: 特别地，非常；另外；临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品；额外的，另外收费的；特大的；额外的，[经]另外收费的

examples.en: They need to offer something extra to attract customers.
examples.zh: 他们需要提供额外的东西以吸引顾客。

words.definition: a statement in which you tell someone that you will cause them harm or trouble if they do not do what you want; danger, intimidation
words.translation: 威胁，恐吓；凶兆

examples.en: Your threats don’t scare me.
examples.zh: 你的那些威胁吓不倒我。

examples.en: threats made against his wife and children
examples.zh: 对他妻儿的威胁

examples.en: Nichols never carried out his threat to resign.
examples.zh: 尼科尔斯威胁过要辞职，但从未付诸行动。

words.definition: mostly or mainly; mainly, basically, mostly, primarily, freely
words.translation: 主要地；大部分；大量地

examples.en: The state of Nevada is largely desert.
examples.zh: 内华达州大部分是沙漠。

examples.en: It had been a tiring day, largely because of all the tedious waiting.
examples.zh: 那一天真累人，主要是因为等得无聊。

words.definition: to improve something; raise, cement, boost, muscle, gain
words.translation: 提高；加强；增加

examples.en: Good lighting will enhance any room.
examples.zh: 良好的照明能给房间增色不少。

examples.en: The publicity has enhanced his reputation.
examples.zh: 这次宣传提高了他的声誉。

words.definition: happening, done, or existing most of the time or in most situations; traditional, conventional, common, ordinary, regulation
words.translation: 通常的，惯例的；平常的

examples.en: Make a cheese sauce in the usual way.
examples.zh: 按通常的做法做奶酪酱。

examples.en: I’ll meet you at the usual time.
examples.zh: 我在老时间和你碰头。

examples.en: She ate twice as much as usual.
examples.zh: 她吃了平时食量两倍的东西。

words.definition: someone whose job is to take tourists to a place and show them around; to take someone to a place; manual, enchiridion; aim, man
words.translation: 指南；向导；入门书；引导；带领；操纵；[计]引导

examples.en: a tour guide
examples.zh: 导游

examples.en: an experienced mountain guide
examples.zh: 一位有经验的登山向导

words.definition: to happen or be present in a particular situation or place; occur, live, harbor
words.translation: 存在；生存；生活；继续存在

examples.en: The custom of arranged marriages still exists in many countries.
examples.zh: 许多国家仍存在包办婚姻的习俗。

examples.en: Opportunities exist for students to gain sponsorship.
examples.zh: 学生有机会获得资助。

examples.en: Stop pretending that the problem doesn’t exist.
examples.zh: 别再假装这个问题不存在了。

words.definition: a large number of cases of a disease that happen at the same time; popular, fashionable, going, ruling, pop; infection, infectious disease
words.translation: 流行的；传染性的；传染病；流行病；风尚等的流行；[医]流行的

examples.en: Over 500 people died during last year’s flu epidemic.
examples.zh: 去年流感大暴发期间有五百多人死亡。

words.definition: white, grey or black gas that is produced by something burning; to suck or breathe in smoke from a cigarette, pipe etc or to do this regularly as a habit; tobacco, ephemerality; fume; puff on
words.translation: 烟；抽烟；无常的事物；冒烟，吸烟；弥漫；[环境]烟；吸烟；抽

examples.en: cigarette smoke
examples.zh: 香烟的烟雾

examples.en: Smoke from burning fields drifted across nearby roads.
examples.zh: 地里燃烧产生的烟雾飘到了附近的公路上。

examples.en: the pall of smoke (= thick cloud of smoke ) that hung over the city
examples.zh: 笼罩在城市上空的浓烟

words.definition: not completely hard, but not soft, and not easy to bend into a different shape; to make or become firm; a business or company, especially a small one; committed, strict, precise, rigid, confirmed; steady; steadily; corporation, establishment, company, incorporation
words.translation: 坚定的；牢固的；严格的；结实的；使坚定；使牢固；稳固地；公司；商号

examples.en: The sofa cushions are fairly firm.
examples.zh: 沙发的坐垫很硬。

examples.en: a firm green apple
examples.zh: 硬的青苹果

examples.en: Most doctors recommend sleeping on a firm mattress.
examples.zh: 大多数医生建议睡硬床垫。

words.definition: to say something in a strong way; stress, highlight
words.translation: 强调，着重

examples.en: The report emphasizes the importance of improving safety standards.
examples.zh: 报告强调了改进安全标准的重要性。

examples.en: Logan made a speech emphasizing the need for more volunteers.
examples.zh: 罗根发表演讲，强调需要更多的志愿者。

words.definition: poems in general, or the art of writing them; poem, verse
words.translation: 诗；诗意，诗情；诗歌艺术

examples.en: He reads a lot of poetry.
examples.zh: 他大量阅读诗歌。

examples.en: a poetry magazine
examples.zh: 诗歌杂志

words.definition: noticing or realizing something; aware, intended, studied, designed
words.translation: 意识到的；故意的；神志清醒的

examples.en: The driver was still conscious when the ambulance arrived.
examples.zh: 救护车赶到时，司机仍然神志清醒。

words.definition: something that you hope to achieve in the future; target, object, destination, cause, aim
words.translation: 目标；球门，得分数；终点；攻门，射门得分

examples.en: Your goal as a parent is to help your child become an independent adult.
examples.zh: 身为父母，你的目标就是要培养孩子成为独立的成年人。

words.definition: the final result of a meeting, discussion, war etc – used especially when no one knows what it will be until it actually happens; product, result, conclusion, event, feedback
words.translation: 结果，结局；成果

examples.en: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
examples.zh: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

words.definition: someone who reads books, or who reads in a particular way; audience, Adobe Reader
words.translation: 读者；阅读器；读物；[图情]读者；[计]阅读器

examples.en: The book will appeal to young readers.
examples.zh: 这本书会吸引年轻读者。

examples.en: I’ve always been an avid reader (= someone who reads a lot ) .
examples.zh: 我向来是一个嗜书如命的人。

words.definition: the opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past; credit, name, fame, celebrity, prestige
words.translation: 名声，名誉；声望

examples.en: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
examples.zh: 艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

words.definition: to tell or show what you are feeling or thinking by using words, looks, or actions; clear and definite; a train or bus that does not stop in many places and therefore travels quickly; voice, put; precise, decided, technical, rapid, specific; rapido, flier
words.translation: 表达；快递；明确的；迅速的；专门的；快车，快递，专使；捷运公司；[交]快车，快递，专使

examples.en: Parents have expressed their concerns about their children’s safety.
examples.zh: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

examples.en: She expressed an interest in seeing York.
examples.zh: 她表示有兴趣见见约克。

examples.en: Many people have expressed their opposition to the proposals.
examples.zh: 许多人反对这些提议。

words.definition: to suddenly see someone or something, especially after searching for them; someone whose job is to find out secret information about another country, organization, or group; detect, scout around; scout around, keek; illegal, espionage
words.translation: 侦察；发现；暗中监视；间谍；密探；[军]当间谍；[军]间谍

examples.en: Ellen suddenly spied her friend in the crowd.
examples.zh: 埃伦突然在人群中找到了她的朋友。

words.definition: a building where Christians go to worship; exercise, worship; ecclesial, hierurgical
words.translation: 教堂；礼拜；教派；教会的；礼拜的；领…到教堂接受宗教仪式

examples.en: a short church service
examples.zh: 简短的教堂礼拜仪式

examples.en: church bells
examples.zh: 教堂的钟

words.definition: not in the correct way; behaviour that is not morally right; not correct, and not based on true facts; Wrong is also an adverb; in error, incorrectly; bad, injustice; false, incorrect, unhappy, improper, inadequate; vilify, asperse
words.translation: 错误地；邪恶地，不正当地；坏事；不公正；错误的；失常的；不适当的；委屈；无理地对待；诽谤；邪恶的，不正当地

examples.en: You’ve spelt my name wrong.
examples.zh: 你把我的名字拼错了。

examples.en: What? Have I done it wrong ?
examples.zh: 什么？我做得不对吗？

examples.en: I asked him to sort those files, but he’s done it all wrong (= in completely the wrong way ) .
examples.zh: 我让他整理这些文件，可是他弄得根本不对。

words.definition: an action, especially an official one, that is intended to deal with a particular problem; to find the size, length, or amount of something, using standard units such as  inch es  ,metres etc; extent, degree, survey, dimension, size; sound, scale, estimate; take stock of, weigh up
words.translation: 测量；措施；程度；尺寸；估量；权衡

examples.en: New safety measures were being demanded after last night’s horrific train crash.
examples.zh: 昨晚发生严重的火车相撞事故后，民众要求制定新的安全措施。

examples.en: The new bridge was erected as a temporary measure to replace the one which was destroyed by floods.
examples.zh: 建这座新桥是为了临时代替被洪水毁坏的那座桥。

words.definition: most of the people or things in a group; plurality, multitude
words.translation: 多数；成年

examples.en: The Labour Party won a huge majority at the last general election.
examples.zh: 工党在上次大选中以巨大的票数优势获胜。

words.definition: a place where goods are sold to the public. In British English, a store is large and sells many different things, but in American English, a store can be large or small, and sell many things or only one type of thing.; to put things away and keep them until you need them; shop, reserve, warehouse, market; reposit, put away
words.translation: 商店；储备，贮藏；仓库；贮藏，储存；[贸易][金融]储备，贮藏；[建][经]仓库；贮藏，[贸易]储存

examples.en: At Christmas the stores stay open late.
examples.zh: 在圣诞节期间，商店营业到很晚。

words.definition: a description of how something happened, that is intended to entertain people, and may be true or imaginary; to decorate (a pot, wall, etc) with scenes from history or legends; relation, history, novel, tale, fiction; lie
words.translation: 故事；小说；新闻报道；来历；假话；用历史故事画装饰；说谎

examples.en: a book of short stories
examples.zh: 短篇小说集

examples.en: We cuddled together over a bedtime story .
examples.zh: 我们依偎在一起看睡前故事。

examples.en: The film was based on a true story .
examples.zh: 这部影片是根据真实故事改编的。

words.definition: someone who knows a lot about a particular subject, especially one that is not a science subject; student, academic
words.translation: 学者；奖学金获得者

examples.en: a Shakespearean scholar
examples.zh: 研究莎士比亚的学者

words.definition: to obtain something by buying it or being given it; earn, buy, score, find, make
words.translation: 获得；取得；学到；捕获

examples.en: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
examples.zh: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

examples.en: She has acquired an email address and a site on the World Wide Web.
examples.zh: 她获得了一个电子邮件地址和万维网网址。

words.definition: if a person or a thing is reflected in a mirror, glass, or water, you can see an image of the person or thing on the surface of the mirror, glass, or water; glass, image; give back, flash back
words.translation: 反映；反射，照出；表达；显示;反省；反省；反射，映现；深思

examples.en: The drop in consumer spending reflects concern about the economy.
examples.zh: 消费支出的下降反映出人们对经济的担忧。

words.definition: affecting or including the whole world; spherical, ball-shaped
words.translation: 全球的；总体的；球形的

examples.en: global climate change
examples.zh: 全球气候变化

examples.en: the global economy
examples.zh: 全球经济

words.definition: a group or class of people, things etc that have similar qualities or features; to put things in a particular order or arrange them in groups according to size, type etc; category, manner, way of, variety, kind, mode, nature; travel, company, mix, associate, concert; systematize
words.translation: 种类；方式；品质；分类；协调；交往；[计]分类；将…分类；将…排序；挑选出某物

examples.en: Most of the victims developed psychological problems of one sort or another (= of various different types ) .
examples.zh: 大多数受害者都出现了这样那样的心理问题。

examples.en: They do burgers, pizzas, that sort of thing .
examples.zh: 他们供应汉堡包、比萨饼什么的。

words.definition: to stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping; the time before or after a funeral when friends and relatives meet to remember the dead person; awake, arouse; inspire, make someone tick; vigil, night watch
words.translation: 醒来；唤醒；警觉；尾迹；守夜；守丧；叫醒；激发

examples.en: When she woke, the sun was streaming through the windows.
examples.zh: 她醒来时，阳光泻入窗内。

examples.en: Try not to wake the baby.
examples.zh: 尽量不要吵醒宝宝。

words.definition: a feeling of being not sure whether something is true or right; to think that something may not be true or that it is unlikely; challenge, question, query, suspicion; suspect of, be suspicious of
words.translation: 怀疑；疑问；疑惑；不信；恐怕；拿不准；[法]怀疑

examples.en: There was still one little nagging doubt at the back of his mind.
examples.zh: 他的心头仍有一丝挥之不去的疑虑。

words.definition: a  geometric  shape; to be an important part of a process, event, or situation, or to be included in something; digital, price, value, number, rate; occur, cast, offer, come out; indicate, expect, guess, find, feel
words.translation: 数字；人物；图形；价格；（人的）体形；画像；计算；出现；扮演角色；[数]数字；认为；描绘；象征

examples.en: A hexagon is a six-sided figure.
examples.zh: 六边形是一种有六条边的几何图形。

words.definition: an organization that consists of a group of people who have the same aims, do the same kind of work etc; union, alliance, society, corporation, unity, combination
words.translation: 协会，联盟，社团；联合；联想；[心理]联想

examples.en: the Association of Master Builders
examples.zh: 建筑师协会

words.definition: a connection between two or more things; connection, statement, bearing, concern, story
words.translation: 关系；叙述；故事；亲属关系；[计]关系

examples.en: The price the meat is sold for bears no relation to (= is not connected to ) the price the farmer receives.
examples.zh: 肉的售价和农民拿到的价格无关。

words.definition: to block a hole or pipe so that water, smoke etc cannot go through it; if an activity comes to a stop, it stops happening; cheese, quit; remain, desist from; visit, bar, stay, obstacle, dam
words.translation: 停止；堵塞；断绝；车站；障碍；逗留；中止；被塞住；[交]车站

examples.en: Stop throwing those stones!
examples.zh: 别再扔那些石头了！

words.definition: to give money, help, ideas etc to something that a lot of other people are also involved in; make contribution, offer up
words.translation: 贡献，出力；投稿；捐献；[图情]投稿；[经]捐献

examples.en: The three sons also contribute to the family business.
examples.zh: 3个儿子也为家族企业做贡献。

words.definition: to save something or someone from being harmed or destroyed; maintain, save, secure, corn, sustain; conservation area, conservation district
words.translation: 保存；保护；维持；腌；禁猎；保护区；禁猎地；加工成的食品

examples.en: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
examples.zh: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

words.definition: to look at something carefully and thoroughly because you want to find out more about it; inspect, review, survey; probe, check for
words.translation: 检查；调查；检测；考试

examples.en: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
examples.zh: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

examples.en: Hegel’s philosophy will be examined in detail in Chapter 4.
examples.zh: 黑格尔的哲学将在第4章作详细探讨。

words.definition: easy to notice or understand; distinct, visible, prominent, marked, evident
words.translation: 明显的；显著的；平淡无奇的

examples.en: The obvious way of reducing pollution is to use cars less.
examples.zh: 减少污染显而易见的办法就是少用汽车。

words.definition: knowledge gained through reading and study; knowledge, study, letter; studying
words.translation: 学习；学问；学习（learn的现在分词）；[心理]学习；[心理]学习（learn的现在分词）

examples.en: a man of great learning
examples.zh: 学识渊博的人

words.definition: a belief, custom, or way of doing something that has existed for a long time, or these beliefs, customs etc in general; convention, usage, heritage, tale, prescription
words.translation: 惯例，传统；传说

examples.en: the traditions of South East Asia
examples.zh: 东南亚的传统

examples.en: the tradition that the eldest son inherits the property
examples.zh: 长子继承家产的传统

examples.en: By tradition, it’s the bride’s parents who pay for the wedding.
examples.zh: 根据传统习俗，婚礼的费用由新娘的父母承担。

words.definition: something you say or write, especially publicly or officially, to let people know your intentions or opinions, or to record facts; presentation, profession, relation, representation, bill
words.translation: 声明；陈述，叙述；报表，清单；[法]声明

examples.en: In an official statement, she formally announced her resignation.
examples.zh: 在一份官方声明中，她正式宣布辞职。

words.definition: to start a company, organization, system, etc that is intended to exist or continue for a long time; build, found, constitute, put, station
words.translation: 建立；创办；安置

examples.en: The city of Boerne was established by German settlers in the 1840s.
examples.zh: 博恩市是德国移民于19世纪40年代建立的。

examples.en: Our goal is to establish a new research centre in the North.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是在北方建立一个新的研究中心。

words.definition: to start doing something instead of another person, or start being used instead of another thing; restore, return, shift, tender
words.translation: 取代，代替；替换，更换；归还，偿还；把…放回原处

examples.en: I’m replacing Sue on the team.
examples.zh: 我将接替队里的休。

examples.en: Lectures have replaced the old tutorial system.
examples.zh: 课堂授课取代了旧式的导师制。

words.definition: to not have something that you need, or not have enough of it; when there is not enough of something, or none of it; ask, claim; fail, low in; shortage, short of, deficiency, need, drought
words.translation: 缺乏；不足；没有；需要

examples.en: Alex’s real problem is that he lacks confidence.
examples.zh: 亚历克斯的真正问题是缺乏信心。

words.definition: the place or situation in which something begins to exist; birth, extraction, dawn
words.translation: 起源；原点；出身；开端；[数]原点

examples.en: The tradition has its origins in the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 这一传统源于中世纪。

examples.en: old folk tales of unknown origin
examples.zh: 起源不明的古老民间传说

words.definition: continuously moving or changing; something that causes action or change; vital, actional; trends, momentum, impetus
words.translation: 动态的；动力的；动力学的；有活力的；动态；动力；[力]动态的；[力]动力

examples.en: a dynamic and unstable process
examples.zh: 不断变化的、不稳定的过程

words.definition: to experience physical or mental pain; stomach, stand, experience, tough, abide; stomach, come under
words.translation: 遭受；忍受；经历；(Suffer)人名；(意)苏费尔；遭受，忍受；受痛苦；经验；受损害

examples.en: At least he died suddenly and didn’t suffer.
examples.zh: 至少他死得突然，没有遭罪。

examples.en: She’s suffering a lot of pain.
examples.zh: 她遭受着巨大的痛苦。

words.definition: relating to women or girls; an animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs; delicate, feminine; she, jenny
words.translation: 女性的；雌性的；柔弱的，柔和的；女人；[动] 雌性动物；[生物]雌性的；[植][动]雌性动物

examples.en: female voters
examples.zh: 女性选民

examples.en: Over half of the staff is female.
examples.zh: 半数以上的员工是女性。

words.definition: an illness which affects a person, animal, or plant; illness, ill, sickness, complaint; to infect
words.translation: 病，[医] 疾病；弊病；传染；使…有病；[医]病，疾病

examples.en: His father died of heart disease.
examples.zh: 他父亲死于心脏病。

examples.en: She contracted the disease while she was abroad on holiday.
examples.zh: 她在国外度假时染上了这种疾病。

words.definition: the amount of money you have to pay for goods or services; to say publicly that you think someone has done something wrong; fee, instruction, cost, bidding, word; electrify, inflict on; law, sue for
words.translation: 费用；电荷；掌管；控告；命令；负载；使充电；使承担；指责；装载；对…索费；向…冲去；[会计]费用；[法]控告；[电]负载；[电]使充电；[电]充电；索价；向前冲；记在账上

examples.en: Guided tours are provided at no charge .
examples.zh: 免费提供有导游带队的观光游览。

examples.en: Your order will be sent free of charge (= with no cost ) .
examples.zh: 你订的货物将免费运送。

words.definition: farm animals, especially cattle; if a shop stocks a particular product, it keeps a supply of it to sell; birth, blood, stem; ordinary, mediocre; be furnished with; corner
words.translation: 股份，股票；库存；血统；树干；家畜；存货的，常备的；平凡的；进货；备有；装把手于…；[金融]股份，股票；[贸易]库存；[贸易]存货的，常备的；囤积；办货；出新芽

examples.en: We have a huge stock of quality carpets on sale.
examples.zh: 我们备有大量优质地毯出售。

words.definition: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement, especially in business or politics; transfer, surmount; transact
words.translation: 谈判，商议；转让；越过；谈判，交涉

examples.en: His first aim is to get the warring parties back to the negotiating table (= discussing something ).
examples.zh: 他的首要目标就是把交战各方拉回到谈判桌上。

words.definition: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly; trust, hope
words.translation: 依靠；信赖

examples.en: They relied heavily on the advice of their professional advisers.
examples.zh: 他们非常依赖专业顾问的建议。

words.definition: a strong hope or wish; If you desire something, you want it; requirement, wants, do, need, wish; feel like, wanna, require, mean, exact; rare, aspire, long for, yearn for, die for
words.translation: 欲望；要求，心愿；性欲；想要；要求；希望得到…；渴望

examples.en: female sexual desire
examples.zh: 女性的性欲

examples.en: She had remarried and desired a child with her new husband.
examples.zh: 她再婚了，想跟新任丈夫生一个孩子。

words.definition: a children’s activity in which they play with toys, pretend to be someone else etc; If you are game for something, you are willing to do something new, unusual, or risky; to play games of chance for money, stakes, etc; gamble; competition, play, sport, tournament, match; brave, stronghearted; gamble, shake the elbows
words.translation: 游戏；比赛；勇敢的；赌博

examples.en: The boys were playing a game in the backyard.
examples.zh: 男孩们在后院里玩游戏。

examples.en: He said he's game for a similar challenge next year.
examples.zh: 他说明年他敢尝试一次类似的挑战。

words.definition: a piece of writing or a plan that is not yet in its finished form; to write a plan, letter, report etc that will need to be changed before it is in its finished form; a piece of writing that is not yet in its finished form
words.translation: 汇票；草稿；选派；（尤指房间、烟囱、炉子等供暖系统中的）（小股）气流；起草；制定；征募；初步画出或（写出）的；（设计、草图、提纲或版本）正在起草中的，草拟的；以草稿形式的；草图的

examples.en: the rough draft of his new novel
examples.zh: 他的新小说的草稿

examples.en: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
examples.zh: 我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。

examples.en: All parties eventually approved the final draft (= finished form ) of the peace treaty.
examples.zh: 各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。

words.definition: relating to the health or state of someone’s mind; spiritual, inner; psychopath, madman
words.translation: 精神的；脑力的；疯的；精神病患者；[心理]精神的

examples.en: The centre provides help for people suffering from mental illness .
examples.zh: 该中心对精神病患者提供帮助。

examples.en: Stress has an effect on both your physical and mental health .
examples.zh: 压力对身体健康和心理健康都有影响。

words.definition: the part of a plant or tree that grows under the ground and gets water from the soil; to grow roots; parent, principle, father, radix; radicate; fix on, hold in place
words.translation: 根；根源；词根；祖先；生根；根除；[数][植]根；生根，固定；根源在于

examples.en: tree roots
examples.zh: 树根

examples.en: These plants produce a number of thin roots.
examples.zh: 这些植物会长出一些细根。

words.definition: something that happens or exists in society, science, or nature, especially something that is studied because it is difficult to understand; wonder, miracle
words.translation: 现象；奇迹；杰出的人才；[物]现象

examples.en: Homelessness is not a new phenomenon .
examples.zh: 无家可归已不是什么新现象。

words.definition: if different people or organizations unite, or if something unites them, they join together in order to achieve something; intermix; league, band, combine, connect, rally
words.translation: 使…混合；使…联合；使…团结；团结；联合；混合

examples.en: Our goal is to unite the opposition parties and defeat the President.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是联合各反对党挫败总统。

words.definition: treating everyone in a way that is right or equal; absolutely or squarely; quite; an outdoor event, at which there are large machines to ride on, games to play, and sometimes farm animals being judged and sold; beautiful, fine, clear, just, impartial; definitely, directly, equally, immediately, straight; expo, exhibition, beauty
words.translation: 公平的；美丽的，白皙的；[气象] 晴朗的；公平地；直接地；清楚地；转晴；展览会；市集；美人；[气象]晴朗的；[经]展览会

examples.en: Why does Eric get to go and I don’t? It’s not fair!
examples.zh: 为什么埃里克能去我不能？这不公平！

examples.en: Life isn’t always fair.
examples.zh: 生活并非总是公平的。

examples.en: My boss expects a lot – but he’s very fair.
examples.zh: 我的老板要求很高——但是他很公平。

words.definition: having happened or started only a short time ago; latest, modern, current, nearest, last
words.translation: 最近的；近代的；[地质]最近的

examples.en: Irving’s most recent book
examples.zh: 欧文最新的书

examples.en: recent research into the causes of cancer
examples.zh: 近来对致癌原因的研究

examples.en: the recent past
examples.zh: 不久前

words.definition: an arrangement with a company in which you pay them money, especially regularly, and they pay the costs if something bad happens, for example if you become ill or your car is damaged; assurance, safety, premium, compensation
words.translation: 保险；保险费；保险契约；赔偿金；[保险]保险

examples.en: Your father took out insurance to cover the mortgage.
examples.zh: 你父亲购买了抵押借款保险。

words.definition: a work of art or a document that is not a copy, but is the one produced by the writer or artist; existing or happening first, before other people or things; archetype, antitype; initial, premier, primitive
words.translation: 原件；原作；原物；原型；原始的；最初的；独创的；新颖的；[摄]原件；[经]原物；[摄]原始的

examples.en: The colours are much more striking in the original.
examples.zh: 原作的色彩要鲜艳得多。

examples.en: I’ll keep a copy of the contract, and give you the original.
examples.zh: 我将留一份合同副本，把原件给你。

words.definition: to give something to someone in exchange for money; promote, find a market; bring to market, go to sb for; marketing, disappointment
words.translation: 销售；推销；出卖；欺骗；失望；推销术；卖；出售；受欢迎；有销路

examples.en: If you offer him another hundred, I think he’ll sell.
examples.zh: 如果你再加一百元钱，我想他会卖的。

examples.en: He regrets selling all his old records.
examples.zh: 他后悔把所有的老唱片都卖掉了。

words.definition: the official legal position or condition of a person, group, country etc; capacity, ranking
words.translation: 地位；状态；情形；重要身份；重要身分

examples.en: These documents have no legal status in Britain.
examples.zh: 这些文件在英国并无法律效力。

examples.en: What is your marital status (= are you married or not ) ?
examples.zh: 你的婚姻状况是什么？

words.definition: good wishes - used when sending your good wishes to someone or when ending a short letter or message; to think about someone or something in a particular way; estimation, respect, notice, publicity; view, study, honor, think about; take care of, watch
words.translation: 注意；尊重；问候；凝视；注重，考虑；看待；尊敬；把…看作；与…有关；注意，注重；注视

examples.en: My husband sends his regards .
examples.zh: 我丈夫向你问好。

examples.en: Hope to see you soon. Regards, Chris
examples.zh: 希望很快见到你。 祝安，克里斯

words.definition: when people laugh, or the sound of people laughing; risus
words.translation: 笑；笑声

examples.en: Foster joined in the laughter.
examples.zh: 福斯特也跟着笑了起来。

examples.en: He looked shocked, then burst into laughter (= started laughing ).
examples.zh: 他一脸的震惊，接着便放声大笑起来。

words.definition: to make a serious public request for help, money, information etc; an urgent request for something important; attract, clamour for; asking, request, motion, charm
words.translation: 呼吁，恳求；上诉；诉诸，求助；有吸引力，迎合爱好；（体育比赛中）诉诸裁判；呼吁，请求；吸引力，感染力；诉诸裁判；[法]上诉

examples.en: She is not happy with the decision and plans to appeal.
examples.zh: 她不服判决，打算上诉。

words.definition: agree, love, uphold, make sure, sustain; affection, keen on
words.translation: 赞成；喜欢；像；赐予；证实；喜爱；欢心；好感

words.definition: to be acceptable, suitable, or  convenient  for a particular person or in a particular situation; a set of clothes made of the same material, usually including a jacket with trousers or a skirt; become, condition, season, adapt to something; litigation, group, team, lawsuit, law; balance, be in order
words.translation: 适合；使适应；诉讼；恳求；套装，西装；一套外衣；组；套装；合适；相称

examples.en: Whatever your reason for borrowing, we have the loan that suits your needs .
examples.zh: 不管您因何贷款，我们都会有满足您需要的贷款。

examples.en: There’s a range of restaurants to suit all tastes .
examples.zh: 有各种各样的餐馆可以满足所有口味。

examples.en: There are countryside walks to suit everyone .
examples.zh: 有适合每个人的乡村步行路径。

words.definition: the thing or things that someone owns; performance, nature, ownership, estate, capability
words.translation: 性质，性能；财产；所有权；[经]财产；[法]所有权

examples.en: The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests’ personal property .
examples.zh: 宾馆对住客个人财物的丢失和损坏概不负责。

examples.en: Some of the stolen property was found in Mason’s house.
examples.zh: 在梅森家里找到了部分被盗财物。

words.definition: slightly hot, especially in a pleasant way; to make someone or something warm or warmer, or to become warm or warmer; intense, hot, tropical, enthusiastic, passionate; fire, sympathize; excite; heating up, calefaction
words.translation: 温暖的；热情的；同情；激动；变温暖；取暖；加热；使…兴奋；使…温暖；使…感兴趣

examples.en: The house was lovely and warm.
examples.zh: 那房子漂亮温暖。

examples.en: I hope we get some warm weather soon.
examples.zh: 我希望天气很快就会回暖。

examples.en: I’ve put your dinner in the oven to keep it warm.
examples.zh: 我把你的饭菜放进了烤箱里保温。

words.definition: sceptical, suspicious
words.translation: 怀疑的；怀疑论的，不可知论的

examples.en: Not all theory that we read in this course is skeptical.
examples.zh: 我们在这门课中提及的理论不全是怀疑性的。

examples.en: L.M.:Well, I was skeptical myself in the beginning. But these are facts. The findings are very reproducible and we are waiting for confirmation by other labs.
examples.zh: 大爷：我老人家一开始也是很怀疑的。但是这个是事实。这个发现可以被反复验证，我们正在等待别的实验是的验证。

words.definition: the power you have because of your official position; rod, jurisdiction
words.translation: 权威；权力；当局；[法]权力

examples.en: an agreement between the US and Colombian authorities
examples.zh: 美国和哥伦比亚当局的一份协议

words.definition: the movement you make when you put one foot in front of or behind the other when walking; to bring your foot down on something; procedure, move; go, walk, track; wend one's way, pad
words.translation: 步，脚步；步骤；步伐；梯级；踏，踩；走；[建]梯级；走，迈步

examples.en: a video of baby’s first steps
examples.zh: 一盒婴儿学步的录像带

examples.en: He took one step and fell.
examples.zh: 他走了一步就跌倒了。

examples.en: I had to retrace my steps (= go back the way I came ) several times before I found the shop.
examples.zh: 我来回走了几次才找到那家商店。

words.definition: a duty to be in charge of someone or something, so that you make decisions and can be blamed if something bad happens
words.translation: 责任，职责；义务

examples.en: Kelly’s promotion means more money and more responsibility.
examples.zh: 凯利获得提升，这意味着钱多了，责任也更大了。

words.definition: a substance used in chemistry or produced by a chemical process; relating to substances, the study of substances, or processes involving changes in substances; chymic
words.translation: 化学制品，化学药品；化学的；[化工]化学的

examples.en: the organic chemicals industry
examples.zh: 有机化学工业

examples.en: synthetic chemicals
examples.zh: 合成化学品

words.definition: in or from the south of a country or area; austral
words.translation: 南的；南方的；南方人

examples.en: a southern accent
examples.zh: 南部口音

examples.en: Southern Italy
examples.zh: 意大利南部

words.definition: to change or move something slightly to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose; regulate, coordinate, frame, restructure; correct, adapt to something
words.translation: 调整，使…适合；校准；调整，校准；适应

examples.en: Check and adjust the brakes regularly.
examples.zh: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

examples.en: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning.
examples.zh: 尝尝汤的味道，然后调整佐料用量。

examples.en: If your employment status changes, your tax code will be adjusted accordingly.
examples.zh: 如果就业状况改变，你的免税代码也会作相应调整。

words.definition: ordinary, usual, or happening every day; daily, household, routine; peacetime
words.translation: 每天的，日常的；平时；寻常日子

examples.en: the problems of everyday life
examples.zh: 日常生活中的问题

examples.en: wearing everyday clothes
examples.zh: 穿平常衣服

examples.en: a simple, everyday object
examples.zh: 简单的日常物品

words.definition: someone who studies and develops ideas about the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil etc; wise man, rishi
words.translation: 哲学家；哲人

examples.en: Plato, Aristotle, and other Greek philosophers
examples.zh: 柏拉图、亚里士多德和其他希腊哲学家

words.definition: a large thin book with a paper cover that contains news stories, articles, photographs etc, and is sold weekly or monthly; journal, mags
words.translation: 杂志；弹药库；胶卷盒

examples.en: a magazine article
examples.zh: 杂志中的文章

examples.en: She glanced over the magazine racks.
examples.zh: 她扫了一眼杂志架。

words.definition: problems or difficulties; to say something or ask someone to do something which may use or waste their time or upset them; worry, fault, headache; harry, worry, tear; worry, bother about
words.translation: 麻烦；烦恼；故障；动乱；使烦恼；折磨；费心，烦恼

examples.en: Recent stock market losses point to trouble ahead.
examples.zh: 最近股市的下跌预示着未来将有麻烦。

words.definition: the vehicles moving along a road or street; transportation, commerce, trade, carriage; exchange, trade in
words.translation: 交通；运输；贸易；[通信] 通信量；用…作交换；在…通行；[交]交通；[通信]通信量；交易，买卖

examples.en: There wasn’t much traffic on the roads.
examples.zh: 路上车辆不多。

examples.en: The sound of the traffic kept me awake.
examples.zh: 车辆来往的嘈杂声令我无法入睡。

words.definition: how big or small something is; to sort according to size; measurement, magnitude, dimension
words.translation: 大小；尺寸；一定尺寸的；依大小排列

examples.en: He’s a small boy, about John’s size.
examples.zh: 他是个小男孩，个子和约翰差不多。

examples.en: Jensens’ house is about the same size as ours.
examples.zh: 詹森的房子和我们的差不多大。

examples.en: He’s quite a big dog, but he’s still not full size yet.
examples.zh: 这条狗体型很大，但还没有长足。

words.definition: a long thin creature with no bones and no legs that lives in soil; nobody, endless screw; work; inch

examples.zh: …一种使安全软件失灵的新型计算机蠕虫病毒。

words.definition: to use your teeth to cut, crush, or chew something; the act of cutting or crushing something with your teeth; cut, gnaw at; smart, mouthful; smart, gnaw at

examples.zh: 那只狗把他的手咬出血了。

words.definition: password, cryptogram; encode
words.translation: 代码，密码；编码；法典；制成法典；代码，[遗][通信]密码；[计]编码；[法]法典

words.definition: to succeed in dealing with a difficult problem or situation; a long loose piece of clothing worn by priests on special occasions; manage, contest; gown, robe

examples.zh: 有时候我觉得很难应付。

examples.en: He coped quite well as manager while still captaining the team.
examples.zh: 他是球队的主教练，同时兼任队长，干得相当好。

words.definition: the act of paying for something; compensation, punishment, consideration, rod, discipline
words.translation: 付款，支付；报酬，报答；偿还；惩罚，报应；付款，[会计]支付

examples.en: Payment can be made by cheque or credit card.
examples.zh: 可以用支票或信用卡付款。

examples.en: We do accept payment in instalments (= paying in small amounts over a period of time ) .
examples.zh: 我们确实接受分期付款。

examples.en: She demanded payment in advance .
examples.zh: 她要求预先付款。

words.definition: to lead or take part in a series of actions intended to achieve a particular social or political result; a series of actions intended to achieve a particular result relating to politics or business, or a social improvement; war, battle; movement, activity, exercise, sport, battle
words.translation: 作战；参加竞选；参加活动；运动；活动；战役

examples.en: Jones ran a good campaign.
examples.zh: 琼斯的活动搞得很成功。

examples.en: Police have launched a campaign to crack down on drug dealers.
examples.zh: 警方发起了一场严厉打击毒贩的运动。

words.definition: delivery, pursuit, job, work, task; apply oneself, struggle; wear down

examples.zh: 这绝非如此，因为供应链本身就依赖于低廉的劳动力成本。

words.definition: someone you work with – used especially by professional people; brother, fellow, associate
words.translation: 同事，同僚

examples.en: a colleague of mine from the bank
examples.zh: 我在银行的一位同事

examples.en: She discussed the idea with some of her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她和几位同事讨论了这个想法。

words.definition: one part or feature of a whole system, plan, piece of work etc, especially one that is basic or important; theory, mechanism, factor, basic, essential
words.translation: 元素；要素；原理；成分；自然环境；[数]元素

examples.zh: 本课程加入了商务和管理方面的内容。

words.definition: the physical ability to see; to see something from a long distance away, or see something you have been looking for; vision, scene, eye, scope, seeing; see, clap eyes on; level, watch; off-the-cuff, improvisatorial
words.translation: 视力；景象；眼界；见解；看见；瞄准；见票即付的；即席的；观看

examples.en: Anne’s sight is very good for someone of her age.
examples.zh: 安妮的视力对于她这个年龄的人来说算是非常好的。

examples.en: He began to lose his sight six years ago.
examples.zh: 六年前他开始视力衰退。

examples.en: an emergency operation to save his sight
examples.zh: 挽救他视力的紧急手术

words.definition: a strong belief in the honesty, goodness etc of someone or something; to believe that someone is honest or will not do anything bad or wrong; duty, liability, belief, faith, confidence; credit, believe in; hope, believe in
words.translation: 信任，信赖；责任；托拉斯；盼望；赊卖给；依靠

examples.en: At first there was a lack of trust between them.
examples.zh: 起初，他们之间缺乏信任。

examples.en: an agreement made on the basis of mutual trust
examples.zh: 在相互信任的基础上达成的一项协议

examples.en: You betrayed your father’s trust (= did something bad even though he trusted you ) .
examples.zh: 你辜负了你父亲对你的信任。

words.definition: a way in which two things or ideas are related to each other; to physically join two or more things, people, or places; relationship, connection, bearing, contact, concern; couple, become one
words.translation: [计] 链环，环节；联系，关系；连接，连结；联合，结合；[计]链环，环节；[计]连接，[铁路]连结

examples.en: Send an email to the above address to report a broken link (= a link that is not working properly ).
examples.zh: 如发现链接失败，请发送电子邮件至上述地址告知。

words.definition: a large area with houses, shops, offices etc where people live and work, that is smaller than a city and larger than a village; ville, burgh
words.translation: 城镇，市镇；市内商业区；[建]城镇，市镇

examples.en: an industrial town in the Midlands
examples.zh: 英格兰中部的一座工业城镇

examples.en: I walked to the nearest town.
examples.zh: 我走到最近的镇上。

words.definition: the right to do what you want without being controlled or restricted by anyone; independence, liberty
words.translation: 自由，自主；直率；[物]自由，自主

examples.en: People here like their freedom and privacy.
examples.zh: 这里的人喜欢他们所拥有的自由与隐私权。

examples.zh: 公民的权利与自由

examples.en: the freedom to vote
examples.zh: 选举自由

words.definition: to be in a particular position or condition; lie on, be located on
words.translation: 坐；位于；(Sit)人名；(东南亚国家华语)硕；(罗)西特

examples.zh: 议会大楼位于一个大广场上。

examples.en: He’s got a computer sitting on his desk, but he doesn’t use it.
examples.zh: 他有一台电脑放在书桌上，但他不用。

examples.en: My climbing boots were sitting unused in a cupboard.
examples.zh: 我的登山靴在橱柜里，一直没有穿。

words.definition: an amount of something worth ten pounds, $500 etc; importance, estate, property, price, value
words.translation: 值…的；价值；财产

examples.en: You should not deprecate your own worth.
examples.zh: 你不应该贬低你自己的价值。

words.definition: to do something wrong or illegal; sin, do sth. wrong
words.translation: 犯罪，做错事；把交托给；指派…作战；使…承担义务；把...交托给

examples.en: Women commit fewer crimes than men.
examples.zh: 女性犯罪比男性少。

words.definition: a member of your family who lived a long time ago; father, root, grandfather
words.translation: 始祖，祖先；被继承人；始祖，[生物]祖先

examples.en: My ancestors were French.
examples.zh: 我的祖先是法国人。

words.definition: to use violence or threats to take control of a plane, vehicle, or ship; when a plane, vehicle etc is hijacked; rob of, spoliate; chantage, extortion
words.translation: 抢劫；揩油；劫持；威逼；敲诈

examples.en: The airliner was hijacked by a group of terrorists.
examples.zh: 该航班被一帮恐怖分子劫持。

words.definition: to stop working or doing an activity for a time and sit down or lie down to relax; a period of time when you are not doing anything tiring and you can relax or sleep; relax; lay-up, stillness; relax, still
words.translation: 使休息，使轻松；把…寄托于；休息，静止；休息时间；剩余部分；支架；休息；静止；依赖；安置

examples.en: If you’re tired, we’ll stop and rest for a while.
examples.zh: 如果你累了，我们就停下来歇一会儿。

words.definition: to start working in a particular profession or organization, or to start studying at a school or university; institute, come into, participate in, go into, get into; participate in, take part in, go through; import, inputting
words.translation: 进入；开始；参加；[计] 输入；回车；参加，登场；进去；[计]输入

examples.en: Both the boys entered the army.
examples.zh: 两个男孩都参了军。

examples.en: She entered politics in 1996.
examples.zh: 她于1996年进入政界。

examples.en: He entered the Church (= became a priest ) as a young man.
examples.zh: 他年轻时就领了圣职。

words.definition: a new idea, method, or invention; reformation, renovation, renewal
words.translation: 创新，革新；新方法

examples.en: We must encourage innovation if the company is to remain competitive.
examples.zh: 公司要想保持竞争力，就必须鼓励革新。

words.definition: to make something continue to exist or happen for a period of time; maintain, undertake, support, accept, favor
words.translation: 维持；支撑，承担；忍受；供养；证实

examples.en: She found it difficult to sustain the children’s interest.
examples.zh: 她发现很难保持孩子们的兴趣。

examples.en: He was incapable of sustaining close relationships with women.
examples.zh: 他无法和女人维持亲密关系。

examples.en: the policies necessary to sustain economic growth
examples.zh: 维持经济增长必需的政策

words.definition: a picture of an object in a mirror or in the lens of a camera; icon, portrait; indicate, vision, glass, figure
words.translation: 影像；想象；肖像；偶像；反映；象征；作…的像

examples.en: She peered closely at her image in the mirror.
examples.zh: 她仔细检视镜子中自己的映像。

words.definition: to be sold for a particular price in a shop; the sale of goods in shops to customers, for their own use and not for selling to anyone else; sell-through, resale
words.translation: 零售；转述；以零售方式；零售的

examples.en: Their products are retailed all over Britain.
examples.zh: 他们的产品在英国各地都有零售。

words.definition: someone who is between 13 and 19 years old
words.translation: 十几岁的青少年；十三岁到十九岁的少年

examples.en: a TV sex education series aimed at teenagers
examples.zh: 一部针对青少年的性教育电视系列片

words.definition: to say that you will cause someone harm or trouble if they do not do what you want; indicate, forecast, shadow, cow; to menace, hang over
words.translation: 威胁；恐吓；预示；可能来临

examples.zh: 邮政工人威胁如果不加薪，他们就要罢工。

words.definition: an international sports game; relating to or involving more than one nation; mundane
words.translation: 国际组织；国际体育比赛；外国居留者；国际股票；国际的；两国（或以上）国家的；超越国界的；国际关系的；世界的

examples.en: the response of the international community
examples.zh: 国际社会的反响

examples.en: the UN and other international organizations
examples.zh: 联合国和其他国际组织

words.definition: to do something again; the sign that tells a performer to play a piece of music again, or the music that is played again; read back, echo; counterpart, iterance; do over, begin again
words.translation: 重复；复制；背诵；副本；重做；重复发生

examples.zh: 这套操每天做两次。

examples.en: We must not repeat the mistakes of the past.
examples.zh: 我们不能再犯以前的错误。

examples.en: The team are hoping to repeat their success (= achieve the same good result ) of last season.
examples.zh: 球队希望再续上一赛季的佳绩。

words.definition: a building or part of a building where you can buy things, food, or services; to go to one or more shops to buy things; store, market; make a purchase
words.translation: 商店；店铺；购物；[贸易]商店；买东西

examples.zh: 理发店

examples.en: a fish-and-chip shop
examples.zh: 炸鱼薯条店

examples.zh: 当地的商店

words.translation: 民族；人们；亲属（复数）；民间的

examples.zh: 我敢肯定有些人宁愿自己不在这里。

examples.zh: 感谢全国广播公司的工作人员。

examples.zh: 等到家乡的人听说这事吧！

words.translation: 证明合法；整理版面

examples.zh: 没有任何理由能证明一个战争有理。

words.translation: 提到，谈到；提及，论及；说起；提及，说起

examples.en: Was my name mentioned at all?
examples.zh: 我的名字被提到过吗？

examples.zh: 其中的一些问题在他的报告里提到了。

examples.en: (= it is important enough to mention ) that they only studied a very small number of cases.
examples.zh: 必须说明的是他们仅研究了几个个案。

words.definition: happening or done every day; a newspaper that is printed and sold every day, or every day except Sunday; everyday, household, routine; journal; habitually, diurnally

examples.zh: 每日飞往迈阿密的航班

examples.zh: 公司已实行对雇员的随机毒品测试。

examples.zh: 胡乱放了几枪。

examples.en: We looked at a random sample of 120 families.
examples.zh: 我们研究了随机抽样的120个家庭。

words.translation: 下降；衰退；斜面；衰落；谢绝；婉拒

examples.zh: 官方数字显示外国游客数量骤降。

examples.zh: 这张邮票贴不牢。

words.definition: one of the two long metal tracks fastened to the ground that trains move along; to complain angrily about something, especially something that you think is very unfair; pen, rider; rate, beef about

examples.zh: 几名乘客斜靠在轮船的栏杆上。

words.translation: 落下；变成；来临；减弱；下降；秋天；瀑布；秋天的；[气象]下降；砍倒；击倒

examples.zh: 那棵树快要倒下了。

examples.en: The book fell from his hands.
examples.zh: 书从他手上跌落。

examples.en: Enough rain had fallen to flood the grounds.
examples.zh: 雨量很大，淹没了地面。

words.definition: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them; deal with, to consult; deal with, to relate to
words.translation: 参考；涉及；提到；查阅；委托；归诸于；使…求助于

examples.zh: 在他的讲话中，他提到了最近的加拿大之行。

words.definition: happening or continuing for only a little time or for less time than usual; a short film shown in the cinema; to almost do something but then decide not to do it; insufficient, deficient, lacking; pop, hardly more than; deficiency, need, drought, want, default
words.translation: 短的；不足的；矮的，低的；短；缺乏；短路；短裤；不足；突然；唐突地；急速的；唐突的

examples.en: a short meeting
examples.zh: 一个短会

examples.en: Morris gave a short laugh.
examples.zh: 莫里斯笑了一声。

examples.en: a short course on business English
examples.zh: 商业英语短期课程

words.definition: a situation in which two or more people disagree, often angrily; brush, reasoning, dispute
words.translation: 论证；论据；争吵；内容提要

examples.en: We need to provide a convincing argument as to why the system should be changed.
examples.zh: 我们得提出有说服力的论据，证明为何要改变体制。

words.definition: to give someone the responsibility for doing something; a piece of work that must be done, especially one that is difficult or unpleasant or that must be done regularly; job, work, role, pursuit, labor
words.translation: 分派任务；工作，作业；任务；[计]任务

examples.zh: 珍被委以举办一场慈善篮球赛的任务。

words.definition: if one thing matches another, or if two things match, they look attractive together because they are a similar colour, pattern etc; an organized sports event between two teams or people; equal, rival; suit, balance; competition, game, tournament, play, contest

examples.en: We painted the cabinets green to match the rug.
examples.zh: 我们把柜子刷成绿色，和地毯相配。

examples.en: Do you think this outfit matches?
examples.zh: 你认为这套衣服配吗？

examples.en: a beech dining table with four chairs to match (= chairs that match it )
examples.zh: 配有四把椅子的山毛榉餐桌

words.definition: used by, involving, or relating to the army, navy, or airforce; the military forces of a country; martial, soldierly; force, soldier, battalion
words.translation: 军事的；军人的；适于战争的；军队；军人

examples.en: a military helicopter
examples.zh: 军用直升机

examples.en: military equipment
examples.zh: 军事设备

examples.en: The government has threatened to take military action if the rebels do not withdraw from the area.
examples.zh: 政府警告说，如果叛乱分子不从该地区撤出，就要采取军事行动。

words.definition: a state of disagreement or argument between people, groups, countries etc; if two ideas, beliefs, opinions etc conflict, they cannot exist together or both be true; interference, difference, war, battle, collision; combat, collide with
words.translation: 冲突，矛盾；斗争；争执；冲突，抵触；战斗

examples.en: the threat of industrial conflict in the coalfields
examples.zh: 煤田发生劳资纠纷的风险

examples.en: Marx points out the potential conflicts below the surface of society.
examples.zh: 马克思指出了隐藏在社会表层之下的潜在矛盾。

examples.zh: 他坚持《圣经》字面真理的观点使他与其他的基督教领袖发生了冲突。

words.definition: something or someone that gives you happiness and pleasure; to be happy because of something; pleasure, festival, fun, sweet, enjoyment; jubilate; be pleased, lift up one's head
words.translation: 欢乐，快乐；乐趣；高兴；欣喜，欢喜；高兴，使快乐

examples.en: The garden was his pride and joy.
examples.zh: 这座花园是他的骄傲和乐趣所在。

words.definition: to confuse someone or make them feel slightly anxious because they do not understand something; something that is difficult to understand or explain; baffle, discomfit; contemplate; enigma, difficult problem
words.translation: 使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出；谜；难题；迷惑；冥思苦想

examples.en: a question that continues to puzzle scientists
examples.zh: 一直困扰科学家的问题

examples.en: He was puzzled by the reactions to his remark.
examples.zh: 他对自己的话引起的反应感到困惑不解。

examples.en: What puzzles me is why his books are so popular.
examples.zh: 令我不解的是，他的书为什么如此受欢迎。

words.definition: to produce a picture of something using a pencil, pen etc; the final result of a game or competition in which both teams or players have the same number of points; picture, absorb, pull, attract, engage; pull; lot, tie
words.translation: 画；拉；吸引；平局；抽签；拖

examples.en: Katie had drawn a cottage with a little stream running next to it.
examples.zh: 凯蒂画了一间小茅舍，旁边流淌着一条小溪。

examples.en: She asked the little girl to draw a picture of the man she’d spoken to.
examples.zh: 她让小女孩把刚才和她说话的那个男人画出来。

examples.en: Keith was drawing a complicated-looking graph.
examples.zh: 基思在画一张看上去很复杂的图表。

words.translation: 开车；猛击；飞跑；驱动器；驾车；[心理] 内驱力，推进力；快车道；推动，发动（机器等）；[交]驾驶（马车，汽车等）；驱赶；[机]驱动器；[动][心理]内驱力，推进力

examples.en: the man driving the car
examples.zh: 开车的男子

examples.en: Can you drive?
examples.zh: 你会开车吗？

examples.en: So when did you learn to drive ?
examples.zh: 那么你是什么时候学会开车的？

words.definition: if two things contrast, the difference between them is very easy to see and is sometimes surprising; a difference between people, ideas, situations, things etc that are being compared; parallel, distinction, differential
words.translation: 对比；形成对照；差别；对照物

examples.en: an essay comparing and contrasting (= showing how two things are similar and different ) Verdi and Wagner and their operas
examples.zh: 把威尔第和瓦格纳以及他们的歌剧进行比较和对照的一篇文章

words.definition: someone’s family, education, previous work etc; prehistory
words.translation: 背景；隐蔽的位置；作…的背景；背景的；发布背景材料的；[物]背景

examples.en: Students with a background in chemistry will probably find the course easier.
examples.zh: 学过化学的学生可能会觉得这门课程容易些。

examples.en: It’s important to understand other people, people from different backgrounds .
examples.zh: 要理解别人，理解那些来自不同背景的人，这是很重要的。

examples.en: Do you know anything about his background?
examples.zh: 关于他的背景，你知道什么吗？

words.definition: an upright flat structure made of stone or brick, that divides one area from another or surrounds an area; enclosure, fence; inwall; mural
words.translation: 墙壁，围墙；似墙之物；用墙围住，围以墙；墙壁的

examples.en: the Great Wall of China
examples.zh: 中国的长城

examples.en: We climbed over the wall into the orchard.
examples.zh: 我们翻墙进了果园。

words.definition: if you combine two or more different things, or if they combine, they begin to exist or work together; a machine used by farmers to cut grain, separate the seeds from it, and clean it; bond, associate; band, bond, couple, become one, connect; integrated works, Konzern
words.translation: 使化合；使联合，使结合；联合收割机；联合企业；联合，结合；化合；[农机]联合收割机

examples.en: Diets are most effective when combined with exercise.
examples.zh: 节食和锻炼相结合是最有效的。

examples.en: Ruth hesitated, uncertain of how to combine honesty and diplomacy in her answer.
examples.zh: 露丝犹豫了，她不知道怎样回答才能既诚实又婉转。

words.definition: a set of letters, arranged in a particular order, and used in writing; ABC, rudiments
words.translation: 字母表，字母系统；入门，初步；[语]字母表，字母系统

examples.en: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
examples.zh: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

words.definition: to take part in a war or battle; a situation in which two people or groups hit, push etc each other; combat, war; struggle with; action, combat
words.translation: 打架；与…打仗，与…斗争；反对…提案；战斗，斗志；搏斗，斗争；打仗；战斗，搏斗；斗志

examples.en: Neither country is capable of fighting a long war .
examples.zh: 两个国家都没有能力打持久战。

examples.en: Later the Indians fought the Anglo settlers.
examples.zh: 后来，印第安人跟英国殖民者打起了仗。

words.definition: an arrangement or promise to do something, made by two or more people, companies, organizations etc; accordance, protocol, unity, identity, keeping
words.translation: 协议；同意，一致；[法]协议
