words.definition: someone’s ultimate aim is their main and most important aim, that they hope to achieve in the future; final, organic, fundamental, radical, underlying; telos, fundamental principle
words.translation: 最终的；极限的；根本的；终极；根本；基本原则；[物]极限的

examples.en: The ultimate outcome of the experiment cannot be predicted.
examples.zh: 试验的最后结果无法预测。

words.definition: someone who is skilled has the training and experience that is needed to do something well; experienced, accomplished, clever, practiced, master
words.translation: 熟练的；有技能的；需要技能的

examples.en: Skilled craftsmen, such as carpenters, are in great demand.
examples.zh: 对木工之类的熟练工匠需求量很大。

examples.en: The company is fortunate to have such highly skilled workers.
examples.zh: 公司有这样一些技能熟练的工人真是幸运。

words.definition: to form a word by writing or naming the letters in order; a piece of magic that someone does, or the special words or ceremonies used in doing it; possess, invite, court, secure; cycle, grace, while, charm, period of time; turn taking
words.translation: 拼，拼写；意味着；招致；拼成；迷住；轮值；符咒；一段时间；魅力；拼字；轮替

examples.en: How do you spell ‘juice’?
examples.zh: juice 怎么拼？

examples.en: Pupils should know how to spell commonly used words.
examples.zh: 小学生应该知道常用词的拼法。

words.definition: to prevent someone’s plans, efforts, or attempts from succeeding; defeat, discomfit; founder, come to naught; thwarted, unprofitable
words.translation: 挫败；阻挠；使感到灰心；挫败的；无益的；失败；受挫

examples.en: Their attempts to speak to him were frustrated by the guards.
examples.zh: 他们想跟他说话，但被警卫拦住了。

words.definition: if a situation, fact etc inclines you to do or think something, it influences you towards a particular action or opinion; a slope; pitch, slope, affect; slope, lean; hill, slope, decline, pitch
words.translation: 倾斜；倾向；易于；斜面；斜坡；使倾斜；使倾向于

examples.en: The telescope is inclined at an angle of 43 degrees.
examples.zh: 这架望远镜以43度角倾斜。

words.definition: a strong thread made of several threads twisted together, used for tying or fastening things; thread, linea; spread, pink
words.translation: 线，弦，细绳；一串，一行；线，细绳；扎，缚；使排成一列，串起；伸展，拉直

examples.en: Her key hung on a string around her neck.
examples.zh: 她的钥匙穿了根绳子挂在脖子上。

examples.en: a ball of string
examples.zh: 一团细绳

examples.en: I need a piece of string to tie this package.
examples.zh: 我需要一根绳子来捆这个包裹。

words.definition: a thin flat piece of food cut from a larger piece; to cut meat, bread, vegetables etc into thin flat pieces; proportion, part, portion, percent, integral; chip off, chip out; cut open, to cut
words.translation: 薄片；部分；菜刀，火铲；切下；把…分成部分；将…切成薄片；切开；割破

examples.en: pizza slices
examples.zh: 比萨块

examples.en: Cut the tomatoes into slices .
examples.zh: 把番茄切成片。

words.definition: the area just inside the door of a house or other building, that leads to other rooms; passage, corridor
words.translation: 过道，门厅，走廊；会堂；食堂；学生宿舍；大厅，前厅；娱乐中心，会所；门厅，走廊；[建]会堂

examples.en: a huge tiled entrance hall
examples.zh: 铺着地砖的大门厅

words.definition: believing that good things will happen in the future; rose-colored, rosy
words.translation: 乐观的；乐观主义的

examples.en: Andrew took a more optimistic view.
examples.zh: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

words.definition: words that you say or write in order to praise someone or something; to say that you admire and approve of someone or something, especially publicly; worship, favoring and praising; celebrate, bless, admire; speak highly of, talk up
words.translation: 赞扬；称赞；荣耀；崇拜；赞美，歌颂；表扬；赞美

examples.en: It’s important to give children plenty of praise and encouragement.
examples.zh: 对小孩子多加表扬和鼓励是很重要的。

examples.en: Her teacher was full of praise for her work.
examples.zh: 老师对她的作业赞不绝口。

examples.en: His first novel received high praise .
examples.zh: 他的第一部小说受到了高度赞扬。

words.definition: a reason that you give to explain careless or offensive behaviour; to forgive someone for doing something that is not seriously wrong, such as being rude or careless; reason, sake, account, blind, occasion; forgive, pardon for; beg for mercy
words.translation: 借口；理由；原谅；为…申辩；给…免去；作为借口；请求宽恕；表示宽恕

examples.en: I’m tired of listening to his excuses.
examples.zh: 我听厌了他的种种理由。

words.definition: the person in charge of an institution; managers, adjustment, ruler
words.translation: 主管人员；统治者，管理者；[自] 调节器；地方长官；[机][自]调节器

examples.en: the prison governor
examples.zh: 监狱长

words.definition: one of the two long parts of your body between your shoulders and your hands; to provide weapons for yourself, an army, a country etc in order to prepare for a fight or a war; weapon, equipment, setup; war preparation
words.translation: 手臂；武器；袖子；装备；部门；武装起来；[军]装备；武装；备战

examples.en: Dave has a broken arm .
examples.zh: 戴夫手臂断了。

examples.en: Tim’s mother put her arms around him.
examples.zh: 蒂姆的母亲伸出双臂搂着他。

examples.en: Pat was carrying a box under his arm .
examples.zh: 帕特腋下挟着一个盒子。

words.definition: the part of your body that you stand on and walk on; last, trilby; hoof it, pad; Make Payment, disburse
words.translation: 脚；英尺；步调；末尾；步行；跳舞；总计；[解剖]脚；支付；给……换底

examples.en: My foot hurts.
examples.zh: 我脚痛。

examples.en: I had blisters on the soles of my feet .
examples.zh: 我的脚底起泡了。

examples.en: I dropped a glass earlier, so don’t walk around in bare feet .
examples.zh: 我刚才打破了一个玻璃杯，所以不要光着脚到处走。

words.definition: the view of something in a film or television programme that is produced by having the camera in a particular position; in bad condition because of being used too much or treated badly; emission, sending, launch, shell, projection; varied, shabby
words.translation: 发射；炮弹；射手；镜头；用尽的；破旧的；杂色的，闪光的；射击（shoot的过去式和过去分词）；[军]发射

examples.en: In the opening shot, we see Travolta’s feet walking down the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 在开场的镜头中，我们看到特拉沃尔塔的脚在人行道上行走。

words.definition: about or relating to; about, as for, with reference to, in relation to, in respect of; involving, relating
words.translation: 关于；就…而言；涉及；使关心（concern的ing形式）；忧虑

examples.en: calls from young children concerning lost pets
examples.zh: 小孩子打来的有关宠物走失的电话

examples.en: the facts concerning Marr’s car crash
examples.zh: 有关马尔撞车事故的事实

words.definition: adding to or replacing something; new, raw; beginning, threshold, opening, conception, start; hardly, just
words.translation: 新鲜的；清新的；淡水的；无经验的；开始；新生；泛滥；刚刚，才；最新地；[水文]淡水的

examples.en: I’ll just make some fresh coffee.
examples.zh: 我来重新煮点咖啡。

examples.en: The report provides fresh evidence about the way the business was run.
examples.zh: 报告提供了有关该公司运营方式的新证据。

examples.en: You’ll have to start again on a fresh sheet of paper.
examples.zh: 你得拿张新的纸重新开始。

words.definition: to look at someone or something for a period of time, paying attention to what is happening; a small clock that you wear on your wrist or keep in your pocket; protect, look into; observation, monitoring, surveillance; sight, regard
words.translation: 观察；注视；看守；警戒；手表；监视；守护；值班人；观看，注视；守侯，看守

examples.en: Do you mind if I watch?
examples.zh: 你介意我看着吗？

examples.en: We sat and watched the sunset.
examples.zh: 我们坐下来看日落。

examples.en: Ruth could not bear to watch her parents arguing.
examples.zh: 露丝看不得父母争吵。

words.definition: the position or level that someone holds in an organization, especially in the police or the army, navy etc; if something is rank, it has a very strong unpleasant smell; to arrange objects in a line or row; degree, classification, row, range, grade; evil, unpleasant, poisonous; arrange, form; form up
words.translation: 排；等级；军衔；队列；讨厌的；恶臭的；繁茂的；排列；把…分等；[军]军衔；列为；列队

examples.en: He was sentenced to prison and stripped of his rank (= had his rank taken from him ) .
examples.zh: 他被判入狱，并且被剥夺了军衔。

words.definition: a gas that has no colour or smell, is present in air, and is necessary for most animals and plants to live. It is a chemical element: symbol O; O2
words.translation: [化学] 氧气，[化学] 氧；氧气，[化学]氧

examples.en: The human brain needs to be without oxygen for only four minutes before permanent damage occurs.
examples.zh: 人脑缺氧只需4分钟就会造成永久性损伤。

words.definition: a strong feeling of trust or confidence in someone or something; belief, confidence, trust, credit, loyalty
words.translation: 信仰；信念；信任；忠实

examples.en: People have lost faith in the government.
examples.zh: 人们已失去了对政府的信心。

words.definition: an arrangement in which you pay a sum of money to borrow something for a short time; to pay money to borrow something for a short period of time; employment, rental, letting; rent, employ; take on
words.translation: 雇用，租用；租金，工钱；雇用；出租；受雇

examples.en: a car hire company
examples.zh: 汽车租赁公司

words.definition: a belief that some objects or actions are lucky or unlucky, or that they cause events to happen, based on old ideas of magic; aberglaube, fetish
words.translation: 迷信

examples.en: the old superstition that walking under a ladder is unlucky
examples.zh: 认为从梯子下面穿过不吉利的古老迷信

words.definition: the part of your face which you put food into, or which you use for speaking; jaws, ostium; grumble
words.translation: 口，嘴；河口；做作地说，装腔作势地说；喃喃地说出；[解剖]口，嘴

examples.en: He lifted his glass to his mouth.
examples.zh: 他把玻璃杯举到嘴边。

examples.en: Liam was fast asleep with his mouth wide open.
examples.zh: 利亚姆大张着嘴，睡得很熟。

words.definition: a large area of land that is covered with trees; woodland
words.translation: 植树于，使成为森林；森林

examples.en: a tropical forest
examples.zh: 热带森林

examples.en: the danger of forest fires
examples.zh: 发生森林火灾的危险

words.definition: to control an activity or process, especially by rules; possess, define, contain, manage, state
words.translation: 调节，规定；控制；校准；有系统的管理

examples.en: strict rules regulating the use of chemicals in food
examples.zh: 限制化学品在食物中使用的严格规定

words.definition: to not notice something, or not see how important it is; forget, examine, survey, review, inspect; inobservancy, negligence
words.translation: 忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上；忽视；眺望

examples.en: It is easy to overlook a small detail like that.
examples.zh: 那样的小细节很容易被忽略。

examples.en: Nobody could overlook the fact that box office sales were down.
examples.zh: 谁也无法忽视票房销售额在下降这个事实。

words.definition: someone who starts a new business or arranges business deals in order to make money, often in a way that involves financial risks; contractor, enterpriser
words.translation: 企业家；承包人；主办者

words.definition: to give a particular excuse for your actions; excuse for; pray for, cry on
words.translation: 借口；为辩护；托称；为...[法]辩护；恳求；[法]辩护

examples.en: She stayed home from work, pleading illness.
examples.zh: 她告病在家不去上班。

words.definition: a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, which has a back, a seat, and four legs; to be the  chairperson  of a meeting or committee; cathedra
words.translation: 椅子；讲座；（会议的）主席位；大学教授的职位；担任（会议的）主席；使…入座；使就任要职；[家具]椅子

examples.en: a kitchen chair
examples.zh: 厨房椅

examples.en: They bought a new table and chairs.
examples.zh: 他们买了一套新的桌椅。

examples.en: One of the chair legs was broken.
examples.zh: 椅子有一条腿断了。

words.definition: a series of metal rings which are joined together in a line and used for fastening things, supporting weights, decoration etc; to fasten someone or something to something else using a chain, especially in order to prevent them from escaping or being stolen; restriction, cord; bound, enslave
words.translation: 链；束缚；枷锁；囚禁；用铁链锁住；[计]链；用铁练锁住

examples.en: She had a gold chain around her neck.
examples.zh: 她脖子上戴了条金项链。

examples.en: a length of heavy chain
examples.zh: 一段沉重的链条

examples.en: the Mayor’s chain of office
examples.zh: 市长的链徽

words.definition: if a part of your body is painful, it hurts; hurt, bitter, miserable
words.translation: 痛苦的；疼痛的；令人不快的

examples.en: stiff painful joints
examples.zh: 僵硬疼痛的关节

examples.en: Is your arm very painful?
examples.zh: 你的手臂很疼吗？

examples.en: The neck becomes swollen and painful to the touch (= hurts when you touch it ) .
examples.zh: 脖子肿起来了，一碰就疼。

words.definition: if you enlarge something, or if it enlarges, it increases in size or scale; extend, broaden; extend, grow
words.translation: 扩大；放大；详述；使增大；扩展

examples.en: an operation to enlarge her breasts
examples.zh: 她的丰胸手术

examples.en: Police will have the pictures enlarged in an attempt to identify the thief.
examples.zh: 为了确认窃贼的身份，警方会将这些照片放大。

words.definition: one of the two parts of the body at each side of the neck where the arm is connected; to accept a difficult or unpleasant responsibility, duty etc; undertake, accept, sustain
words.translation: 肩，肩膀；肩部；肩负，承担

examples.en: She tapped the driver on the shoulder.
examples.zh: 她拍拍司机的肩。

examples.en: He put his arm around her shoulders.
examples.zh: 他用手臂搂住她的肩。

examples.en: His shoulders were broad and powerful.
examples.zh: 他的肩膀宽阔强壮。

words.definition: not definite or certain, and may be changed later; experimental, cut-and-try; hypothesis, proof, experiment, try
words.translation: 试验性的，暂定的；踌躇的；假设，试验；[试验]试验性的，暂定的

examples.en: I passed on my tentative conclusions to the police.
examples.zh: 我把我的初步结论递交给了警方。

examples.en: The government is taking tentative steps towards tackling the country’s economic problems.
examples.zh: 政府正在采取临时性措施来解决国家的经济问题。

words.definition: different from what is normal or expected, especially in a way that you disapprove of or cannot understand; remaining, extraordinary, temporary, surplus, residual; put, wack
words.translation: 奇数的；古怪的；剩余的；临时的；零散的；奇数；怪人；奇特的事物；[数]奇数的；[数]奇数

examples.en: It was an odd thing to say.
examples.zh: 这话说得很奇怪。

examples.en: an odd way to behave
examples.zh: 古怪的行为

examples.en: They’re an odd couple.
examples.zh: 他们是古怪的一对。

words.definition: if two or more facts, ideas etc correlate or if you correlate them, they are closely connected to each other or one causes the other; either of two things that correlate with each other; relative; associated
words.translation: 关联；相关物；相关联的人；关联的

examples.en: Attempts to correlate specific language functions with particular parts of the brain have not advanced very far.
examples.zh: 试图把特定的语言功能和大脑特定区域相联系的努力还没有取得很大进展。

words.definition: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way; divide
words.translation: 使…相异；使…不同；(Differ)人名；(法)迪费；相异；意见分歧

examples.en: The story he told police differed from the one he told his mother.
examples.zh: 他告诉警察的话和告诉他母亲的不同。

words.definition: weighing a lot; huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro; largely, freely, big, importantly, massively
words.translation: 沉重的；繁重的，巨大的；拥挤的；阴沉的；重物；严肃角色；大量地；笨重地

examples.en: The wardrobe was too heavy for me to move on my own.
examples.zh: 衣橱太重，我一个人移不动。

examples.en: a heavy suitcase
examples.zh: 沉重的手提箱

examples.en: The males are seven times heavier than the females.
examples.zh: 雄性的重量是雌性的七倍。

words.definition: staying in good condition for a long time, even if used a lot; continued, sustained, service, lasting; hardgoods
words.translation: 耐用的，持久的；耐用品

examples.en: Wood is a durable material.
examples.zh: 木头是耐用材料。

words.definition: if a belief, custom, situation etc prevails, it exists among a group of people at a certain time; obtain, win
words.translation: 盛行，流行；战胜，获胜

examples.en: Justice will prevail.
examples.zh: 正义终将获胜。

words.definition: determination to be successful, rich, powerful etc; careerism, aspiration; pursue / pursuit, go after
words.translation: 野心，雄心；抱负，志向；追求；有…野心

examples.en: He was young and full of ambition.
examples.zh: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

words.definition: glory, credit, title; regard, esteem, worship
words.translation: 荣誉；信用；头衔；尊敬（等于honour）；给…以荣誉

words.definition: to divide something into separate parts and share it between two or more people; a tear or crack in something made of cloth, wood etc; leave, quit; leave, quit, get out; crack, cleavage; cloven, cleft
words.translation: 分离；使分离；劈开；离开；分解；裂缝；劈开的；被劈开；断绝关系；[木]裂缝

examples.en: We agreed to split the cost .
examples.zh: 我们同意分摊这笔费用。

words.definition: an alphabetical list of names, subjects etc at the back of a book, with the numbers of the pages where they can be found; if documents, information etc are indexed, an index is made for them; finger, indicatrix; to point out, to indicate
words.translation: 指标；指数；索引；指针；做索引；[图情]索引；指出；编入索引中

examples.en: ...the consumer price index.
examples.zh: …消费价格指数。

words.definition: from or relating to a country that is not your own; external, diplomatic
words.translation: 外国的；外交的；异质的；不相关的

examples.en: foreign students
examples.zh: 外国学生

examples.en: Can you speak any foreign languages?
examples.zh: 你会讲外语吗？

examples.en: the success of foreign companies in various industries
examples.zh: 外国公司在各行业的成功

words.definition: an amount of something that is available to be used; to provide people with something that they need or want, especially regularly over a long period of time; provision, furnishing; afford, tender, lend; provide with, furnish with
words.translation: 供给，补给；供应品；供给，提供；补充；供给，[经]补给；[经]供给，提供；[经]供给；替代

examples.en: The nation’s fuel supplies will not last forever.
examples.zh: 这个国家的燃料供应不会无穷无尽。

examples.en: To protect the food supply , the government ordered the slaughter of affected cattle.
examples.zh: 为保护食品供应，政府下令宰杀被感染的牛。

words.definition: water that falls in small drops from clouds in the sky; if it rains, drops of water fall from clouds in the sky; wet, monsoon; Make it Rain
words.translation: 雨；下雨；雨天；雨季；降雨；[气象]雨

examples.en: a night of wind and rain
examples.zh: 风雨交加的夜晚

examples.en: There will be heavy rain in most parts of the country.
examples.zh: 全国大部分地区将有大雨。

words.definition: when a group of people or countries agree or are joined together; accordance, agreement, alliance, identity, combination, union, association
words.translation: 团结；一致；联合；个体

examples.en: economic unity
examples.zh: 经济统一

examples.en: European unity
examples.zh: 欧洲的一体化

words.definition: not drunk; cool, philosophical; disenchant
words.translation: 冷静的，清醒的；未醉的；使严肃；使醒酒，使清醒；(Sober)人名；(英)索伯

examples.en: He’s a nice guy when he’s sober.
examples.zh: 他没喝醉时是个不错的家伙。

words.definition: the work of providing houses for people to live in; covering, tenement
words.translation: 房屋；住房供给；[机] 外壳；遮盖物；机器等的防护外壳或外罩；[建]房屋；[机]外壳

examples.en: government housing policy
examples.zh: 政府的住房政策

examples.en: public services such as education, housing and transport
examples.zh: 诸如教育、住房和交通等的公共服务

words.definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top supported by legs; to leave a bill etc to be discussed or dealt with in the future; form, tabulation; leave in the air, leave aside
words.translation: 桌子；表格；平地层；制表；搁置；嵌合；桌子的

examples.en: The food was served on long tables.
examples.zh: 食物放在长餐桌上供应。

words.definition: a series of actions which are designed to achieve something important; plan, scheme, procedure, routine, formulation; formulate, mark out
words.translation: 计划，规划；节目；程序；编程序；制作节目；[计]程序；规划；拟…计划

examples.en: the US space program
examples.zh: 美国太空计划

words.definition: the quality of being very careful to avoid danger or risks; to warn someone that something might be dangerous, difficult etc; warning, care; alarm, alert, warn
words.translation: 小心，谨慎；警告，警示；警告

examples.en: The physician must exercise caution when prescribing antidepressants.
examples.zh: 医师在开抗抑郁药处方时必须谨慎。

words.definition: in spite of the fact that has just been mentioned; yet; and, granted, but, yet, only
words.translation: 尽管如此，但是

examples.en: The region was extremely beautiful. Nonetheless Gerard could not imagine spending the rest of his life there.
examples.zh: 那个地区非常漂亮，然而杰拉德却无法想象自己要在那里度过余生。

examples.en: The paintings are complex, but have plenty of appeal nonetheless.
examples.zh: 这些画复杂难懂，不过还是不乏吸引力。

words.definition: to control and direct something such as money or energy towards a particular purpose; a television station and all the programmes that it broadcasts; aim, boot; door, exit, neck, route, narrow
words.translation: 引导，开导；形成河道；通道；频道；海峡

examples.en: Water had channelled grooves in the rock.
examples.zh: 水在岩石上冲出了沟槽。

words.definition: if a story unfolds, or if someone unfolds it, it is told; crack, assume, open up; expand, develop
words.translation: 打开；呈现；展开；显露

examples.en: As the story unfolds, we learn more about Max’s childhood.
examples.zh: 随着故事的展开，我们对马克斯的童年有了更多的了解。

words.definition: special attention or importance; stress, unode
words.translation: 重点；强调；加强语气

examples.en: a change of emphasis in government policy
examples.zh: 政府政策重心的变化

words.definition: a turbulent situation or period of time is one in which there are a lot of sudden changes; angry, chaotic, troubled, confused
words.translation: 骚乱的，混乱的；狂暴的；吵闹的；激流的，湍流的

examples.en: the turbulent times of the French Revolution
examples.zh: 法国大革命的动荡时期

examples.en: He has had a turbulent political career.
examples.zh: 他的政治生涯动荡不定。

words.definition: someone who gets services or advice from a professional person, company, or organization; customer, consumer, principal, guest, correspondent
words.translation: [经] 客户；顾客；委托人；[计][经]客户；[审计]委托人

examples.en: a meeting with an important client
examples.zh: 与一位重要客户的会面

words.definition: to become stronger again after a period of weakness or defeat; a large public meeting, especially one that is held outdoors to support a political idea, protest etc; league, restore; assemble, fall in; assembly, feedback, meet, gathering, congregation
words.translation: 团结；重整；恢复；（网球等）连续对打；集会；回复；公路赛车会；集合；恢复健康、力量等

examples.en: After a shaky start, he rallied and won the title in style.
examples.zh: 虽然开局不顺，但他振作精神，最后漂亮地赢得了冠军。

examples.en: The Tokyo stock market rallied later in the day.
examples.zh: 当天晚些时候东京股市止跌回升。

words.definition: a laboratory; laboratory
words.translation: 实验室，研究室

examples.en: the school science lab
examples.zh: 学校的科学实验室

words.definition: extremely weak; weak, small, thin
words.translation: 微弱的，无力的；虚弱的；薄弱的

examples.en: His voice sounded feeble and far away.
examples.zh: 他的声音听上去既无力又遥远。

examples.en: She was too feeble to leave her room.
examples.zh: 她身体虚弱，无法走出自己的房间。

words.definition: the way someone or something looks to other people; occurrence, aspect, emergence, external, outside
words.translation: 外貌，外观；出现，露面

examples.en: He was always criticising his wife’s appearance.
examples.zh: 他老是批评妻子的外表。

examples.en: We are often attracted to somebody first by their physical appearance .
examples.zh: 我们经常先被一个人的外貌吸引。

examples.en: Women, in general, tend to be more concerned than men about their personal appearance .
examples.zh: 总的来说，女性比男性更注重自己的仪容。

words.definition: without any dirt, marks etc; to remove dirt from something by rubbing or washing; a process in which you clean something; pure, sanitary; do out, rid up; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, strictly, fully; dusting, sweep
words.translation: 清洁的，干净的；清白的；使干净；完全地；打扫；打扫，清扫

examples.en: Are your hands clean?
examples.zh: 你的手干净吗？

examples.en: clean towels
examples.zh: 干净的毛巾

examples.en: Make sure you keep the wound clean .
examples.zh: 一定要保持伤口清洁。

words.definition: to say very strongly that you do not approve of something or someone, especially because you think it is morally wrong; denounce, deplore
words.translation: 谴责；判刑，定罪；声讨

examples.en: Politicians were quick to condemn the bombing.
examples.zh: 政治家们立即对爆炸事件进行了谴责。

words.definition: Sunday is the day after Saturday and before Monday
words.translation: 星期日；礼拜日

examples.en: I thought we might go for a drive on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我原以为我们可能星期日去开车兜风。

words.definition: an occasion when you put on a piece of clothing that is being made for you, to see if it fits properly; right for a particular situation or occasion; assembly, device, apparatus, installation, unit; adaptive, calculated, matching, well, worthy
words.translation: 装配，装置；试穿，试衣；适合的，适宜的；相称的；[机]装配，装置；[服装]试穿，试衣

examples.en: a sink with chrome fittings (= handle and taps )
examples.zh: 带镀铬配件的洗涤槽

words.definition: to do what you have to do or are asked to do; engage, abide by/obey/observe
words.translation: 遵守；顺从，遵从；答应

examples.en: The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
examples.zh: 联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

words.definition: introduce, present, prefer, file, advance; cosmetic brush
words.translation: 致使；提出；实施；着色；以…回报；打底；交纳；粉刷

words.definition: an amount expressed as if it is part of a total which is 100; centage
words.translation: 百分比；百分率，百分数；[数]百分比

examples.en: Interest rates fell by six percentage points (= 6% ) .
examples.zh: 利息下降了6个百分点。

examples.en: The numbers are small in percentage terms (= when calculated as a percentage ) .
examples.zh: 按百分比来看，这些数字很小。

words.definition: the state of existing; presence, being, entity, life, is
words.translation: 存在，实在；生存，生活；存在物，实在物；[计]存在，实在

examples.en: Scientists have many theories about how the universe first came into existence (= started to exist ).
examples.zh: 关于宇宙的起源，科学家有多种理论。

words.definition: to catch someone by forcing them into a place from which they cannot escape; a piece of equipment for catching animals; ensnare; web, mesh, pit
words.translation: 诱捕；使…受限制；使…陷入困境；陷阱；圈套；[建] 存水湾；[计]陷阱；[建]存水弯

examples.en: The police trapped the terrorists at a roadblock.
examples.zh: 警察在设有路障的地方堵住了恐怖分子。

words.definition: a building where horses are kept; steady and not likely to move or change; to put or keep a horse in a stable; mews, cowshed; steady, settled, committed, firm, strong
words.translation: 马厩；牛棚；稳定的；牢固的；坚定的；被关在马厩；[畜牧]马厩；[物]稳定的

examples.en: Our stable abuts against his dwelling.
examples.zh: 我们的马厩和他的住所毗连。

words.definition: a small area of still water in a hollow place; billiard ball
words.translation: 联营；撞球；水塘；共同资金；联营，合伙经营

examples.en: pools of water with tiny fish in them
examples.zh: 有小鱼的一个个水池

examples.en: Mosquitoes breed in stagnant pools of water.
examples.zh: 蚊子在死水塘中繁殖。

words.definition: a large building where sick or injured people receive medical treatment; infirmary
words.translation: 医院；[医]医院

examples.en: They are building a new hospital.
examples.zh: 他们正在建一家新医院。

words.definition: a public room in a hotel or other building, that is used by many people as a place to relax; to stand, sit, or lie in a lazy or relaxed way; retiring room, lobby; lig, knock around; hack around, fiddle around
words.translation: 休息室；闲逛；躺椅；（英）酒吧间；懒洋洋地躺卧；闲混；[建]休息室；虚度光阴

examples.en: the television lounge
examples.zh: 电视放映室

words.definition: expressed or considered in numbers; digital
words.translation: 数值的；数字的；用数字表示的（等于numeric）；[数]数值的

examples.en: a numerical code
examples.zh: 数字密码

examples.en: The home team tried to utilize their numerical advantage (= the fact that they had more players than the other team ).
examples.zh: 主队试图利用他们在人数上的优势。

examples.en: Make sure the files are organized in numerical order.
examples.zh: 务必把这些档案按数字顺序排列。

words.definition: something that is popular or thought to be good at a particular time; to shape or make something, using your hands or only a few tools; mode, style, type; make use of, employ, influence, exercise, shift
words.translation: 时尚；时装；样式；时髦人物；使用；改变；做成…的形状；[服装]时装

examples.en: His ideas are coming back into fashion (= they are becoming popular again ) .
examples.zh: 他的观点又流行起来。

examples.en: Their music will never go out of fashion (= stop being fashionable ) .
examples.zh: 他们的音乐永不过时。

examples.en: Self-help books are all the fashion (= they are very fashionable ) .
examples.zh: 自助类的书籍很流行。

words.definition: learn, come to realize
words.translation: 认识到，明白

examples.en: In the first half they realise their boss is exploiting them and begin to understand the theory of surplus value.
examples.zh: 在前半部，工人们认识到他们的老板是在剥削他们，开始了解剩余价值理论。

examples.en: I hope that as time goes on we will realise that it is important for us to talk openly about Aids, because it is the only way to make it appear normal, like cancer.
examples.zh: 我希望随着时间的推移，人们将认识到公开谈论艾滋病是一件重要的事情，因为这是唯一一条使它成为像癌症一样的正常疾病的途径。

words.definition: an arrangement with a shop, bank etc that allows you to buy something and pay for it later; to believe or admit that someone has a quality, or has done something good; faith, reputation, honor, loan, confidence; put faith in, believe in
words.translation: 信用，信誉；[金融] 贷款；学分；信任；声望；相信，信任；把…归给，归功于；赞颂；[金融]贷款

examples.en: The store agreed to let him have credit.
examples.zh: 商店同意他赊购。

examples.en: What’s the credit limit on your Visa card?
examples.zh: 你的维萨卡信用额度是多少？

words.definition: when something changes from one form or state to another; conversion, switching, changing
words.translation: 过渡；转变；[分子生物] 转换；变调；[分子生物]转换

examples.en: Making the transition from youth to adulthood can be very painful.
examples.zh: 从青少年过渡到成年有时是一个非常痛苦的过程。

examples.en: a society that is in transition
examples.zh: 一个正在转型的社会

examples.en: the period of transition to full democracy
examples.zh: 向全面民主的过渡时期

words.definition: a sudden event such as a flood, storm, or accident which causes great damage or suffering; tragedy, evil, calamity, grief
words.translation: 灾难，灾祸；不幸

examples.en: One hundred and twenty people died in China’s worst air disaster .
examples.zh: 有120人在中国这起最惨烈的空难事故中丧生。

examples.en: the economic consequences of the Chernobyl nuclear disaster
examples.zh: 切尔诺贝利核灾难给经济带来的后果

examples.en: The 1987 hurricane was the worst natural disaster to hit England for decades.
examples.zh: 1987年的飓风是英格兰数十年来遭遇的最为严重的自然灾害。

words.definition: to introduce or start a system, rule, legal process etc; an organization that has a particular purpose such as scientific or educational work, or the building where this organization is based; found, construct, father, initiate; academy, college, union, school
words.translation: 开始（调查）；制定；创立；提起（诉讼）；学会，协会；学院

examples.en: We had no choice but to institute court proceedings against the airline.
examples.zh: 我们别无选择，只能对航空公司提起诉讼。

words.definition: to show that something is definitely true, especially by providing more proof; identify, favor, sustain, validate
words.translation: 确认；确定；证实；批准；使巩固

examples.en: New evidence has confirmed the first witness’s story.
examples.zh: 新的证据证实了第一个证人的说法。

examples.en: To confirm my diagnosis I need to do some tests.
examples.zh: 为了证实我的诊断，我要做一些化验。

words.definition: a structure made of wood, metal, plastic etc that surrounds something such as a picture or window, and holds it in place; to deliberately make someone seem guilty of a crime when they are not guilty, by lying to the police or in a court of law; configuration, mechanics, texture, structure; design, construct, engineer, style, project
words.translation: 框架；结构；[电影] 画面；设计；建造；陷害；使…适合；有木架的；有构架的；[建][计]框架；[电影]画面

examples.en: They removed the picture from its wooden frame.
examples.zh: 他们把画从木镜框中取下来。

words.definition: 1/100th of the standard unit of money in some countries. For example, there are 100 cents in one dollar or in one  euro  : symbol ¢.; minute, penny
words.translation: 分；一分的硬币；森特（等于半音程的百分之一）

examples.en: A cup of rice which cost thirty cents a few weeks ago is now being sold for up to one dollar.
examples.zh: 几周前价值30美分的1杯米如今卖到了1美元。

words.definition: one of the pieces of flesh inside your body that you use in order to move, and that connect your bones together; to use your strength to go somewhere; strength, force, might, power, beef; enhance, cement, build up
words.translation: 肌肉；力量；加强；使劲搬动；使劲挤出

examples.en: Relax your stomach muscles , then stretch again.
examples.zh: 放松腹部肌肉，然后再绷紧。

examples.en: Regular exercise will help to strengthen your muscles .
examples.zh: 经常锻炼有助于强健肌肉。

examples.en: Rooney has pulled a muscle in his thigh and won’t play tomorrow.
examples.zh: 鲁尼大腿肌肉拉伤，明天不能参赛了。

words.definition: someone, especially a child or young person, who is mature behaves in a sensible and reasonable way, as you would expect an adult to behave; to become fully grown or developed; developed, adult, due; age, flower
words.translation: 成熟的；充分考虑的；到期的；成年人的；成熟；到期；[农学][地质]成熟的；[农学][地质]成熟

examples.en: Laura is very mature for her age .
examples.zh: 相对她的年龄来说劳拉是很成熟的。

examples.en: We’re mature enough to disagree on this issue but still respect each other.
examples.zh: 我们都很成熟，尽管我们对此事意见不同，但还是彼此尊重。

words.definition: a doctor; medical doctor, medico
words.translation: [医] 医师；内科医师；[医]医师；[内科]内科医师

examples.en: ...your family physician.
examples.zh: …你的家庭医生。

words.definition: someone’s identity is their name or who they are; accordance, estate, unity, agreement, quality
words.translation: 身份；同一性，一致；特性；恒等式

examples.en: The identity of the killer is still unknown.
examples.zh: 凶手的身份仍未查明。

words.definition: to surprise someone very much; take aback, take by surprise
words.translation: 使吃惊

examples.en: Dave amazed his friends by suddenly getting married.
examples.zh: 戴夫突然结婚，令朋友们非常吃惊。

words.definition: a large sea fish with several rows of very sharp teeth that is considered to be dangerous to humans; fraud, swindler; con game; extort, black mail
words.translation: 鲨鱼；骗子；诈骗；敲诈

examples.en: Sharks were circling around our boat.
examples.zh: 鲨鱼在我们的小船周围游弋。

words.definition: very large, solid, and heavy; huge, extensive, macro, substantial, tremendous, enormous
words.translation: 大量的；巨大的，厚重的；魁伟的

examples.en: The bell is massive, weighing over 40 tons.
examples.zh: 那口钟非常大，有40多吨重。

examples.en: the castle’s massive walls
examples.zh: 城堡高大厚实的围墙

words.definition: firmly held in a particular position and not moving or shaking; to hold someone or something so they become more balanced or controlled, or to become more balanced or controlled; a  boyfriend  or  girlfriend  that someone has been having a romantic relationship with; settled, constant, stable, composed, permanent; firm, stabilitate; firmly, equably; fixed bolster, fixed support
words.translation: 稳定的；不变的；沉着的；稳固；稳定地；稳固地；关系固定的情侣；固定支架；使稳定；使坚定

examples.en: It takes a steady hand to perform surgery.
examples.zh: 做手术手要稳。

words.definition: the state of being able to read and write
words.translation: 读写能力；精通文学

examples.en: a new adult literacy campaign
examples.zh: 新一轮成人识字[扫盲]运动

words.definition: lack of knowledge or information about something; darkness, unwisdom
words.translation: 无知，愚昧；不知，不懂

examples.en: Excuse my ignorance, but how does it actually work?
examples.zh: 请原谅我的无知，它究竟是如何运作的？

words.definition: to officially stop something from continuing, especially for a short time; wait, phase back
words.translation: 延缓，推迟；使暂停；使悬浮

examples.en: Sales of the drug will be suspended until more tests are completed.
examples.zh: 这种药品在完成进一步检验之前将暂停销售。

examples.en: Talks between the two countries have now been suspended.
examples.zh: 两国间的对话现已中止。

words.definition: a baby or very young child; intended for babies or very young children; baby, minor; earlier, young, baby, minor, tender
words.translation: 婴儿；幼儿；未成年人；婴儿的；幼稚的；初期的；未成年的

examples.en: An infant’s skin is very sensitive.
examples.zh: 幼儿的皮肤非常敏感。

words.definition: one of the two bones that your teeth are in; chin, jowl; rabbit on; lesson
words.translation: 颌；下巴；狭窄入口；唠叨；教训；[脊椎]颌；[地质]狭窄入口；对…唠叨

examples.en: a broken jaw
examples.zh: 碎裂的颌骨

words.definition: a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a decoration; pillar, tier
words.translation: 纵队，列；专栏；圆柱，柱形物；纵队，[数]列

examples.en: He writes a weekly column for ‘The Times’.
examples.zh: 他每周为《泰晤士报》写一篇专栏文章。

words.definition: if you fuel a vehicle, or if it fuels up, fuel is put into it; a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that can be burned to produce heat or energy; catalyst, elding
words.translation: 得到燃料；燃料；刺激因素；[能源]燃料

examples.en: We’d better fuel up at the next town.
examples.zh: 我们最好在下个小镇加油。

examples.en: The van was fuelled and waiting in the basement car park.
examples.zh: 小货车加好了油，在地下停车场等着。

words.definition: to be a very good example of an idea or quality; objectify, reify
words.translation: 体现，使具体化；具体表达；(Embody)人名；(英)恩博迪

examples.en: She embodies everything I admire in a teacher.
examples.zh: 她具备了我所钦佩的教师该具备的一切素质。

words.definition: a flat round piece of finely cut beef(= meat from a cow ) which is cooked and eaten in a bread bun; burger, beefburger
words.translation: 汉堡包，火腿汉堡；牛肉饼，肉饼；碎牛肉；汉堡包，汉堡

words.definition: a specially prepared hard surface for cars, buses, bicycles etc to travel on; highway, path, instrument, way, course; itinerant
words.translation: 公路，马路；道路；手段；（狗）沿臭迹追逐（猎物）；（美）巡回的；[公路]公路，马路；[交]道路

examples.en: 65 Maple Road
examples.zh: 枫树路65号

words.definition: to run slowly and steadily, especially as a way of exercising; a slow steady run, especially done as a way of exercising; surge; canter; dogging, trot
words.translation: 慢跑；轻推；蹒跚行进；使颠簸；轻推，轻撞；颠簸着移动

examples.en: I go jogging every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早晨都去慢跑。

words.definition: a fault or weakness that makes someone or something less successful or effective than they should be; defect, deficiency, disadvantage, vice, fault
words.translation: 缺点；短处

examples.en: Peter was painfully aware of his own shortcomings.
examples.zh: 彼得痛苦地认识到了自己的短处。

words.definition: to examine or think about something carefully, in order to understand it; study, break down
words.translation: 分析；分解；细察

examples.en: She still needs to analyse the data.
examples.zh: 她仍需要分析这些数据。

examples.en: You need to sit down and analyse why you feel so upset.
examples.zh: 你得坐下来想一想自己为什么会那么生气。

examples.en: Joe had never tried to analyze their relationship.
examples.zh: 乔从未试图去理清他们的关系。

words.definition: the system of communication that you use to have a conversation with someone in another place; to talk to someone by telephone; phone, call; make a phone call, call up sb
words.translation: （美）电话；电话机；电话耳机；打电话；（美）[通信]电话；[通信]打电话

examples.en: The telephone rang just as I was leaving.
examples.zh: 我正要走，电话铃响了。

words.definition: a unit for measuring the amount of  energy  that food will produce
words.translation: 卡路里（热量单位）

examples.en: A potato has about 90 calories.
examples.zh: 一个马铃薯大约有90卡路里的热量。

examples.en: a calorie-controlled diet
examples.zh: 控制热量的日常饮食

examples.en: I need to burn off a few calories (= lose some weight by exercising ) .
examples.zh: 我要消耗掉一些卡路里。

words.definition: containing poison or producing poison; toxic, evil, rank, vicious, venomous
words.translation: 有毒的；恶毒的；讨厌的

examples.en: Some mushrooms are extremely poisonous.
examples.zh: 一些蘑菇有剧毒。

examples.en: poisonous gases such as hydrogen sulfide
examples.zh: 硫化氢等有毒气体

examples.en: poisonous substances
examples.zh: 有毒物质

words.definition: someone who is vain is too proud of their good looks, abilities, or position – used to show disapproval; empty, blank

examples.zh: 男人有时会和女人一样虚荣。

words.definition: a small tool used in work such as science or medicine; facilities, vehicle, engine, tool, implement

examples.zh: 那些男人躲在一间被炸毁的农舍里。

examples.zh: 我周围的人都在奔跑着寻找地方躲避。

examples.zh: …一座由低矮的尖屋顶遮蔽的木房子。

examples.zh: 我们包了一条船带我们到一些较小的岛上去。

words.definition: relating to or supporting a system of government that is not led by a king or queen; someone who believes in government by elected representatives only, with no king or queen

examples.en: Lower taxes made Republican voters happier with their party.
examples.zh: 更低的税率使共和党选民对该党更加满意。

words.definition: the smallest amount of something or number of things that is possible or necessary; the minimum number, degree, or amount of something is the smallest or least that is possible, allowed, or needed; lowest, least, smallest
words.translation: 最小值；最低限度；最小化；最小量；最小的；最低的；[数]最小的

examples.zh: 我们最起码应该招两名新教师。

words.definition: an important official statement about a particular situation or plan, or the act of making this statement; profession, announcement
words.translation: （纳税品等的）申报；宣布；公告；申诉书；（纳税品等的）[税收]申报；[法]申诉书

examples.zh: 停火声明

examples.zh: 从前按照伊斯兰法律，作简单的声明就可以离婚。

examples.zh: 火里飞出的火星

examples.zh: 金属之间互相摩擦，迸出一串火星。

examples.en: A dropped cigarette may have sparked the fire.
examples.zh: 一支丢弃的香烟可能引发了这场火灾。

words.definition: to make light or a shadow appear somewhere; all the people who perform in a play, film etc; throw, pitch, mould, figure; putting, throw; figure, shy
words.translation: 投，抛；计算；浇铸；投射（光、影、视线等）；投掷，抛；铸件，[古生] 铸型；演员阵容；脱落物；[印刷]浇铸；[机]铸件，[古生]铸型；投，抛垂钓鱼钩；计算，把几个数字加起来

examples.zh: 低垂的树枝投下的阴影

words.definition: money in the form of coins or notes rather than cheques,  credit card s  etc; If you cash a cheque, you exchange it at a bank for the amount of money that it is worth; ready, real money
words.translation: 现款，现金；将…兑现；支付现款；现款，[会计]现金

examples.zh: 在一次公寓盗窃案中现金被盗。

examples.en: There are similar charges if you want to cash a cheque or withdraw money at a branch other than your own.
examples.zh: 如果你在其他银行兑现支票或支取现金，将会产生差不多的手续费。

words.definition: the part of your hand that is shaped like a thick short finger and helps you to hold things; turn over, browse through

examples.zh: 我拦顺路车进了城。

words.translation: 衣服，服装；外表，外观；给…穿衣服

examples.zh: 她穿上衣服并拉好拉链。

words.translation: 力量；力气；兵力；长处

examples.zh: 我在努力增强体力。

examples.zh: 乔用尽全力打他。

examples.en: He never ceased to be amazed by her physical strength .
examples.zh: 他一直对她的体力感到惊诧。

words.definition: to make something very wet; freight, water logging; permeant, satd

examples.zh: 水从洞里流进来，浸湿了地毯。

words.definition: a flow of water, air, smoke etc, or the direction in which it is flowing; to flow quickly and in great amounts; tide, ray; flow, flood, dance; shed, sweat

examples.zh: 一股冷气穿过敞开的门直冲进来。

words.definition: looking or facing in the direction that is behind you; If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing; retarded, inverted; contrary, counter

examples.zh: 她头也不回地走了。

examples.zh: 跳水运动员向后翻转跳入水中。

examples.en: He took two steps backward.
examples.zh: 他往后退了两步。

words.definition: to make someone remember something that they must do; jack, put in mind
words.translation: 提醒；使想起

examples.zh: 是的，我会去那里的。 谢谢提醒。

examples.en: He made a few notes to remind himself of what he wanted to say.
examples.zh: 他记了几条，提醒自己要说些什么。

examples.zh: 我锁上门，然后把钥匙丢进手提包里。

examples.zh: 巧克力蛋糕

examples.zh: 格伦在葬礼上表现得平静而镇定。

examples.zh: 一种可以减弱刺眼强光的特殊屏幕

examples.zh: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

examples.zh: …汽车尾气。

examples.zh: 我将引用莎士比亚的几行诗作为我讲话的开场白。

examples.zh: 阿塔兰特跑起来很快。

examples.zh: 走着去很远，或许我们应该乘公共汽车。

words.translation: 指导；通知；命令；教授

examples.zh: 伊娃按照指示径直去了宾馆。

words.translation: 童年时期；幼年时代

examples.zh: 我的童年很快乐。

examples.zh: 传教士们去异国他乡教化当地人民。

examples.zh: 佩登深受艾尔郡人的尊敬。

examples.zh: 他被尊为文学才子。

examples.zh: 我们必须对家庭的构成重新定义。

examples.zh: 找个特殊的钻头，钻个尺寸合适的孔。

words.translation: 本质的，固有的；[物][生物]本质的，固有的

examples.zh: 该话题本身的趣味

examples.zh: 多出来的部分可以修剪掉。

examples.zh: 把混合料倒入四个小碟子里。

words.translation: 授予；给予；(Confer)人名；(英)康弗；协商

examples.zh: 宪法还授予巴西25个成员州极大的权力。

words.translation: 值得的；有价值的；配得上的，相称的；可尊敬的；应…的；杰出人物；知名人士

examples.zh: 利兹联队是比赛当之无愧的获胜者。

examples.zh: 值得钦佩的对手

words.translation: 开业者，从业者，执业医生

examples.zh: 非常规医学的执业医生

words.translation: 经验主义的，完全根据经验的；实证的

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["empirical evidence"]}
examples.zh: 实验证据

words.translation: 工程，工程学；设计；管理（engineer的ing形式）；建造

examples.zh: 他们的发明有助于电气工程学的发展。

words.translation: 文盲的；不识字的；没受教育的；文盲

examples.zh: 这封信文笔拙劣，错误连篇。

words.translation: 丰富的；充裕的；盛产

examples.zh: 提供给高素质的员工的大量机会

words.translation: 扭曲；使失真；曲解；变形
