words.translation: 学费；讲授

examples.en: I had to have extra tuition in maths.
examples.zh: 我不得不上数学补习课。

words.definition: a large area of rock or a mountain with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river; precipice, escarpment
words.translation: 悬崖；绝壁；[地理]悬崖

examples.en: The car rolled over the edge of a cliff.
examples.zh: 汽车翻下了悬崖边。

words.definition: stomach, go, stand, tough, tolerate; stay, hold, stomach
words.translation: 忍受，容忍；停留；遵守；持续；忍受

examples.en: I can’t abide that man – he’s so self-satisfied.
examples.zh: 我受不了那个人，他太自满了。

words.definition: a work of art, a piece of writing or music etc that is of very high quality or that is the best that a particular artist, writer etc has produced; chef-d'oeuvre, magnum opus
words.translation: 杰作；绝无仅有的人

examples.en: Mary Shelley was just 18 when she wrote the horror masterpiece ‘Frankenstein’.
examples.zh: 玛丽•雪莱创作《科学怪人》这部恐怖小说名作的时候年仅18岁。

words.definition: to send something somewhere using a particular route; a way from one place to another; door, vector, exit, channel, thread
words.translation: 按某路线发送；路线；航线；通道；[航]航线

examples.en: Trains are taking a lot of freight that used to be routed via trucks.
examples.zh: 火车正在运送过去由卡车运送的大批货物。

words.definition: an eminent person is famous, important, and respected; outstanding, excellent, obvious, prominent, brilliant
words.translation: 杰出的；有名的；明显的

examples.en: an eminent lawyer
examples.zh: 杰出的律师

words.definition: a quick look; to quickly look at someone or something; dekko, shufti; run one's eyes over, catch a glimpse of
words.translation: 一瞥；一滑；闪光；扫视，匆匆一看；反光；瞥闪，瞥见；扫视；瞥见；擦过

examples.en: He gave her a quick glance and smiled.
examples.zh: 他迅速地瞥了她一眼，笑了。

examples.en: The brothers exchanged glances (= looked at each other quickly ) .
examples.zh: 兄弟俩互相瞥了一眼。

words.definition: to be in a difficult or painful situation for a long time without complaining; resist, tough, abide; resist, abide
words.translation: 忍耐；容忍；持续

examples.en: It seemed impossible that anyone could endure such pain.
examples.zh: 似乎谁都不可能忍受这样的疼痛。

words.definition: the ability to understand and realize what people or situations are really like; perception, penetration
words.translation: 洞察力；洞悉

examples.en: a woman of great insight
examples.zh: 一位极有眼光的妇女

words.definition: If you defy someone or something that is trying to make you behave in a particular way, you refuse to obey them and behave in that way; spurn at, sneeze at; challenge, dare, war, confrontation
words.translation: 藐视；公然反抗；挑衅；使落空；挑战；对抗

examples.en: This was the first (and last) time that I dared to defy my mother.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次（也是最后一次）胆敢违抗我母亲。

words.definition: a particular place or area, especially a pleasant place where you spend time; to notice someone or something, especially when they are difficult to see or recognize; for buying or paying immediately, not at some future time; location, site, where; recognize, soil, mud, dirty; on-the-spot, on-site; accurately, just, true
words.translation: 地点；斑点；认出；弄脏；用灯光照射；现场的；现货买卖的；准确地；恰好；[贸易]现场的

examples.en: a nice quiet spot on the beach
examples.zh: 海滩上一个安静的好地方

examples.en: I chose a spot well away from the road.
examples.zh: 我选了一个远离马路的地点。

words.definition: the joint that bends in the middle of your leg; to hit someone with your knee; lap, genu
words.translation: 膝盖，膝；用膝盖碰；膝盖，[解剖]膝

examples.en: Lucy had a bandage round her knee.
examples.zh: 露西的膝盖上缠着绷带。

examples.en: a knee injury
examples.zh: 膝伤

words.definition: If someone clings to a position or a possession they have, they do everything they can to keep it even though this may be very difficult; stay, stand on
words.translation: 坚持，墨守；紧贴；附着

examples.en: Instead, he appears determined to cling to power.
examples.zh: 反而，他看来坚决要握紧权力不放。

examples.en: Another congressman clung on with a majority of only 18.
examples.zh: 另一位国会议员在获得仅仅18张多数票的情况下保住了位子。

words.definition: to move by jumping on one foot; a short jump; jump, clear; jump, ball, dance, spring; jump, dance
words.translation: 单足跳跃〔跳行〕；蹦跳,跳跃；跳舞；一次飞行的距离；[计][通信]跳跃；跳过；舞会；短途旅行；单脚跳；作短途旅行

examples.en: a little girl hopping and skipping
examples.zh: 一个蹦蹦跳跳的小女孩

words.definition: to move up, down, or across something using your feet and hands, especially when this is difficult to do; a process in which you move up towards a place, especially while using a lot of effort; arise, raise, scale; scale, come up; escalade
words.translation: 爬；攀登；上升

examples.en: Harry climbed the stairs.
examples.zh: 哈里爬上楼梯。

examples.en: Boys were climbing trees along the river bank.
examples.zh: 男孩们在河边爬树。

words.definition: to mean something; bid, bespeak
words.translation: 表示，指示

examples.en: What does the word ‘curriculum’ denote that ‘course’ does not?
examples.zh: curriculum一词的哪些含义是course没有的？

words.definition: To facilitate an action or process, especially one that you would like to happen, means to make it easier or more likely to happen; promote, boost, further
words.translation: 促进；帮助；使容易

examples.en: The new airport will facilitate the development of tourism.
examples.zh: 新机场将促进旅游业的发展。

words.definition: fair and sensible; rational, logical, possible, just, legitimate
words.translation: 合理的，公道的；通情达理的

examples.en: a reasonable request
examples.zh: 合情合理的要求

examples.en: Be reasonable — you can’t expect her to do all the work on her own!
examples.zh: 要讲道理，你不能指望她一个人干所有的工作！

examples.en: I thought it was a perfectly reasonable (= completely reasonable ) question.
examples.zh: 我认为这个问题问得很有道理。

words.translation: 电视（television）

words.definition: someone whose job is to deliver messages or documents, or someone who takes a message to someone else; precursor, forerunner
words.translation: 报信者，送信者；先驱

examples.en: There will be a messenger at the airport to collect the photographs from our courier.
examples.zh: 机场会有一名信使从我们的快递员那儿取走照片。

words.definition: the inside surface of your hand, in which you hold things; vola
words.translation: 手掌；棕榈树；掌状物；将…藏于掌中；[林]棕榈树

examples.en: He held the pebble in the palm of his hand .
examples.zh: 他把那颗卵石握在手心里。

words.definition: your birthday is a day that is an exact number of years after the day you were born
words.translation: 生日，诞辰；诞生的日子

examples.en: It’s my birthday on Monday.
examples.zh: 星期一是我的生日。

examples.en: My aunt called to wish me a happy birthday.
examples.zh: 我姑妈打电话来祝我生日快乐。

examples.en: Anne’s birthday party
examples.zh: 安妮的生日派对

words.definition: the freedom and the right to do whatever you want without asking permission or being afraid of authority; freedom, permission, leave
words.translation: 自由；许可；冒失

examples.en: the fight for liberty and equality
examples.zh: 争取自由和平等的斗争

words.definition: to breathe quickly with short noisy breaths, for example because you have been running or because it is very hot; rare, aspire; asthma, wheeziness
words.translation: 喘息；渴望；气喘吁吁地说出某事；气喘；喷气声

examples.en: He came in panting after running up the steps.
examples.zh: 他跑上台阶，气喘吁吁地走了进来。

examples.en: He was panting for breath .
examples.zh: 他上气不接下气。

examples.en: The dog lay panting on the doorstep.
examples.zh: 那条狗躺在门阶上喘着气。

words.definition: someone you know, but who is not a close friend; knowledge, awareness
words.translation: 熟人；相识；了解；知道

examples.en: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
examples.zh: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

examples.en: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
examples.zh: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

words.definition: having or needing a lot of energy or determination; active, positive, male, live, vigorous
words.translation: 精力充沛的；积极的；有力的

examples.en: an energetic man
examples.zh: 精力旺盛的男子

examples.en: an energetic drive to get more customers
examples.zh: 争取更多客户的十足干劲

words.definition: to make something clearer or easier to understand; illustrate, elucidate
words.translation: 澄清；阐明

examples.en: Reporters asked him to clarify his position (= say exactly what his beliefs are ) on welfare reform.
examples.zh: 记者们要求他阐明他在福利改革问题上的立场。

words.definition: a short piece of writing giving someone’s ideas about politics, society etc; attempt, prose; sample, have a try
words.translation: 散文；试图；随笔；尝试；对…做试验

examples.en: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown.
examples.zh: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

words.definition: to make a fire or light stop burning or shining; silence, go out
words.translation: 熄灭；压制；偿清

examples.en: Please extinguish all cigarettes.
examples.zh: 请把香烟都熄灭了。

examples.en: Firemen were called to extinguish the blaze.
examples.zh: 有人打电话叫消防队员来扑灭大火。

words.definition: an object that is made from two similar parts that are joined together; to put people or things into groups of two, or to form groups of two; pack
words.translation: 一对，一双，一副；把…组成一对

examples.en: earrings, £5 a pair
examples.zh: 耳环，5英镑一副

words.definition: still living and not dead; lively, activated
words.translation: 活着的；活泼的；有生气的

examples.en: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.
examples.zh: 这是一宗严重事故——他们能活着实属幸运。

examples.en: My grandparents are still alive .
examples.zh: 我的祖父母和外祖父母都还健在。

examples.en: We stayed alive by eating berries.
examples.zh: 我们靠吃浆果活命。

words.definition: to make someone or something move by pressing them with your hands, arms etc; when someone pushes something; enhance, drive, boost, press, force; spread, improve, accelerate, extend, gain; determination, decision, resolution, enterprise, attempt
words.translation: 推动，增加；对…施加压力，逼迫；按；说服；推，决心；大规模攻势；矢志的追求；推动；增加；推行；逼迫；推；推进；伸展；努力争取；决心；奋力；攻击；干劲；进取心

examples.en: It didn’t move, so she pushed harder.
examples.zh: 它一动不动，因此她加力去推。

examples.en: I promised to push him on the swings for as long as he wanted.
examples.zh: 我答应他想在秋千上荡多久我就推多久。

examples.en: shoppers pushing their grocery carts
examples.zh: 推着购物车的购物者

words.definition: all the plays, pieces of music etc that a performer or group knows and can perform
words.translation: 全部节目；计算机指令系统；（美）某人或机器的全部技能

examples.en: the behavioural repertoire of infants
examples.zh: 婴幼儿的行为能力

words.definition: very important and needing to be dealt with immediately; emergency, instant
words.translation: 紧急的；急迫的

examples.en: He was in urgent need of medical attention.
examples.zh: 他急需治疗。

examples.en: The report called for urgent action to reduce lead in petrol.
examples.zh: 报告呼吁迅速采取行动，减少汽油中的铅含量。

examples.en: an urgent message
examples.zh: 一封急报

words.definition: something that encourages you to work harder, start a new activity etc; motivation, stimulus, reason, excitement, needle; stimulative, hortatory
words.translation: 动机；刺激；激励的；刺激的

examples.en: As an added incentive, there’s a bottle of champagne for the best team.
examples.zh: 给最优秀的队发一瓶香槟作为额外的鼓励。

words.definition: good things that happen to you by chance; fortune, chance, mercy; have one's day, strike it rich
words.translation: 运气；幸运；带来好运的东西；靠运气，走运；凑巧碰上

examples.en: You’re not having much luck today, are you?
examples.zh: 你今天运气不太好，是不是？

examples.en: He’s had good luck with his roses this year.
examples.zh: 今年他种玫瑰的运气不错。

examples.en: It was an incredible piece of luck.
examples.zh: 真是令人难以置信的好运气。

words.definition: to use something that belongs to someone else and that you must give back to them later; loan, scunge
words.translation: 借；借用；从其他语言中引入；(Borrow)人名；(英)博罗

examples.en: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的笔用一下吗？

examples.en: They borrowed heavily (=  borrowed a lot of money  ) from the bank to start their new business.
examples.zh: 他们向银行贷了巨款来创办新公司。

words.definition: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it; enthrall, beguile; be carried away
words.translation: 使着迷，使神魂颠倒；入迷

examples.en: Politics fascinated Franklin's father.
examples.zh: 政治让富兰克林的父亲着迷。

words.definition: a doctor who does operations in a hospital; sawbones, chirurgeon
words.translation: 外科医生

examples.en: ...a heart surgeon.
examples.zh: …一位心脏外科医生。

words.definition: affecting or involving a machine; wooden, automatic, dead
words.translation: 机械的；力学的；呆板的；无意识的；手工操作的；[机]机械的；[力]力学的

examples.en: The flight has been cancelled due to mechanical failure .
examples.zh: 因机械故障航班被取消了。

examples.en: The plane had to make an emergency landing because of mechanical problems.
examples.zh: 飞机因机械故障不得不紧急降落。

words.definition: an object or piece of information that helps someone solve a crime or mystery; action, plot, scenario
words.translation: 线索；（故事等的）情节；为…提供线索；为…提供情况

examples.en: Police have found a vital clue .
examples.zh: 警方发现了至关重要的线索。

examples.en: Archaeological evidence will provide clues about what the building was used for.
examples.zh: 考古证据将为这幢建筑的用途提供线索。

examples.en: a desperate search for clues
examples.zh: 拼命寻找线索

words.definition: a movement away from the enemy after a defeat in battle; to move away from the enemy after being defeated in battle; withdrawal, pullback; withdraw, bug out
words.translation: 撤退；休息寓所；退避；向后倾

examples.en: Napoleon’s retreat from Moscow
examples.zh: 拿破仑从莫斯科的撤退

examples.en: The rebel forces are in full retreat (= retreating very fast ) .
examples.zh: 叛军全线溃退。

examples.en: The bugler sounded the retreat (= gave a loud signal for retreat ) .
examples.zh: 司号兵吹响撤退号。

words.definition: a metal tool for cutting holes or for pushing something into a small hole; to hit someone or something hard with your  fist (= closed hand ); blanking press, drilling machine; jab
words.translation: 冲压机；打洞器；钻孔机；开洞；以拳重击；[机]冲压机；[计]钻孔机；用拳猛击

examples.en: Make two holes with a hole punch.
examples.zh: 用打孔器打两个孔。

words.definition: to say words for someone else to write down; an order, rule, or principle that you have to obey; require, order, command; instruction, order, bidding, telling, word
words.translation: 命令；口述；使听写；指示

examples.en: Federal funds have to be used as dictated by Washington.
examples.zh: 联邦款项得按照华盛顿规定的途径使用。

words.definition: to put clothes on yourself or someone else; a piece of clothing worn by a woman or girl that covers the top of her body and part or all of her legs; apparel, clothe; frock, suit-dress
words.translation: 给…穿衣；连衣裙；女装；[服装]连衣裙

examples.en: Can you wait a minute? I’m just getting dressed .
examples.zh: 稍等一会儿，我穿下衣服就好。

examples.en: She dressed quickly and went out of the house.
examples.zh: 她很快穿好衣服，走到房子外面。

examples.en: I usually have to dress the kids in the mornings.
examples.zh: 早上我通常得给孩子们穿衣服。

words.definition: directly relating to the subject or problem being discussed or considered; concerned, involved
words.translation: 相关的；切题的；中肯的；有重大关系的；有意义的，目的明确的；有关的；有重大作用的

examples.en: Relevant documents were presented in court.
examples.zh: 法庭上出示了相关的文件。

examples.en: We received all the relevant information.
examples.zh: 我们收到了所有相关信息。

words.definition: unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone to talk to; remote, doleful
words.translation: 寂寞的；偏僻的；孤独者

examples.en: a lonely old man
examples.zh: 一个孤单的老人

examples.en: Don’t you get lonely being on your own all day?
examples.zh: 你整天独自一人不感到寂寞吗？

words.definition: worried about something; eager, hungry, desired, sick, keen
words.translation: 焦虑的；担忧的；渴望的；急切的

examples.en: She gave me an anxious look.
examples.zh: 她焦急地看了我一眼。

words.definition: evening; evening, sunset
words.translation: 夏娃；前夕；傍晚；重大事件关头

examples.en: one summer’s eve
examples.zh: 一个夏日的傍晚

words.definition: a piece of soft thin paper, used especially for blowing your nose on; set, gauze
words.translation: 组织；纸巾；薄纱；一套；饰以薄纱；用化妆纸揩去；[纺]薄纱

examples.en: a box of tissues
examples.zh: 一盒面巾纸

words.definition: the degree to which something can reasonably be expected to happen; possibility, probability, feasibility, potential, maybe
words.translation: 可能性，可能

examples.en: If I refused, it would in all likelihood mean I’d lose my job.
examples.zh: 如果我拒绝，那我十有八九会丢掉工作。

words.definition: to think or know that something is going to happen in the future; predict, think ahead
words.translation: 预见；预知

examples.en: I’ve put your name on the list and I don’t foresee any problems.
examples.zh: 我把你的名字写在名单上了，估计不会有什么问题。

examples.en: The disaster could not have been foreseen.
examples.zh: 这场灾难是始料未及的。

words.definition: to confuse someone; bemuddle, enchant
words.translation: 使迷惑，使不知所措

examples.en: He was bewildered by his daughter’s reaction.
examples.zh: 他被女儿的反应弄糊涂了。

words.definition: to join two things together using glue; a sticky substance used for joining things together; conglutinate
words.translation: 粘合；似胶般固着于；胶；各种胶合物

examples.en: Glue the fabric around the window.
examples.zh: 用胶把这布粘在窗户四周。

words.definition: many times; again and again, iteratively
words.translation: 反复地；再三地；屡次地

examples.en: Graham was repeatedly warned not to work so hard.
examples.zh: 格雷厄姆一再被提醒工作不要这么拼命。

words.definition: A cloak is a long, loose, sleeveless piece of clothing which people used to wear over their other clothes when they went out; subterfuge, cloke; overcurtain, obscure
words.translation: 斗蓬；宽大外衣；托词；遮掩；隐匿

words.definition: a period of time in history that is known for a particular event, or for particular qualities; years, age, time, date
words.translation: 时代；年代；纪元；[天]纪元

examples.en: His death marked the end of an era.
examples.zh: 他的去世标志着一个时代的终结。

examples.en: the Victorian era
examples.zh: 维多利亚时代

words.definition: many, or involving many things, people, events etc; a number that contains a smaller number an exact number of times; numerous, many, hundred; time, paralleling
words.translation: 多重的；多样的；许多的；倍数；[电] 并联；[数]倍数；[电]并联

examples.en: Baxter was rushed to the hospital with multiple stab wounds.
examples.zh: 巴克斯特因多处刺伤被紧急送往医院。

examples.en: Having multiple partners increases your risk of sexual diseases.
examples.zh: 性伴侣多会增加得性病的风险。

examples.en: His new album includes multiple versions of the same songs.
examples.zh: 他的新专辑包括同一些歌曲的多种版本。

words.definition: to do a calculation in which you add a number to itself a particular number of times; ride; breed, improve, accelerate, gain; diversiform, variant
words.translation: 乘；使增加；使繁殖；使相乘；多样地；复合地；多层的；多样的；繁殖；增加

examples.en: Children will learn to multiply in the second grade.
examples.zh: 儿童在二年级学习乘法。

words.definition: a boat that carries people or goods across a river or a narrow area of water; to carry people or things a short distance from one place to another in a boat or other vehicle; lift, cross, wing
words.translation: 渡船；摆渡；渡口；（乘渡船）渡过；用渡船运送；空运

examples.en: They had recrossed the River Gambia by ferry.
examples.zh: 他们乘船又一次渡过了冈比亚河。

words.definition: a small house on the land of a large country house, usually at the main entrance gate; to make a formal or official complaint, protest etc; hotel, fonda; introduce, present, prefer, file, advance; board, guest
words.translation: 旅馆；门房；集会处；山林小屋；提出；寄存；借住；嵌入；寄宿；临时住宿

examples.en: the porter’s lodge
examples.zh: 传达室

words.definition: quickly, willingly, and without complaining; easily, lightly
words.translation: 容易地；乐意地；无困难地

examples.en: Jack readily agreed to help.
examples.zh: 杰克爽快地答应帮忙。

words.definition: the process of watching something or someone carefully for a period of time; view, monitoring, surveillance, watch
words.translation: 观察；监视；观察报告

examples.en: He spent two nights under close observation in hospital.
examples.zh: 他在医院接受了两个晚上的严密观察。

examples.en: His orders were to keep the men under observation.
examples.zh: 他下的命令是监视这些人。

examples.en: Art classes help develop children’s powers of observation.
examples.zh: 美术课有助于提高儿童的观察力。

words.definition: something that covers all or part of your face, to protect or to hide it; to hide your feelings or the truth about a situation; blind, face-piece; dissimulate, make sb up; belie, disguise
words.translation: 面具；口罩；掩饰；戴面具；化装；使模糊

examples.en: a surgical face mask
examples.zh: 外科手术口罩

examples.en: He was attacked and robbed by two people wearing masks .
examples.zh: 他被两个蒙面人袭击并抢劫。

words.definition: to go from one subject to another in no fixed order; a skipping movement; dance, to leap; jump, clear; jump, spring
words.translation: 跳跃；跳绳；遗漏；跳读；跳过

examples.en: They saw the man with a little girl skipping along behind him.
examples.zh: 他们看到那个男人身后跟着一个蹦蹦跳跳的小女孩。

words.definition: a quality or feature, especially one that is considered to be good or useful; If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation; particularity, idiosyncracy; ascribe to
words.translation: 属性；特质；归属；把…归于

examples.en: What attributes should a good manager possess?
examples.zh: 一名优秀的经理应该具备哪些素质？

examples.en: Women tend to attribute their success to external causes such as luck.
examples.zh: 女性往往把她们的成功归因于外因，如运气。

words.definition: Adolescent is used to describe young people who are no longer children but who have not yet become adults. It also refers to their behaviour.; a young person, usually between the ages of 12 and 18, who is developing into an adult; pubertal, hebetic; youths, teener
words.translation: 青春期的；未成熟的；青少年；[人类]青少年

examples.en: It is important that an adolescent boy should have an adult in whom he can confide.
examples.zh: 一个青春期男孩应该有一个他能倾吐心声的成年人，这是很重要的。

words.definition: a tense situation is one in which you feel very anxious and worried because of something bad that might happen; If your muscles tense, if you tense, or if you tense your muscles, your muscles become tight and stiff, often because you are anxious or frightened; any of the forms of a verb that show the time, continuance, or completion of an action or state that is expressed by the verb. ‘I am’ is in the present tense, ‘I was’ is past tense, and ‘I will be’ is future tense.; intense, stressed; get nervous; strain, get nervous
words.translation: 紧张的；拉紧的；变得紧张；使拉紧；时态；拉紧，变得紧张

examples.en: Is anything wrong? You look a little tense.
examples.zh: 有什么不对劲吗？你看起来有点紧张。

examples.en: Newman's stomach muscles tensed.
examples.zh: 纽曼的腹部肌肉绷紧了。

words.definition: to make time pass in an enjoyable way, so that you do not get bored; to entertain, wile away
words.translation: 娱乐；消遣；使发笑；使愉快

examples.en: Doing jigsaws would amuse Amy for hours on end.
examples.zh: 拼图能让埃米连续玩上几个小时。

examples.en: The kids amused themselves playing hide-and-seek.
examples.zh: 孩子们玩捉迷藏玩。

words.definition: one of several natural substances that exist in food such as meat, eggs, and beans, and which your body needs in order to grow and remain strong and healthy; albumose; glaireous
words.translation: 蛋白质；朊；蛋白质的；[生化]蛋白质；[生化]蛋白质的

examples.en: Where do you get your protein?
examples.zh: 你从哪里获得蛋白质？

examples.en: I know that I get around 90g of protein from that.
examples.zh: 我知道我会从中得到90克左右的蛋白质。

words.definition: money that you risk as the result of a horse race, card game etc; to risk losing something that is valuable or important to you on the result of something; bonus, dividend; encourage, carry, fund, second, back; lay, make a bet
words.translation: 桩，棍子；赌注；火刑；奖金；资助，支持；系…于桩上；把…押下打赌；打赌

examples.en: For a dollar stake, you can win up to $1,000,000.
examples.zh: 押一美元赌注，最多可赢一百万美元。

words.definition: land that is always very wet or covered with a layer of water; If something swamps a place or object, it fills it with water; wetland, cienaga; embog; sunk
words.translation: 沼泽；湿地；使陷于沼泽；使沉没；使陷入困境；[地理]沼泽；下沉；陷入沼泽；陷入困境；不知所措（过去式swamped，过去分词swamped，现在分词swamping，第三人称单数swamps，名词swampiness，形容词swampy）

examples.en: I spent one whole night by a swamp behind the road listening to frogs.
examples.zh: 我整个晚上都在这条路后面的一个沼泽地旁听蛙鸣。

examples.en: Their electronic navigation failed and a rogue wave swamped the boat.
examples.zh: 他们的电子导航装置失灵了，一个巨浪吞没了那只船。

words.definition: to change the colour of something, especially something made of wood, by using a special liquid; a mark that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood, coffee, or ink; poison, pollute; tainture, jaup
words.translation: 沾污；败坏；给…着色；污点；瑕疵；着色剂；[试剂][生物]着色剂

examples.en: We’ve decided to stain the shelves blue.
examples.zh: 我们决定把架子涂成蓝色。

words.definition: having a lot of money, possessions etc; The wealthy are people who are wealthy; rich, sufficient, plenary; the rich, haves
words.translation: 富有的；充分的；丰裕的；富人

examples.en: the wealthy nations of the world
examples.zh: 世界上的富国

examples.en: The best education should not be available only to the wealthy.
examples.zh: 不应该只有富人才能得到最好的教育。

words.definition: grave problems, situations, or worries are very great or bad; the place in the ground where a dead body is buried; to cut, carve, sculpt, or engrave; important, serious, significant, great, cracking; death, end; brand, heart, engrave
words.translation: 重大的；严肃的；黯淡的；墓穴，坟墓；死亡；雕刻；铭记

examples.en: Matthew’s life is in grave danger .
examples.zh: 马修的生命危在旦夕。

examples.en: The report expressed grave concern over the technicians’ lack of training.
examples.zh: 报告中对技术人员缺乏培训深表忧虑。

examples.en: I have grave doubts about his ability.
examples.zh: 我十分怀疑他的能力。

words.definition: something that shows what something else is like, or that is a sign of a particular situation; meditation, contemplation
words.translation: 反射；沉思；映象；[热][光][物]反射

examples.en: Can you see your reflection in the glass?
examples.zh: 你能看到玻璃里你的影像吗？

words.definition: If you say that someone has the wit to do something, you mean that they have the intelligence and understanding to make the right decision or take the right action in a particular situation; that is to say; namely (used to introduce statements, as in legal documents); wisdom, intelligence, brain, mind, mentality
words.translation: 智慧；才智；智力；<古>知道；即

examples.en: The information is there and waiting to be accessed by anyone with the wit to use it.
examples.zh: 信息是现成的，等着有头脑的人去获取和利用。

words.definition: an important job that involves travelling somewhere, done by a member of the air force, army etc, or by a spacecraft; role, assignment, task, delegation; send along, dispatch
words.translation: 使命，任务；代表团；布道；派遣；向……传教

examples.en: He was sent on over 200 missions before being killed in action.
examples.zh: 在阵亡之前他奉命执行过200多次军事任务。

examples.en: US troops taking part in the peacekeeping mission
examples.zh: 参与维和任务的美军

words.definition: the part of a television or computer where the picture or information appears; to do tests on a lot of people to find out whether they have a particular illness; curtain, creen; project, ree; shoot, make a film
words.translation: 屏，幕；屏风；筛；拍摄；放映；掩蔽；[家具]屏风；拍电影

examples.en: a computer with an 18-inch colour screen
examples.zh: 带18英寸彩色屏幕的电脑

examples.en: He went on staring at the TV screen .
examples.zh: 他继续盯着电视屏幕看。

words.definition: to invent a story, piece of information etc in order to deceive someone; manufacture, make, doctor
words.translation: 制造；伪造；装配

examples.en: The police were accused of fabricating evidence.
examples.zh: 警方被控捏造证据。

words.definition: dry powder consisting of extremely small bits of dirt that is in buildings on furniture, floors etc if they are not kept clean; to clean the dust from a surface by moving something such as a soft cloth across it; powder, dirt; sift
words.translation: 灰尘；尘埃；尘土；撒；拂去灰尘；[环境]尘埃

examples.en: All the furniture was covered in dust .
examples.zh: 所有的家具都蒙上了灰尘。

examples.en: a thick layer of dust
examples.zh: 厚厚的一层灰尘

examples.en: There’s not a speck of dust in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房里一尘不染。

words.definition: the part of a country’s military force that is trained to fight on land in a war; battalion, heer
words.translation: 陆军，军队；陆军，[军]军队

examples.en: The army are helping to clear up after the floods.
examples.zh: 陆军部队正协助洪灾后的清理工作。

examples.en: an army officer
examples.zh: 陆军军官

examples.en: Army units launched attacks on bases near Jounieh port.
examples.zh: 陆军部队对朱尼耶港附近的基地发动了进攻。

words.definition: someone whose job is to make men’s clothes, that are measured to fit each customer perfectly; dressmaker, needlecraft, sartor, seamster
words.translation: 剪裁；使合适；裁缝；[服装]裁缝

examples.en: In his youth his father bound him out to a tailor.
examples.zh: 他年轻时他父亲叫他去给一个裁缝当学徒。

words.definition: a natural tendency to behave in a particular way or a natural ability to know something, which is not learned; intuition, natural ability; abrim
words.translation: 本能，直觉；天性；充满着的；[生物]本能，直觉；[心理]天性

examples.en: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

words.definition: approach, proximity
words.translation: 附近；街坊；接近；街区

words.definition: the legal right to be the only producer or seller of a book, play, film, or record for a specific length of time; literary property, intellectual property
words.translation: 版权，著作权；版权的；受版权保护的；保护版权；为…取得版权；[法]版权，著作权

examples.en: Who owns the copyright of this book?
examples.zh: 谁拥有这本书的版权？

examples.en: The database will be protected by copyright .
examples.zh: 这个数据库将受到版权保护。

words.definition: If you discard something, you get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it; yield, desert, quit; fall out of, render up, to renounce, to abandon, to give up; rejection, abandonment
words.translation: 抛弃；放弃；丢弃；被丢弃的东西或人

examples.en: Read the manufacturer's guidelines before discarding the box.
examples.zh: 先阅读制造商的说明书再把盒子丢掉。

words.definition: the mass of things like fine threads that grows on your head; capello, poil; pilar
words.translation: 头发；毛发；些微；除去…的毛发；生长毛发；形成毛状纤维；毛发的；护理毛发的；用毛发制成的；[解剖]毛发；[解剖]毛发的

examples.en: Her hair was short and dark.
examples.zh: 她的头发又短又黑。

examples.en: a short fat man with no hair on his head
examples.zh: 光头的矮胖男人

words.definition: a loud sound and the energy produced by something such as a bomb bursting into small pieces; blast, burst, detonation
words.translation: 爆炸；爆发；激增；[力]爆炸

examples.en: We heard a loud explosion.
examples.zh: 我们听到一声巨大的爆炸声。

words.definition: a strong feeling of wanting to hurt or criticize someone because they have done something bad to you or been unkind to you; to make someone angry; wrath, bile; provoke, enrage; chafe at, be hot under the collar
words.translation: 怒，愤怒；忿怒；使发怒，激怒；恼火；怒，[心理]愤怒；发怒

examples.en: There is growing anger among the people against the government.
examples.zh: 民众对政府越来越不满。

words.definition: unable to speak, because you are angry, surprised, shocked etc; tongueless, speechless
words.translation: 哑的，无说话能力的；不说话的，无声音的

examples.en: He stared at the burnt-out car in dumb disbelief.
examples.zh: 他难以置信地望着烧毁的汽车，话也说不出来了。

examples.en: She was struck dumb with terror.
examples.zh: 她吓得说不出话来。

words.definition: the study of the countries, oceans, rivers, mountains, cities etc of the world; terrain, landform
words.translation: 地理；地形；[地理]地理

examples.en: a geography lesson
examples.zh: 地理课

words.definition: a small metal or plastic object that holds or fastens things together; to cut small amounts of something in order to make it tidier; shear, crop; shear, trim off; shear, cutting back
words.translation: （塑料或金属的）夹子；回纹针；修剪；剪报；剪；剪掉；缩短；给…剪毛（或发）用别针别在某物上，用夹子夹在某物上；[园艺]修剪；夹牢；痛打；夹子；回形针

examples.en: The wire is held on with a metal clip.
examples.zh: 电线用金属夹子固定。

examples.en: a wad of money in a gold clip
examples.zh: 用金夹子夹着的一沓钞票

words.definition: a place made or chosen by a bird to lay its eggs in and to live in; to build or use a nest; soil, eyrie; nidificate
words.translation: 巢，窝；安乐窝；温床；筑巢；嵌套；找鸟巢

examples.en: a bird’s nest
examples.zh: 鸟窝

examples.en: In May the females build a nest and lay their eggs.
examples.zh: 雌鸟在5月份筑巢产蛋。

examples.en: Young eagles leave the nest after only two months.
examples.zh: 雏鹰仅仅两个月以后就会飞离鸟巢。

words.definition: the natural lines you can see in a substance such as wood, which are the result of its structure; particle, texture, corn, commissariat
words.translation: 粮食；颗粒；[作物] 谷物；纹理；成谷粒；[粮食]粮食；[摄]颗粒；[作物]谷物；[木][纺][岩]纹理

examples.en: ...a grain of wheat.
examples.zh: …一颗麦粒。

words.definition: feeling very ashamed and sad because you know that you have done something wrong; sinful, culpable
words.translation: 有罪的；内疚的

examples.en: She looked self-conscious and guilty.
examples.zh: 她看上去很不自然，很内疚的样子。

examples.en: It was his guilty conscience that made him offer to help.
examples.zh: 他是因为良心上过意不去才提出帮忙的。

words.definition: to make a book, list, record etc, using different pieces of information, music etc; to edit, copy-edit
words.translation: 编译；编制；编辑；[图情] 汇编；[图情]汇编

examples.en: The document was compiled by the Department of Health.
examples.zh: 这份文件是由卫生部汇编的。

words.definition: cloudy air near the ground which is difficult to see through; if something made of glass fogs or becomes fogged, it becomes covered in small drops of water that make it difficult to see through; vapor, smog; obfuscate, befog; mist
words.translation: 雾；烟雾，尘雾；迷惑；使模糊；使困惑；以雾笼罩；[气象][摄]雾；被雾笼罩；变模糊

examples.en: It will be a cold night, and there may be fog patches .
examples.zh: 今夜天气寒冷，部分地区可能有雾。

examples.en: A blanket of fog covered the fields.
examples.zh: 大雾笼罩了田野。

examples.en: The fog lifted (= disappeared ) in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午，雾散了。

words.definition: a white or grey mass in the sky that forms from very small drops of water; horde, melasma; confuse, make hay of
words.translation: 云；阴云；云状物；一大群；黑斑；使混乱；以云遮敝；使忧郁；玷污；[气象]云

examples.en: Fears of renewed terrorist attacks cast a cloud over the event (= spoilt the happy situation ) .
examples.zh: 对恐怖分子再次发动袭击的担心给这次活动蒙上了一层阴影。

words.definition: a small piece of something solid, without a particular shape; to tolerate or put up with; endure (in the phrase lump it); piece, block, tumor, mass, node; tough, resist; gross, volumed; greatly, quite, badly, extremely, too, highly, far
words.translation: 块，块状；肿块；瘤；很多；笨人；混在一起；使成块状；忍耐；笨重地移动；成团的；总共的；很；非常；[医]肿块

examples.en: Strain the custard to remove lumps.
examples.zh: 滤去牛奶蛋糊里的面块。

words.definition: to limit or control the size, amount, or range of something; block, set a limit to
words.translation: 限制；约束；限定

examples.en: The new law restricts the sale of hand guns.
examples.zh: 新法规限制手枪的销售。

examples.en: You may need to restrict access to certain files (= limit the number of people who can read them ) .
examples.zh: 某些档案可能需要限制查阅。

examples.en: The agreement will restrict competition.
examples.zh: 这个协议将限制竞争。

words.definition: a powder that is used to add a hot taste to food; to add pepper to food; peper, capsicum; besprinkle
words.translation: 胡椒；辣椒；胡椒粉；加胡椒粉于；使布满；[食品][植]胡椒；[园艺]辣椒；[食品]加胡椒粉于

examples.en: salt and pepper
examples.zh: 盐和胡椒粉

words.definition: a story that is told using sound and moving pictures, shown at a cinema or on television; to use a camera to record a story or real events so that it can be shown in the cinema or on television; movie, membrane, cinema; cinematograph
words.translation: 电影；薄膜；胶卷；轻烟；在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影；[电影]电影；[感光]胶卷

examples.en: Have you seen any good films recently?
examples.zh: 你最近看过什么好的影片吗？

words.definition: a small round red or black fruit with a long thin stem and a stone in the middle; hymen, virginal membrane
words.translation: 樱桃；樱桃树；如樱桃的鲜红色；处女膜，处女；[木][园艺]樱桃

examples.en: a bunch of cherries
examples.zh: 一串樱桃

examples.en: cherry pie
examples.zh: 樱桃馅饼

words.definition: on the outside of something; outside, external, out
words.translation: 外面的，外部的；远离中心的；环外命中

examples.en: Remove the tough outer leaves before cooking.
examples.zh: 烹煮之前先把外面的老叶子去掉。

words.definition: a piece of clothing that covers you from your waist to your feet and has a separate part for each leg; britches, short trousers
words.translation: 裤子；短裤

examples.en: She was wearing dark blue pants and a white sweater.
examples.zh: 她穿着深蓝色长裤和白色毛衣。

words.definition: if something floats, it moves slowly through the air or stays up in the air; a large vehicle that is decorated to drive through the streets as part of a special event; execute, to put into practice; fan, swing; drift, caroche
words.translation: 使漂浮；实行；彩车，花车；漂流物；浮舟；浮萍；浮动；飘动，散播；摇摆；付诸实施

examples.en: I looked up at the clouds floating in the sky.
examples.zh: 我仰望着天上的浮云。

examples.en: Leaves floated gently down from the trees.
examples.zh: 叶子从树上轻轻飘落。

words.definition: a type of small bag in or on a coat, trousers etc that you can put money, keys etc in; If someone pockets something, they put it in their pocket, for example, because they want to steal it or hide it; You use pocket to describe something that is small enough to fit into a pocket, often something that is a smaller version of a larger item; money, container, vessel, QIAN; lock, stomach, stand, go, tough; miniative, baby-size
words.translation: 口袋；钱；容器；隐藏；忍受；将…放入衣袋；小型的，袖珍的；金钱上的

examples.en: Luke came in with his hands in his pockets.
examples.zh: 卢克走了进来，双手插在口袋里。

examples.en: The policeman told me to turn out my pockets (= take everything out of them ) .
examples.zh: 警察让我把口袋里的东西都掏出来。

examples.en: Anthony snatched his letters and pocketed them.
examples.zh: 安东尼抓过他的信，放进了衣袋中。

words.definition: money in the till is money that a company or organization has; until; to prepare land for growing crops; glacial drift; unto, hasta; farm, plant crops; plant crops
words.translation: [地理][水文] 冰碛；放钱的抽屉；备用现金；直到；直到为止；耕种；犁；[地理][水文]冰碛；[会计]备用现金；耕耘

examples.en: You keep as much money as you need in the till to run your operations.
examples.zh: 你做业务要储备足够的钱。

words.definition: to stop the water in a river or stream from flowing by building a special wall across it; a special wall built across a river or stream to stop the water from flowing, especially in order to make a lake or produce electricity; control over, take control of; bar, obstacle, let, stop
words.translation: 控制；筑坝；[水利] 水坝；障碍；[水利]水坝

examples.en: They built a dam along the seashore to retain the seawater.
examples.zh: 他们沿海岸筑起一道堤坝以拦住海水。

words.definition: to become worse; go ill, change for the worse; go ill, exasperate
words.translation: 恶化，变坏；恶化

examples.en: Ethel’s health has deteriorated.
examples.zh: 埃塞尔的健康状况恶化了。

examples.en: America’s deteriorating economy
examples.zh: 美国日渐恶化的经济

words.definition: a hard black mineral which is dug out of the ground and burnt to produce heat; char; charcoal, xylanthrax
words.translation: 上煤；加煤；煤；煤块；木炭；给…加煤；把…烧成炭；[矿物]煤

examples.en: Put some coal on the fire.
examples.zh: 往火里加点煤。

examples.en: the coal mining industry
examples.zh: 采煤业

examples.en: a lump of coal
examples.zh: 一块煤

words.definition: a statement in which someone complains about something; sickness, complain of
words.translation: 抱怨；诉苦；疾病；委屈

examples.en: If you wish to make a complaint, you should see the manager.
examples.zh: 如果你要投诉，应该去找经理。

examples.en: The sales assistants are trained to deal with customer complaints in a friendly manner.
examples.zh: 售货员都受过培训，要以友好的态度处理顾客的投诉。

words.definition: a photograph; picture, pix
words.translation: 照片

examples.en: Can you take a photo of me and Rachel?
examples.zh: 你能给我和雷切尔拍张照吗？

words.definition: to find exactly where you are by looking around you or using a map; the eastern part of the world, especially China and Japan; adapt, condition, suit, season; east; eastern; to the east
words.translation: 使适应；确定方向；使朝东；东方；东方诸国；东方的；向东

examples.en: She looked at the street names, trying to orient herself.
examples.zh: 她看看街名，试图确定自己的方位。

words.definition: if you are bound by an agreement, promise etc, you must do what you have agreed to do or promised to do; an annoying or difficult situation; bond, couple, become one, combine; restrict, rope; difficulty, corner, dilemma, fix
words.translation: 结合；装订；有约束力；过紧；捆绑；困境；讨厌的事情；植物的藤蔓；绑；[法]约束；包扎；凝固

examples.en: The monks are bound by vows of silence.
examples.zh: 僧侣们必须遵守保持缄默的誓言。

words.definition: destroy, damage; die, flag
words.translation: 使麻木；毁坏；死亡；毁灭；腐烂；枯萎

words.definition: if you refresh your computer screen while you are connected to the Internet, you make the screen show any new information that has arrived since you first began looking at it; renovate, to update; revive
words.translation: 更新；使……恢复；使……清新；消除……的疲劳；恢复精神；喝饮料，吃点心；补充给养

examples.en: A shower will refresh you.
examples.zh: 洗个淋浴你就凉快了。

words.definition: a serious promise or agree-ment, especially one made publicly or officially; to make a formal, usually public, promise that you will do something; assurance, certification, commitment, guarantee, mortgage; undertake, assure, promise
words.translation: 保证，誓言；抵押；抵押品，典当物；保证，许诺；用……抵押；举杯祝……健康；[经]抵押

examples.en: The meeting ended with a pledge to step up cooperation between the six states of the region.
examples.zh: 会议以加快该地区6个州之间合作的承诺结束。

words.definition: how likely something is, sometimes calculated in a mathematical way; possibility, feasibility, potential, maybe, chance
words.translation: 可能性；机率；[数] 或然率；[数]或然率

examples.en: You must decide whether, on the balance of probabilities , he committed the crime.
examples.zh: 你们一定要权衡正反两方面的可能性，然后再裁定他是否犯罪。

words.definition: an empty space in something solid; cavity, hollow, aperture; thirl
words.translation: 洞，孔；洞穴，穴；突破口；凿洞，穿孔；（高尔夫球等）进洞

examples.en: I began digging a hole for the plant.
examples.zh: 我开始挖洞种那棵植物。

words.definition: a peaceful time, place, or situation is quiet and calm without any worry or excitement; pacific, calm, still
words.translation: 和平的，爱好和平的；平静的

examples.en: We had a peaceful afternoon without the children.
examples.zh: 孩子们不在，我们度过了一个宁静的下午。

examples.en: It’s very peaceful out here in the woods.
examples.zh: 这树林里真安静。

words.definition: twelve
words.translation: 十二个，一打；一打的；[计量]十二个，一打

examples.en: a dozen eggs
examples.zh: 一打鸡蛋

examples.en: Chris, Helen, and half a dozen others went on holiday together.
examples.zh: 克里斯、海伦和其他六个人一起去度假了。

examples.en: (= about 12 ) cars were parked near the entrance.
examples.zh: 入口附近停了大约十二辆汽车。

words.definition: a machine that can move and do some of the work of a person, and is usually controlled by a computer; droid, golem
words.translation: 机器人；遥控设备，自动机械；机械般工作的人；[自]机器人

examples.en: cars built by robots
examples.zh: 机器人制造的汽车

words.definition: happening or doing something often; to go to a particular place often; confirmed, continual; resort to
words.translation: 频繁的；时常发生的；惯常的；常到，常去；时常出入于

examples.en: Trains rushed past at frequent intervals .
examples.zh: 火车频频驶过。

examples.en: She was a frequent visitor to the house.
examples.zh: 她是家里的常客。

words.definition: an official process of counting a country’s population and finding out about the people; lustrum, nose-count
words.translation: 实施统计调查；人口普查，人口调查

examples.en: He and Mary journeyed to Bethlehem to be counted in the Roman census, and while they were there the child was born.
examples.zh: 他和玛利亚一起去到伯利恒，罗马的人口普查把他们统计在内。 他们在那里时，孩子降生了。

words.definition: to start to feel tired, or make someone feel tired; fatigue, be sick of; tucker; headwear, topknot
words.translation: 疲劳；厌倦；轮胎；头饰；使…疲倦；使…厌烦；[橡胶]轮胎

examples.en: As we neared the summit, we were tiring fast.
examples.zh: 接近山顶时，我们感到越来越累了。

words.definition: the season after autumn and before spring, when the weather is coldest; to spend the winter somewhere; peret, years of age; hibernate, overwinter; brumous, hibernal
words.translation: 冬季；年岁；萧条期；过冬；冬天的；越冬的；[气候]冬季；[气候]冬天的

examples.en: Soon it will be winter.
examples.zh: 很快要到冬天了。

words.definition: to describe something or someone in writing or speech, or to show them in a painting, picture etc; bewrite, describe  v. say what is like
words.translation: 描述；描画

examples.en: a book depicting life in pre-revolutionary Russia
examples.zh: 描写革命前俄国人生活的一本书

words.definition: someone whose job is to treat people’s teeth; dental surgeon
words.translation: 牙科医生

examples.en: Visit your dentist twice a year for a checkup.
examples.zh: 每年看两次牙医做检查。

words.definition: to deliberately make or produce something that is exactly like another thing; something that is made to be exactly like another thing; to duplicate, print off; repeat, lift; repeat, counterpart
words.translation: 复制；复印；抄袭；副本；一册；摹仿；[印刷][计]复制；[印刷]副本

examples.en: Could you copy this letter and send it out, please?
examples.zh: 你能把这封信复印一份发出去吗？

examples.en: To copy a file, press F3.
examples.zh: 拷贝文件按F3键。

words.definition: to prepare food for eating by using heat; someone who prepares and cooks food as their job; chef, kitchener
words.translation: 烹调，煮；厨师，厨子；[劳经]厨师，厨子

examples.en: Where did you learn to cook?
examples.zh: 你在哪里学烹调的？

examples.en: Cook the sauce over a low heat for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 把这调味汁用低火烧十分钟。

examples.en: slices of cooked ham
examples.zh: 熟的火腿片

words.definition: to make it difficult for someone to do something; let, chain, bound; hindrance, incumbrance
words.translation: 妨碍；束缚；使困累；食盒，食篮；阻碍物

examples.en: She tried to run, but was hampered by her heavy suitcase.
examples.zh: 她想跑，但沉重的旅行箱拖累了她。

examples.en: An attempt to rescue the men has been hampered by bad weather.
examples.zh: 对那几名男子的营救行动受到恶劣天气的阻碍。

words.definition: a small flat package that is sent by post or delivered to someone; parcel; encase, sheathe
words.translation: 数据包，信息包；小包，小捆；包装，打包；[计]数据包，信息包；[贸易]小包，小捆

examples.en: Paul tore open the packet as soon as it arrived.
examples.zh: 保罗一收到包裹就拆开了。

words.definition: to make someone suddenly surprised or slightly shocked; surprise; stand in amazement; wonder, consternation
words.translation: 使吓一跳；使惊奇；惊愕；惊恐；惊吓；惊跳；惊奇

examples.en: Sorry, I didn’t mean to startle you.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我不是故意吓你一跳的。

words.definition: said when you are surprised or sometimes angry; the quality of being good; humanity, excellence, mercy, kindness; omigod, bedad
words.translation: 天哪；善良，优秀；精华，养分；善良，仁慈；优秀；真谛；天哪，啊呀

examples.en: My goodness, you have spent a lot!
examples.zh: 啊呀，你花了这么多钱！

words.definition: the period of time during which someone is alive or something exists; whole life, all one's life
words.translation: 一生；寿命；终生；使用期；一生的；终身的

examples.en: It’s the sort of opportunity you see only once in a lifetime.
examples.zh: 这种机会你一辈子也只能碰到一次。

words.definition: to use arguments to protect something or someone from criticism, or to prove that something is right; to claim, forefend; hold position
words.translation: 辩护；防护；[法]辩护；保卫；防守

examples.en: She was always defending her husband in front of their daughter.
examples.zh: 她在女儿面前总是为丈夫辩解。

examples.en: Students should be ready to explain and defend their views.
examples.zh: 学生应该勇于为自己的观点进行解释和辩护。

words.definition: a particular length of time with a beginning and an end; hour, circle, cycle, season, day
words.translation: 周期，期间；时期；月经；课时；（语法学）句点，句号；某一时代的

examples.en: Tomorrow’s weather will be dry with sunny periods.
examples.zh: 明天天气干燥，间或晴朗。

examples.en: The drug was tested over a five-week period.
examples.zh: 那种药品进行了为期五周的试验。

examples.en: They adopted the system for a trial period (= time in which something is tested to see if it works well ) .
examples.zh: 那套系统他们试用了一段时间。

words.definition: the hard central part of a fruit such as an apple; If you core a fruit, you remove its core; quick, kernel, main, heart, essential
words.translation: 核心；要点；果心；[计] 磁心；挖的核；[晶体]核心；[计]磁心

examples.en: Remove the cores, and bake the apples for 40 minutes.
examples.zh: 去除果心，然后把苹果烤40分钟。

examples.en: ...machines for peeling and coring apples.
examples.zh: …苹果削皮去核机。

words.definition: to think someone or something is unpleasant and not like them; Dislike is the feeling that you do not like someone or something; hate, have no relish for; hate, detestation
words.translation: 不喜欢，厌恶；嫌恶，反感，不喜爱

examples.en: Why do you dislike her so much?
examples.zh: 你为什么那么讨厌她？

examples.en: My dislike of thunder and even small earthquakes was due to Mother.
examples.zh: 我对雷声甚至于轻微地震的厌恶都归因于我的母亲。

words.definition: to feed and take care of a child or a plant while it is growing; the education and care that you are given as a child, and the way it affects your later development and attitudes; encourage, raise, heart, mother, foster; nursing, breeding
words.translation: 养育；鼓励；培植；教养；营养物

examples.en: plants nurtured in the greenhouse
examples.zh: 在温室里培育的植物

words.definition: to move an organ, piece of skin etc from one person’s body and put it into another as a form of medical treatment; the operation of transplanting an organ, piece of skin etc; remove, transfer of culture; implantation, engraftment; remove, move
words.translation: 移植；迁移；使移居；移植器官；被移植物；移居者；[林]移植；移居

examples.en: The operation to transplant a kidney is now fairly routine.
examples.zh: 移植肾脏的手术如今相当常见。

words.definition: a telephone; to speak to someone by telephone; telephone, call; call up sb, ring up; telephone, call up sb
words.translation: 电话；耳机，听筒；打电话；[通信]电话；[通信]打电话

examples.en: Much of his work is done by phone .
examples.zh: 他的工作大部分是通过电话进行的。

examples.en: Who was that on the phone ?
examples.zh: 谁来的电话？

examples.en: I wish Amy would get off the phone .
examples.zh: 我真希望埃米别再打电话了。

words.definition: Saturday is the day after Friday and before Sunday
words.translation: 星期六

examples.en: He called her on Saturday morning at the studio.
examples.zh: 他星期六早上在工作室给她打电话。

examples.en: Every Saturday dad made a beautiful pea and ham soup.
examples.zh: 每个星期六爸爸都做一道鲜美的豌豆火腿汤。

words.definition: a set of rooms, especially expensive ones in a hotel; furniture, satellite
words.translation: （一套）家具；套房；组曲；（一批）随员，随从；（一批）[劳经]随员，随从

examples.en: a honeymoon suite
examples.zh: 蜜月套房

examples.en: a suite of rooms for palace guests
examples.zh: 王室贵宾套房

words.definition: to come together to publicly express disapproval or opposition to something; something that you do to show publicly that you think that something is wrong and unfair, for example taking part in big public meetings, refusing to work, or refusing to buy a company’s products; exclaim at, take exception to; declare, aver; obtestation, remonstrance
words.translation: 抗议；断言；表示抗议的；抗议性的

examples.en: ‘I don’t see why I should take the blame for this!’ she protested.
examples.zh: “我不明白为什么我要对此承担责任！”她抗议道。

words.definition: If you do something or if something happens afterward, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned; since, subsequently
words.translation: 以后，后来

examples.en: Shortly afterward, police arrested four suspects.
examples.zh: 之后不久，警方逮捕了４名嫌疑犯。

words.definition: to defend yourself successfully against people who attack, criticize, or oppose you; low range, strive against; strive against, come out against
words.translation: 抵挡；禁得起；反抗

examples.en: The Chancellor has withstood the criticism and held firm.
examples.zh: 总理顶住批评，坚持立场。

words.definition: a film company or the buildings it owns and uses to make its films; atelier, workroom
words.translation: 工作室；[广播][电视] 演播室；画室；电影制片厂；[电视][广播]演播室

examples.en: Depardieu is making a film with one of the big Hollywood studios.
examples.zh: 德帕迪约正在为好莱坞的一家大制片公司拍摄一部电影。

words.definition: making you feel physically relaxed, without any pain or without being too hot, cold etc; pleasant, easy, cozy
words.translation: 舒适的，舒服的；盖被

examples.en: I was so comfortable and warm in bed I didn’t want to get up.
examples.zh: 床上又舒服又暖和，我都不想起来。

words.definition: extremely good; wonderful, excellent, famous, grand, great
words.translation: 极好的；华丽的；宏伟的；(Superb)人名；(罗)苏佩尔布

examples.en: The food was superb.
examples.zh: 食物好吃极了。

examples.en: superb weather
examples.zh: 极好的天气

words.definition: money added to someone’s wages, especially as a reward for good work; prix, dividend
words.translation: 奖金；红利；额外津贴；[劳经]奖金；[经]红利

examples.en: Long-term savers qualify for a cash bonus.
examples.zh: 长期储户可获现金红利。

examples.en: Further additions to your pay may take the form of bonus payments.
examples.zh: 工资以外的钱可能以奖金的形式发放。

examples.en: a Christmas bonus
examples.zh: 圣诞节奖金

words.definition: to gradually change your behaviour and attitudes in order to be successful in a new situation; condition, suit, season; adjust, accomodate to, accommodate to
words.translation: 使适应；改编；适应

examples.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
examples.zh: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

words.definition: to encourage or help an activity to begin or develop further; fan, power, motivate, needle, activate
words.translation: 刺激；鼓舞，激励

examples.en: Her interest in art was stimulated by her father.
examples.zh: 她对艺术的兴趣是她父亲激发的。

words.definition: an event at which people meet to discuss and decide things; session, congress, assembly, gathering; rendezvousing
words.translation: 会议；会见；集会；汇合点；会面；会合（meet的ing形式）

examples.en: We’re having a meeting next week to discuss the matter.
examples.zh: 我们下周将开会讨论此事。

words.definition: a lawyer; lawyer, deputy, agent, factor, secondary
words.translation: 律师；代理人；检查官；[法]代理人

examples.en: ...a prosecuting attorney.
examples.zh: …一位公诉律师。

words.definition: to stop taking part in an activity, belonging to an organization etc, or to make someone do this; beat a retreat, bug out; leave, split
words.translation: 撤退；收回；撤消；拉开；离开

examples.en: calls for Britain to withdraw from the European Union
examples.zh: 要求英国退出欧盟的呼声

words.definition: to try to find out the truth about something such as a crime, accident, or scientific problem; check into, inquire into
words.translation: 调查；研究

examples.en: The state police are investigating the incident.
examples.zh: 州警察正调查此事。

examples.en: The study investigates the impact of violent TV programming on children.
examples.zh: 该研究调查暴力电视节目对儿童的影响。

examples.en: I heard a noise and went downstairs to investigate.
examples.zh: 我听见响声，就下楼去看个究竟。

words.definition: the flat surface that you stand on inside a building; to hit someone so hard that they fall down; land, storey; fall, down with
words.translation: 地板，地面；楼层；基底；议员席；铺地板；打倒，击倒；（被困难）难倒；[建]地板，地面；[建]铺地板

examples.en: a polished wooden floor
examples.zh: 上过蜡的木地板

examples.en: a puddle of water on the kitchen floor
examples.zh: 厨房地面上的一摊水

examples.en: a warehouse that has 410,000 square feet of floor space
examples.zh: 楼面面积为41万平方英尺的仓库

words.definition: someone who sees a crime or an accident and can describe what happened; to see something happen, especially a crime or accident; proof, teste; demonstrate, prove, argue
words.translation: 证人；目击者；证据；目击；证明；为…作证；[法]证人

examples.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward.
examples.zh: 警方呼吁目击者站出来。

examples.en: an eye witness (= someone who sees an event ) to the robbery
examples.zh: 抢劫案的一名目击者

words.definition: the basic systems and structures that a country or organization needs in order to work properly, for example roads, railways, banks etc
words.translation: 基础设施；公共建设；下部构造

examples.en: Some countries lack a suitable economic infrastructure.
examples.zh: 一些国家缺乏适当的经济基础设施。

examples.en: a $65 billion investment package in education, health care and infrastructure
examples.zh: 用于教育、医疗和基础设施的650亿美元一揽子投资计划

words.definition: to move something to a position at the centre of something else; the middle of a space, area, or object, especially the exact middle; center around, center on; concentrate, localise; focus, hub; mid, ental
words.translation: 以…为中心；中心；中央的；集中；将…放在中央

examples.en: The title isn’t quite centred on the page, is it?
examples.zh: 标题并不在这页的正中间，是吗？

words.definition: if it is dark, there is little or no light; when there is no light, especially because the sun has gone down; fuzzy, blue, empty, gloomy; night, gloominess
words.translation: 黑暗的，深色的；模糊的；无知的；忧郁的；黑暗；夜；黄昏；模糊

examples.en: The church was dark and quiet.
examples.zh: 教堂里黑魆魆的，寂静无声。

examples.en: the dark winter days
examples.zh: 阴暗的冬日

examples.en: Suddenly, the room went dark (= became dark ) .
examples.zh: 房间突然变暗了。

words.definition: if a building, wall etc collapses, it falls down suddenly, usually because it is weak or damaged; a sudden failure in the way something works, so that it cannot continue; founder, fall in; crumple up; failure, loss, losing, defeat, reverse
words.translation: 倒塌；瓦解；暴跌；失败；衰竭；使倒塌，使崩溃；使萎陷

examples.en: Uncle Ted’s chair collapsed under his weight.
examples.zh: 椅子承受不了特德叔叔的重量，塌架了。

examples.en: The roof had collapsed long ago.
examples.zh: 屋顶早就塌了。

words.definition: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 2,240 pounds or 1,016 kilograms in Britain, and 2,000 pounds or 907.2 kilograms in the US; lots of, wealth, ocean, sea, body
words.translation: 吨；很多，大量；[计量]吨

examples.en: I’ve got tons of work to do.
examples.zh: 我有很多工作要做。

words.definition: the written information that tells you how to do or use something; direction, order, bidding, word, charge
words.translation: 指令，命令；指示；教导；用法说明

examples.en: Press ‘Enter’ and follow the on-screen instructions.
examples.zh: 按回车键，然后按照电脑屏幕上的指示来操作。

words.definition: to save someone or something from a situation of danger or harm; when someone or something is rescued from danger; deliverance
words.translation: 营救；援救；解救

examples.en: Survivors of the crash were rescued by helicopter.
examples.zh: 空难的生还者被直升机救了出来。

words.definition: a small creature such as a fly or ant, that has six legs, and sometimes wings; ratfink, warb
words.translation: 昆虫；卑鄙的人；[昆]昆虫

examples.en: an insect bite
examples.zh: 昆虫的叮咬

examples.zh: 飞虫

examples.en: Don’t forget to bring insect repellant (= a chemical to keep insects away ).
examples.zh: 不要忘记带上驱虫剂。

words.definition: making you feel embarrassed so that you are not sure what to do or say; testing, embarrassed
words.translation: 尴尬的；笨拙的；棘手的；不合适的

examples.en: I hoped he would stop asking awkward questions .
examples.zh: 我希望他不要再问令人难堪的问题。

examples.en: There was an awkward moment when she didn’t know whether to shake his hand or kiss his cheek.
examples.zh: 她不知道是该跟他握手还是亲他的脸颊，一时很尴尬。

examples.en: an awkward silence
examples.zh: 令人尴尬的沉默

words.definition: a thin book giving information or advertising something
words.translation: 手册，小册子

examples.en: a holiday brochure
examples.zh: 度假手册

words.definition: If you say that a person or a news report damns something such as a policy or action, you mean that they are very critical of it; used to emphasize a statement; condemn, denounce; accuse of, brush down; one point, tittle; abhorrent, dad-burned; extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too; dang
words.translation: 谴责；罚…下地狱；一点；诅咒；可恶的；非常；讨厌

examples.en: ...a sensational book in which she damns the ultraright party.
examples.zh: …她谴责极右党派的一本耸人听闻的书。

words.definition: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a telephone call or vote in private; concession stand, stall
words.translation: 货摊；公用电话亭

examples.en: I called her from a public phone booth near the entrance to the bar.
examples.zh: 我在酒吧入口附近的一个公用电话亭给她打了电话。

words.definition: a door or space through which you can leave a public room, building etc; to leave a place; door, channel, route, way out; to quit, back out
words.translation: 出口，通道；退场；退出；离去；[计]退出

examples.en: We made for the nearest exit.
examples.zh: 我们走向最近的出口。

examples.en: an exit door
examples.zh: 出口门

examples.en: Two men were blocking her exit.
examples.zh: 两个男人挡住了她出去的路。

words.definition: feeling that you want to sleep or rest; worn, harassed
words.translation: 疲倦的；厌倦的，厌烦的；疲倦；对…腻烦（tire的过去分词形式）

examples.en: He looks tired out (= very tired ) .
examples.zh: 他看起来累坏了。

examples.en: ‘No,’ Frank said in a tired voice.
examples.zh: “不。”弗兰克语带疲倦地说。

words.definition: to damage something or make it not as good as it should be; hurt, break, blast
words.translation: 损害；削弱；减少

examples.en: The illness had impaired his ability to think and concentrate.
examples.zh: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

words.definition: a house, apartment etc where people live; residence, accommodation; living
words.translation: 住处；寓所；居住（dwell的现在分词）

examples.en: Some 3,500 new dwellings are planned for the area.
examples.zh: 大约三千五百套新住宅计划在这个地区新建。

words.definition: used to say that you think something is probably true; probably, possibly, maybe
words.translation: 大概；推测起来；可假定

examples.en: It’s raining, which presumably means that your football match will be cancelled.
examples.zh: 下雨了，这可能意味着你们的足球比赛要取消。

words.definition: Christmas is a Christian festival when the birth of Jesus Christ is celebrated. Christmas is celebrated on the 25th of December.
words.translation: 圣诞节；圣诞节期间

examples.en: The day after Christmas is generally a busy one for retailers.
examples.zh: 圣诞节次日对零售商们来说通常都是繁忙的一天。

words.definition: to slide a short distance accidentally, and fall or lose your balance slightly; a small mistake; slide, bowl; shed, slide; error, accident, mistake, fault, sliding; slidable
words.translation: 滑动；滑倒；犯错；失足；减退；滑，滑倒；片，纸片；错误；下跌；事故；滑动的；有活结的；活络的；串行线路接口协议，是旧式的协议（Serial Line Interface Protocol）；[地质]滑动；[地质]使滑动；滑过；摆脱；塞入；闪开；[地质]滑动的

examples.en: Wright slipped but managed to keep hold of the ball.
examples.zh: 赖特滑了一下，但球还抓在手里。

words.definition: to wake up, or to make someone wake up; not sleeping; be aware that, be on to; arouse, wake sb. up; waking, wakeful
words.translation: 觉醒，意识到；醒来；被唤起；醒着的；唤醒；使觉醒；激起，唤起

examples.en: It was midday when she awoke.
examples.zh: 她醒来时已是中午。

examples.en: We awoke to a day of brilliant sunshine.
examples.zh: 我们醒来时阳光明媚。

words.definition: mutual feelings such as respect, trust, or hatred are feelings that two or more people have for each other; corporate, common, collective, joint
words.translation: 共同的；相互的，彼此的

examples.en: I didn’t like Dev, and the feeling seemed to be mutual.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢德夫，他好像也不喜欢我。

examples.en: The two men were a mutual admiration society , gushing about how much they were learning from each other.
examples.zh: 两个男人互相吹捧，盛赞对方让自己受益匪浅。

words.definition: fairly dark or not giving much light, so that you cannot see well; if a light dims, or if you dim it, it becomes less bright; fuzzy, dark, dirty, lowering; breathe upon; fog, mist; simple, turkey, put, idiot, stupid
words.translation: 暗淡的，昏暗的；模糊的，看不清的；悲观的，怀疑的；使暗淡，使失去光泽；使变模糊；笨蛋，傻子；变模糊，变暗淡

examples.en: in the dim light of the early dawn
examples.zh: 在微弱的晨曦里

examples.en: a dim glow
examples.zh: 昏暗的微光

words.definition: a large group of people who have gathered together to do something, for example to watch something or protest about something; if people crowd somewhere, they gather together in large numbers, filling a particular place; burst at the seams, be packed with; lot, band; concentrate, pile, collect, mass, pack
words.translation: 群众,一伙;一堆,许多,大众；拥挤,挤满,挤进；挤满；将…塞进；催逼，催促；人群；一堆；一帮；拥挤，挤；聚集

examples.en: A vast crowd gathered in the main square.
examples.zh: 主广场上聚集了一大群人。

examples.en: She mingled with the crowd of guests, exchanging greetings.
examples.zh: 她穿梭在宾客中间和他们打招呼。

examples.en: Saturday’s game was watched by a capacity crowd (= the maximum number of people that a sports ground etc can hold ) .
examples.zh: 星期六的比赛座无虚席。

words.definition: the way that a story, film, activity etc finishes; conclusion, outcome
words.translation: 结局；结尾

examples.en: Verbal nouns have the ending -ing.
examples.zh: 动名词以-ing结尾。

words.definition: to increase the value, amount, effectiveness etc of something; improve, gain, accelerate, make, grow in; enhance, boost, jack, mount, hot; enhancement, increase, gain, rise, accession
words.translation: 增加；增大

examples.en: Any surplus was sold to augment their income.
examples.zh: 所有多余的东西被售卖一空来增加他们的收入。

words.definition: someone who is directly below another person in rank, and who is officially in charge when that person is not there; agent, representation, factor, secondary, proxy; acting, vice, agent, auxiliary
words.translation: 代理人，代表；副的；代理的；[法][贸易]代理人，代表；[法][贸易]代理的

examples.en: His brother was acting as his deputy in America.
examples.zh: 他的兄弟充当他在美洲的代理人。

words.definition: the way your voice sounds, which shows how you are feeling or what you mean; mood, hues; enchance, to increase
words.translation: 语气；色调；音调；音色；增强；用某种调子说；[光]色调；[声]音调

examples.en: Her tone was sharp with anger.
examples.zh: 她很气愤，语气尖刻。

examples.en: It was obvious from her tone of voice that she didn’t like me.
examples.zh: 从她的语气明显听得出来她不喜欢我。

words.definition: not allowed by the law; an illegal immigrant; unauthorized, unlawful; espionage, secret agent
words.translation: [法] 非法的；违法的；违反规则的；非法移民，非法劳工；[法]非法的；非法移民；间谍

examples.en: illegal drugs
examples.zh: 违禁药品

examples.en: They were involved in illegal activities.
examples.zh: 他们参与了非法活动。

words.definition: the colour of blood; having the colour of blood; deficit, clred; erythroid, rojo
words.translation: 红色，红颜料；赤字；红色的；红肿的，充血的；[光]红色，[颜料][染料]红颜料；[光]红色的

examples.en: I like the way the artist uses red in this painting.
examples.zh: 我喜欢画家在这幅作品中对红色的运用。

examples.en: the reds and yellows of the trees
examples.zh: 红黄斑斓，层林尽染

examples.en: The corrections were marked in red (= in red ink ) .
examples.zh: 修改处用红笔标出。

words.definition: an idea or opinion that is not based on fact; fancy hotels, restaurants, cars etc are expensive and fashionable; to like or want something, or want to do something; interest, like, fantasy; expensive, rich, ideal, picked, dear; enjoy, vision, image; have vision of, to imagine
words.translation: 幻想；想象力；爱好；想象的；奇特的；昂贵的；精选的；想象；喜爱；设想；自负；想像力

examples.en: Oh, that was just a fancy of his.
examples.zh: 啊，那只是他的异想天开。

words.definition: a place where trains or buses regularly stop so that passengers can get on and off, goods can be loaded etc, or the buildings at such a place; to send someone in the military to a particular place for a period of time as part of their military duty; capacity, condition, standing; establish, put, bed, plant
words.translation: 车站；驻地；地位；身份；配置；安置；驻扎；站；身分

examples.en: I want to get off at the next station.
examples.zh: 我要在下一站下车。

examples.en: Grand Central Station
examples.zh: 中央火车站

examples.en: Is there a waiting room in the station?
examples.zh: 车站里有候车室吗？

words.definition: to shake slightly in a way that you cannot control, especially because you are upset or frightened; Tremble is also a noun; roll, rock; roll, frisson
words.translation: 发抖；战栗；焦虑；摇晃；颤抖

examples.zh: 他的嘴唇开始颤抖，接着就哭了起来。

examples.en: I will never forget the look on the patient's face, the tremble in his hand.
examples.zh: 我将永远不会忘记那病人脸上的表情和他颤抖的手。

words.definition: to make it difficult for something to develop or succeed; situated at or further towards the back or rear; posterior; slow, impede; latter, back, rear
words.translation: 成为阻碍；后面的；(Hinder)人名；(芬)欣德；阻碍；打扰

examples.en: His career has been hindered by injury.
examples.zh: 由于受伤，他的事业受到了阻碍。

examples.en: policies that will hinder rather than help families
examples.zh: 对家庭有害无益的政策

examples.en: the hinder parts

words.definition: a very small town in the countryside; community, thorpe
words.translation: 村庄；村民；（动物的）群落；[建]村庄

examples.en: a little fishing village
examples.zh: 一座小渔村

words.definition: the natural process of decaying, or the part of something that has decayed; to decay by a gradual natural process, or to make something do this; corruption, decomposition; fall into decay, blet; corrupt, eat out; rats, fiddlesticks
words.translation: 腐烂；腐败；腐坏；堕落；（表示厌恶、蔑视、烦恼等）胡说；糟了；[植保]腐烂；[植保]使腐烂；[木]使腐朽；使堕落

examples.en: the smell of rot
examples.zh: 腐烂的气味

examples.en: wood that is soft with rot
examples.zh: 腐烂变软的木头

words.translation: 不重要的，琐碎的；琐细的

examples.zh: 一笔极小的金额

words.definition: to help a skill, feeling, idea etc develop over a period of time; Foster parents are people who officially take a child into their family for a period of time, without becoming the child's legal parents. The child is referred to as their foster child.; cultivate, rear, raise, plant, mother
words.translation: 培养；养育，抚育；抱（希望等）；收养的，养育的；(Foster)人名；(英、捷、意、葡、法、德、俄、西)福斯特

examples.zh: 主教鼓励一种包容各个阶层的社区精神。

examples.zh: 小杰克被安置在养父母家。

words.definition: any substance that makes things dirty, such as mud or dust; earth, dust, clay, powder

examples.en: You should have seen the dirt on that car!
examples.zh: 你没看见那车上沾了多少泥！

examples.en: His face and hands were black with dirt.
examples.zh: 他的脸和手黑乎乎的，全是泥。

examples.en: a patch of grass, covered in dog dirt
examples.zh: 满是狗屎的一小片草地

words.definition: encourage, agree, heart, sustain
words.translation: 支撑；鼓励；赞成；举起

words.definition: an animal, plant, human, or any other living thing; living being, biosome
words.translation: 有机体；生物体；微生物；[生物]生物体

examples.zh: 一切生物都要适应环境条件的变化。

examples.en: Genes operate together in determining the characteristics of an individual organism.
examples.zh: 基因的共同作用决定生物个体的特性。

examples.zh: 我关掉电视时，孩子们都发出不满的抱怨声。

examples.en: Richard’s jokes make you groan rather than laugh.
examples.zh: 理查德的笑话让你哭笑不得。

words.definition: an act of polishing a surface to make it smooth and shiny; to make something smooth, bright, and shiny by rubbing it; grace, buffing; furbish; Polak
words.translation: 磨光，擦亮；擦亮剂；优雅，精良；擦亮，变光滑；波兰的；[机]磨光，擦亮；上光剂，擦亮剂；[机]磨光，使发亮

examples.zh: 偶尔擦拭一下能使墙砖保持美观。

words.definition: a date or time by which you have to do or complete something
words.translation: 截止期限，最后期限

examples.en: I’m always working under pressure to meet deadlines (= finish something on time ) .
examples.zh: 我总是在赶工期的压力下工作。

words.translation: 几率；胜算；不平等；差别

examples.en: We are offering odds of 6-1 on the fight ending in a knockout.
examples.zh: 我们以6比1的赔率赌该拳击赛以击倒告终。

words.definition: belief, confidence, trust, hope
words.translation: 信赖；信心；受信赖的人或物

examples.en: the country’s heavy reliance on trade
examples.zh: 该国对贸易的严重依赖

words.definition: to say publicly or officially that something important is true or exists; indicate, sound, post, state, publish
words.translation: 宣告，公布；声明；表明；赞扬

examples.en: The President proclaimed the republic’s independence.
examples.zh: 总统宣布共和国独立。

words.definition: to work together with a person or group in order to achieve something, especially in science or art; team, work together
words.translation: 合作；勾结，通敌

examples.en: Much later he collaborated with his son Michael on the English translation of a text on food production.
examples.zh: 后来他和儿子迈克尔合作，把一个有关食品生产的文本翻译成英语。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger; If something alarms you, it makes you afraid or anxious that something unpleasant or dangerous might happen; panic, tocsin; exercise, alert, warn
words.translation: 闹钟；警报，警告器；惊慌；警告；使惊恐；警报，[安全]警告器

examples.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
examples.zh: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

examples.en: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
examples.zh: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

examples.en: a sophisticated alarm system
examples.zh: 精密的警报系统

words.definition: a pale red colour; to prick lightly with a sword or rapier; pale red; picture, ideal; stick, string
words.translation: 粉红色；化身，典范；石竹花；头面人物；扎，刺，戳；使…变粉红色；使…面红耳赤；粉红的；比较激进的；石竹科的；脸色发红的

examples.en: Her room was decorated in bright pinks and purples.
examples.zh: 她的房间装饰成明亮的粉红色和紫色。

examples.en: She had arrived dressed in pink.
examples.zh: 她穿着粉色的衣服来了。

words.definition: putting, cast, throw; wap; wallow
words.translation: 投掷；摇荡；投掷的距离；掷币赌胜负；使…不安；突然抬起；使…上下摇动；与…掷币打赌；辗转；被乱扔；颠簸；掷钱币决定某事

examples.en: It would be better to decide it on the toss of a coin.
examples.zh: 最好用抛硬币的方式来对此事做决定。

words.definition: the point at which two lines or edges meet; region, area, difficulty, zone, section; stock; forestall, monopolize
words.translation: 角落，拐角处；地区，偏僻处；困境，窘境；囤积；相交成角；垄断；迫至一隅；使陷入绝境；把…难住

examples.en: He pulled a dirty handkerchief out by its corner and waved it at me.
examples.zh: 他拽出一块脏手帕，捏着一角向我挥动。

words.definition: an arm or leg; extremitas, offshoot
words.translation: 肢，臂；分支；枝干；切断…的手足；从…上截下树枝

examples.en: She would be able to stretch out her cramped limbs and rest for a few hours.
examples.zh: 她将可以伸开蜷缩的四肢，休息几个小时。

words.definition: a piece of heavy metal that is lowered to the bottom of the sea, a lake etc to prevent a ship or boat moving; to fasten something firmly so that it cannot move; kelleg, backer patron; fix, nail
words.translation: 锚；抛锚停泊；靠山；新闻节目主播；抛锚；使固定；主持节目；末棒的；最后一棒的；[船]锚；[机]使固定

examples.en: We dropped anchor a few yards offshore.
examples.zh: 我们在离岸几码远的地方抛锚停航。

examples.zh: 第二天早上他们起锚，又开始向南航行。

words.definition: a large area of flat land that is higher than the land around it; altiplano, high land; level out

examples.zh: 一个宽阔的山谷展开，通向一片平坦的高原耕地。

words.translation: 举起；提升；鼓舞；空运；抄袭；电梯；起重机；搭车；消散；升起；耸立

examples.en: Sophie lifted the phone before the second ring.
examples.zh: 铃响了一下苏菲就接起了电话。

examples.en: He lifted the lid on the pot of soup.
examples.zh: 他揭开汤锅的盖子。

examples.en: The lumber was lifted by crane and dropped into the truck.
examples.zh: 木材由起重机搬运到卡车上。

words.definition: a small piece of meat on a bone, usually cut from a sheep or pig; to cut something into smaller pieces; brand, label, logo, cut; hew
words.translation: 砍；排骨；商标；削球；剁碎；突然转向

examples.en: a grilled pork/lamb chop
examples.zh: 烤猪排/羊排

words.definition: impressive and respected; imperial, formidable
words.translation: 威严的；令人敬畏的；八月（简写为Aug）

examples.en: an august institution
examples.zh: 庄严的机构

words.definition: trousers made of denim(= a strong, usually blue, cotton cloth ); overall, jea
words.translation: 牛仔裤；工装裤

examples.en: ...a young man in jeans and a worn T-shirt.
examples.zh: …一个穿着牛仔裤和破旧T恤衫的年轻人。

words.definition: not having much experience of how complicated life is, so that you trust people too much and believe that good things will always happen; simple, tender
words.translation: 天真的,幼稚的；天真的，幼稚的；轻信的

examples.en: a naive young girl
examples.zh: 天真的小女孩

examples.en: Jim can be so naive sometimes.
examples.zh: 吉姆有时候非常幼稚。

words.definition: a board with buttons marked with letters or numbers that are pressed to put information into a computer or other machine; to put information into a computer, using a keyboard; keyset, key panel, klavier; key in
words.translation: 键盘；键入；用键盘式排字机排字；[计]键盘

examples.en: a computer keyboard
examples.zh: 计算机键盘

words.definition: nervous and embarrassed about meeting and speaking to other people, especially people you do not know; if a horse shies, it makes a sudden movement away from something because it is frightened; chicken, blate; cast, recoil from; throw, cast, pitch; putting, cast, throw, jump
words.translation: 害羞的；畏缩的，胆怯的；投；畏缩；惊退；厌恶；投掷；惊跳；乱掷

examples.en: He was a quiet shy man.
examples.zh: 他是个话不多、害羞的男人。

examples.en: a shy smile
examples.zh: 羞怯的微笑

examples.en: As a teenager, I was painfully shy (= extremely shy ) .
examples.zh: 我十几岁时害羞得很。

words.definition: used when speaking to a man in order to be polite or show respect; don, gentleman
words.translation: 先生；（用于姓名前）爵士；阁下；（中小学生对男教师的称呼）先生；老师；阁下，先生

examples.en: ‘Report back to me in an hour, sergeant.’ ‘Yes, sir.’
examples.zh: “一小时后向我报告，中士。”“是，长官。”

examples.en: Can I help you, sir?
examples.zh: 我能为您效劳吗，先生？

examples.en: Sir! You dropped your wallet.
examples.zh: 先生！ 您的钱包掉了。

words.definition: an action that is against religious rules and is considered to be an offence against God; to do something that is against religious rules and is considered to be an offence against God; error, evil, crime, mistake, blame; commit a crime, offend against
words.translation: 罪恶；罪孽；过失；犯罪；犯过失

examples.en: She needed to confess her sins and ask for forgiveness.
examples.zh: 她需要忏悔罪过，请求宽恕。

examples.en: He knew that he had committed a terrible sin .
examples.zh: 他知道自己犯下了可怕的罪行。

words.definition: used as a polite way of saying that someone is old or becoming old; oldish
words.translation: 上了年纪的；过了中年的；稍老的

examples.en: a well-dressed elderly woman
examples.zh: 穿着考究的老妇人

words.definition: unusual or interesting enough to be easily noticed; prominent, obvious, marked, tremendous, noted; beating
words.translation: 显著的，突出的，惊人的；打击的；罢工的；打（strike的ing形式）；[劳经]罢工的

examples.en: a dark man with striking features
examples.zh: 相貌出众、肤色黝黑的男子

words.definition: the amount of business done during a particular period; volume of business, rollover; upturned, eversible
words.translation: 翻覆；[贸易] 营业额；流通量；半圆卷饼；失误；翻过来的；可翻转的；[贸易]营业额

examples.en: The company had a turnover of $3.8 million.
examples.zh: 那个公司拥有380万美元的营业额。

words.definition: if something is optional, you do not have to do it or use it, but you can choose to if you want to; selectable, hit-or-miss; elective subjects
words.translation: 可选择的，随意的；选修科目

examples.en: three optional courses
examples.zh: 三门选修课

examples.en: The other excursions are optional.
examples.zh: 其他的短途旅行是自选项目。

words.definition: the reflexive form of one27
words.translation: 自己；亲自

examples.en: It is only through study that one really begins to know oneself.
examples.zh: 只有通过学习，一个人才能真正了解自己。

words.definition: a part of a situation or a quality involved in it; measurement, size
words.translation: 方面;[数] 维；尺寸；次元；容积 vt标出尺寸；规格的；[数]维；容积

examples.en: You can have a spiritual dimension to your life without being religious.
examples.zh: 即使你不信宗教，也可以在生命中拥有精神层面的内容。

words.definition: to become or make something become smaller or less; micrify, minify; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 使减少；使变小；减少，缩小；变小

examples.en: The party’s share of the electorate has diminished steadily.
examples.zh: 支持这个政党的选民比例持续下降。

examples.en: These drugs diminish blood flow to the brain.
examples.zh: 这些药物会减少流向脑部的血液量。

words.definition: very unusual or strange; fantastic, funny, fatastic
words.translation: 奇异的（指态度，容貌，款式等）

examples.en: a bizarre coincidence
examples.zh: 奇怪的巧合

examples.en: dancers in rather bizarre costumes
examples.zh: 身着奇装异服的舞者

words.definition: to put your arms around someone and hold them in a friendly or loving way; the act of holding someone close to you, especially as a sign of love; involve, contain; hug, cuddle; hug
words.translation: 拥抱；信奉，皈依；包含

examples.en: Jack warmly embraced his son.
examples.zh: 杰克热情拥抱他的儿子。

examples.en: Maggie and Laura embraced.
examples.zh: 玛吉和劳拉拥抱在一起。

words.definition: to plant or scatter seeds on a piece of ground; a fully grown female pig; seed, distribute, spread; seed
words.translation: 播种；散布；使密布；母猪

examples.en: Sow the seeds in late March.
examples.zh: 三月底播种。

words.definition: if something heightens a feeling, effect etc, or if a feeling etc heightens, it becomes stronger or increases; enhance, raise, cement, muscle; strengthen, breeze up
words.translation: 提高；增高；加强；使更显著；升高；变强

examples.en: There are fears that the march will heighten racial tension.
examples.zh: 有人担心这次游行会加深种族间的紧张局势。

examples.en: Increased levels of fat in the diet could heighten the risk of cancer.
examples.zh: 饮食中脂肪摄入量的提升会增加患癌症的风险。

words.definition: an object made out of stone, wood, clay etc by an artist; carving, incision; grave, engrave
words.translation: 雕塑；雕刻；刻蚀；[建]雕塑；[轻]雕刻

examples.en: ...stone sculptures of figures and animals.
examples.zh: …人物及动物石雕。

words.definition: an un-reasonable dislike and distrust of people who are different from you in some way, especially because of their race, sex, religion etc – used to show disapproval; to influence someone so that they have an unfair or unreasonable opinion about someone or something; violation, bias; hurt, blast
words.translation: 偏见；侵害；损害；使有偏见

examples.en: Women still face prejudice in the workplace.
examples.zh: 女性在职场中仍然面临歧视。

examples.en: It takes a long time to overcome these kinds of prejudices.
examples.zh: 战胜这些偏见需要假以时日。

words.definition: a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out whether they are suitable for a job, course of study etc; to ask someone questions during an interview; audience; cover, to receive
words.translation: 接见，采访；面试，面谈；采访；接见；对…进行面谈；对某人进行面试

examples.en: a portfolio of work presented at interview
examples.zh: 在面试时呈递的工作成果样本

words.definition: when you get something that is newer or better than the one you had before; restoration, substitute
words.translation: 更换；复位；代替者；补充兵员

examples.en: Our old car is badly in need of replacement.
examples.zh: 我们的旧车急需更换。

examples.en: replacement windows
examples.zh: 新换的窗户

words.definition: to allow something to happen, especially by an official decision, rule, or law; an official written statement giving you the right to do something; to allow, make a promise; license, let, have, grant; license, patent
words.translation: 许可；允许；许可证，执照

examples.en: Smoking is only permitted in the public lounge.
examples.zh: 只允许在公共休息室里抽烟。

examples.en: He had more than the permitted level of alcohol in his blood.
examples.zh: 他血液中的酒精含量超出了允许的水平。

words.definition: the cause, idea etc that is the most important, although it is not easily noticed; organic, potential, fundamental, preferred, ultimate
words.translation: 潜在的；根本的；在下面的；优先的；放在…的下面；为…的基础；优先于（underlie的ing形式）

examples.en: the underlying causes of her depression
examples.zh: 她抑郁的根本原因

examples.en: There is an underlying assumption that younger workers are easier to train.
examples.zh: 有一种潜在的假设，认为年轻一些的雇员容易培训。
