words.definition: the amount by which two activities, ideas, things etc overlap; If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.; repeat, segistration
words.translation: 重叠；重复；部分重叠；部分的同时发生

examples.en: a large degree of overlap
examples.zh: 很大程度上的重叠

examples.en: When the bag is folded, the bottom overlaps one side.
examples.zh: 把包折叠起来时，其底部与一边就重合了。

examples.en: Overlap the slices carefully so there are no gaps.
examples.zh: 把薄片小心地叠放在一起，那样就没有间隙。

words.definition: a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine; plane, airplane
words.translation: 飞机（等于airplane）；[航]飞机（等于airplane）

examples.en: The aeroplane landed us at the airport in Barcelona.
examples.zh: 飞机把我们降落在巴塞罗那机场。

words.definition: to let someone go free, after having kept them somewhere; when someone is officially allowed to go free, after being kept somewhere; deliver, send, free, project, convey; liberation, issuance
words.translation: 释放；发射；让与；允许发表；发布

examples.en: Police arrested several men, who were later released.
examples.zh: 警察逮捕了几个人，后来都释放了。

examples.en: The bears are eventually released into the wild.
examples.zh: 这些熊最后被放回野生环境中。

words.definition: the situation or experience of being poor; difficulty, shortage, hardness, want
words.translation: 贫困；困难；缺少；低劣

examples.en: Millions of elderly people live in poverty .
examples.zh: 数百万老年人生活在贫困之中。

examples.en: We need an effective strategy to fight poverty .
examples.zh: 我们需要制定一个有效的对策来与贫困作斗争。

examples.en: continued efforts to alleviate poverty and raise living standards
examples.zh: 缓解贫困和提高生活水平的不懈努力

words.definition: very rude or insulting and likely to upset people; a planned military attack involving large forces over a long period; evil, rank; attack, attempt, push
words.translation: 攻击的；冒犯的；无礼的；讨厌的；攻势；攻击

examples.en: I found her remarks deeply offensive.
examples.zh: 我觉得她的话令人非常恼火。

examples.en: offensive behaviour
examples.zh: 无礼的行为

words.definition: someone’s female child; girl, dau.
words.translation: 女儿；[遗][农学] 子代；女儿的；子代的；[遗][农学]子代

examples.en: She’s got two daughters and one son.
examples.zh: 她有两个女儿和一个儿子。

examples.en: our eldest daughter
examples.zh: 我们的长女

words.definition: sudden and unexpected; sudden, short, angular
words.translation: 生硬的；突然的；唐突的；陡峭的

examples.en: an abrupt change of plan
examples.zh: 计划的突然改变

words.definition: to make a legal claim against someone, especially for money, because they have harmed you in some way; law, accuse sb. of sth.; law, bring charge against
words.translation: 控告；请求；(Sue)人名；(日)末(名)；(法)休；(英)休(女子教名Susan、Susanna的昵称)；提出请求

examples.en: If the builders don’t fulfil their side of the contract, we’ll sue.
examples.zh: 如果建筑商不履行合同，我们就要提出起诉。

examples.en: The company is suing a former employee.
examples.zh: 该公司正在起诉一名前雇员。

examples.en: The railway may sue for damages (= in order to get money ) because of loss of revenue.
examples.zh: 铁道部门可能会因收入损失而提出起诉，要求赔偿。

words.definition: not considering yourself or your ideas to be as important as other people’s; If you humble someone who is more important or powerful than you, you defeat them easily
words.translation: 谦逊的；简陋的；（级别或地位）低下的；不大的；使谦恭；轻松打败（尤指强大的对手）；低声下气

examples.en: a modest and humble man
examples.zh: 一个谦卑的男人

examples.en: Honda won fame in the 1980s as the little car company that humbled the industry giants.
examples.zh: 20世纪80年代，本田作为一家小型汽车公司因一举击垮行业巨头而声名鹊起。

words.definition: a small group of people or things within a much larger group; ethnic minorities, nonage
words.translation: 少数民族；少数派；未成年；少数的；属于少数派的

examples.en: Gaelic is still spoken in Ireland by a tiny minority.
examples.zh: 爱尔兰仍有极少数人在说盖尔语。

words.definition: peasant, sodbuster
words.translation: 农夫，农民；农夫，[农]农民

examples.en: She dickered with the farmer for the best fruit.
examples.zh: 她要买最好的水果而跟农民讨价还价。

examples.en: The farmer peddled his fruit from house to house.
examples.zh: 那个农民挨家挨户兜售他的水果。

examples.en: As a farmer, you should learn how to yoke the oxen together.
examples.zh: 作为农民，你应该学会怎样把一对牛用轭连起来。

words.definition: someone who lives in a  colony  but who is a citizen of the country that rules the colony; relating to a country that controls and rules other countries, usually ones that are far away
words.translation: 殖民地居民；殖民地的，殖民的

examples.en: In our freedom, we reject the colonial apartheid system that has caused genocide to our people, and to all Indigenous peoples.
examples.zh: 以我们自由的名义, 我们拒绝这对我们人民, 和所有原住民造成种族灭绝的殖民隔离体系.

examples.en: At the same time, the anti-colonial movements for independence in Asia, Africa and the Caribbean appropriated Lincoln as an exemplar of freedom and national unity.
examples.zh: 同时，追求独立的反殖民运动在亚洲、非洲和加勒比地区展开，这些运动都将林肯作为自由和国家统一的榜样。

words.definition: based on incorrect information or ideas; artificial, wrong, incorrect, improper, inaccurate; trickily
words.translation: 错误的；虚伪的；伪造的；欺诈地

examples.en: I don’t want to give you any false hopes .
examples.zh: 我不想让你有任何虚假的希望。

examples.en: The statement gives us a false impression that we understand something when we do not.
examples.zh: 这句话使我们产生错觉，以为自己懂了，但其实并没懂。

examples.en: false assumptions about people of other cultures
examples.zh: 对来自其他文化的人的错误假设

words.definition: to charge a tax on something; Tax is an amount of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services such as road and schools; scot, heavy burden
words.translation: 向…课税；使负重担；税金；重负

examples.en: Cigarettes are heavily taxed in Britain.
examples.zh: 在英国，香烟被课以重税。

examples.en: No-one enjoys paying tax.
examples.zh: 没人喜欢缴税。

examples.en: ...a pledge not to raise taxes on people below a certain income.
examples.zh: …一个对收入低于一定水平的人不提高税收的承诺。

words.definition: to hit your fingers lightly on something, for example to get someone’s attention; a piece of equipment for controlling the flow of water, gas etc from a pipe or container; percuss; pat; water faucet, rotary swivel
words.translation: 轻敲；轻打；装上嘴子；水龙头；轻拍；轻击；轻叩

examples.en: He tapped the table nervously with his fingers.
examples.zh: 他紧张地用手指轻轻地敲打桌子。

words.definition: a ball shape; extent, boundary, region, scope, spectrum, territory, range; case, invest
words.translation: 范围；球体；包围；放入球内；使…成球形；球体的；[数]球体

examples.en: Because the earth spins, it is not a perfect sphere.
examples.zh: 因为地球旋转，所以它不是个完完全全的球体。

words.definition: a long thin metal instrument that doctors and scientists use to examine parts of the body; to ask questions in order to find things out, especially things that other people do not want you to know; investigation, research; examine, explore; burrow into
words.translation: 探针；调查；探测；[电子][医]探针；[航]探测；探查；用探针探测

examples.en: a police corruption probe
examples.zh: 对警察贪污行为的彻底调查

words.definition: the money that someone pays regularly to use a room, house etc that belongs to someone else; to regularly pay money to live in a house or room that belongs to someone else, or to use something that belongs to someone else; letting, hire; lease out, hire out
words.translation: 租金；出租；租用；租借；[租赁]租金；[租赁]租

examples.en: I pay the rent at the beginning of every month.
examples.zh: 我每逢月初交付房租。

words.definition: something that is spontaneous has not been planned or organized, but happens by itself, or because you suddenly feel you want to do it; autonomous, mechanical, natural, initiative
words.translation: 自发的；自然的；无意识的

examples.en: The crowd gave a spontaneous cheer.
examples.zh: 人群自发地欢呼起来。

examples.en: My spontaneous reaction was to run away.
examples.zh: 我的本能反应就是逃跑。

words.definition: a way of eating in which you only eat certain foods, in order to lose weight, or to improve your health; to limit the amount and type of food that you eat, in order to become thinner; eating, food and drink
words.translation: 饮食；食物；规定饮食；节食；[食品]饮食；[医]规定饮食

examples.en: Lyn always seems to be on a diet.
examples.zh: 琳恩似乎一直在节食。

examples.en: a salt-free diet
examples.zh: 无盐饮食

examples.en: Not all diets are good for you.
examples.zh: 不是所有的节食方法都适合你。

words.definition: if a car or bicycle coasts, it moves without any effort from you or any power from the engine; the area where the land meets the sea; taxi; rivage, seacoast
words.translation: 滑行；沿岸航行；海岸；滑坡；[海洋]海岸

examples.en: He pushed in the clutch and coasted to a halt.
examples.zh: 他踩下离合器，滑行了一会儿便停下来了。

words.definition: hesitate, stand at; puzzle, baffle; trip
words.translation: 踌躇，蹒跚；失足；犯错；绊倒；蹒跚而行；使…困惑；使…绊倒

words.definition: a man whose job is to serve food and drinks to passengers on a plane or ship; chamberlain, seneschal; manage, conduct, run, direct, control
words.translation: 管家；乘务员；膳务员；工会管事；当服务员；当管事；管理

examples.en: race stewards
examples.zh: 比赛组织者

words.definition: a thin paper cover in which you put and send a letter; cover, involucrum
words.translation: 信封，封皮；包膜；[天] 包层；包迹；[天]包层

examples.en: envelopes and stamps
examples.zh: 信封和邮票

examples.en: She tore open the envelope and frantically read the letter.
examples.zh: 她撕开信封慌忙看信。

examples.en: He got a job stuffing envelopes (= filling them with letters ) at the campaign headquarters.
examples.zh: 他找了一份在竞选总部装信封的工作。

words.definition: to break or to make something break, either so that it gets lines on its surface, or so that it breaks into pieces; a very narrow space between two things or two parts of something; fracture, open up; fracture, come apart at the seams; split, crevice; greatest, best, perfect, prime
words.translation: 使破裂；打开；变声；裂缝；声变；噼啪声；最好的；高明的；破裂；爆裂；[高分子]裂缝

examples.en: Don’t put boiling water in the glass or it will crack.
examples.zh: 不要把沸水倒进这个玻璃杯里，否则它会破裂的。

examples.en: Concrete is liable to crack in very cold weather.
examples.zh: 在严寒的天气条件下混凝土可能会开裂。

examples.en: He picked up a piece of rock and cracked it in half.
examples.zh: 他捡起一块石头，把它击碎成两半。

words.definition: used to emphasize that something has been done completely or has finished completely; not wearing any clothes – used humorously; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, strictly, fully; birthday suit, entireness
words.translation: 完全地；总共；总而言之；整个；裸体

examples.en: an old custom that has vanished altogether
examples.zh: 一个彻底消亡的古老习俗

examples.en: Congress could ban the procession altogether.
examples.zh: 国会可以完全禁止这次游行。

words.definition: a large piece of equipment that produces high temperatures, used for heating and shaping metal objects; to illegally copy something, especially something printed or written, to make people think that it is real; furnace, smelter; trump up, to fake; doctor, trump up
words.translation: 熔炉，锻铁炉；铁工厂；伪造；做锻工；前进；[机]锻造

examples.en: Someone stole my credit card and forged my signature.
examples.zh: 有人偷了我的信用卡，并假冒我的签名。

examples.en: a forged passport
examples.zh: 假护照

words.definition: If you have patience, you are able to stay calm and not get annoyed, for example, when something takes a long time, or when someone is not doing what you want them to do; tolerance, endurance
words.translation: 耐性，耐心；忍耐，容忍

examples.en: He doesn't have the patience to wait.
examples.zh: 他没有耐心等。

words.definition: soon; soon, immediately, now
words.translation: 立刻；简短地；唐突地

examples.en: Ms Jones will be back shortly.
examples.zh: 琼斯女士很快就会回来。

words.definition: up to this time; hereunto, erenow
words.translation: 迄今；至今

examples.en: a species of fish hitherto unknown in the West
examples.zh: 迄今在西方还不为人知的一种鱼

words.definition: likely to do something or suffer from something, especially something bad or harmful; liable, apt
words.translation: 俯卧的；有…倾向的，易于…的；(Prone)人名；(意、法)普罗内；[昆]俯卧的

examples.en: His eyes shifted to the prone body on the floor.
examples.zh: 他的视线移向了趴在地上的尸体。

words.definition: a request that is urgent or full of emotion; explanation, asking, request, prayer, excuse
words.translation: 恳求，请求；辩解，辩护；借口，托辞

examples.en: Caldwell made a plea for donations.
examples.zh: 考德威尔恳求捐款。

words.definition: someone who likes talking about other people’s private lives – used to show disapproval; If you gossip with someone, you talk informally, especially about other people or local events. You can also say that two people gossip.; essay, quidnunc; chat about, make conversation
words.translation: 小道传闻；随笔；爱说长道短的人；闲聊；传播流言蜚语

examples.en: Rick’s a terrible gossip.
examples.zh: 里克就爱说三道四。

examples.en: We spoke, debated, gossiped into the night.
examples.zh: 我们交谈、争论、闲聊到夜间。

examples.en: Eva gossiped with Sarah.
examples.zh: 伊娃与萨拉闲聊。

words.definition: a strong feeling of interest and enjoyment about something and an eagerness to be involved in it; passion, flame, fire, warmth
words.translation: 热心，热忱，热情

examples.en: Gillian and Darren greeted the speakers with great enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 吉利恩和达伦非常热情地接待了演讲者。

examples.en: We went along to the local diving club, full of enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 我们兴高采烈地去了当地的潜水俱乐部。

examples.en: They go about their tasks with little enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 他们执行任务时没多大干劲。

words.definition: someone or something that is beautiful is extremely attractive to look at; fair, seraphic
words.translation: 美丽的

examples.en: She was even more beautiful than I had remembered.
examples.zh: 她比我记忆中更美。

examples.en: a beautiful bunch of flowers
examples.zh: 一束美丽的花

words.definition: a game used to make money for a state or a  charity  in which people buy tickets with a series of numbers on them. If their number is picked by chance, they win money or a prize.; sweepstake, scratchcard
words.translation: 彩票；碰运气的事，难算计的事；抽彩给奖法

examples.en: a lottery ticket
examples.zh: 彩票

examples.en: Do you really think winning the lottery would make you happy?
examples.zh: 你真的认为彩票中奖会带给你幸福吗？

words.definition: extremely good, attractive, enjoyable etc; wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great; weirdo, geezer
words.translation: 奇异的；空想的；异想天开的；古怪的；极好的，极出色的；不可思议的；不切实际的；古怪的人；极好的

examples.en: You look fantastic!
examples.zh: 你看上去棒极了！

examples.en: It’s a fantastic place, really beautiful!
examples.zh: 这真是个好地方，漂亮极了！

words.definition: an instrument for writing or drawing with ink; to write something such as a letter, a book etc, especially using a pen; writer, author, rail; write on
words.translation: 钢笔；作家；围栏；写；关入栏中

examples.en: a ballpoint pen
examples.zh: 圆珠笔

examples.en: a felt-tip pen
examples.zh: 毡头笔

examples.en: a pen and ink drawing
examples.zh: 钢笔画

words.definition: not guilty of a crime; An innocent is someone who is innocent; dark, empty, clear; simple, turkey, put
words.translation: 无辜的；无罪的；无知的；天真的人；笨蛋；[法]无辜的

examples.en: Nobody would believe that I was innocent.
examples.zh: 没人肯相信我是清白的。

examples.en: The court found him innocent and he was released.
examples.zh: 法庭判他无罪，他被释放了。

examples.en: She had always regarded Greg as a hopeless innocent where women were concerned.
examples.zh: 她过去一直认为格雷格在关于女人方面是一个不可救药的无知者。

words.definition: joneses, vicinage; adjacent, nearby; on speaking terms; abut upon, abut against
words.translation: 邻居；邻近的；友好；毗邻而居；邻接

examples.en: I parked my baby at the neighbor's house.
examples.zh: 我把小孩寄放在邻居家里。

examples.en: It means you love Him with all your heart, and you love your neighbor as yourself.
examples.zh: 它意味着你全心全意的爱上帝并且像爱自己那样爱邻居。

examples.en: See, if you break any one of those commandments, you do not love your neighbor as yourself.
examples.zh: 看，如果你违反了其中任何一条戒律，你就没能像爱自己那样爱邻居。

words.definition: language in its usual form, as opposed to poetry; essay, monotony; ordinary, stock, stupid
words.translation: 散文；单调；散文的；平凡的；乏味的；写散文；乏味地讲话；把…写成散文

examples.en: Shute's prose is stark and chillingly unsentimental.
examples.zh: 舒特的散文刻板而冷峻。

words.definition: something that you say, do, or give in order to express your respect or admiration for someone; gift, giving, present
words.translation: 礼物；[税收] 贡物；颂词；（尤指对死者的）致敬，悼念，吊唁礼物；[税收]贡物

examples.en: The players wore black armbands as a tribute to their late teammate.
examples.zh: 球员们戴着黑纱悼念已故的队友。

examples.en: I’d like to pay tribute to (= praise and admire publicly ) the party workers for all their hard work.
examples.zh: 我谨向党内工作人员致敬，感谢他们的辛苦努力。

words.definition: a feeling that you have no hope at all; to feel that there is no hope at all; hopelessness, acedia; throw up one's hands, lose heart
words.translation: 绝望；令人绝望的人或事；绝望，丧失信心

examples.en: The noise from the neighbours used to drive him to despair .
examples.zh: 过去，邻居的噪音常常吵得他心烦意乱。

words.definition: a plan, idea, or method that is feasible is possible and is likely to work; possible, working, potential, viable
words.translation: 可行的；可能的；可实行的

examples.en: a feasible solution
examples.zh: 可行的解决方法

words.definition: the glass part of an electric light, that the light shines from; third wheel, electric lamp
words.translation: 电灯泡；鳞茎；球状物；生球茎；膨胀成球状；[电]电灯泡；[植]鳞茎

examples.en: a 100-watt bulb
examples.zh: 一个100瓦的灯泡

words.definition: a powerful and illegal drug made from  morphine; horse, herion
words.translation: [药][毒物] 海洛因，吗啡；[药][毒物]海洛因，吗啡

examples.en: a heroin addict
examples.zh: 海洛因瘾君子

words.definition: to send out electronic signals, messages etc using radio, television, or other similar equipment; release, send, communicate, project, let go
words.translation: 传输；传播；发射；传达；遗传

examples.en: The US Open will be transmitted live via satellite.
examples.zh: 美国公开赛将通过卫星现场直播。

examples.en: The system transmits information over digital phone lines.
examples.zh: 这一系统通过数字电话线路传输信息。

words.definition: to send goods by air, sea, or train; goods that are carried by ship, train, or aircraft, and the system of moving these goods; ship, transit, forward; charges, carriage
words.translation: 运送；装货；使充满；货运；运费；船货；[交]运费；[水运]船货

examples.en: freight services
examples.zh: 货运公司

examples.en: We’ll send your personal belongings by air freight and your furniture by sea freight .
examples.zh: 你的个人物品我们将以空运方式运送，家具将以海运方式运送。

words.definition: a part of a written law or legal document covering a particular subject of the whole law or document; item, provision, article
words.translation: 条款；[计] 子句；[法]条款；[计]子句

examples.en: A confidentiality clause was added to the contract.
examples.zh: 合同中加上了一项保密条款。

words.definition: part of a machine or a set of parts that does a particular job; theory, element, technique, skill, machinery
words.translation: 机制；原理，途径；进程；机械装置；技巧

examples.en: the brake mechanism
examples.zh: 刹车装置

examples.en: a clock mechanism
examples.zh: 钟表机件

words.definition: one of the foods that you use to make a particular food or dish; element, factor, material, basic, essential
words.translation: 原料；要素；组成部分；构成组成部分的

examples.en: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 把所有食材都放在一个大碗里。

examples.en: The food is home-cooked using fresh ingredients.
examples.zh: 这种食物是用新鲜的食材在家里烹制的。

words.definition: feeling unhappy because someone has something that you wish you had; leary, leery
words.translation: 妒忌的；猜疑的；唯恐失去的；戒备的

examples.en: She got insanely jealous and there was a terrible fight.
examples.zh: 她变得过分地猜忌，接着是一场激烈的打斗。

words.definition: to turn over the earth using a plough so that seeds can be planted; a piece of farm equipment used to turn over the earth so that seeds can be planted; till, plow; open circuit, clear the way for; cultivated land, arable land
words.translation: 犁；耕；耕地（等于plow）；[农机]犁；用犁耕田；开路

examples.en: In those days the land was plowed by oxen.
examples.zh: 在那个年代是用公牛来犁地的。

examples.en: a ploughed field
examples.zh: 犁过的地

words.definition: a musical play in which all of the words are sung
words.translation: 歌剧；歌剧院；歌剧团

examples.en: We go to the opera (= go to a performance of opera ) regularly.
examples.zh: 我们常去听歌剧。

examples.en: an opera singer
examples.zh: 歌剧演员

words.definition: the quality of being better, more skilful, more powerful etc than other people or things; advantage, edge
words.translation: 优越，优势；优越性

examples.en: Janet always spoke with an air of superiority.
examples.zh: 珍妮特说话时总显得盛气凌人。

words.definition: to make a formal statement of what is true, especially in a court of law; demonstrate, prove, favor, make sure, argue; seal of, give evidence of
words.translation: 证明，证实；作证；证明

examples.en: Mr Molto has agreed to testify at the trial.
examples.zh: 莫尔托先生已经同意出庭作证。

examples.en: Can you testify that you saw the defendant at the scene of the crime?
examples.zh: 你能作证你看到被告在犯罪现场吗？

words.definition: a way of expressing or getting rid of strong feelings; exit, market, way out
words.translation: 出口，排放孔；[电] 电源插座；销路；发泄的方法；批发商店；[电]电源插座；[贸易]销路

examples.en: ...the largest retail outlet in the city.
examples.zh: …该市最大的零售专卖店。

words.definition: to straighten your arms, legs, or body to full length; the action of stretching a part of your body out to its full length, or a particular way of doing this
words.translation: 伸展,张开；（大量地）使用，消耗（金钱，时间）；使竭尽所能；使全力以赴；伸展，延伸

examples.en: Carl sat up in bed, yawned, and stretched.
examples.zh: 卡尔从床上坐起来，打了个呵欠，伸了伸懒 腰。

examples.en: Always stretch before exercising.
examples.zh: 锻炼之前都要做伸展运动。

words.definition: a place where a lot of people go for holidays; If you resort to a course of action that you do not really approve of, you adopt it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want; instrument, shift, road, tool, implement; appeal, ask for help
words.translation: 凭借，手段；度假胜地；常去之地；求助，诉诸；常去；采取某手段或方法

examples.en: Lagoon Reef is one of the best resort hotels.
examples.zh: 潟湖礁是最好的度假酒店之一。

examples.en: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
examples.zh: 他那累人的工作日程已经使他不得不求助于毒品了。

words.definition: the best or most important; principal, supreme, main, lead; firstly, primarily, initially, first of all, chiefly
words.translation: 最重要的；最先的；首先；居于首位地

examples.en: one of the country’s foremost authorities on chemical warfare
examples.zh: 该国化学战方面的最高权威之一

examples.en: Rostropovich was long considered the world’s foremost cellist.
examples.zh: 长期以来，罗斯特罗波维奇一直被视为世界上首屈一指的大提琴家。

words.definition: extremely large; huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro
words.translation: 巨大的，广大的；无边无际的；非常好的

examples.en: People who travel by rail still read an immense amount.
examples.zh: 人们坐火车旅行时仍然会读很多书。

examples.en: Regular visits from a social worker can be of immense value to old people living alone.
examples.zh: 对于独居老人来说社工的经常探望很重要。

words.definition: to say that something is true or that someone has done something wrong, although it has not been proved; declare, asseverate
words.translation: 宣称，断言；提出…作为理由

examples.en: She alleged that there was rampant drug use among the male members of the group.
examples.zh: 她指称该组织中有大量的男性成员吸毒。

words.definition: a long heavy piece of wood or metal used in building houses, bridges etc; to send a radio or television signal through the air, especially to somewhere very distant; ray, stream; to transmit, send out; irradiate
words.translation: 横梁；光线；电波；船宽；[计量] 秤杆；发送；以梁支撑；用…照射；流露；[建]横梁；[船]船宽；[计量]秤杆；照射；堆满笑容

examples.en: ...high-energy laser beams.
examples.zh: …高能激光束。

words.definition: to live in a particular place; belong, room, harbor, live, reside in
words.translation: 居住；存在于；细想某事

examples.en: They dwelt in the forest.
examples.zh: 他们住在森林里。

words.definition: one of a fixed number of changes in the appearance of the Moon or a  planet  when it is seen from the Earth; stage, age, grade
words.translation: 月相；[物]相；阶段；[天]位相

examples.en: We should phase the input and output of the machine.
examples.zh: 我们应该使机器的输入功率和输出功率的相位同步。

words.definition: to be driving faster than the legal limit; the rate at which something moves or travels; quicken up, to accelerate; velocity, prosperity, up, tempo; make a go of
words.translation: 超速，加速；加速，迅速前行；兴隆；速度，速率；迅速，快速；昌盛，繁荣；[力]速度，速率；加快…的速度；使成功，使繁荣

examples.en: I got caught speeding on the A40 yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我在 A40 号干线公路上超速行驶被逮到。

words.definition: a government, especially one that was not elected fairly or that you disapprove of for some other reason; government, power
words.translation: 政权，政体；社会制度；管理体制

examples.en: The regime got rid of most of its opponents.
examples.zh: 该政权清除了大多数反对者。

words.definition: a group of people chosen to do a particular job, make decisions etc; council, soviet
words.translation: 委员会

examples.en: a committee meeting
examples.zh: 委员会会议

words.definition: someone who is kept as a prisoner by an enemy so that the other side will do what the enemy demands; guarantee, pledge
words.translation: 人质；抵押品

examples.en: The group are holding two tourists hostage (= keeping them as hostages ) .
examples.zh: 这伙人挟持了两名游客作为人质。

examples.en: a family taken hostage at gunpoint
examples.zh: 在枪口下被劫为人质的一家人

words.definition: a large area of a country or of the world, usually without exact limits; area, extent, boundary, zone, spectrum, territory
words.translation: 地区；范围；部位；[地理]地区；[医]部位

examples.en: efforts to bring peace to the region
examples.zh: 给这个地区带来和平的努力

words.definition: a sudden strong feeling of excitement and pleasure, or the thing that makes you feel this; to make someone feel excited and happy; intensity, stress, tension, warmth, excitation; tie oneself up in knots; quake, judder
words.translation: 激动；震颤；紧张；使…颤动；使…紧张；使…感到兴奋或激动；[医]震颤；颤抖；感到兴奋；感到紧张

examples.en: Winning first place must have been quite a thrill.
examples.zh: 赢得第一名肯定让人非常激动。

examples.en: Even though I’ve been acting for years, I still get a thrill out of going on stage.
examples.zh: 尽管我演了多年戏，走上舞台我仍然感到十分激动。

examples.en: It gave Pat a thrill to finally see the group perform live.
examples.zh: 帕特终于看到这个乐队现场表演，感到十分激动。

words.definition: to give someone the official right to do or have something
words.translation: 称做…；定名为…；给…称号；使…有权利

examples.en: a documentary entitled ‘The Price of Perfection’
examples.zh: 一部名为《完美的代价》的纪录片

words.definition: more than what was agreed or expected; attached, added, plus, more, excess
words.translation: 附加的，额外的

examples.en: Additional information can be obtained from the centre.
examples.zh: 可以从中心获取更多信息。

words.definition: relating to or caused by something; someone whose job is to look after or help customers in a public place; accompanied; waiter, suite
words.translation: 伴随的；侍候的；服务员，侍者；随员，陪从

examples.en: Such patients run an increased probability of hospitalization, with all the attendant costs to the patient and to the health care system that hospitalization entails.
examples.zh: 此类患者趋于住院治疗的的几率增加，随之而来的患者和医疗保健系统住院治疗所承担的费用也增加。

words.definition: to make a loud high noise with your voice because you are hurt, frightened, excited etc; a loud high sound that you make with your voice because you are hurt, frightened, excited etc; pipe, shriek; squeal
words.translation: 尖叫；呼啸；发出尖锐刺耳的声音；令人触目惊心；尖叫声；尖锐刺耳的声音；极其滑稽可笑的人

examples.en: After the first few shots, people started screaming.
examples.zh: 几声枪响过后，人们开始尖叫起来。

examples.en: a screaming baby
examples.zh: 尖声哭叫的婴儿

examples.en: The children were screaming with laughter .
examples.zh: 小孩子们在尖声欢笑。

words.definition: extremely unhappy, for example because you feel lonely, cold, or badly treated; poor, painful, mean, base, dirty
words.translation: 悲惨的；痛苦的；卑鄙的

examples.en: I’ve been so miserable since Pat left me.
examples.zh: 自从帕特离我而去后，我十分痛苦。

examples.en: I spent the weekend feeling miserable .
examples.zh: 我那个周末心情很糟糕。

examples.en: Jan looks really miserable .
examples.zh: 简看上去很痛苦。

words.definition: someone who has been a soldier, sailor etc in a war; old moustache, warhorse; seasoned
words.translation: 老兵；老手；富有经验的人；老运动员；经验丰富的；老兵的

examples.en: a Vietnam veteran
examples.zh: 越战老兵

words.definition: a husband or wife; mateship, sexual partner
words.translation: 配偶；和…结婚

examples.en: Spouses were invited to the company picnic.
examples.zh: 配偶受到邀请参加公司的野餐会。

words.definition: an occasion when you travel from one place to another, especially over a long distance; to travel; tour, trip; travel, have a trip, go on a trip, wayfare
words.translation: 旅行；行程；[交]旅行

examples.en: the friends they made on the journey
examples.zh: 他们在旅途中交下的朋友

words.definition: a line of colour, especially one of several lines of colour all close together; to mark with a stripe or stripes; category, variety, manner, nature, kind
words.translation: 条纹，斑纹；种类；加条纹于…；[植保][植]条纹，斑纹

examples.en: a shirt with black and white stripes
examples.zh: 黑白条纹衬衫

words.definition: damage, injury, or trouble caused by someone’s actions or by an event; to have a bad effect on something; damage, detriment; hurt, knife, injure
words.translation: 伤害；损害；危害

examples.en: The scandal did his career a lot of harm.
examples.zh: 丑闻对他的职业生涯造成很大损害。

examples.en: Our children deserve protection from harm.
examples.zh: 我们的儿童理应得到保护免受伤害。

words.definition: to make someone feel afraid; be nervous of, be fearful of
words.translation: 使惊吓；吓唬…；害怕，惊恐

examples.en: Don’t stand so near the edge! You’re frightening me.
examples.zh: 别站得那么靠边！你要把我吓坏了。

examples.en: She was frightened by the anger in his eyes.
examples.zh: 她被他眼中的怒火吓住了。

examples.en: Computers used to frighten me, but not now.
examples.zh: 电脑过去让我感到害怕，但现在不了。

words.definition: wise and careful use of money, so that none is wasted; economy, saving
words.translation: 节俭；节约；[植] 海石竹；[植]海石竹

examples.en: They were rightly praised for their thrift and enterprise.
examples.zh: 他们因勤俭节约和开创精神而受到了应得的表扬。

words.definition: an organization, meeting, TV programme etc where people have a chance to publicly discuss an important subject; consultation, seminar
words.translation: 论坛，讨论会；法庭；公开讨论的广场

examples.en: Members of the council agreed that was an important forum for discussion.
examples.zh: 理事会成员们一致认为那是一个用于讨论的重要论坛。

words.definition: to translate spoken words from one language into another; say, bring sb to do sth; account, translate
words.translation: 说明；口译；解释；翻译

examples.en: They spoke good Spanish, and promised to interpret for me.
examples.zh: 他们西班牙语说得很好，答应替我翻译。

words.definition: to kill someone by dropping them with a rope around their neck, or to die in this way, especially as a punishment for a serious crime; paint, swing from; trail; moratorium, pause
words.translation: 悬挂，垂下；装饰；绞死；使悬而未决；悬挂；暂停，中止；悬着，垂下；被绞死；悬而不决

examples.en: If he is found guilty, he will almost certainly hang.
examples.zh: 如果被判有罪，他几乎肯定会被处以绞刑。

words.definition: an expression of thanks to God
words.translation: 感恩

examples.en: I gather all my thanksgiving and delight into my walking.
examples.zh: 我将我所有的感恩和愉悦注入到走路中。

words.definition: a metal container, like a large bullet, which is full of an explosive substance and is fired from a large gun; to remove something such as beans or nuts from a shell or  pod; configuration, profile, shot; chip, flake off; skin, flay
words.translation: 壳，贝壳；炮弹；外形；剥落；设定命令行解释器的位置；[动][机]壳，贝壳；剥皮；炮轰

examples.en: We ran for cover as shells dropped all around us.
examples.zh: 周围炮弹四处飞落，我们奔跑着寻找地方躲避。

examples.en: an exploding mortar shell
examples.zh: 一枚爆炸的迫击炮弹

words.definition: a long flat narrow board attached to a wall or in a frame or cupboard, used for putting things on; etagere, bink
words.translation: 架子；搁板；搁板状物；暗礁；[家具]搁板

examples.en: shelves of books
examples.zh: 一层层书架的书

examples.en: supermarket shelves
examples.zh: 超级市场的货架

examples.en: the amount of shelf space available
examples.zh: 可用的货架空间

words.definition: a tool you use for picking up and eating food, with a handle and three or four points; to put food into your mouth or onto a plate using a fork; harrow; branch off, diverge
words.translation: 叉；餐叉；耙；叉起；使成叉状；分叉；分歧

examples.en: Put the knives and forks on the table.
examples.zh: 把刀叉摆放在桌子上。

words.definition: to try to sell goods, usually by going from place to place and trying to persuade people to buy them; a large bird that hunts and eats small birds and animals; tout, cough up; have a cough; eagle
words.translation: 兜售，沿街叫卖；捕捉；咳出；鹰；鹰派成员；掠夺他人的人；清嗓；咳嗽；像鹰一般地袭击；[鸟]鹰

words.definition: to become firm or stiff, or to make something firm or stiff; stiffen
words.translation: 变硬，变坚固；变坚强；变冷酷；(Harden)人名；(英、德、罗、瑞典)哈登；(法)阿尔当

examples.en: It will take about 24 hours for the glue to harden.
examples.zh: 胶水干透大约需要24小时。

words.definition: school examinations taken as practice before official examinations; to laugh at someone or something and try to make them look stupid by saying unkind things about them or by copying them; not real, but intended to be very similar to a real situation, substance etc; guy, simulate, pattern, imitate; make game of, jeer at; derisiveness, imitation; affected, false, assumed, simulate; lyingly, falsely
words.translation: 英国模拟考试（mocks）；愚弄，嘲弄；仿制的，模拟的，虚假的，不诚实的；嘲弄；模仿；使…失望；使…无效；嘲弄，嘲笑；仿制品；嘲笑对象；模拟的；假装的；伪造的；虚伪地

examples.en: I’m revising for my mocks.
examples.zh: 我在复习准备模拟考试。

words.definition: a system of voting, usually in secret, or an occasion when you vote in this way; to ask someone to vote for something; vote, poll; cast one's vote, poll; seek a vote
words.translation: 投票；投票用纸；投票总数；抽签决定；使投票表决；拉选票

examples.en: The party leader is elected by secret ballot .
examples.zh: 政党领袖是通过无记名投票选举产生的。

examples.en: Workers at the plant held a ballot and rejected strike action.
examples.zh: 工厂工人举行投票，否决了罢工行动。

words.definition: to make a great effort to achieve something; apply oneself, struggle, labor
words.translation: 努力；奋斗；抗争

examples.en: He strives hard to keep himself very fit.
examples.zh: 他努力使自己保持非常的健康。

words.definition: to dislike someone very much and feel angry towards them; an angry unpleasant feeling that someone has when they hate someone and want to harm them; detest, turn away from; despite, hatred
words.translation: 憎恨；厌恶；遗憾；反感

examples.en: Why do you hate me so much?
examples.zh: 你为什么那么恨我？

words.definition: to complain in an annoying way, especially in an unhappy voice and without good reason; a long low sound expressing pain, unhappiness, or sexual pleasure; beef about, repine; regret, lamentation; beef about, rail against
words.translation: 抱怨，悲叹；呻吟；呻吟声；悲叹；抱怨；呻吟着说

examples.en: ‘I feel seasick already,’ she moaned.
examples.zh: “我已经开始晕船了。”她抱怨道。

examples.en: He moaned and groaned all the way there.
examples.zh: 他去的一路上抱怨个没完。

words.definition: exactly the same, or very similar; self, same
words.translation: 同一的；完全相同的；完全相同的事物；[数]同一的

examples.en: four identical houses
examples.zh: 四幢一模一样的房子

words.definition: if something rolls, especially something round, or if you roll it, it moves along a surface by turning over and over; a piece of paper, camera film, money etc that has been rolled into the shape of a tube; turn, wheel; wave, turn, screw, rock; book, volume
words.translation: 卷；滚动，转动；辗；卷，卷形物；名单；摇晃；滚动；转动；起伏，摇晃

examples.en: His sleeves were rolled above his elbows.
examples.zh: 他的袖子卷到了胳膊肘的上面。

words.definition: the act or process of asking questions in order to get information; investigation, exploration, probe, research, search
words.translation: 探究；调查；质询

examples.en: On further inquiry, it emerged that Malcolm had not been involved in the incident.
examples.zh: 进一步的调查表明，马尔科姆没有参与该事件。

examples.en: The local council set up a committee of inquiry to look into policing arrangements.
examples.zh: 当地市政会成立了一个调查委员会来对治安维护措施进行调查。

words.definition: a performance in which dancing and music tell a story without any speaking
words.translation: 芭蕾舞剧；芭蕾舞乐曲

examples.en: We’re going to the ballet tomorrow evening.
examples.zh: 我们明天晚上要去看芭蕾舞演出。

words.definition: far away in space or time; remote, faraway
words.translation: 遥远的；冷漠的；远隔的；不友好的，冷淡的

examples.en: the sound of distant gunfire
examples.zh: 远处的炮火声

examples.en: Her honeymoon seemed a distant memory .
examples.zh: 她的蜜月似乎成了遥远的记忆。

examples.en: That affair was in the dim and distant past (= a long time ago ) .
examples.zh: 那件事已成为遥远的过去了。

words.definition: a small house in the country; shed, cabin
words.translation: 小屋；村舍；（农舍式的）小别墅

examples.en: a country cottage
examples.zh: 乡间小屋

examples.en: We’re staying in a holiday cottage in Dorset.
examples.zh: 我们住在多塞特的一个度假小别墅里。

words.definition: having all the features that are typical or expected of a particular thing or situation; a book, play, or film that is important and has been admired for a long time; traditional, conventional; chefdoeuvre, scriptures
words.translation: 经典的；古典的，传统的；最优秀的；名著；经典著作；大艺术家

examples.en: The Coca-Cola bottle is one of the classic designs of the last century.
examples.zh: 可口可乐瓶是上个世纪的经典设计之一。

words.definition: important; obvious, excellent, remarkable, brilliant, marked
words.translation: 突出的，显著的；杰出的；卓越的

examples.en: a prominent Russian scientist
examples.zh: 杰出的俄罗斯科学家

examples.en: The World Cup will have a prominent place on the agenda.
examples.zh: 世界杯赛将占据议程表的重要位置。

words.definition: a short phrase that is easy to remember and is used in advertisements, or by politicians, organizations etc; banner, catchline
words.translation: 标语；呐喊声

examples.en: an advertising slogan
examples.zh: 一句广告口号

examples.en: demonstrators shouting political slogans
examples.zh: 高喊政治口号的示威者

examples.en: the Democrats’ campaign slogan
examples.zh: 民主党的竞选口号

words.definition: the usual or normal situation, way of doing something etc; criterion, quota
words.translation: 标准，规范；规范，基准；[经管]定额，分配之工作量

examples.en: Joyce’s style of writing was a striking departure from the literary norm.
examples.zh: 乔伊斯的写作风格与传统的文学风格大相径庭。

words.definition: to manage the work or money of a company or organization; manage, afford, perform, conduct, implement
words.translation: 管理；执行；给予

examples.en: The money will be administered by local charities.
examples.zh: 这笔资金将由当地慈善机构管理。

examples.en: Our office administers the affairs of the Society.
examples.zh: 我们办公室管理协会的事务。

words.definition: September is the ninth month of the year in the Western calendar
words.translation: 九月

examples.en: Her son, Jerome, was born in September.
examples.zh: 她的儿子杰罗姆出生于9月。

examples.en: We didn't make the original September 30 release date.
examples.zh: 我们没有赶上原定9月30日的发行日。

words.definition: a member of the same class in a school, college or – in the US – a university
words.translation: 同班同学

examples.en: He acquainted his classmate with my sister.
examples.zh: 他把我妹妹介绍给他的同班同学。

examples.en: He acquainted his classmate with my younger brother.
examples.zh: 他把我的弟弟介绍给他的同班同学。

examples.en: I, who am your classmate, can understand you.
examples.zh: 我是你的同班同学,能了解你。

words.definition: to share things among a group of people, especially in a planned way; portion, part, spread
words.translation: 分配；散布；分开；把…分类

examples.en: a man distributing leaflets to passers-by
examples.zh: 一个向路人派发传单的男子

words.definition: to deal with a problem or improve a bad situation; a way of dealing with a problem or making a bad situation better; cure, help, repair; therapy, satisfaction, cure
words.translation: 补救；治疗；纠正；赔偿

examples.en: To remedy the situation, the water must be chemically treated.
examples.zh: 为了改善这种情况，水必须进行化学处理。

words.definition: difficult to see, hear, smell etc; to suddenly become unconscious for a short time; an act of becoming unconscious; fuzzy, weak, dark, vague; pass out, flake out; asphyxy, swound
words.translation: 模糊的；头晕的；虚弱的；[医] 衰弱的；昏倒；变得微弱；变得没气力；[中医] 昏厥，昏倒；[医]虚弱的；衰弱的；[中医]昏厥，昏倒

examples.en: She gave a faint smile.
examples.zh: 她淡淡一笑。

examples.en: a very faint noise
examples.zh: 很微弱的声响

examples.en: the faint light of dawn
examples.zh: 微弱的晨光

words.definition: a complicated official system that is annoying or confusing because it has a lot of rules, processes etc
words.translation: 官僚主义；官僚机构；官僚政治

examples.en: the reduction of unnecessary bureaucracy
examples.zh: 消除不必要的官僚体制

words.definition: someone who lives in a particular town, country, or state; people, municipality
words.translation: 公民；市民；老百姓；[法]公民

examples.en: We need our schools to teach students to be good citizens.
examples.zh: 我们需要学校把学生培养为好公民。

examples.en: The mayor urged citizens to begin preparing for a major storm.
examples.zh: 一场特大暴风雨即将到来，市长敦促市民做好准备。

words.definition: to increase gradually in amount or degree; used as part of the name of a mountain; enhance, boost, jack, hot, gain; climb, arise, raise, go up; peak, foundation plate
words.translation: 增加；爬上；使骑上马；安装，架置；镶嵌，嵌入；准备上演；成立（军队等）；山峰；底座；乘骑用马；攀，登；运载工具；爬；上升

examples.en: Tension here is mounting , as we await the final result.
examples.zh: 我们等待着最终结果，这里的气氛也越来越紧张。

examples.en: Casualties on both sides of the battle have continued to mount.
examples.zh: 交战双方的伤亡人数继续增加。

words.definition: an act of nodding; to move your head up and down, especially in order to show agreement or understanding; swing, bob; noddle; to oscillate, to swing
words.translation: 点头；打盹；摆动；点头表示

examples.en: The woman greeted us with a nod of the head.
examples.zh: 那个女人向我们点点头打招呼。

examples.en: I showed the doorman my card and he gave a friendly nod.
examples.zh: 我向门卫出示了卡片，他友善地点了点头。

words.definition: something that protects a person or thing from harm or damage; to protect someone or something from being harmed or damaged; dong, fendering; avoid, shadow, guard, curtain; protect sb./sth. from sth.
words.translation: 盾；防护物；保护者；遮蔽；包庇；避开；保卫；防御；起保护作用

examples.en: He used his left hand as a shield against the reflecting sunlight.
examples.zh: 他用左手遮挡反射过来的阳光。

words.definition: Tuesday is the day after Monday and before Wednesday
words.translation: 星期二

examples.en: He phoned on Tuesday, just before you came.
examples.zh: 他星期二打了电话，刚好在你来之前。

examples.en: Talks are likely to start next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 会谈可能在下星期二开始。

words.definition: something that makes it difficult to achieve some­thing; interference, let, bar, disturbance, dam
words.translation: 障碍，干扰；妨害物

examples.en: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
examples.zh: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

examples.en: Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
examples.zh: 妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。

examples.en: We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
examples.zh: 我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。

words.definition: someone who you try to defeat in a competition, game, fight, or argument; equal, anti, comparative, rival, match; contrary, adverse, against
words.translation: 对手；反对者；敌手；对立的；敌对的

examples.en: Graf’s opponent in today’s final will be Sukova.
examples.zh: 格拉芙今天的决赛对手将是苏科娃。

examples.en: He is admired even by his political opponents.
examples.zh: 他甚至受到政敌的钦佩。

words.definition: a southeast wind comes from the southeast; the direction that is exactly between south and east; If you go southeast, you travel toward the southeast
words.translation: 东南的；来自东南的；东南；东南地区；来自东南

examples.en: the southeast quarter of the city
examples.zh: 该市的东南部

examples.en: I know we have to go southeast, more or less.
examples.zh: 我知道我们大概得往东南方向走。

words.definition: a very high hill; range, cordillera
words.translation: 山；山脉；[地理]山

examples.en: the highest mountain in Austria
examples.zh: 奥地利最高的山

examples.en: the Rocky Mountains
examples.zh: 落基山脉

examples.en: a steep mountain road
examples.zh: 陡峭的山路

words.definition: pleasant; pleasant, adaptive, lovely, calculated, grateful
words.translation: 令人愉快的；适合的；和蔼可亲的

examples.en: We spent a most agreeable couple of hours.
examples.zh: 我们非常愉快地度过了几个小时。

examples.en: an agreeable young man
examples.zh: 一个讨人喜欢的年轻人

words.definition: small in degree; to offend someone by treating them rudely or without respect; small, tender, mild, spare; forget, despise; go-by, floccinaucinihilipilification
words.translation: 轻微的，少量的；脆弱的；细长的；不重要的；轻视，忽略；怠慢；轻蔑

examples.en: a slight improvement
examples.zh: 些许的改进

examples.en: a slight increase
examples.zh: 少许的增加

examples.en: a slight change of plan
examples.zh: 计划的略微变动

words.definition: a dilute liquid has been made weaker by the addition of water or another liquid; to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid; watery, attenuant; break, deliquate; thin
words.translation: 稀释的；淡的；稀释；冲淡；削弱；变稀薄；变淡

examples.en: dilute hydrochloric acid
examples.zh: 稀盐酸

words.definition: to quickly push your finger or some other pointed object into something or someone; to quickly push your fingers, a stick etc into something or someone; moon, run through; stick, pink; soldier, spine
words.translation: 刺，捅；戳；伸出；刺探；闲荡；刺；袋子；懒汉；拨开

examples.en: One of the nurses poked her head around the door.
examples.zh: 其中一名护士从门里探出头来。

words.definition: goals, intention, purpose, behalf, objective
words.translation: 目的；利益；理由；日本米酒

words.definition: when a  jury  in a law court retires, they go away to consider whether someone is guilty or not; withdraw, beat a retreat; leave, split, quit; superannuation, sequestration
words.translation: 退休；撤退；退却；退隐；退兵信号；离开；收回

examples.en: At the age when most people retire, he is ready to face a new career.
examples.zh: 在大多数人退休的年纪，他准备要面对一项新事业。

words.definition: erroneous ideas or information are wrong and based on facts that are not correct; false, wrong, improper, incorrect, inaccurate
words.translation: 错误的；不正确的

examples.en: His economic predictions are based on some erroneous assumptions.
examples.zh: 他的经济预测是基于错误假设之上的。

words.definition: a small piece of printed paper that gives you the right to pay less for something or get something free; Oakley, annie oakley
words.translation: 息票；赠券；联票；[经] 配给券；[金融]息票；[贸易]赠券；[经]配给券

examples.en: The coupon entitles you to ten cents off your next purchase.
examples.zh: 这张优惠券可以让你在下次购物时节省10分钱。

words.definition: a building where important  cultural  , historical, or scientific objects are kept and shown to the public
words.translation: 博物馆

examples.en: the Museum of Modern Art
examples.zh: 现代艺术博物馆

examples.en: The museum has an extensive collection of early photographs.
examples.zh: 这座博物馆藏有大量早期的照片。

words.definition: to make something look more attractive by putting something pretty on it; paint, hang, make, post; set sth out, trick out
words.translation: 装饰；布置；授勋给

examples.en: Children’s pictures decorated the walls of the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室的墙上装点着儿童画。

words.definition: the quality of being honest and strong about what you believe to be right; truth, honesty, full, righteousness, completeness
words.translation: 完整；正直；诚实；廉正；[数]完整

examples.en: the territorial integrity of the country
examples.zh: 国家的领土完整

words.definition: to tell someone that something will definitely happen or is definitely true so that they are less worried; undertake, swear for
words.translation: 保证；担保；使确信；弄清楚

examples.en: The document is genuine, I can assure you .
examples.zh: 我能向你保证，这文件是真的。

words.definition: the feeling of being excited; stimulus, incentive, needle
words.translation: 兴奋；刺激；令人兴奋的事物

examples.en: We were both new to the excitements of life in the big city.
examples.zh: 我们俩都是初次感受大城市多姿多彩的生活。

words.definition: a disadvantage of a situation, plan, product etc; defect, deficiency, disadvantage, vice, fault
words.translation: 缺点，不利条件；退税

examples.en: It’s a great city – the only drawback is the weather.
examples.zh: 这是座很不错的城市，唯一的不足就是天气。

words.definition: to state publicly that something is true; declare, to be certain; recognize, confirm on
words.translation: 肯定；断言；确认

examples.en: The general affirmed rumors of an attack.
examples.zh: 将军证实了袭击的传闻。

words.definition: to be the cause of something, or be the basic thing from which something develops
words.translation: 成为……的基础；位于……之下

examples.en: the one basic principle that underlies all of the party’s policies
examples.zh: 贯穿该党各项政策的那一条基本原则

words.definition: to gradually disappear; peter, color fading; discolor; stupid, literal-minded
words.translation: 褪色；凋谢；逐渐消失；平淡的；乏味的；[电影][电视] 淡出；[电影][电视] 淡入；使褪色

examples.en: Hopes of a peace settlement are beginning to fade.
examples.zh: 达成和平协议的希望日渐渺茫。

examples.en: Over the years her beauty had faded a little.
examples.zh: 岁月流逝，她的美貌已略逊当年。

words.definition: reasonable and likely to be true or successful; smooth-tongued, rhetoric
words.translation: 貌似可信的，花言巧语的；貌似真实的，貌似有理的

examples.en: His story certainly sounds plausible.
examples.zh: 他的叙述听上去当然很合理。

examples.en: a plausible explanation
examples.zh: 说得过去的解释

words.definition: a small amount of food that is eaten between main meals or instead of a meal; to eat small amounts of food between main meals or instead of a meal; proportion, portion, percent, part, integral; nosh
words.translation: 小吃，快餐；一份，部分；吃快餐，吃点心；[贸易]小吃，快餐

examples.en: I grabbed a quick snack.
examples.zh: 我赶紧吃了点零食。

examples.en: Drinks and light snacks are served at the bar.
examples.zh: 酒吧里供应饮料和小吃。

examples.en: snack foods like crisps and peanuts
examples.zh: 炸薯片和花生之类的小吃

words.definition: if you have a preference for something, you like it more than another thing and will choose it if you can; tendency, liability, priority, trend, favour
words.translation: 偏爱，倾向；优先权；[经][计]优先权

examples.en: Do you have a colour preference ?
examples.zh: 你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？

examples.en: Parents may be able to express a preference as to the school their child will attend.
examples.zh: 家长也许可以表明愿意让孩子就读哪所学校。

examples.en: The amount of sugar you add will depend on personal preference .
examples.zh: 加多少糖取决于个人的喜好。

words.definition: to take hold of something suddenly and violently; grasp, absorb, see, read, noble; lock, do with
words.translation: 抓住；夺取；理解；逮捕；利用；（机器）卡住

examples.en: Suddenly he seized my hand.
examples.zh: 他突然抓住我的手。

words.definition: to move a rake across a surface in order to make the soil level, gather dead leaves etc; a gardening tool with a row of metal teeth at the end of a long handle, used for making soil level, gathering up dead leaves etc; seek, beat for; seek, slope; pendence, obliqueness
words.translation: 搜索；用耙子耙；掠过，擦过；耙子；斜度；钱耙；放荡的人，浪子；[船]倾斜；掠过；[船]斜度

examples.en: The searchlight raked the open ground around the prison.
examples.zh: 探照灯在监狱周围的空地上来回扫射。

words.definition: a serious argument or disagreement; discuss, debate, argue, stem, block; debate, argue with; argument, debate, brush, controversy
words.translation: 辩论；怀疑；阻止；抗拒；争吵；争论

examples.en: What happened next is hotly disputed .
examples.zh: 关于后来发生了什么，争论很激烈。

words.definition: to leave your own country in order to live in another country; transmigrate; to immigrate, to migrate
words.translation: 移居；移居外国；移民

examples.en: He emigrated to Belgium.
examples.zh: 他移民去了比利时。

words.definition: very unkind in a way that is intended to hurt someone’s feelings or make their character seem bad; severe, fallen, malicious, poisonous
words.translation: 恶毒的；恶意的；堕落的；有错误的；品性不端的；剧烈的；(Vicious)人名；(英)维舍斯

examples.en: Sarah can be quite vicious at times.
examples.zh: 萨拉有时相当狠毒。

examples.en: a vicious personal attack on the Duchess
examples.zh: 对公爵夫人恶毒的人身攻击

examples.en: She was shocked by the vicious tone in his voice.
examples.zh: 她对他恶毒的语气感到震惊。

words.definition: something that is exotic seems unusual and interesting because it is related to a foreign country – use this to show approval; outside, extraneous
words.translation: 异国的；外来的；异国情调的；[物]异国的；[语]外来的

examples.en: exotic birds
examples.zh: 外国的奇异鸟类

examples.en: exotic places
examples.zh: 有异国风情的地方

words.definition: judging and dealing with situations in a practical way according to what is actually possible rather than what you would like to happen; living, breathing
words.translation: 现实的；现实主义的；逼真的；实在论的

examples.en: Is this a realistic target?
examples.zh: 这个目标能够实现吗？

words.definition: having large strong muscles; robust, intramuscular
words.translation: 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；强健的

examples.en: She was fast and strong, with a slender, muscular body.
examples.zh: 她动作敏捷，身体强壮，身材苗条，肌肉结实。

examples.en: He’s very muscular.
examples.zh: 他很强壮。

words.definition: a greater distance than before or than something else; a  comparative  form of ‘far’; more distant; moreover, again, besides, then, additionally; further
words.translation: 更远地；此外；更进一步地；进一步的；更远的（far的比较级）

examples.en: We decided not to go any farther.
examples.zh: 我们决定不再往前走了。

examples.en: Most of them were locals, but some had come from farther afield (= a greater distance away ) .
examples.zh: 他们大部分是当地人，但也有一些来自较远的地方。

words.definition: when something such as money or skills are not used in a way that is effective, useful, or sensible; to use more money, time, energy etc than is useful or sensible; waste materials, substances etc are unwanted because the good part of them has been removed; refuse, garbage, dissipation, wear; lose, spend, consume; trifle away, fiddle away; spare, unnecessary, redundant
words.translation: 浪费；废物；荒地；损耗；地面风化物；消耗；使荒芜；废弃的；多余的；荒芜的；变消瘦；挥霍钱财

examples.en: excessive waste in state spending
examples.zh: 政府支出方面的过度浪费

words.definition: a game between two teams of 11 players in which players try to get points by hitting a ball and running between two sets of three sticks; Chinese Cricket, grig
words.translation: 板球，板球运动；蟋蟀；[昆]蟋蟀

words.definition: to talk about a religious subject in a public place, especially in a church during a service; drum in; boost, sermonize; homily
words.translation: 说教；讲道；鼓吹；传道；反复灌输；宣扬

examples.en: He traveled the southern states, preaching the gospel .
examples.zh: 他游历南方各州宣讲福音。

words.definition: if something grieves you, it makes you feel very unhappy; harry, excruciate; mourn over, lament over
words.translation: 使悲伤，使苦恼；(Grieve)人名；(英)格里夫；悲痛，哀悼

examples.en: My aunt, it grieves me to say, gets things confused.
examples.zh: 我的姑妈，说起来我很难过，她有点颠三倒四的。

words.definition: a purple or brown mark on your skin that you get because you have fallen, been hit etc; to affect someone badly and make them feel less confident; abrasion, brush-burn; wound, brush burn
words.translation: 擦伤；挫伤；青肿；使受瘀伤；使受挫伤；[外科]青肿；受伤

examples.en: minor cuts and bruises
examples.zh: 轻微的伤口和淤青

words.definition: the state of being known about by a lot of people because of your achievements; tradition, celebrity, tale
words.translation: 名声，名望；传闻，传说；使闻名，使有名望

examples.en: He claims he is not really interested in fame.
examples.zh: 他称自己对出名真的没有兴趣。

words.definition: very good, especially in a way that makes you feel happy and excited; wonderful, excellent, famous, intense, super
words.translation: 极好的；极其的，非常的；可怕的

examples.en: That’s a terrific idea!
examples.zh: 这个主意真棒！

examples.en: The actress who played the lawyer was terrific.
examples.zh: 扮演律师的女演员表演十分出色。

words.definition: to put something firmly and deeply into something else, or to be put into something in this way; rear, bed
words.translation: 栽种；使嵌入，使插入；使深留脑中

examples.en: One of the bullets passed through Andrea's chest before embedding itself in a wall.
examples.zh: 其中一颗子弹穿过安德烈亚的胸膛然后嵌入一面墙中。

words.definition: now, compared with what happened in the past; today, contemporarily
words.translation: 现今；时下；当今

examples.en: Nowadays people are rarely shocked by the sex they see on television.
examples.zh: 如今人们在电视上看见性爱镜头不太会感到吃惊了。

examples.en: Most people nowadays are aware of the importance of a healthy diet.
examples.zh: 现在大多数人都明白健康饮食的重要性。

words.definition: relating to the outside of something or of a person’s body; foreign, outer, outside, surface, out; outside, without, surface, face, garment
words.translation: 外部的；表面的；[药] 外用的；外国的；外面的；外部；外观；外面；[药][动]外部的；外用的

examples.en: the external appearance of the building
examples.zh: 大楼的外观

words.definition: a sudden quick movement of a liquid, electricity, chemical etc through something; if a feeling surges or surges up, you begin to feel it very strongly; very rough seas; sharp rise, balloon; jolt, jounce
words.translation: 汹涌；大浪，波涛；汹涌澎湃；巨涌；起大浪，蜂拥而来；大浪；激增；使颠簸

examples.en: a device that protects your computer against electrical surges
examples.zh: 一台计算机电涌保护设备

words.definition: all the teachers in a university; ability, capacity, competence, department, power
words.translation: 科，系；能力；全体教员

examples.en: Both faculty and students oppose the measures.
examples.zh: 教师和学生都反对这些措施。

words.definition: to free prisoners, a city, a country etc from someone’s control; deliver, issue, emancipate
words.translation: 解放；放出；释放

examples.en: A few days later, our armies liberated the city.
examples.zh: 几天以后，我军解放了这座城市。

words.definition: to put someone’s or something’s name on an official list; an official list of names of people, companies etc, or a book that has this list; book in, book down; entry, page, enrollment
words.translation: 登记；注册；记录；挂号邮寄；把…挂号；正式提出；寄存器；登记簿；[专利]注册；挂号

examples.en: The tanker is registered in Rotterdam.
examples.zh: 这艘油轮是在鹿特丹登记的。

words.definition: a feeling of being physically relaxed and satisfied, so that nothing is hurting you, making you feel too hot or cold etc; to make someone feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them or touching them; relief, ease, consolation; quiet, soothe
words.translation: 安慰；舒适；安慰者；使（痛苦等）缓和

examples.en: I dress for comfort, not fashion.
examples.zh: 我穿衣服只讲舒服，不追求时髦。

examples.en: Alan was very reluctant to leave the warmth and comfort of the fire.
examples.zh: 艾伦很不情愿离开暖和舒适的火堆。

examples.en: Now you can watch your favorite movies in the comfort of your own home.
examples.zh: 现在你可以舒舒服服地在自己家里看你最喜欢的电影了。

words.definition: the things that happen to someone or something, especially unpleasant things that end their existence or end a particular period; lot, destiny, fortune, portion, cup of tea; predestine, foreordain
words.translation: 命运；注定

examples.en: I wouldn’t wish such a fate on my worst enemy.
examples.zh: 就算是我不共戴天的仇敌，我也不希望他遭遇这样的命运。

words.definition: the sets of programs that tell a computer how to do a particular job
words.translation: 软件

examples.en: She loaded the new software .
examples.zh: 她给电脑装上新的软件。

examples.en: a software company
examples.zh: 软件公司

words.definition: an area of land used for growing crops or keeping animals; follow the plough; grange, steading; till, plant crops
words.translation: 种田，务农；经营农场；农场；农家；畜牧场；[农经]农场；[畜牧]畜牧场；养殖；耕种；佃出（土地）

examples.en: The family has farmed here for generations.
examples.zh: 这家人世代在此务农。

words.definition: to move or develop more slowly than others; backwardness, prisoner; trail, take the dust of; file over, titubate; finishing, last, eventual, rearmost, dernier
words.translation: 落后；迟延；防护套；囚犯；桶板；落后于；押往监狱；加上外套；最后的；[电子]滞后；缓缓而行；蹒跚

examples.en: We’ve had the hot-water tank lagged.
examples.zh: 我们已给热水箱加上了保温外罩。

words.definition: happening regularly or all the time; a number or quantity that never changes; permanent, steady; invariable
words.translation: 不变的；恒定的；经常的；[数] 常数；恒量；[数]常数

examples.en: There was a constant stream of visitors to the house.
examples.zh: 参观这幢房子的游客川流不息。

examples.en: Amy lived in constant fear of being attacked.
examples.zh: 埃米一直生活在害怕遭到袭击的恐惧之中。

examples.en: He kept in constant contact with his family while he was in Australia.
examples.zh: 他在澳大利亚时一直和家人保持着联系。

words.definition: April is the fourth month of the year in the Western calendar
words.translation: 四月

examples.en: The changes will be introduced in April.
examples.zh: 这些变更将于4月实施。

words.definition: friendly and easy to like; pleasant, friendly, sweet, benign
words.translation: 和蔼可亲的，亲切的；(Amiable)人名；(法)阿米亚布勒；(英)阿米娅布尔

examples.en: The driver was an amiable young man.
examples.zh: 司机是位友善的年轻人。

examples.en: She was in an amiable mood.
examples.zh: 她心情很好。

words.definition: if something is worthwhile, it is important or useful, or you gain something from it
words.translation: 值得做的，值得花时间的

examples.en: He wanted to do a worthwhile job.
examples.zh: 他想做有意义的工作。

examples.en: We decided to give the money to a worthwhile cause (= one that helps people ) .
examples.zh: 我们决定把这笔钱投入到慈善事业中。

words.definition: to deliberately kill or injure someone using a gun; an occasion when someone takes photographs or makes a film; flight, pot, screen, spring; put, screen, pop; photography, rapid, rush
words.translation: 射击，射中；拍摄；发芽；使爆炸；给…注射；射击；摄影；狩猎；急流；[摄]拍摄；拍电影

examples.en: Police shot one suspect when he pulled a gun on them.
examples.zh: 警方在一名嫌疑人拔枪指着他们时击毙了他。

examples.en: Smith killed his wife, and then shot himself.
examples.zh: 史密斯杀死妻子，然后开枪自杀。

examples.en: A woman was shot dead in an attempted robbery.
examples.zh: 一名女子在一桩未遂抢劫案中中枪身亡。

words.definition: made, done, seen etc on the Internet or on a computer, rather than in the real world; valid, available, effective, telling, significant
words.translation: [计] 虚拟的；实质上的，事实上的（但未在名义上或正式获承认）；[计][物]虚拟的；有效的；实质上的，事实上的

examples.en: The website allows you to take a virtual tour of the art gallery.
examples.zh: 这个网站可让你对美术馆作一番虚拟参观。

examples.en: constructing virtual worlds
examples.zh: 构筑虚拟世界

words.definition: able or likely to harm or kill you; critical, risky, threatening, precarious, perilous
words.translation: 危险的

examples.en: laws about dangerous dogs
examples.zh: 有关危险犬类的法律

examples.en: Some of these prisoners are extremely dangerous.
examples.zh: 这些囚犯中有些极为危险。

examples.en: The powdered milk was not as good as breast milk, and was downright dangerous (= actually dangerous ) when it was mixed with unclean water.
examples.zh: 奶粉没有母乳好，用不洁净的水冲调更会造成危险。

words.definition: to walk somewhere in a slow relaxed way; tour, bummel; roam around, have a walk
words.translation: 漫步；闲逛；巡回演出；散步

words.definition: the part that is furthest away from people, and most difficult to reach; profoundity, deepness
words.translation: [海洋] 深度；深奥；[海洋]深度

examples.en: Astronomers may one day travel to the depths of space.
examples.zh: 天文学家也许有一天可以到太空深处去。

words.definition: to make something less likely to happen; stem, block, dispute, prohibit
words.translation: 阻止；使气馁

examples.en: Aspirin may discourage tumour growth in some types of cancer.
examples.zh: 阿司匹林可能遏制某些恶性肿瘤的生长。

words.definition: containing many small parts or details that all work or fit together; complicated, sophisticated, involved, detailed
words.translation: 复杂的；错综的，缠结的

examples.en: intricate patterns
examples.zh: 繁复的图案

words.definition: careful, thorough, and exact; strict, rigid, precise, severe, tight
words.translation: 严格的，严厉的；严密的；严酷的

examples.en: a rigorous analysis of defence needs
examples.zh: 对国防需求的缜密分析

examples.en: the rigorous standards required by the college
examples.zh: 大学规定的严格标准

words.definition: a man who has never been married
words.translation: 学士；单身汉；（尚未交配的）小雄兽

examples.en: Gerald was 38, and a confirmed bachelor (=  a man who has decided that he will never marry  ) .
examples.zh: 杰拉德38岁，抱定主意独身。

examples.en: The Crown Prince was Japan’s most eligible bachelor (=  a rich young man who has not yet married  ) .
examples.zh: 皇太子是日本最理想的适婚男子。

words.definition: if a plane taxis, it moves along the ground before taking off or after landing; a car and driver that you pay to take you somewhere; coast; motorcab, cab
words.translation: 乘出租车；滑行；出租汽车；[车辆]乘出租车；[航]滑行；[车辆]出租汽车

examples.en: The plane taxied to a halt.
examples.zh: 飞机滑行一段距离后停下来。

words.definition: one of the people who live in a particular place; liver, resident, dweller, habitant
words.translation: 居民；居住者

examples.en: a city of six million inhabitants
examples.zh: 有600万居民的城市

words.definition: relating to your teeth; odontic
words.translation: 牙科的；牙齿的，牙的；齿音；[解剖]牙科的

examples.en: Good oral hygiene and regular dental care are important, whatever your age.
examples.zh: 无论年龄大小，良好的口腔卫生和定期的牙齿保健都非常重要。

words.definition: cloth used for making clothes, curtains etc; cloth, organization, formation, construction, textile
words.translation: 织物；布；组织；构造；建筑物；[纺]织物

examples.en: our new range of fabrics and wallpapers
examples.zh: 我们新的织物和墙纸系列

words.definition: to put bait on a hook to catch fish or in a trap to catch animals; food used to attract fish, animals, or birds so that you can catch them; harry, worry, trouble, tear, induce; gentle, lure
words.translation: 引诱；在…中放诱饵；折磨；饵；诱饵

examples.en: He baited his hook with pie.
examples.zh: 他把馅饼放在钓钩上作饵。

words.definition: simple and easy to understand; simple, precise, honest, transparent, plain; directly, openly
words.translation: 简单的；坦率的；明确的；径直的；直截了当地；坦率地

examples.en: This area of law is far from straightforward (= complicated ) .
examples.zh: 法律的这个领域很复杂。

words.definition: relating to sport for young people below a particular age; a child who goes to a junior school; inferior, lower
words.translation: 年少的；后进的；下级的；年少者，晚辈；地位较低者；大学三年级学生

examples.en: the junior football club
examples.zh: 青少年足球俱乐部

words.definition: one of the main periods into which a year is divided, each of which has a particular type of weather. The seasons are spring, summer, autumn, and winter; to add salt, pepper etc to food you are cooking; period, day, page; adapt, condition, suit
words.translation: 时期；季节；赛季；给…调味；使适应；[天]季节

examples.en: the effect on plants as the seasons start to change
examples.zh: 换季对植物的影响

words.definition: a room, building, or piece of land that adjoins something is next to it and connected to it; abut upon, abut against; abut upon, neighbor
words.translation: 毗连，邻接

examples.en: A vacant plot of land adjoins his house.
examples.zh: 有一块空地紧挨着他家。

words.definition: the part of your face above your eyes and below your hair; quantum, supercilium
words.translation: 眉，眉毛；额；表情；[解剖]额

examples.en: He wiped his brow with the back of his hand.
examples.zh: 他用手背擦了擦额头。

words.definition: crazy or very silly; crazy, possessed, foolish, stupid, bugs; fury, agriothymia
words.translation: 疯狂的；发疯的；愚蠢的；着迷的；狂怒

examples.en: He can’t possibly get that finished in time. He must be mad !
examples.zh: 他不可能按时完成的。他一定是疯了！

examples.en: I’d go mad (= start to feel crazy ) if I was stuck at home all day.
examples.zh: 如果我整天困在家里我会发疯的。

examples.en: He’s been driving me mad !
examples.zh: 他真让我受不了！

words.definition: without being affected or prevented by something; regardless of, hatred; make a difficulty, exasperate
words.translation: 不顾；恶意；怨恨；刁难；使恼怒

examples.en: We went out in spite of the rain.
examples.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是出去了。

examples.en: Kelly loved her husband in spite of the fact that he drank too much.
examples.zh: 虽然丈夫酗酒，凯莉仍然爱着他。

words.definition: a state in which all your weight is evenly spread so that you do not fall; if a government balances the budget, they make the amount of money that they spend equal to the amount of money available; regularity, equilibriums; equilibrize, close an account; suit, be commensurate to
words.translation: 平衡；余额；匀称；使平衡；结算；使相称；[会计]余额；保持平衡；相称；抵销

examples.en: I lost my balance and fell on my face.
examples.zh: 我失去平衡，脸着地摔倒了。

words.definition: very rarely or almost never; scarcely ever
words.translation: 很少，不常

examples.en: Karen had seldom seen him so angry.
examples.zh: 卡伦很少见他这么生气过。

words.definition: not good, or not as good as someone or something else; someone who has a lower position or rank than you in an organization; junior, lower; lessness, subordinate
words.translation: 差的；自卑的；下级的，下等的；下级；次品；[植]下级的，下等的

examples.en: I felt very inferior among all those academics.
examples.zh: 与那些大学教师在一起，我自惭形秽。

examples.en: wine of inferior quality
examples.zh: 劣质葡萄酒

examples.en: inferior goods
examples.zh: 质量低劣的商品

words.definition: having the highest power in a country; a king or queen; wonderful, excellent, famous, super, great; emperor, monarch
words.translation: 至高无上的；有主权的；拥有最高统治权的；不折不扣的；极好的；君主；独立国；最高统治者

examples.en: Lithuania and Armenia signed a treaty in Vilnius recognizing each other as independent sovereign states.
examples.zh: 立陶宛和亚美尼亚在维尔纽斯签订了一份互相承认各自为独立主权国家的协定。

words.definition: the act of paying someone to work for you; usage, utilization, profession, career, use, pursuit
words.translation: 使用；职业；雇用；[劳经]雇用

examples.en: She was offered employment in the sales office.
examples.zh: 她获聘在销售部工作。

words.definition: bread that has been heated so that it is brown on both sides and no longer soft; to drink a glass of wine etc to thank some-one, wish someone luck, or celebrate something; bottoms up; to roast, bake; to roast
words.translation: 干杯；烤面包；接受敬酒的人；（在某领域）广受赞誉的人；向…祝酒，为…干杯；吐司；烤；敬酒；使暖和；烘，烤

examples.en: I had a piece of toast for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早饭吃了一片吐司。

words.definition: very strange and unusual, and difficult to understand or explain; magic, mysterious, fantastic; fate, prediction, lot, destiny, fortune
words.translation: 怪异的；不可思议的；超自然的；（苏格兰）命运；预言

examples.en: A really weird thing happened last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚发生了一件非常奇怪的事。

examples.en: He’s a weird bloke.
examples.zh: 他是个古怪的家伙。

examples.en: They sell all sorts of weird and wonderful (= very strange ) products.
examples.zh: 他们出售各种稀奇古怪的产品。

words.definition: within a particular country; inner, inherent, domestic, inside, home
words.translation: 内部的；内在的；国内的；[药]内部的

examples.en: We have no interest in interfering in the internal affairs of other countries.
examples.zh: 我们对干涉其他国家内政不感兴趣。

examples.en: the threat to internal security
examples.zh: 对国内安全的威胁

examples.en: internal markets
examples.zh: 国内市场

words.definition: to make someone feel ashamed or stupid, especially when other people are present; make a chump out of
words.translation: 羞辱；使…丢脸；耻辱

examples.en: Her boss humiliated her in front of all her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她的老板在所有同事面前羞辱了她。

words.definition: to force someone to do something; pressure, force, enforce
words.translation: 强迫，迫使；强使发生；(Compel)人名；(法)孔佩尔

examples.en: His performance compelled the audience’s attention .
examples.zh: 他的表演吸引了观众的注意力。

words.definition: honest and truthful; explicit, naked, confessed
words.translation: 坦白的，直率的；老实的；免费邮寄特权；免费邮寄

examples.en: To be perfectly frank, I think it’s a bad idea.
examples.zh: 老实说，我认为这个主意不好。

words.definition: sleeping; sleeping, stupid
words.translation: 睡着的；麻木的；长眠的；熟睡地；进入睡眠状态

examples.en: Quiet! The baby’s asleep.
examples.zh: 安静！ 宝宝在睡觉。

words.definition: someone who does someone else’s job for a limited period of time, especially in a sports team or school; to use something new or diffe-rent instead of something else; replacement, proxy; supply, fill in; replace, cover for, take the place of somebody, stand in for sb
words.translation: 代用品；代替者；替代；[计]替代；代替

examples.en: Germany brought on a substitute at half time.
examples.zh: 德国队在比赛半场时换上一名替补队员。

examples.en: substitute goalkeeper
examples.zh: 替补守门员

words.definition: severe, cruel, or unkind; severe, grinding, crude, tight, hard
words.translation: 严厉的；严酷的；刺耳的；粗糙的；刺目的；(Harsh)人名；(英)哈什；[声]刺耳的

examples.en: the harsh measures taken against the protesters
examples.zh: 针对抗议者采取的严厉措施

examples.en: ‘She’s an idiot!’ ‘Aren’t you being a bit harsh?’
examples.zh: “她是个白痴！”“你是不是有点太苛刻了？”

examples.en: a harsh, authoritarian regime
examples.zh: 残酷的独裁政权

words.definition: the repairs, painting etc that are necessary to keep something in good condition; conservation, keep
words.translation: 维护，维修；保持；生活费用；[经]生活费用

examples.en: the cost of repairs and maintenance
examples.zh: 维修保养费

examples.en: The theatres were closed on Saturday and Sunday for routine maintenance .
examples.zh: 戏院周六和周日关闭进行例行维护。

examples.en: Engineers are carrying out essential maintenance work on the main line to Cambridge.
examples.zh: 机修工正在对通往剑桥的干线进行必要的养护。

words.definition: to have a particular weight; view, measure, study, regard, think of; break ground; trade-off
words.translation: 权衡；考虑；称…重量；称重量；重量为…；具有重要性；成为…的重荷；起锚；[计量]称重量

examples.en: The young birds weigh only a few grams.
examples.zh: 雏鸟重量只有几克。

examples.en: Do you know how much it weighs?
examples.zh: 你知道它的重量吗？

examples.en: (= how much ) do you weigh?
examples.zh: 你的体重是多少？

words.definition: if something repels you, it is so unpleasant that you do not want to be near it, or it makes you feel ill; refuse, roll back
words.translation: 击退；抵制；使厌恶；使不愉快

examples.en: The smell repelled him.
examples.zh: 这气味让他反感。

words.definition: a round object with a map of the Earth drawn on it; this earthly round, terra; sphere; conglobate
words.translation: 地球；地球仪；球体；使…成球形；成球状；[天]地球

examples.en: We export our goods all over the globe.
examples.zh: 我们的商品出口到世界各地。

words.definition: to make someone feel happy, interested, or eager; warm, stir up; warm, fire, to agitate
words.translation: 激起；刺激…，使…兴奋；激动

examples.en: His playing is technically brilliant, but it doesn’t excite me.
examples.zh: 他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

words.definition: a type of animal that drinks milk from its mother’s body when it is young. Humans, dogs, and whales are mammals.; suckler
words.translation: [脊椎] 哺乳动物；[脊椎]哺乳动物

examples.en: A whale is a kind of mammal.
examples.zh: 鲸是一种哺乳动物。

examples.en: The whale is a mammal.
examples.zh: 鲸鱼是哺乳动物。

examples.en: The problem with that theory is that no other mammal has resorted to this method of cooling down.
examples.zh: 这一理论的问题在于，没有其他的哺乳动物采取了这种降低体温的方式。

words.definition: to start something, usually something big or important; when a new product, book etc is made available or made known; release, send, project, drive, let go; proceed, start in; emission, shot, sending, projection, loose
words.translation: 发射（导弹、火箭等）；发起，发动；使…下水；发射；发行，投放市场；下水；汽艇；[航]发射（导弹、火箭等）；开始；起飞；[航]发射

examples.en: The organization has launched a campaign to raise $150,000.
examples.zh: 为了筹集15万美元，该组织发起了一场募捐活动。

examples.en: The Canadian police plan to launch an investigation into the deal.
examples.zh: 加拿大警方计划对这宗交易进行调查。

examples.en: The book launched his career as a novelist.
examples.zh: 这本书开启了他的小说创作生涯。

words.definition: to remove unwanted substances from water, air etc by passing it through a special substance or piece of equipment; something that you pass water, air etc through in order to remove unwanted substances and make it clean or suitable to use; sink in, seep into; strainer, percolator; penetrate, lauter
words.translation: 滤过；渗入；慢慢传开；滤波器；[化工] 过滤器；筛选；滤光器；[电子][光]滤波器；[轻][核][化工]过滤器；[轻][核][化工]过滤；渗透；用过滤法除去

examples.en: The water in the tank is constantly filtered.
examples.zh: 鱼缸里的水在不停地被过滤。

examples.en: The ozone layer filters harmful UV rays from the sun.
examples.zh: 臭氧层过滤掉有害的太阳紫外线。

words.definition: someone who votes in a particular area; being one of the parts of something; element, client, component, principal; component, electoral
words.translation: 成分；选民；委托人；构成的；选举的

examples.en: He told his constituents that he would continue to represent them to the best of his ability.
examples.zh: 他告诉他的选民们他会继续竭尽所能代表他们。

words.definition: to accept that you are responsible for a piece of work, and start to do it; accept, pursue, address, try, offer
words.translation: 承担，保证；从事；同意；试图

examples.en: He undertook to pay the money back in six months.
examples.zh: 他保证在六个月之内还钱。

words.definition: having a very thin edge or point that can cut things easily; Sharp is also an adverb; intense, grinding, burning, cutting, quick; suddenly, abruptly; fraud, cusp; grind; dress oneself, trick up
words.translation: 急剧的；锋利的；强烈的；敏捷的；刺耳的；急剧地；锐利地；突然地；尖头；骗子；内行；磨快；把音调升高；打扮；升音演奏

examples.en: Make sure you use a good sharp knife.
examples.zh: 你一定要用锋利的好刀。

examples.en: Its teeth are razor sharp (= very sharp ) .
examples.zh: 它的牙齿非常锋利。

examples.en: Do not cross the bridge but turn sharp left to go down on to the towpath.
examples.zh: 不要过桥，而是向左急转下到纤道上去。

words.definition: if something that happens is a shock, you did not expect it, and it makes you feel very surprised, and usually upset; to make someone feel very surprised and upset, and unable to believe what has happened; blow, stroke, strike, hit; scandalize, astound; bushy, unkempt
words.translation: 休克；震惊；震动；打击；禾束堆；使休克；使震惊；使震动；使受电击；把…堆成禾束堆；浓密的；蓬乱的；[临床]休克；[临床]使休克

examples.en: She was shaking with shock and humiliation.
examples.zh: 她又是震惊，又是羞辱，身体直发抖。

words.definition: to avoid giving a direct answer to a question; a row of small bushes or trees growing close together, usually dividing one field or garden from another; bar, obstacle, dam, let, stop
words.translation: 用树篱笆围住；避免作正面答复；对冲，套期保值；树篱；障碍；[建]树篱

examples.en: You’re hedging again - have you got the money or haven’t you?
examples.zh: 你又在闪烁其词了，你究竟有没有钱？

examples.en: ‘That depends on my partner,’ she hedged.
examples.zh: “那取决于我的合伙人。”她避重就轻地答道。

words.definition: a shop or a part of a shop where medicines are prepared and sold; dispensary, officina
words.translation: 药房；配药学，药剂学；制药业；一批备用药品；[药]配药学，药剂学

examples.en: an all-night pharmacy
examples.zh: 通宵药店

words.definition: a sound made by a vehicle that is travelling fast; bum
words.translation: 急速上升；嗡嗡声；[摄] 变焦摄影；摄像机移动；[摄]变焦摄影

words.definition: the crime of being disloyal to your country or its government, especially by helping its enemies or trying to remove the government using violence; recreancy
words.translation: [法] 叛国罪；不忠；[法]叛国罪

examples.en: The defendant was convicted of high treason (= treason of the worst kind ) and sentenced to death.
examples.zh: 被告被判犯有严重叛国罪，并处以死刑。

words.definition: someone who travels and works in a spacecraft; cosmonaut, spaceman
words.translation: 宇航员，航天员；太空旅行者；[航]宇航员，航天员

words.definition: a substance that is put on the soil to make plants grow; manure
words.translation: [肥料] 肥料；受精媒介物；促进发展者；[肥料]肥料

examples.en: ...farming without any purchased chemical, fertilizer or pesticide.
examples.zh: …不使用任何购买的化学品、肥料或杀虫剂的耕作。

words.definition: a piece of ground or a surface that slopes; if the ground or a surface slopes, it is higher at one end than the other; hill, pitch; pitch, tip up; carry, tip up
words.translation: 斜坡；倾斜；斜率；扛枪姿势；逃走；[数]斜率；使倾斜；扛

examples.en: a steep slope
examples.zh: 陡坡

examples.en: a gentle
examples.zh: 缓坡

examples.en: She looked back up the grassy slope.
examples.zh: 她回头望了一眼那绿草如茵的坡地。

words.definition: a narrow piece of attractive cloth that you use, for example, to tie your hair or hold things together; belt, band, strip
words.translation: 带；缎带；（勋章等的）绶带；带状物；勋表；形成带状；把…撕成条带；用缎带装饰

examples.en: little girls with ribbons in their hair
examples.zh: 头发上系着丝带的小姑娘们

examples.en: a bundle of letters tied with pale blue ribbon
examples.zh: 一捆用淡蓝色丝带扎好的信

examples.en: The ribbon was cut and the new station was officially open.
examples.zh: 剪彩后，新车站正式开始运营。

words.definition: a structure made of wires or bars in which birds or animals can be kept; to put or keep an animal or bird in a cage; prison, jail
words.translation: 笼，兽笼；牢房，监狱；把…关进笼子；把…囚禁起来

examples.en: I hate to see birds in cages.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢看到鸟在笼子里。

words.definition: a fast plane with a jet engine; if a liquid or gas jets out from somewhere, it comes quickly out of a small hole; emission, ejection nozzle; coal-black, jet-black; shoot out, send up
words.translation: 喷射，喷嘴；喷气式飞机；黑玉；墨黑的；射出；[流]喷射，[机]喷嘴；[航]喷气式飞机；[航]乘喷气式飞机

examples.en: He owns a private jet.
examples.zh: 他拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

words.definition: if two things alternate, or if you alternate them, they happen one after the other in a repeated pattern; two alternate things are placed one after the other in a regular pattern; An alternate is a person or thing that replaces another, and can act or be used instead of them; turn by one's, take one's turn; rotate; rotary, vicissitudinary; refill
words.translation: 交替；轮流；交替的；轮流的；替换物；使交替；使轮流；[物]交替的

examples.en: The two patterns alternate over periods of two to seven years in the tropical Pacific.
examples.zh: 在热带的太平洋地区，这两种现象的交替周期超过了两到七年。

examples.en: To make the tiger blink, you alternate the transparency between the two areas by locating both the areas and paths in the corresponding XML.
examples.zh: 要让老虎眨眼，可以通过在相应的 XML 中定位这两个区域及其路径来在两个区域间交替透明性。

examples.en: In most jurisdictions, twelve jurors and two alternates are chosen.
examples.zh: 在大多数审判中，12名陪审员和2名替补人员会被选出。

words.definition: a liquid obtained from petroleum, used mainly for producing power in the engines of cars, trucks etc; gas, benzine
words.translation: 汽油；[油气]汽油

examples.en: A gasoline engine drives the motorboat.
examples.zh: 汽油引擎推动汽船。

examples.en: No cars in Brazil run on pure gasoline anymore. The government requires that all vehicles run on blended fuel of about one-quarter ethanol.
examples.zh: 如今巴西不再使用单纯靠汽油驱动的汽车，政府要求所有机动车均采用含四分之一乙醇的混合燃料。

words.definition: the curved back part of your foot; (of a vessel) to lean over; list; careen
words.translation: 脚后跟；踵；倾侧

examples.en: black boots with high heels
examples.zh: 有高跟的黑靴子

words.definition: the part of a piece of clothing that covers all or part of your arm; arm, connecting
words.translation: [机] 套筒，[机] 套管；袖子，[服装] 袖套；给……装袖子；给……装套筒；套筒，[机]套管；袖子，[服装]袖套

examples.en: a dress with long sleeves
examples.zh: 长袖连衣裙

words.definition: the time at the beginning of the day when light first appears; if day or morning dawns, it begins; morning, origin; come out, break of day
words.translation: 黎明；开端；破晓；出现；被领悟；[天]黎明

examples.en: When dawn broke (= the first light of the day appeared ) , we were still 50 miles from Calcutta.
examples.zh: 破晓的时候，我们离加尔各答还有50英里。

examples.en: I was up at the crack of dawn (= very early in the morning ) to get the plane.
examples.zh: 我一大早就起来赶飞机。

examples.en: We worked from dawn to dusk (= through the whole day while it is light ) .
examples.zh: 我们从早干到晚。
