examples.en: ...fishing tackle.
examples.zh: …渔具。

words.definition: to become red in the face, usually because you are embarrassed; the red colour on your face that appears when you are embarrassed; feel cheap; red, shame
words.translation: 脸红；感到惭愧；红色；羞愧

examples.en: Wilson saw she was watching him and blushed.
examples.zh: 威尔逊看到她在注视着自己，不由得脸红了。

examples.en: Joan blushed at the unexpected compliment.
examples.zh: 这意外的夸奖让琼脸红了。

examples.en: Kate blushed scarlet.
examples.zh: 凯特满脸绯红。

words.definition: relating to the work of missionaries; someone who has been sent to a foreign country to teach people about Christianity and persuade them to become Christians; Boanerges, preacher
words.translation: 传教的；传教士的；传教士

examples.en: missionary work
examples.zh: 传教工作

examples.en: a missionary hospital
examples.zh: 教会医院

words.definition: used to emphasize an angry statement or order; to injure someone so that blood comes, or to cover something with blood; intense, cruel; greatly, quite, badly, far, too
words.translation: 血腥的；非常的；嗜杀的，残忍的；血色的；使流血；很

examples.en: It serves you bloody well right.
examples.zh: 你实在是活该。

words.definition: the opinion that you have about yourself; me, self
words.translation: 自我；自负；自我意识；[心理]自我

examples.en: That promotion really boosted her ego (= made her feel better about herself ).
examples.zh: 那次晋升确实增强了她的自信心。

examples.en: I need someone to massage my bruised ego (= when you feel less confident than before ).
examples.zh: 我需要有人来安抚我受挫的自信心。

examples.en: a fragile ego
examples.zh: 脆弱的自尊心

words.definition: the quality of being brave when you are facing a difficult or dangerous situation or when you are very ill; nerve, heart
words.translation: 勇气；胆量

examples.en: Sue showed great courage throughout her illness.
examples.zh: 休在生病期间表现出了极大的勇气。

examples.en: Driving again after his accident must have taken a lot of courage (= needed courage ) .
examples.zh: 他出事故后再驾车肯定需要很大的勇气。

words.definition: an area of sand or small stones at the edge of the sea or a lake; to pull a boat onto the shore away from the water; seabeach, foreshore; take the ground, make one's pitch
words.translation: 海滩；湖滨；将…拖上岸；[海洋]海滩；搁浅；定居

examples.en: a sandy beach
examples.zh: 沙滩

examples.en: surfers on the beach
examples.zh: 沙滩上的冲浪者

words.definition: a round object with a hard surface, that contains a baby bird, snake, insect etc and which is produced by a female bird, snake, insect etc; to urge or incite, esp to daring or foolish acts; apple, customer, fellow, guy, bird; encourage, fan
words.translation: 蛋；卵子；家伙；鸡蛋；煽动；怂恿；[禽]蛋

examples.en: Blackbirds lay their eggs in March.
examples.zh: 乌鸫在3月产蛋。

examples.en: an ostrich egg
examples.zh: 鸵鸟蛋

examples.en: The eggs hatch (= break open to allow the baby out ) in 26 days.
examples.zh: 这些蛋要26天才能孵化。

words.definition: the natural outer layer of a person’s or animal’s body; to remove the skin from an animal, fruit, or vegetable; dermis, cutis; shell, decorticate; heal over, close up
words.translation: 皮肤；外皮；剥皮；[解剖]皮肤；愈合；长皮

examples.en: She had thick black hair and smooth dark skin.
examples.zh: 她一头浓密的黑发，皮肤黝黑光滑。

examples.en: The skin on his hands was dry and rough.
examples.zh: 他手上的皮肤干燥粗糙。

words.definition: to remove something from the surface of a liquid, especially floating fat, solids, or oil; conceal, hold back; page, brush; nonfat, defatted
words.translation: 略读；撇去…的浮物；从…表面飞掠而过；去除；（为逃税而）隐瞒（部分收入）；撇；撇去的东西；表层物；瞒报所得的收入；脱脂的；撇去浮沫的；表层的；浏览；掠过

examples.en: Julie skimmed the sports page.
examples.zh: 朱莉浏览了体育版。

words.definition: to regularly travel a long distance to get to work; A commute is the journey that you make when you commute; exchange for, give for
words.translation: （搭乘车、船等）通勤；代偿；通勤（口语）；减刑；[数]交换；用……交换；使……变成

examples.en: Baldry’s 20-year prison sentence was commuted to three years.
examples.zh: 鲍德里二十年的刑期被减至三年。

examples.en: The average Los Angeles commute is over 60 miles a day.
examples.zh: 洛杉矶平均通勤路程每天超过60英里。

words.definition: very good; brilliant, excellent, wonderful, famous, prominent
words.translation: 辉煌的；灿烂的；极好的；杰出的

examples.en: a splendid idea
examples.zh: 很妙的主意

examples.en: a splendid opportunity
examples.zh: 绝佳的机会

examples.en: The staff are doing a splendid job.
examples.zh: 员工们干得非常棒。

words.definition: someone who is not at all brave; chicken, molly; timid, harehearted
words.translation: 懦夫，懦弱的人；胆小的，懦怯的

examples.en: Try it. Don’t be such a coward.
examples.zh: 试一下，别那么胆小。

words.definition: to shout or say something very loudly, especially because you are frightened, angry, or excited; a loud shout; scream out, shout out; cry, wow
words.translation: 大叫，叫喊；喊声，叫声

examples.en: ‘Help me!’ she yelled hysterically.
examples.zh: “救救我！”她歇斯底里地大叫。

examples.en: I yelled out, ‘Here I am!’
examples.zh: 我大声喊道:“我在这儿！”

examples.en: The crowd are on their feet yelling.
examples.zh: 观众站着高声呐喊。

words.definition: a structure from which water is pushed up into the air, used for example as decoration in a garden or park; principle, well
words.translation: 喷泉，泉水；源泉；[地质]喷泉，泉水

examples.en: He was a fountain of information on Asian affairs.
examples.zh: 他是亚洲事务的信息源。

words.definition: an offence in football, hockey etc in which a player gets between an opponent and the ball; intervention, prevention, let, bar, dam
words.translation: 障碍；阻碍；妨碍；[化学]阻碍

examples.en: John was irritated by drivers parking near his house and causing an obstruction.
examples.zh: 约翰被众司机在他房子附近停车而造成阻塞所激怒。

words.definition: if you are redundant, your employer no longer has a job for you; spare, unnecessary, surplus, waste, superfluous
words.translation: 多余的，过剩的；被解雇的，失业的；冗长的，累赘的；[计]多余的，过剩的

examples.en: Seventy factory workers were made redundant in the resulting cuts.
examples.zh: 在继而发生的裁员中，70名工厂工人被解雇。

words.definition: a thin piece of material that women wear to cover their faces at formal occasions or for religious reasons; to cover something with a veil; yashmak, facemask; shadow, shield, curtain
words.translation: 面纱；面罩；遮蔽物；托词；遮蔽；掩饰；以面纱遮掩；用帷幕分隔；[服装]面罩

examples.en: She lifted her veil with both hands.
examples.zh: 她用双手揭开面纱。

examples.en: a bridal veil
examples.zh: 新娘的面纱

words.definition: the most important parts of something, to which more detail can be added later; framework, cadre; boned, scrawny
words.translation: 骨架，骨骼；纲要；骨瘦如柴的人；骨骼的；骨瘦如柴的；概略的；[测][建]骨架，[解剖]骨骼；[解剖]骨骼的

examples.en: We agreed on a skeleton outline of the proposal.
examples.zh: 我们给提案商定了一个基本框架。

words.definition: to stop yourself feeling thirsty, by drinking something; conclude, go out; die, cool, go out
words.translation: 熄灭，[机] 淬火；解渴；结束；冷浸；熄灭，[机]淬火；熄灭；平息

examples.en: We stopped at a small bar to quench our thirst.
examples.zh: 我们在一家小酒吧停下来喝点东西解渴。

words.definition: one of the tubes which carries blood to your heart from other parts of your body; vessel, texture, grain, nerve, disposition
words.translation: 血管；叶脉；[地质] 岩脉；纹理；翅脉；性情；使成脉络；象脉络般分布于；[植]叶脉；[地质]岩脉；[木]纹理；[昆]翅脉

examples.en: the pulmonary vein
examples.zh: 肺静脉

examples.en: She felt the blood racing through her veins as they kissed.
examples.zh: 他们接吻时她觉得热血沸腾。

words.definition: an official limit on the number or amount of something that is allowed in a particular period; norm, allowance
words.translation: 配额；定额；限额；[经管]定额；[经]限额

examples.en: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
examples.zh: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

examples.en: There are plans to introduce strict immigration quotas.
examples.zh: 有计划要推行严格的移民限额制度。

words.definition: to praise someone in order to please them or get something from them, even though you do not mean it; please, glad, satisfy
words.translation: 奉承；谄媚；使高兴

examples.en: Perry would always flatter Mrs. Mitchell by praising her cooking.
examples.zh: 佩里常常奉承米切尔太太，称赞她的烹调手艺。

words.definition: a decimal system is based on the number 10; a  fraction (= a number less than 1 )  that is shown as a  full stop  followed by the number of  tenth s  ,  hundredth s  etc. The numbers 0.5, 0.175, and 0.661 are decimals.; fractional; small number, haet
words.translation: 小数的；十进位的；小数；[数]十进位的；[数]小数

examples.en: changing to a decimal system
examples.zh: 改为十进制

examples.en: calculations accurate to three decimal places
examples.zh: 精确到小数点后三位的计算

words.definition: a sour-tasting liquid made from malt or wine that is used to improve the taste of food or to preserve it; acetum
words.translation: 醋；[食品]醋

examples.en: The  sugared  vinegar is  refined from the sugarcane and  pine.
examples.zh: 加糖的醋是从甘蔗和松木中精炼出来的.

examples.en: To make the red-wine vinaigrette, whisk together the oil, vinegar and mustard in a medium bowl until well combined.
examples.zh: 制作红酒醋油沙司，将油、醋和芥末放在一个中等大小的碗里一起搅拌，直到混合均匀。

examples.en: In cooking, vinegar can be used alone or to add flavor without calories to our food, but what will it do if we use it on our hair?
examples.zh: 在烹饪中，醋可以单独食用，也可以用作食物调味料不附加任何卡路里，但如果我们把它涂抹到头发上呢？

words.definition: a set of clothes worn by an actor or by someone to make them look like something such as an animal, famous person etc; clothing, wear, garment, apparel
words.translation: 服装，装束；戏装，剧装；给…穿上服装；[服装]服装，装束

examples.en: the film’s lavish costumes and spectacular sets
examples.zh: 影片中奢华的戏装和壮观的场景

examples.en: Hallowe’en costumes
examples.zh: 万圣节前夕化装服

words.definition: someone who steals things from another person or place; pilferer, ganef
words.translation: 小偷，贼

examples.en: Thieves broke into the offices and stole $150,000’s worth of computer equipment.
examples.zh: 小偷破门进入办公室，偷走了价值15万美元的电脑设备。

examples.en: They were nothing but petty thieves (= thieves who steal small things ) .
examples.zh: 他们只不过是小毛贼。

words.definition: a bird that looks like a large chicken and is often eaten at Christmas and at Thanksgiving; simple, put
words.translation: 火鸡；笨蛋；失败之作

examples.en: roast turkey
examples.zh: 烤火鸡

words.definition: a light cloud low over the ground that makes it difficult for you to see very far; gauze; fog; fog, obfuscate
words.translation: 薄雾；视线模糊不清；模糊不清之物；下雾；变模糊；[气象]薄雾；使模糊；使蒙上薄雾

examples.en: We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.
examples.zh: 薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。

examples.en: He vanished into the mist.
examples.zh: 他消失在雾中。

examples.en: The hills were shrouded in mist (= covered in mist, so that you could not see them ) .
examples.zh: 山峦笼罩在雾霭之中。

words.definition: a structure with a curved top and straight sides that supports the weight of a bridge or building; to form or make something form a curved shape; lune; primary, major, central, main, leading; hog
words.translation: 弓形，拱形；拱门；主要的；使…弯成弓形；用拱连接；拱起；成为弓形

examples.en: When she passed under the arch leading out of the park, Mira whooped with delight.
examples.zh: 从通向公园外的拱门下走过时，米拉高兴地喊叫起来。

words.definition: a load of goods sent by sea, road, or air, or the act of sending them; loading
words.translation: 装货；装载的货物

examples.en: The goods are ready for shipment.
examples.zh: 货物已经准备好装运。

words.definition: cold and without any pleasant or comfortable features; raw, wild, flat, frozen, blank
words.translation: 阴冷的；荒凉的，无遮蔽的；黯淡的，无希望的；冷酷的；单调的

examples.en: a bleak January afternoon
examples.zh: 一月里一个阴冷的下午

examples.en: The landscape was bleak.
examples.zh: 景色一片凄凉。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that food is cooked inside, shaped like a metal box with a door on the front; furance, kiln
words.translation: 炉，灶；烤炉，烤箱；[炉窑]炉，灶

examples.en: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C.
examples.zh: 把烤箱预热至200摄氏度。

examples.en: Press the mixture onto the bread and bake in a hot oven for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 把混合料抹在面包上，然后在烤箱内高温烘烤10分钟。

words.definition: when someone pretends to have certain beliefs or opinions that they do not really have – used to show disapproval; untruthfulness, falsity
words.translation: 虚伪；伪善

examples.en: It would be sheer hypocrisy to pray for success, since I’ve never believed in God.
examples.zh: 我从不相信上帝，因此为获成功而祈祷是纯粹的虚伪之举。

words.definition: to send out gas, liquid, smoke etc, or to allow it to escape; when gas, liquid, smoke etc is sent out, or the substance that is sent out; issue, forgive; issue, shed; firing, dismissal
words.translation: 解雇；卸下；放出；免除；排放；卸货；[劳经]解雇；[环境]排放；[流]流出

examples.en: Hospitals now tend to discharge patients earlier than in the past.
examples.zh: 与过去相比，现在医院更趋向于让病人早些出院。

words.definition: something unimportant or not valuable; cake, bit; fool, kid around; lose, spend, moon, fool away
words.translation: 琐事；蛋糕；少量；开玩笑；闲混；嘲弄；浪费；虚度

examples.en: There’s no point in arguing over trifles.
examples.zh: 为琐事争吵毫无意义。

words.definition: an animal or plant produced by scientists from one cell of another animal or plant, so that they are exactly the same; to make an exact copy of a plant or animal by taking a cell from it and developing it artificially; klon, asexual propagation; repeat, to duplicate
words.translation: 克隆；无性系；无性繁殖；靠营养生殖而由母体分离繁殖的植物；无性繁殖，复制；[生物]克隆；[植][农学][遗]无性系；[遗]无性繁殖，复制

words.definition: to accidentally break the surface of your skin by rubbing it against something; a wound caused by rubbing that slightly breaks the surface of your skin; grass, feed, raw, range; brush burn; pasturage
words.translation: 放牧；擦伤；轻擦；吃草

examples.en: I fell on the gravel, severely grazing my knee.
examples.zh: 我摔倒在砾石路上，膝盖擦伤得很严重。

words.definition: February is the second month of the year in the Western calendar
words.translation: 二月

examples.en: He joined the Army in February 1943.
examples.zh: 他1943年2月参军。

examples.en: His exhibition opens on February 5.
examples.zh: 他的展览2月5日开幕。

words.definition: electrical force measured in volts; electric tension, electrical pressure
words.translation: [电] 电压；[电]电压

examples.en: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
examples.zh: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

words.definition: instrumental music is for instruments, not for voices; a piece of music in which no voices are used, only instruments; helpful, useful, assistant
words.translation: 乐器的；有帮助的；仪器的，器械的；器乐曲；工具字，工具格

examples.en: ...a CD of vocal and instrumental music.
examples.zh: …一张声乐和器乐光盘。

words.definition: the hand when it is tightly closed, so that the fingers are curled in towards the  palm  . People close their hand in a fist when they are angry or are going to hit someone.; writing, calligraphy; squeeze, grip
words.translation: 拳，拳头；〈口〉笔迹；掌握；[印]指标参见号；紧握；握成拳；用拳打；拳头；笔迹；拳打

examples.en: She held the money tightly in her fist.
examples.zh: 她把钱紧紧地攥在手中。

examples.en: Malcolm clenched his fist (= held his fist very tightly closed ) angrily.
examples.zh: 马尔科姆愤怒地握紧拳头。

examples.en: Dooley stood up and shook his fist in her face.
examples.zh: 杜利站起身，在她眼前挥舞着拳头。

words.definition: to fasten or close something by turning it, or to be fastened in this way; a thin pointed piece of metal that you push and turn in order to fasten pieces of metal or wood together; force, enforce; spiral, helix; turn, roll
words.translation: 旋，拧；压榨；强迫；螺旋；螺丝钉；吝啬鬼；[机]螺丝钉；转动，拧

examples.en: "Yes, I know that," Kelly said, screwing the silencer onto the pistol.
examples.zh: “是的，我知道那事。”凯利一边把消音器拧到手枪上一边说道。

words.definition: the top part of your leg, between your knee and your  hip; upper leg
words.translation: 大腿，股；[解剖]大腿，股

examples.en: chicken thighs
examples.zh: 鸡腿

words.definition: very bad - used, for example, about things you see, taste, or smell, or about the weather; terrible, awesome, fearful, dire, dreadful
words.translation: 可怕的；极讨厌的

examples.en: The weather has been really horrible all week.
examples.zh: 整个星期天气都很糟。

examples.en: a horrible smell
examples.zh: 极难闻的气味

examples.en: The food looked horrible, but it tasted OK.
examples.zh: 那食物看上去很糟，可吃起来还不错。

words.definition: the thick dark liquid from under the ground from which petrol is produced; to put oil onto part of a machine or part of something that moves, to help it to move or work more smoothly; petroleum, geoline; gas, melt; thaw out
words.translation: 油；石油；油画颜料；加油；涂油；使融化；[油脂]油；融化；加燃油

examples.en: a rise in the price of oil
examples.zh: 石油价格的上涨

examples.en: the importance of protecting our oil supplies
examples.zh: 保护我们石油供应的重要性

examples.en: an oil refinery
examples.zh: 炼油厂

words.definition: a weapon that can fly over long distances and that explodes when it hits the thing it has been aimed at; dejectile
words.translation: 导弹；投射物；导弹的；可投掷的；用以发射导弹的；[航][军]导弹

examples.en: a nuclear missile
examples.zh: 核导弹

examples.en: a missile attack
examples.zh: 导弹袭击

words.definition: to give someone their money back, especially because they are not satisfied with the goods or services they have paid for; an amount of money that is given back to you if you are not satisfied with the goods or services that you have paid for; return, hand back; replace, tender; payment, repayment
words.translation: 退还；偿还，归还；退款；偿还，偿还额；[金融]偿还，归还；[金融]偿还；付还；[金融]偿还，[会计]偿还额

examples.en: I took the radio back, and they refunded my money .
examples.zh: 我把收音机送回去，他们给我退了款。

words.definition: covered in or full of water or another liquid; the rain; to make something wet; humid, moisty; humidity, a rainy day; moisten, bemoisten
words.translation: [气象][物] 潮湿的；有雨的；雨天；湿气；弄湿；[气象][物]潮湿的

examples.en: I’ve washed your shirt but it’s still wet.
examples.zh: 我把你的衬衫洗过了，不过现在还是湿的。

examples.en: wet grass
examples.zh: 湿草地

examples.en: The man in the boat was wet through (= completely wet ).
examples.zh: 船上的那人浑身湿透。

words.definition: a substance consisting of very small pieces of rocks and minerals, that forms beaches and deserts; to make a surface smooth by rubbing it with  sandpaper  or using a special piece of equipment; dene, hurst
words.translation: 沙；沙地；沙洲；沙滩；沙子；撒沙于；以沙掩盖；用砂纸等擦平或磨光某物；使撒沙似地布满；给…掺沙子；[土壤]沙

examples.en: a mixture of sand and cement
examples.zh: 沙和水泥的混合物

examples.en: I have sand in my shoe.
examples.zh: 我的鞋里有沙子。

words.definition: a set of steps built for going from one level of a building to another; step, ladder
words.translation: 楼梯，阶梯；梯级；[建]梯级

examples.en: We walked up four flights of stairs (= sets of stairs ) .
examples.zh: 我们往上走了四段楼梯。

words.definition: a mass of very small drops of a liquid which float in the air, for example because the liquid has been heated
words.translation: 蒸气（等于vapor）；水蒸气

examples.en: water vapour
examples.zh: 水蒸气

words.definition: if you unify two or more parts or things, or if they unify, they are combined to make a single unit; accord, reconcile
words.translation: 统一；使相同，使一致

examples.en: Strong support for the war has unified the nation.
examples.zh: 对战争的坚决支持使这个国家团结了起来。

examples.en: His music unifies traditional and modern themes.
examples.zh: 他的音乐结合了传统和现代的主题。

words.definition: an inland area, city etc is not near the coast; in a direction away from the coast and towards the centre of a country; hinterland, outback; internal, domestic, home; inwardly, inclusively
words.translation: 内地；内陆；内陆的；内地的；国内的；在内地；向内地；向内陆；在内陆；[地理]内陆；[地理]内陆的；[地理]向内陆

examples.en: The next day, we drove inland.
examples.zh: 第二天，我们乘车开往内陆。

examples.en: We beached the boat and headed inland.
examples.zh: 我们想使船靠岸，朝内陆方向驶去。

examples.en: In 1985 a glacier buried this shore; since then the ice has retreated a half mile inland.
examples.zh: 1985年，一座冰川在海滨融化，自那时起冰川已经向内陆退缩了半英里。

words.definition: Hydrogen is a colourless gas that is the lightest and commonest element in the universe
words.translation: [化学] 氢

examples.en: Water contains hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 水含有氢和氧。

examples.en: Water can be reduced to oxygen and hydrogen by electrolysis.
examples.zh: 水通过电解可以分解为氧和氢。

examples.en: The first bubbles to escape from the liquid are a mixture of air and hydrogen.
examples.zh: 从该液体中最先逸出的气泡是空气和氢的混合物。

words.definition: able to learn and understand things quickly; intelligent, experienced, wise, skilled, smart
words.translation: 聪明的；机灵的；熟练的

examples.en: a clever man
examples.zh: 聪明的人

words.definition: if animals breed, they  mate  in order to have babies; a type of animal that is kept as a pet or on a farm; increase, result; attract, keep, school, cause, mother; category, variety, manner, nature, description
words.translation: 繁殖；饲养；产生；[生物] 品种；种类，类型；养育，教育；引起；[生物]品种

examples.en: Eagles breed during the cooler months of the year.
examples.zh: 鹰在一年中较凉爽的季节交配繁殖。

words.definition: if something invariably happens or is invariably true, it always happens or is true; always, toujours
words.translation: 总是；不变地；一定地

examples.en: It invariably rains when I go there.
examples.zh: 我每次去那儿都下雨。

examples.en: The security guards were invariably ex-servicemen.
examples.zh: 保安人员毫无例外地都是退伍军人。

words.definition: a table or a small shop with an open front, especially outdoors, where goods are sold; if an engine or vehicle stalls, or if you stall it, it stops because there is not enough power or speed to keep it going; booth, concession stand; desist from, come to a stop; prolong, drag on
words.translation: 货摊；畜栏；托辞；停止，停转；拖延；[贸易]货摊；使停转；使陷于泥中

examples.en: a market stall
examples.zh: 市场摊位

words.definition: a storm with strong winds and a lot of snow; blizzard, stormy weather
words.translation: 暴风雪；雪暴；[气象]雪暴

examples.en: The snowstorm added to our difficulties.
examples.zh: 暴风雪增加了我们的困难。

examples.en: From beneath, it was at times like gazing into a snowstorm. It was hard not to think of souls.
examples.zh: 从下面往上看时，就像在暴风雪中抬头看到的一样，让人不禁想起了逝去的那些亡灵。

examples.en: I step outside the house and nothing can stop me—the late season snowstorm, the puddle of standing water at the bottom of my porch steps that will never evaporate, the mud and muck this season brings.
examples.zh: 我踏出家门，没有任何事情能阻挡我——深冬季节的暴风雪、我家门廊台阶上那永远挥散不去的雨水坑，还有这个季节带来的烂泥和污秽。

words.definition: the real or imaginary line that marks the edge of a state, country etc, or the edge of an area of land that belongs to someone; region, extent, spectrum, territory, area
words.translation: 边界；范围；分界线；[地质]边界

examples.en: National boundaries are becoming increasingly meaningless in the global economy.
examples.zh: 在全球经济中，国界已经变得越来越没有意义。

examples.en: We would need their agreement to build outside the city boundary .
examples.zh: 我们在市界以外的地方建房需要他们批准。

examples.en: The stream curves round to mark the boundary of his property.
examples.zh: 小河打了个弯，为他这块地划出了边界。

words.definition: A Negro is someone with dark skin who comes from Africa or whose ancestors came from Africa; relating to or characteristic of Negroes
words.translation: 黑人；黑人的

examples.en: Slavery was “an unqualified evil to the negro, the white man, and the State,” said Abraham Lincoln in the 1850s.
examples.zh: 奴隶制，“对于黑人、白人与合众国来说都是一种彻底的邪恶，”1850年林肯如此说道。

words.definition: a short time during which someone stops speaking or doing something before starting again; to stop speaking or doing something for a short time before starting again; hang, moratorium; stop, time out
words.translation: 暂停；间歇；暂停，停顿，中止；踌躇

examples.zh: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。

examples.en: After a long pause , she went on.
examples.zh: 停了好一会儿，她才继续下去。

words.definition: a long stick or post usually made of wood or metal, often set upright in the ground to support something; to push a boat along in the water using a pole; electrode, climax
words.translation: 杆；极点；电极；用竿支撑；[建]杆

examples.en: a telephone pole
examples.zh: 电话线杆

words.definition: causing problems, in an annoying way; tight, evil, rank, unpleasant

examples.zh: 烦人的孩子

examples.en: troublesome itching
examples.zh: 难受的痒

words.definition: Oval things have a shape that is like a circle but is wider in one direction than the other; a shape like a circle, but wider in one direction than the other; elliptical, ovate; ellipse, elliptical shape
words.translation: 椭圆的；卵形的；椭圆形；卵形；[数]卵形的；[数]卵形

examples.en: ...the small oval framed picture of a little boy.
examples.zh: …一个小男孩的镶在椭圆形框架里的小幅照片。

words.definition: a sharp pain in your eyes or skin, caused by being hit, by smoke etc; if an insect or a plant stings you, it makes a very small hole in your skin and you feel a sharp pain because of a poisonous substance; stimulus, smart, incentive, excitement, hit; stick, pink; smart, bite

examples.zh: 她感觉泪水刺痛了眼睛。

words.definition: to press something or make it smaller so that it takes up less space, or to become smaller; impact, pack
words.translation: 受压缩小；压缩，压紧；精简

examples.en: Light silk is best for parachutes, as it compresses well and then expands rapidly.
examples.zh: 轻质丝绸最适合制作降落伞，因为这种面料便于压缩，而且展开迅速。

examples.en: Isobel nodded, her lips compressed.
examples.zh: 伊索贝尔紧闭着双唇点了点头。

examples.en: The miners used rock drills and compressed air to drive through hard rock.
examples.zh: 矿工使用钻岩机和压缩空气来凿穿坚硬的岩石。

words.definition: a medical condition that makes you cough a lot; to suddenly push air out of your throat with a short sound, often repeatedly; tussis, ough; hawk
words.translation: 咳嗽，咳嗽声；咳嗽病；咳出；[临床]咳嗽，咳嗽声；[临床]咳嗽

examples.en: He’s got a bad cough.
examples.zh: 他咳嗽得很厉害。

examples.en: Symptoms include a sore throat and dry cough.
examples.zh: 症状是喉咙痛和干咳。

examples.en: cough medicine
examples.zh: 止咳药

words.definition: tidy and carefully arranged; elegant, flowing, graceful
words.translation: 灵巧的；整洁的；优雅的；齐整的；未搀水的；平滑的

examples.en: neat handwriting
examples.zh: 工整的笔迹

examples.zh: 他的衣服总是很整洁。

examples.en: Everything in the house was neat and tidy.
examples.zh: 房子里的每样物品都干净整齐。

words.definition: a long narrow part of a plant that supports leaves, fruits, or flowers; to walk in a proud or angry way, with long steps; stem, tracking, handle; trail, follow up on; move in on
words.translation: （植物的）茎，秆；（支持叶子、果实和花的）梗，柄；追踪；高视阔步；追踪，潜近；（支持叶子、果实和花的）[植]梗，[生物]柄；高视阔步地走；潜近，偷偷接近

examples.en: celery stalks
examples.zh: 芹菜茎

words.definition: bread or cake that is stale is no longer fresh or good to eat; banal, trite; urinate; urine, emiction

examples.zh: 法式面包极易变味。

examples.en: stale cake
examples.zh: 不新鲜的蛋糕

words.definition: a natural white mineral that is added to food to make it taste better or to preserve it; preserved with salt; to add salt to food to make it taste better; pungency; saliferous, brackish

examples.en: This might need some salt and pepper.
examples.zh: 这里面也许要加点盐和胡椒粉。

examples.en: a pinch of salt
examples.zh: 一撮盐

examples.en: Could you pass the salt?
examples.zh: 递一下盐好吗？

words.definition: the standard unit of money in Britain, which is divided into 100 pence; If you pound something, you crush it into a paste or a powder or into very small pieces; prison, devel; hold, prison; drive, belt
words.translation: 英镑；重击，重击声；兽栏；拘留所；捣烂；敲打；监禁，拘留；连续重击，猛击

examples.en: They spent over a thousand pounds.
examples.zh: 他们花了一千多英镑。

examples.en: a multi-million pound business
examples.zh: 一笔几百万英镑的生意

examples.en: a five pound note
examples.zh: 五英镑的纸币

words.definition: the part of your body that joins your head to your shoulders, or the same part of an animal or bird; if two people are necking, they kiss for a long time in a sexual way; narrow, channel, sound, collar
words.translation: 脖子；衣领；海峡；搂著脖子亲吻；变狭窄

examples.zh: 迈克揉了揉后颈。

examples.en: You have a lot of tension in your neck muscles.
examples.zh: 你的颈部肌肉很紧张。

examples.en: He patted his horse’s neck.
examples.zh: 他拍了拍马脖子。

words.definition: to make an object such as a ball move quickly through the air by pushing your hand forward quickly and letting the object go; an action in which someone throws something; cast, pitch; pitch; putting, cast, risk, venture, adventure
words.translation: 投；抛；掷；投掷；冒险

examples.zh: 公共汽车猛地停住，我们都往前栽。

words.translation: 筑成池塘；池塘；[水文]池塘

examples.zh: 小路下斜通到池塘。

examples.zh: 这个池塘在冬天常常结冰。

examples.zh: 各种野花和野草环绕着这个小池塘。

words.definition: a small piece of paper that you buy and stick onto an envelope or package before posting it; to put your foot down onto the ground loudly and with a lot of force; symbol, impression, print, seal, flag; brand, heart; break down, go to sticks and staves

examples.zh: 一枚 29 美分的邮票

examples.en: Richard collects stamps.
examples.zh: 理查德集邮。

examples.en: a second-class stamp
examples.zh: 一张二类邮件的邮票

words.definition: to cook something, such as meat, in an  oven  or over a fire, or to cook in this way; roasted; a large piece of roasted meat; torrefy, bake; broil, toast; baking, broiled; bulgogi, bar-b-q

examples.zh: 这鸡你是准备烤的吗？

examples.zh: 烤肉的香味

examples.zh: 我们捉到一只兔子，放在火上烧烤。

words.definition: the main building or offices used by a large company or organization; command, main office
words.translation: 总部；指挥部；司令部

examples.zh: 联合国总部

words.translation: 到来；到达；到达者

examples.zh: 警方及时赶到才阻止了事态恶化。

examples.en: Traffic problems account for one third of late arrivals.
examples.zh: 迟到的人有三分之一是因为交通问题。

words.translation: 手帕；头巾，围巾

examples.zh: 打扫房屋前， 她把头发用一块大手帕扎起来。

words.translation: 胃；腹部；胃口；忍受；吃下；[解剖]腹部

examples.zh: 我饿得胃都痛了。

examples.en: His stomach was full of food.
examples.zh: 他的胃里塞满了食物。

words.definition: a feeling of great sadness, usually because someone has died or because something terrible has happened to you; to feel or express sorrow; soreness, disconsolateness; feel sad
words.translation: 悲伤；懊悔；伤心事；遗憾；感到悲伤

examples.en: the family’s joys and sorrows
examples.zh: 这家人的喜与悲

words.definition: a vehicle or ship specially built to carry large quantities of gas or liquid, especially oil
words.translation: 油轮；运油飞机；油槽车；坦克手

examples.zh: 一艘希腊油轮已经搁浅了。

words.definition: to turn with a circular movement around a central point, or to make something do this; wheel, circle, spin; turn, spin, swing
words.translation: 旋转；循环；[植] 辐状的；使旋转；使转动；使轮流

examples.en: The Earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours.
examples.zh: 地球每24小时绕地轴自转一周。

examples.en: Rotate the pan halfway through the baking time.
examples.zh: 烘烤到一半时把盘子转一下。

words.definition: Something that is an integral part of something is an essential part of that thing; whole, complete, full, intact; proportion, part, portion, percent, fraction
words.translation: 积分的；完整的，整体的；构成整体所必须的；积分；部分；完整；[数]积分的；[数]积分

examples.zh: 仪式、庆典和节日是每个人类社会不可缺少的组成部分。

words.definition: a type of food made from flour and water that is mixed together and then baked; living, keep, livelihood
words.translation: 面包；生计；在…上洒面包屑

examples.en: Would you like some bread with your soup?
examples.zh: 你喝汤时要吃点面包吗？

examples.en: a loaf of brown bread
examples.zh: 一条黑面包

examples.en: a piece of bread and butter
examples.zh: 一块黄油面包

words.definition: a small flat plastic case containing  magnetic tape  , that can be used for playing or recording sound
words.translation: 盒式磁带；暗盒；珠宝箱；片匣

examples.en: His two albums released on cassette have sold 10 million copies.
examples.zh: 他以磁带形式发行的两张专辑已售出1000万份。

words.definition: a metal blade fixed into a handle, used for cutting or as a weapon; to put a knife into someone’s body; sword, chiv; injure, scar; to break open
words.translation: 刀；匕首；用刀切；（口）伤害；[机]刀；劈开；划过

examples.en: a knife and fork
examples.zh: 一副刀叉

examples.en: Some young people are carrying knives to defend themselves.
examples.zh: 一些年轻人带着刀子防身。

examples.en: a kitchen knife
examples.zh: 厨房用刀

words.definition: a type of insect that has large wings, often with beautiful colours; scalewing, papilio
words.translation: 蝴蝶；蝶泳；举止轻浮的人；追求享乐的人；[昆]蝴蝶

examples.en: Gwen’s a real social butterfly .
examples.zh: 格温是个十足的交际花。

words.definition: if a sound or remark rings in your ears, you continue to remember it very clearly, exactly as it sounded, after it has finished; a piece of jewellery that you wear on your finger; sound; bell, annulus; invest, case
words.translation: 按铃；敲钟；回响；成环形；戒指；铃声，钟声；拳击场；环形物；包围；套住

examples.zh: 他离开了华盛顿，总统的赞扬还在他耳际回响。

words.definition: someone’s welfare is their health and happiness; Welfare services are provided to help with people's living conditions and financial problems; happiness, weal
words.translation: 福利；幸福；福利事业；安宁；福利的；接受社会救济的

examples.en: Our only concern is the children’s welfare.
examples.zh: 我们唯一关心的是孩子们的幸福。

examples.en: Child welfare services are well established and comprehensive.
examples.zh: 儿童福利机构发展成熟、体系完善。

words.definition: the place that someone or something is going to; goal, end-point
words.translation: 目的地，终点；[计]目的地，终点

examples.en: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
examples.zh: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

words.definition: a substance such as air, which is not solid or liquid, and usually cannot be seen; gasoline, wase; oil, to fill the tank; to fill the tank, Pump It
words.translation: 气体；[矿业] 瓦斯；汽油；毒气；加油；毒（死）；[矿业]瓦斯；放出气体；空谈

examples.en: hydrogen gas
examples.zh: 氢气

words.definition: cheerful and excited; someone who is homosexual, especially a man; festival, cheerful, enjoyable; homosexual person, homophile
words.translation: 快乐的；放荡的；艳丽的；同性恋者

examples.en: She felt excited and quite gay.
examples.zh: 她感到兴奋而快活。

words.definition: a large printed notice, picture, or photograph, used to advertise something or as a decoration; advertisement, bill, publicity
words.translation: 海报，广告；招贴；[印刷]招贴

examples.en: A team of volunteers were putting up posters .
examples.zh: 一队志愿者正在张贴海报。

examples.en: a poster campaign for the election
examples.zh: 选举的海报宣传

words.definition: a large quantity of something; plenty, pregnancy, amplitude, enrichment
words.translation: 充裕，丰富；充裕，[地化]丰富

examples.zh: 墨西哥的这个地区有大量的安全沙滩与宜人的气候。

words.translation: 蚊子

examples.zh: 雄蚊不叮。

examples.en: Are your mosquito bites still itching?
examples.zh: 你被蚊子咬的地方还痒吗?

examples.en: The frog darted out its tongue to catch a mosquito.
examples.zh: 这只青蛙突然伸出舌头捕捉蚊子。

words.translation: 暴乱；放纵；蔓延；骚乱；放荡；浪费，挥霍

examples.zh: 城市骚乱

examples.zh: 监狱暴乱

examples.zh: 他的被杀引发了严重的种族骚乱。

examples.zh: 高温和香槟酒使他感到眩晕。

examples.zh: 她开始感到一阵阵的眩晕。

words.translation: 橡树；橡木色；橡木家具；栎树的；栎木制的；[植]栎树的

words.definition: turning in a circle around a fixed point, like a wheel; rolling, revolutionary

examples.en: the rotary movement of the helicopter blades
examples.zh: 直升机螺旋桨叶的转动

words.definition: a long pole with a wide flat blade at one end, used for rowing a boat; rower, yuloh; gondole

words.definition: a journey in a plane or space vehicle, or the plane or vehicle that is making the journey; fly, liner; pot, take a shot at

examples.zh: 他当即就订了去图卢兹的航班。

examples.zh: 希思罗机场每天只有三趟飞往洛根机场的航班。

words.translation: 壶；[化工] 釜；罐；鼓；[轻]壶；[化工]釜

examples.en: She filled the kettle and switched it on.
examples.zh: 她把水壶灌满，打开了开关。

examples.en: The kettle’s boiling (= the water in it is boiling ).
examples.zh: 水壶里的水开了。

examples.en: (= start boiling water in a kettle ), will you?
examples.zh: 烧壶水，好吗？

words.definition: ripe fruit or crops are fully grown and ready to eat; developed, mature, adult; examine, survey
words.translation: 熟的，成熟的；时机成熟的；搜查；调查；进行搜查；(Ripe)人名；(意、瑞典)里佩；[植][医]熟的，成熟的

examples.en: Those tomatoes aren’t ripe yet.
examples.zh: 那些番茄还没熟。

words.definition: a place where young children are taken care of during the day while their parents are at work; soil, nest
words.translation: 苗圃；托儿所；温床；[林]苗圃

examples.en: She puts her baby in this nursery and then goes back to work.
examples.zh: 她把孩子送到这家托儿所然后回去上班。

words.definition: the daughter of your brother or sister, or the daughter of your wife’s or husband’s brother or sister
words.translation: 外甥女，侄女

examples.en: ...his niece, the daughter of his eldest sister.
examples.zh: …他的外甥女，他大姐的女儿。

words.definition: shelter or protection from someone or something; haven, shadow, home, harbor, umbrella; get out of, run from

words.definition: a meal at a party or other occasion, in which people serve themselves at a table and then move away to eat; if something, especially wind, rain, or the sea, buffets something, it hits it with a lot of force; blow, stroke, shock, strike, hit; breast, be at grips with; fight, struggle (with); self-help

examples.zh: 他捏了捏她的手，她笑了。

examples.zh: 他扣动扳机，但没有反应。

words.translation: 折磨；拷问；歪曲

examples.zh: 这个政权的政治异己可能会遭受酷刑。

words.definition: someone or something that has won a competition, especially in sport; If you champion a person, a cause, or a principle, you support or defend them; title, first; encourage, second, back, carry, hand; classical, royal
words.translation: 冠军；拥护者；战士；支持；拥护；优胜的；第一流的

examples.en: the world heavyweight boxing champion
examples.zh: 世界重量级拳击冠军

examples.en: the Olympic champion
examples.zh: 奥运会冠军

examples.en: He passionately championed the poor.
examples.zh: 他曾热情地捍卫穷人。

words.definition: a country governed by elected representatives of the people, and led by a president, not a king or queen; commonwealth, respublica
words.translation: 共和国；共和政体

examples.zh: 前德意志联邦共和国

examples.zh: 有九个共和国参加了全民公决。

examples.en: He flung his coat over the back of a chair.
examples.zh: 他把外套扔在椅背上。

words.definition: relating to music or consisting of music; a play or film that includes singing and dancing; harmonious, sweet

examples.zh: 童话故事《灰姑娘》的音乐剧版

examples.zh: 金在音乐事业的开始阶段只为黑人观众演奏。

examples.en: The street lights go on at dusk.
examples.zh: 街灯在黄昏时亮起来。

words.definition: a stiff punishment is great or severe; the body of a dead person; mechanical, severe, wooden, rigid, dead; thoroughly, entirely, completely, fully, tight; worker, dead body

examples.zh: 三十岁之前，我训练后从不会感到身体发僵。

words.definition: a neat pile of things; If you stack a number of things, you arrange them in neat piles; pile, bing; pile, heap up
words.translation: 堆；堆叠；使堆叠；把…堆积起来；堆积，堆叠

examples.zh: 一摞摞脏盘子

examples.zh: 白色棉布衬衫

examples.zh: 百分之百纯棉制作。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that is fixed inside a house or building and is sold as part of the house; equipment, furniture, facility, plant

words.translation: 青蛙；[铁路] 辙叉；饰扣；捕蛙

examples.zh: 这个蝌蚪已长成青蛙。

examples.zh: 蝌蚪会变成青蛙。

examples.en: The frog darted out its tongue to catch a mosquito.
examples.zh: 这只青蛙突然伸出舌头捕捉蚊子。

words.definition: very serious and sincere; if something starts happening in earnest, it begins properly – used when it was happening in a small or informal way before; crucial, important, serious, considerable, material; sincerity, staidness
words.translation: 认真的，热心的；重要的；认真；定金；诚挚；[贸易]定金

examples.zh: 相当认真的一个年轻人

examples.zh: 马修斯在和一个年轻姑娘认真地谈话。

examples.zh: 为社会做贡献的真诚愿望

words.definition: a solid substance made of fat or oil and used to make candles, polish etc; to rub a layer of wax into a floor, surface etc to protect it or make it shine; increase, make; waxen

words.translation: 喇叭，扬声器；扩音器；[电子]喇叭，扬声器

examples.en: The loudspeaker announced the arrival of the train.
examples.zh: 广播说火车进站了。

words.translation: 海军的；军舰的；(Naval)人名；(西、德、印)纳瓦尔

examples.zh: 海军军官

examples.zh: 宽敞的居住空间

examples.zh: 天气潮湿时衣服会发霉。

examples.zh: 这种油可能包含致癌物和有毒的霉。

examples.zh: 他拖了几个星期才去世，让所有的医生都很惊讶。

words.definition: the act of keeping something; memory, preservation, mind, hold, reservation
words.translation: 保留；扣留，滞留；记忆力；闭尿

examples.zh: 几分钟之内这个地方挤满了警官，他们开始搜查附近的一片树林。

examples.zh: 在操场上叫嚷奔跑的孩子们

words.translation: 誓言，誓约；诅咒，咒骂

examples.zh: 总统宣誓就职。

words.translation: 马克思主义者；马克思主义的

examples.zh: …一个信奉马克思主义的国家。

examples.zh: 他的前妻显然是想榨干他每一分钱。

examples.zh: 往火上再添些木柴。

examples.zh: 擦得锃亮的木地板

examples.en: Her house was made of wood .
examples.zh: 她家的房子是木头盖的。

examples.zh: 顺着箭头指示的方向去X光科。

words.definition: when someone fits a piece of equipment somewhere; device, apparatus, unit, gear, appliance
words.translation: 安装，装置；就职；[机]安装，装置

examples.zh: 警报系统的安装和维护

words.definition: a light soft shoe that you wear at home; baboosh, pantofle, chinela
words.translation: 拖鞋；用拖鞋打

examples.zh: …一双旧拖鞋。

words.definition: the act of having sex; society, communication, gender, exchange
words.translation: 性交；交往；交流

examples.en: social intercourse
examples.zh: 社交

words.definition: the liquid that comes from fruit and vegetables, or a drink that is made from this; extract, syrup

examples.zh: 一纸盒橙汁

examples.zh: 请来一杯可乐和一杯番茄汁。

words.definition: the soft thick hair that sheep and some goats have on their body; erio, Lana
words.translation: 羊毛；毛线；绒线；毛织品；毛料衣物；[纺]绒线

examples.en: a pure wool skirt
examples.zh: 纯羊毛裙子

words.translation: 破坏，渐渐破坏；挖掘地基

examples.zh: 持续的战斗有可能破坏通过谈判达成协议的努力。

words.translation: 厨房；炊具；炊事人员；[建]厨房

examples.zh: 萨姆走进厨房去沏一壶茶。

examples.zh: 她在厨房里做饭。

examples.zh: 已宣布进入紧急状态。

examples.zh: 斯蒂尔先生被宣布破产了。

examples.zh: 烤之前把香肠戳孔。

words.translation: 晚餐，晚饭；夜宵

examples.zh: 周五为什么不过来吃晚饭呢？

examples.zh: 我们在一家意大利小餐馆吃了晚饭。

words.translation: 温暖；热情；激动

examples.zh: 她被火的温暖吸引着，走进了房间。

words.translation: 纬度；界限；活动范围；[地理]纬度

examples.zh: 这些鸟在北纬地区繁殖。

words.translation: 群众；多数

examples.zh: 我从来不吃早饭。

examples.zh: 我们吃了一顿丰盛的早餐，然后出发去远足了。

words.definition: an open container with a handle, used for carrying and holding things, especially liquids; barrel, pail; pour down
words.translation: 桶，水桶；铲斗；一桶的量；倾盆而下；颠簸着行进；[机]铲斗

examples.en: They were drinking beer by the bucket.
examples.zh: 他们狂饮啤酒。

words.definition: able or likely to explode; a substance that can cause an explosion; volatile, fulminic; blasting agent, detonator
words.translation: 爆炸的；爆炸性的；爆发性的；炸药；爆炸物；[力]爆炸的；[化工]炸药；[力]爆炸物

examples.en: Because the gas is highly explosive, it needs to be kept in high-pressure containers.
examples.zh: 由于这种气体极易爆炸，因此需要保存在高压容器内。

examples.en: A small explosive device (= bomb ) was set off outside the UN headquarters today.
examples.zh: 今天有一枚小型炸弹在联合国总部外爆炸。

words.definition: using a system in which information is recorded or sent out electronically in the form of numbers, usually ones and zeros; numerical; figure, key, number
words.translation: 数字的；手指的；数字；键

examples.en: digital TV
examples.zh: 数字电视

examples.en: a digital signal
examples.zh: 数字信号

examples.en: a digital camera
examples.zh: 数码照相机

words.definition: the middle part of an animal’s body, near its stomach; to fill with air and become rounder in shape; stomach, appetite, abdomen; summon up; plump
words.translation: 腹部；胃；食欲；涨满；鼓起；使鼓起

examples.en: She laid her hands on her swollen belly.
examples.zh: 她把手放在隆起的肚子上。

words.definition: to say that an action is illegal or not allowed; stem, block, dispute, bar, discourage
words.translation: 阻止，禁止

examples.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the factory.
examples.zh: 厂区严禁吸烟。

words.definition: A lapse of something such as concentration or judgment is a temporary lack of that thing, which can often cause you to make a mistake; error, sin, mistake, blame, passing; cease to be in force, out of service
words.translation: (一时的) 走神，判断错误；失效；流逝；过失；背离，失检；陷入

examples.en: I had a little lapse of concentration in the middle of the race.
examples.zh: 我在比赛中走了一下神。

examples.en: He was a genius and because of it you could accept lapses of taste.
examples.zh: 他是一个天才，因此他偶失得体，人们也可以接受。

words.definition: a special occasion when people celebrate something such as a religious event, and there is often a public holiday; holiday, joy, celebration; cheerful, enjoyable
words.translation: 节日；庆祝，纪念活动；欢乐；节日的，喜庆的；快乐的

examples.en: Christmas is one of the main festivals in the Christian Calendar.
examples.zh: 圣诞节是基督教历的重大节日之一。

words.definition: a piece of equipment, especially electrical equipment, such as a  cooker  or  washing machine  , used in people’s homes; device, apparatus, installation, unit, tool
words.translation: 器具；器械；装置；[机]装置

examples.en: The device most often used to do this is a load balancer, which is an appliance that accepts requests from the outside world and hands them off to the next available application server.
examples.zh: 进行这一操作最常用的设备是一个负载均衡器，这是一个从外部接收请求并将它们移交给下一个可用应用程序服务器的装置。

words.definition: frozen raindrops which fall as hard balls of ice; to call to someone in order to greet them or try to attract their attention; precipitation, blast; welcome, rah
words.translation: 冰雹；致敬；招呼；一阵；向欢呼；猛发；使像下雹样落下（过去式hailed，过去分词hailed，现在分词hailing，第三人称单数hails）；万岁；欢迎；[气象]冰雹

examples.en: heavy showers of rain and hail
examples.zh: 夹着冰雹的阵阵大雨

words.definition: the space between two straight lines or surfaces that join each other, measured in degrees; fish, figure for; hao, jiao
words.translation: 钓鱼；谋取；角度，角，方面；角度，[数]角

examples.en: You didn’t measure the angle accurately.
examples.zh: 你没有量准角度。

words.definition: remarks, jokes etc that are vulgar deal with sex in a very rude and offensive way; popular, low, mainland, coarse, informal; populace, common man
words.translation: 粗俗的；通俗的；本土的；平民，百姓

examples.en: vulgar behaviour
examples.zh: 粗俗的行为

words.definition: someone who is travelling in a vehicle, plane, boat etc, but is not driving it or working on it; traveler, viator
words.translation: 旅客；乘客；过路人；碍手碍脚的人；[交]乘客

examples.en: Neither the driver nor the passengers were hurt.
examples.zh: 司机和乘客均未受伤。

words.definition: to get back an amount of money that you have paid; exploit, carve out; protest against sth, exclaim at; reconstruction, influence
words.translation: 开拓；回收再利用；改造某人，使某人悔改；改造，感化；再生胶；抗议，喊叫

examples.en: You may be entitled to reclaim some tax.
examples.zh: 你也许可以享受一定额度的退税。

words.definition: a situation that is unusual or amusing because something strange happens, or the opposite of what is expected happens or is true; of, resembling, or containing iron; hit, satire; ferrous
words.translation: 讽刺；反语；具有讽刺意味的事；铁的；似铁的

examples.en: Life is full of little ironies.
examples.zh: 生活中充满了小小的讽刺。

words.definition: done quickly, immediately, or at the right time; to make someone decide to do something; a word or words said to an actor in a play, to help them remember what to say; rapid, fast, fly, forward, ready; facilitate, boost, further; cue, noting; punctually
words.translation: 敏捷的，迅速的；立刻的；提示；促进；激起；（给演员）提白；付款期限；DOS命令：改变DOS系统提示符的风格；准时地；[计]提示

examples.en: Prompt action must be taken.
examples.zh: 必须立即采取行动。

examples.en: Prompt payment is requested.
examples.zh: 请立即付款。

examples.en: a prompt response
examples.zh: 迅速的答复

words.definition: a line of people waiting to enter a building, buy something etc, or a line of vehicles waiting to move; to form or join a line of people or vehicles waiting to do something or go somewhere; train, alignment, tail, rank; line up for, stand in a line
words.translation: 队列；长队；辫子；排队；排队等候；[数]队列；[数]排队

examples.en: You’ll have to join the queue.
examples.zh: 你得排队。

words.definition: the distance from one side of something to the other; width, range
words.translation: 宽度，幅度；宽宏

examples.en: We need to provide more breadth in the college curriculum.
examples.zh: 我们需要扩大学院课程的范围。

words.definition: to say officially that you want to stop fighting, because you realize that you cannot win; when you say officially that you want to stop fighting because you realize that you cannot win; desert, quit; give in to sb, throw up the sponge; submission, Caved In
words.translation: 使投降；放弃；交出；听任；投降；屈服；自首

examples.en: Germany surrendered on May 7th, 1945.
examples.zh: 德国于 1945 年 5 月 7 日投降。

examples.en: The terrorists were given ten minutes to surrender.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子被限定在十分钟之内投降。

words.definition: a sudden shaking of the earth’s surface that often causes a lot of damage; temblor, seismic event
words.translation: 地震；大动荡；[地震]地震

examples.en: An earthquake measuring 6.1 on the Richter scale struck southern California on June 28.
examples.zh: 6月28日加州南部地区发生了里氏6.1级地震。

examples.en: The city is in an earthquake zone.
examples.zh: 该市位于地震带。

words.definition: an old-fashioned method of sending messages using radio or electrical signals; to send a message by telegraph; wire, tgm; wire transfer, cable transfer; wire
words.translation: [通信] 电报机，电报；电汇；流露出；打电报给…；[通信]电报机，电报；[通信]打电报

examples.en: Once he knew where we were, Lewis telegraphed every few hours.
examples.zh: 一知道我们在哪里，刘易斯就每隔几小时发一份电报来。

words.definition: a half of the Earth, especially one of the halves above and below the  equator; semisphere
words.translation: 半球；[天]半球

examples.en: the Northern hemisphere
examples.zh: 北半球

words.definition: the power that is carried by wires, cables etc, and is used to provide light or heat, to make machines work etc; electric power, electric force
words.translation: 电力；电流；强烈的紧张情绪

examples.en: The farm was very isolated, but it had electricity.
examples.zh: 那个农场非常偏远，但有电力供应。

words.definition: a very thin book with paper covers, that gives information about something; booklet, tract
words.translation: 小册子

examples.en: a political pamphlet
examples.zh: 政治宣传册

words.definition: suddenly or surprisingly quickly; happening during the night or for the night; short, pop; all-night
words.translation: 通宵；突然；昨晚；晚上的；通宵的；前夜的；头天晚上；一夜的逗留；连夜快递；过一夜

examples.en: He became a millionaire overnight.
examples.zh: 他一夜之间就成了百万富翁。

words.definition: badly decayed and no longer good to use; weak, fallen, rank; extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too
words.translation: 腐烂的；堕落的；恶臭的；虚弱的；极坏的；非常；(Rotten)人名；(法、德)罗滕；[木]腐烂的；[环境]恶臭的

examples.en: the smell of rotten eggs
examples.zh: 坏鸡蛋的气味

examples.en: Some of the wood was completely rotten.
examples.zh: 有些木头完全腐烂了。

examples.en: The apples went rotten very quickly.
examples.zh: 苹果很快就腐烂了。

words.definition: continuing only for a short time; brief, little, passing; visitor, migratory bird
words.translation: 短暂的；路过的；瞬变现象；过往旅客；候鸟

examples.en: transient fashions
examples.zh: 短暂的时尚

words.definition: a hot dark brown drink that has a slightly bitter taste; caffe
words.translation: 咖啡；咖啡豆；咖啡色；[食品][作物]咖啡

examples.en: Do you want a cup of coffee?
examples.zh: 你要来杯咖啡吗？

examples.en: Do you like your coffee white (= with milk ) or black (= without milk ) ?
examples.zh: 你的咖啡要加奶还是不加奶？

words.definition: a circle made from leaves or flowers that you put on the place where a person is buried; crown, lei, corolla; zone, environ; orbit, serpentuate
words.translation: 花冠；圈状物；环绕（等于wreathe）；[轻]花冠；盘旋（等于wreathe）

examples.en: The prime minister laid a wreath at the war memorial.
examples.zh: 首相向战争纪念碑献了花圈。

words.definition: to give someone poison, especially by adding it to their food or drink, in order to harm or kill them; a substance that can cause death or serious illness if you eat it, drink it etc; slow, pollute; wine, liquor, drink; toxic, virous, venenous
words.translation: 污染；使中毒，放毒于；败坏；阻碍；毒药，毒物；酒；有毒害的事物；[助剂] 抑制剂；有毒的；毒药，[毒物]毒物；[助剂]抑制剂

examples.en: She was accused in 1974 of poisoning her second husband, Charles.
examples.zh: 1974 年她被控毒死了她的第二任丈夫查尔斯。

examples.en: He killed several people by poisoning their tea.
examples.zh: 他在茶里下毒杀死了几个人。

words.definition: a  spirit  who is God’s servant in heaven, and who is often shown as a person dressed in white with wings; cherubs, nat
words.translation: 天使；守护神；善人；出钱支持

examples.en: the angel Gabriel
examples.zh: 天使加百列

words.translation: 基督；救世主；天啊！

words.definition: one of a pair of wooden or metal covers on the outside of a window that can be closed to keep light out or prevent thieves from coming in; diaphragm, jalousie
words.translation: 快门；百叶窗；关闭物；遮板；为…装百叶窗；以百叶窗遮闭；[摄]快门；[建]百叶窗；[机]遮板

examples.en: There are a few things you should check before pressing the shutter release.
examples.zh: 在按快门之前，有几件事情你应该检查。

words.definition: a short attack on a place by soldiers, planes, or ships, intended to cause damage but not take control; if police raid a place, they make a surprise visit to search for something illegal; robbery, assault; hit, descend on
words.translation: 袭击；突袭；搜捕；抢劫；对…进行突然袭击；[军]袭击；[军]袭击，突袭

examples.en: a bombing raid
examples.zh: 轰炸

examples.en: an air raid warning siren
examples.zh: 空袭警报

words.definition: to join metals by melting their edges and pressing them together when they are hot; a joint that is made by welding two pieces of metal together; combine, bond; jointing, soldering
words.translation: 焊接；使结合；使成整体；焊接点；[机]焊接

examples.en: The new handle will have to be welded on.
examples.zh: 新的把手得焊上去。

words.definition: to get rid of goods by selling them in a foreign country at a much lower price; a place where unwanted waste is taken and left; pour in; empty the trash
words.translation: 倾倒；倾卸；丢下，卸下；摆脱，扔弃；倾销；垃圾场；仓库；无秩序地累积；倒垃圾

examples.en: Merrill dumped her suitcase down in the hall.
examples.zh: 梅里尔把手提箱扔在门厅里。

words.definition: a round pipe made of metal, glass, rubber etc, especially for liquids or gases to go through; pipe, tunnel; fail, take the subway
words.translation: 管；电子管；隧道；电视机；使成管状；把…装管；用管输送；[生物]管；乘地铁；不及格

examples.en: a tube of toothpaste
examples.zh: 一管牙膏

words.definition: an instrument that shows directions and has a needle that always points north; calliper, divider; case, invest, circumvent, encircle, ring about
words.translation: 指南针，罗盘；圆规；包围；指南针，[航][水运]罗盘

examples.en: a map and compass
examples.zh: 地图和指南针

words.definition: someone who owns or is in charge of a small shop; boss, employer
words.translation: 店主，老板

examples.en: The girl had only worked for the shopkeeper for three days when she packed him in.
examples.zh: 这姑娘替那店主只干了三天， 就辞职不干了。

examples.en: In Jermyn Street in London, a shopkeeper anxiously asked who the next president would be.
examples.zh: 在伦敦的杰明街，一个店主焦急地问道，谁将是（美国）下一任总统。

examples.en: I was an unknown foreigner, and could have easily evaded payment with impunity, yet no London shopkeeper ever mistrusted me.
examples.zh: 我是一个没人知道的异乡人，本可以大胆地轻易逃避付款，但是从来没有一个伦敦的店主不信任我。

words.definition: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose; equipment, furniture, establishment, plant, fixture
words.translation: 设施；设备；容易；灵巧

examples.en: What recreational facilities are now available?
examples.zh: 什么娱乐设施现在是可用的？

words.definition: not interesting or exciting; to make something become less sharp or clear; slow, blunt; relax, benumb; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 钝的；迟钝的；无趣的；呆滞的；阴暗的；使迟钝；使阴暗；缓和；(Dull)人名；(罗、匈)杜尔；(柬)杜；(英)达尔；减少；变迟钝

examples.en: Life is never dull when Elizabeth is here.
examples.zh: 有伊丽莎白在这里生活绝不会无聊。

examples.en: a dull movie
examples.zh: 一部沉闷的电影

examples.en: It sounded pretty dull to me.
examples.zh: 在我听来，这很无聊。

words.definition: a pleat or fold in a part of a garment, usually stitched down so as to make it a better fit or as decoration; curl up, roll up; food, energy, diet, vitality, eating; pucker
words.translation: 卷起；挤进；用某物舒适地裹住；使有褶裥；收拢；大口吃；使隐藏；食物；船尾突出部；缝摺；抱膝式跳水；活力；鼓声；缝褶裥；缩拢；舒服地裹在里面

words.definition: a small object that produces a high whistling sound when you blow into it; to make a high or musical sound by blowing air out through your lips; hooter, tyfon
words.translation: 口哨；汽笛；呼啸声；吹口哨；鸣汽笛；[铁路][船]汽笛；啸啸声

examples.en: The lifeguard blew his whistle.
examples.zh: 救生员吹响哨子。

words.definition: a book made of plain paper on which you can write notes; manual, jotter
words.translation: 笔记本，笔记簿；手册

examples.en: He brought out a notebook and pen from his pocket.
examples.zh: 他从口袋里掏出了一个笔记本和一支钢笔。

words.definition: a wild animal that looks like a large dog and lives and hunts in groups; to eat something very quickly, swallowing it in big pieces; Lothario, lady-killer; tie into, gulp down
words.translation: 狼；色狼；残忍贪婪之人；大吃；狼吞虎咽地吃；[脊椎]狼

examples.en: a pack of wolves
examples.zh: 一群狼

words.definition: the time when crops are gathered from the fields, or the act of gathering them; to gather crops from the fields; outcome, product, event, crop, result; gather, crop, net; mow
words.translation: 收获；产量；结果；收割；得到；收割庄稼

examples.en: The company is now reaping the harvest of careful planning.
examples.zh: 公司现在尝到了精心规划带来的甜头。

words.definition: the young of various species of fish; to cook something in hot fat or oil, or to be cooked in hot fat or oil; deep-fry, panbroil; deepfry
words.translation: 鱼苗；油炸食物；油炸；油煎

examples.en: So when you fry, bake, grill, or roast potatoes you could be generating potentially harmful carcinogens.
examples.zh: 因此当你油炸、烘烤、烧烤或者炒土豆时，有可能会产生有害的致癌物。

words.definition: tightness or stiffness in a wire, rope, muscle etc; strain, intensity, stress; stress, wind up
words.translation: 张力，拉力；紧张，不安；电压；使紧张；使拉紧

examples.en: Tension in the neck muscles can cause headaches.
examples.zh: 颈部肌肉紧张会导致头痛。

examples.en: Muscle tension can be a sign of stress.
examples.zh: 肌肉紧张可能是压力大的迹象。

words.definition: produced or happening four times a year; Quarterly is also an adverb; a magazine that is produced four times a year
words.translation: 季度的，按季度的；一年四次的；按季度，[农] 一季一次地；纵横四分地；季刊

examples.en: We publish a quarterly journal.
examples.zh: 我们出版一份季刊。

examples.en: The rent is payable quarterly.
examples.zh: 房租按季度支付。

examples.en: It makes no difference whether dividends are paid quarterly or annually.
examples.zh: 红利是按季度还是按年度支付没有区别。

words.definition: to shine suddenly and brightly for a short time, or to make something shine in this way; a bright light that shines for a short time and then stops shining; reflect, mirror; stroboflash, coruscation; reflect, flare light; shot, coruscant
words.translation: 使闪光；反射；闪光，闪现；一瞬间；闪光的，火速的

examples.en: Lightning flashed overhead.
examples.zh: 头顶上电光闪闪。

examples.en: Red warning lights flashed on and off (= shone for a short time and then stopped shining ) .
examples.zh: 红色警告灯一闪一闪。

words.definition: feeling strong emotions which make you want to shout at someone or hurt them because they have behaved in an unfair, cruel, offensive etc way, or because you think that a situation is unfair, unacceptable etc; riley, vexed
words.translation: 生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的

examples.en: I was angry because he hadn’t told me his plans.
examples.zh: 我很生气，因为他没有告诉我他的计划。

examples.en: He was beginning to get angry .
examples.zh: 他开始发脾气了。

examples.en: His comments brought an angry response from opposition politicians.
examples.zh: 他的话激起反对派政客愤怒的回应。

words.definition: something that is distinct can clearly be seen, heard, smelled etc; obvious, visible, unique, evident, individual
words.translation: 明显的；独特的；清楚的；有区别的

examples.en: The outline of the ship became more distinct.
examples.zh: 船的轮廓变得更加清晰了。

words.definition: worried or slightly afraid because you think that something bad might happen; uncomfortable, unstable
words.translation: 不舒服的；心神不安的；不稳定的

examples.en: She eventually fell into an uneasy sleep.
examples.zh: 她终于睡着了，但睡得并不踏实。

words.definition: to choose one thing or do one thing instead of another; to choose, to make a choice
words.translation: 选择

examples.en: Depending on your circumstances you can opt for one method or the other.
examples.zh: 根据自己的情况，你可以选择这种或那种方法。

words.definition: a way of criticizing something such as a group of people or a system, in which you deliberately make them seem funny so that people will see their faults; hit, sarcasm
words.translation: 讽刺；讽刺文学，讽刺作品

examples.en: the characteristic use of satire in Jonson’s work
examples.zh: 琼森作品中讽刺手法的独到运用

words.definition: pleased and happy about something; happy, pleased, willing, delighted; pleasure, satisfy
words.translation: 高兴的；乐意的；令人高兴的；灿烂美丽的；使高兴；(Glad)人名；(塞、瑞典)格拉德；(英)格莱德；(法、挪)格拉

examples.en: We’re so glad you came.
examples.zh: 你来了我们真高兴。

examples.en: ‘I’ve decided to accept the job.’ ‘I’m glad.’
examples.zh: “我决定接受这份工作。”“我很高兴。”

words.definition: an area of grass, especially an area where the grass is kept cut short; lawn, herba; feed, range
words.translation: 草；草地，草坪；放牧；使……长满草；使……吃草；[植]草

examples.en: I walked across the grass.
examples.zh: 我走在草地上。

examples.zh: 罗德尼把录音机放在桌面上，按下了播放键。

words.translation: 爬行；蔓延；慢慢地移动；起鸡皮疙瘩；毛骨悚然的感觉；谄媚者

examples.en: He crept back up the stairs, trying to avoid the ones that creaked.
examples.zh: 他蹑手蹑脚地回楼上，尽量避开那些嘎吱作响的梯级。

words.definition: a continuing increase in prices, or the rate at which prices increase; expansion, bulking
words.translation: 膨胀；通货膨胀；夸张；自命不凡；[金融]通货膨胀

examples.en: Inflation is now at over 16%.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀率现已超过16%。

words.definition: to prop or make safe with or as if with a shore; the land along the edge of a large area of water such as an ocean or lake; support, uphold, sustain; leg, backbone, stay
words.translation: 支撑，使稳住；用支柱撑住；海滨；支柱

examples.en: We could see a boat about a mile from shore.
examples.zh: 我们看见离岸边大约一英里的地方有一艘船。

examples.en: Only a few survivors reached the shore.
examples.zh: 仅有几个生还者到达岸边。

examples.en: She began to swim to shore.
examples.zh: 她开始朝岸边游去。

words.definition: a group of countries that are all controlled by one ruler or government; seignorage, empery
words.translation: 帝国；帝王统治，君权

examples.en: the Roman empire
examples.zh: 罗马帝国

words.definition: a government department that is responsible for one of the areas of government work, such as education or health; division, department, sector
words.translation: （政府的）部门

examples.en: ...the Ministry of Justice.
examples.zh: …司法部。

words.definition: a narrow length of plastic that is sticky on one side and is used to stick things together; to record sound or pictures onto a tape; magnetictape, mylar; sound recording, make a record
words.translation: 胶带；磁带；带子；卷尺；录音；用带子捆扎；用胶布把…封住；[计]磁带

examples.en: a photo stuck to the wall with tape
examples.zh: 用胶布贴在墙上的照片

words.definition: connected with God and religion
words.translation: 圣洁的，神圣的；至善的；神圣的东西

examples.en: the holy city of Varanasi
examples.zh: 圣城瓦拉纳西

words.definition: fibre, funicle
words.translation: 纤维；光纤（等于fibre）

examples.en: And remember nuts like almonds with their skins on have more fiber than those without.
examples.zh: 记住，向杏仁那样有皮的坚果比那些没有皮的更富含纤维素。

examples.en: While they bite into the fruit, they could savor the various blends of fiber and juices.
examples.zh: 当他们咬一口水果，他们可以尝到各种水果纤维和汁液的混合。

examples.en: Not only do they offer antioxidants, they contain higher content of vitamins, minerals, and fiber.
examples.zh: 它们不仅提供抗氧化剂，还含有较高含量的维生素、矿物质和纤维。

words.definition: a short test that a teacher gives to a class; trick, mischief; dig at, test for
words.translation: 考查；恶作剧；课堂测验；挖苦；张望；对…进行测验

examples.en: a biology quiz
examples.zh: 生物测验

words.definition: a song or tune; song, cantus
words.translation: 旋律；歌曲；美妙的音乐

examples.en: They played some lovely melodies.
examples.zh: 他们演奏了一些动听的曲子。

examples.en: a haunting melody
examples.zh: 难以忘怀的曲调

words.definition: fertile land or soil is able to produce good crops; rich, viable; pregnancy, enrichment
words.translation: 富饶的，肥沃的；能生育的；[植]能生育的；肥沃，多产

examples.en: 800 acres of fertile cropland
examples.zh: 800英亩的肥沃耕地

words.definition: having the colour of grass or leaves; the colour of grass and leaves; to fill an area with growing plants in order to make it more attractive; herbaceous, vernal; youth, bice
words.translation: 绿色的；青春的；绿色；青春；使…变绿色

examples.en: beautiful green eyes
examples.zh: 漂亮的碧眼

examples.en: Raw coffee beans are green in colour.
examples.zh: 生咖啡豆是绿色的。

words.definition: a situation in which a large number of people have little or no food for a long time and many people die; hunger, fames
words.translation: 饥荒；饥饿，奇缺

examples.en: the great potato famine in Ireland
examples.zh: 爱尔兰严重的土豆荒

examples.en: A million people are facing famine .
examples.zh: 一百万人正面临饥荒。

words.definition: a description of events in a story, especially in a novel; relation, statement, story, telling, tale; related, descriptive
words.translation: 叙述；故事；讲述；叙事的，叙述的；叙事体的

examples.en: At several points in the narrative the two stories cross.
examples.zh: 叙述中两条故事线多次交织在一起。

words.definition: a strong artificial material that is used to make plastics, clothes, rope etc; polymide, polyamide fiber
words.translation: 尼龙，[纺] 聚酰胺纤维；尼龙袜；尼龙，[纺]聚酰胺纤维

examples.en: nylon fabric
examples.zh: 尼龙织物

examples.en: The tent was made of nylon.
examples.zh: 那顶帐篷是尼龙做的。

words.definition: to move into a particular position suddenly, making a short sharp noise, or to make something move like this; a sudden loud sound, especially made by something breaking or closing; an election that is announced suddenly and unexpectedly; pull cut; bite, gnaw at; splutter; sudden, unannounced
words.translation: 突然折断，拉断；猛咬；啪地关上；劈啪声；突然折断；突然的；咬；厉声说；咯嗒一声关上

examples.en: A twig snapped under my feet.
examples.zh: 一根细枝在我脚下嚓一声断开了。

words.definition: a large imaginary animal that has wings and a long tail and can breathe out fire; tiger, wyrm
words.translation: 龙；凶暴的人，凶恶的人；严厉而有警觉性的女人

words.definition: someone who is honest always tells the truth and does not cheat or steal; responsible, effective, transparent, reliable, tried
words.translation: 诚实的，实在的；可靠的；坦率的

examples.en: He was a hard-working, honest man.
examples.zh: 他勤奋老实。

examples.en: Ann had an honest face.
examples.zh: 安有一张诚实的面孔。

words.definition: the money charged for sending a letter, package etc by post; taxe, franking
words.translation: 邮资，邮费；[邮]邮资，邮费

examples.en: How much is the postage for a postcard?
examples.zh: 寄一张明信片的邮资是多少？

words.definition: to cover a place with water, or to become covered with water; a very large amount of water that covers an area that is usually dry; drown out, inundate; stream, spill into; fresh, flow, inundation
words.translation: 淹没；充满；溢出；洪水；泛滥；一大批；涌出；涌进；为水淹没；[水文]洪水

examples.en: Towns and cities all over the country have been flooded.
examples.zh: 全国各地的城镇都被淹没了。

examples.en: The houses down by the river flood quite regularly.
examples.zh: 沿河的房屋常遭水淹。

words.definition: a plane or other vehicle that can fly; plane, airplane, aeroplane
words.translation: 飞机，航空器；[航]飞机，航空器

examples.en: The return flight of the aircraft was delayed.
examples.zh: 飞机的返回航程被推迟了。

words.definition: a large organ in your body that produces bile and cleans your blood; resident, dweller
words.translation: 肝脏；生活者，居民

examples.en: Three weeks ago, it was discovered the cancer had spread to his liver.
examples.zh: 三周前，发现癌已扩散到了他的肝脏。

words.definition: a string of jewels, beads etc or a thin gold or silver chain to wear around the neck
words.translation: 项链

examples.en: ...a diamond necklace and matching earrings.
examples.zh: …一条钻石项链和与之相配的耳环。

words.definition: a small animal with long ears and soft fur, that lives in a hole in the ground; bunny, hare; to hell with
words.translation: 兔子，野兔；让…见鬼去吧

examples.en: The rabbit disappeared in the bushes.
examples.zh: 那只兔子消失在树丛中。

examples.en: At this time, a robust rabbit said: "No, or eat me !
examples.zh: 这时，一只健壮的兔子又说：“不，还是先吃我吧！

words.definition: to win a victory over someone in a war, competition, game etc; failure to win or succeed; down, get the best of; failure, loss, losing, reverse, collapse
words.translation: 击败，战胜；挫败；使…失败；失败的事实；击败的行为；失败；战胜

examples.en: They hoped to defeat the enemy at sea.
examples.zh: 他们希望在海上击败敌人。

words.definition: to laugh quickly, quietly, and in a high voice, because something is funny or because you are nervous or embarrassed; Giggle is also a noun; smirk
words.translation: 傻笑；咯咯地笑；吃吃的笑

examples.en: If you can’t stop giggling you’ll have to leave the room.
examples.zh: 如果你再咯咯地笑个不停，就给我离开屋子。

examples.en: She gave a little giggle.
examples.zh: 她咯咯地笑了一下。

words.definition: a small part of something that remains after the rest of it has been used, destroyed, or eaten; surplus, residual, spare; remaining, surplus, residual, odd
words.translation: 剩余；剩余的

examples.en: Beneath the present church were remnants of Roman flooring.
examples.zh: 在目前的这座教堂下面还有残余的古罗马地板。

words.definition: a bright shiny appearance, with small points of flashing light; to shine in small bright flashes; energy, vitality, spring, vigor; fire, flare; shine on
words.translation: 闪耀；火花；活力；使闪耀；使发光；发泡；活跃

examples.en: the sparkle of the diamonds
examples.zh: 钻石的光芒

words.definition: to push someone or something in a rough or careless way, using your hands or shoulders; a strong push; squeeze, force one's way; push, jundy
words.translation: 挤；强使；撞；猛推；推

examples.en: He shoved her towards the car.
examples.zh: 他推着她走向汽车。

examples.en: Everyone was pushing and shoving to see the prince.
examples.zh: 大家都推着挤着要看王子。

words.definition: to make someone feel calmer and less worried or frightened about a problem or situation
words.translation: 使…安心，使消除疑虑

examples.en: Teachers reassured anxious parents.
examples.zh: 老师们安慰焦急的父母。

words.definition: a large sea animal that eats fish and lives around coasts; to cover the surface of something with something that will protect it; symbol, print; pressure, air proof
words.translation: 密封；印章；海豹；封条；标志；盖章；[机]密封；[皮革][脊椎]海豹

examples.en: Check seals on fridges and freezers regularly.
examples.zh: 定期检查冰箱和冰柜的密封装置。

words.definition: a line where two pieces of cloth, leather etc have been stitched together; joining, juncture; cement, piece, joint; gap, spring off
words.translation: 缝；接缝；缝合；接合；使留下伤痕；裂开；产生裂缝

examples.en: She was repairing Billy’s trousers, where the seam had come undone.
examples.zh: 她在补比利裤子的开线处。

examples.en: Join the shoulder seams together.
examples.zh: 把肩部缝起来。

words.definition: a small book or piece of paper advertising something or giving information on a particular subject; circular, lobule
words.translation: 小叶；传单；[植]小叶

examples.en: Campaigners handed out leaflets on passive smoking.
examples.zh: 发起人分发了关于被动吸烟的传单。

words.definition: Notwithstanding is also an adverb; in spite of something; still, toujours; in spite of, in despite of; although, while, though, as, albeit
words.translation: 尽管，仍然；尽管，虽然；虽然

examples.en: His relations with colleagues, differences of opinion notwithstanding, were unfailingly friendly.
examples.zh: 他与同事们尽管有意见分歧，但关系一直很融洽。

words.definition: the woman that a man is married to; lady, Mrs
words.translation: 妻子，已婚妇女；夫人

examples.en: Have you met my wife?
examples.zh: 你见过我的妻子吗？

examples.en: a refuge for battered wives
examples.zh: 受虐待妻子庇护所

examples.en: his second wife
examples.zh: 他的第二任妻子

words.definition: a plan for achieving something; schedule, design, map, propose, project; plan, scheme, programme, project
words.translation: 计划；制成蓝图；蓝图，设计图；[印刷]蓝图，设计图

examples.en: By changing the tomato’s genetic blueprint , scientists can alter the rate at which it ripens.
examples.zh: 科学家可以通过改变番茄的基因蓝图来改变它的成熟速度。

words.definition: to say something very loudly; a loud call expressing anger, pain, excitement etc; yell out, exclaim; cry, yell out; cry, call
words.translation: 呼喊；喊叫；大声说；呼叫

examples.en: There’s no need to shout! I can hear you!
examples.zh: 用不着大声喊叫！我听得见！

examples.en: ‘Watch out!’she shouted, as the car started to move.
examples.zh: “小心！”汽车开动时，她大声喊道。

words.definition: a family of kings or other rulers whose parents, grandparents etc have ruled the country for many years
words.translation: 王朝，朝代

examples.en: The Habsburg dynasty ruled in Austria from 1278 to 1918.
examples.zh: 哈布斯堡王朝在1278至1918年间统治奥地利。

words.definition: a unit for measuring the power of an engine, or the power of an engine measured like this; soup
words.translation: 马力（功率单位）

examples.en: a two-hundred horsepower engine
examples.zh: 两百马力的发动机

examples.en: the superior horsepower of a Volkswagen
examples.zh: 大众汽车的强劲动力

words.definition: waste material, such as paper, empty containers, and food thrown away; refuse, waste, junk, rubbish, trash
words.translation: 垃圾；废物；[环境]垃圾

examples.en: Can you take out the garbage when you go?
examples.zh: 你走的时候把垃圾带出去好吗？

words.definition: the light and heat that come from the sun when there is no cloud; brightness, Suny
words.translation: 阳光；愉快；晴天；快活

examples.en: We had three days of spring sunshine.
examples.zh: 我们享受了三天的春日阳光。

words.definition: the number 14
words.translation: 十四；十四个；第十四；十四的记号；十四岁；十四点钟；十五世纪

examples.en: He used to work fourteen hours a day.
examples.zh: 他过去一天工作14个小时。

examples.en: I started playing the guitar when I was fourteen (= 14 years old ) .
examples.zh: 我14岁开始弹吉他。

words.definition: a government department or a part of a government department in the US; department, innings
words.translation: 局，处；衣柜；办公桌；[管理]局，处；[家具]办公桌

examples.en: the Federal Bureau of Investigation
examples.zh: 联邦调查局

words.definition: Something that is static does not move or change; noise caused by electricity in the air that blocks or spoils the sound from radio or TV; electrostatic, franklinic
words.translation: 静态的；静电的；静力的；静电；静电干扰；[电磁]静电的

examples.en: The number of young people obtaining qualifications has remained static or decreased.
examples.zh: 获得各种资格证书的年轻人的数量一直保持不变或者已经减少。

words.definition: a large black and white animal that looks like a bear and lives in the mountains of China; bearcat
words.translation: 熊猫；猫熊；[脊椎]熊猫

examples.en: The caged panda chafed against the bars.
examples.zh: 笼子里的大熊猫贴在栅栏上蹭它的身体。

examples.en: No. If the panda  has not quit by morning .
examples.zh: 不，如果明天早上那熊猫还不走

words.definition: a confused state or situation; dissension, entanglemant; intertangle, entangle; rough and tumble
words.translation: 纠纷；混乱状态；使纠缠；处于混乱状态；缠结；乱作一团

examples.en: My hair tangles easily.
examples.zh: 我的头发很容易打结。

words.definition: to use rude and offensive language; plight one's troth, cross my heart; plight one's troth, take an oath; juration, oath
words.translation: 发誓；咒骂；宣誓；诅咒；发誓，宣誓

examples.en: Don’t swear in front of the children.
examples.zh: 不要在孩子们面前说粗话。

words.definition: the flat cutting part of a tool or weapon; sword, vane
words.translation: 叶片；刀片，刀锋；剑；[植][脊椎]叶片；[机]刀片，刀锋

examples.en: a razor blade
examples.zh: 剃刀刀片

words.definition: concerning or produced by  magnetism; geomagnetic
words.translation: 地磁的；有磁性的；有吸引力的

examples.en: magnetic forces
examples.zh: 磁力

words.definition: to breathe air in through your nose in order to smell something; Sniff is also a noun; smell, snuff at; smell, nose, discover; suction, smell, wind
words.translation: 嗅；嗤之以鼻；吸，闻；气味；以鼻吸气；吸气声；闻；用力吸；发觉

examples.en: He opened the milk and sniffed it.
examples.zh: 他打开牛奶闻了闻。

examples.en: At last the sobs ceased, to be replaced by sniffs.
examples.zh: 最后呜咽声终于停止了，取而代之的是抽鼻子的声音。

words.definition: to have drops of salty liquid coming out through your skin because you are hot, ill, frightened, or doing exercise; drops of salty liquid that come out through your skin when you are hot, frightened, ill, or doing exercise; stream, shed; sudor, globule; smart, labour over
words.translation: 使出汗；流出；使干苦活；剥削；藉出汗减轻；焦急地期待；汗；水珠；焦急；苦差使；出汗；辛苦工作；懊恼；结水珠

examples.en: I was sweating a lot despite the air conditioning.
examples.zh: 尽管开着空调，我仍是满头大汗。

words.definition: extremely unattractive and unpleasant to look at; evil, ill, black, wicked
words.translation: 丑陋的；邪恶的；令人厌恶的

examples.en: a very ugly man
examples.zh: 非常丑陋的男子

examples.en: the ugliest building in town
examples.zh: 城里最难看的建筑

examples.en: Nick’s dog is as ugly as sin (= very ugly ).
examples.zh: 尼克的狗难看得要命。

words.definition: connected with or including drawing, printing, or designing; ikonic, imagic
words.translation: 形象的；图表的；绘画似的

examples.en: a graphic artist
examples.zh: 平面造型艺术家

examples.en: the graphic arts
examples.zh: 平面造型艺术

words.definition: land that is owned or controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force; domain, province, world, extent, boundary, region, kingdom
words.translation: 领土，领域；范围；地域；版图；[地理]版图

examples.en: Hong Kong is a Chinese territory.
examples.zh: 香港是中国的领土。

words.definition: unable to control your behaviour, speech etc because you have drunk too much alcohol; loaded, buffy
words.translation: 喝酒（drink的过去分词）；喝醉了的

examples.en: He must be either mad or drunk.
examples.zh: 他要么是疯了，要么是喝醉了。

examples.en: Last night I got drunk and rolfed my dinner.
examples.zh: 昨天晚上我喝醉了，把晚饭全吐出来了。

words.definition: in the area around a particular place
words.translation: 邻近，附近；近处

examples.en: The stolen car was found in the vicinity of the station.
examples.zh: 被盗汽车在车站附近被发现。

examples.en: There used to be a mill in the vicinity.
examples.zh: 附近曾有一座磨坊。

words.definition: someone’s child or children – often used humorously; child, creation, fruit, seed
words.translation: 后代，子孙；产物；[生物]后代，子孙

examples.en: a young mother trying to control her offspring
examples.zh: 一个想管住自己孩子的年轻妈妈

words.definition: a man who rents a room, building, or piece of land to someone; boss, employer
words.translation: 房东，老板；地主；[租赁]房东，老板

examples.en: His landlord doubled the rent.
examples.zh: 他的房东把房租提高了一倍。

words.definition: to walk or move unsteadily, almost falling over; an unsteady movement of someone who is having difficulty in walking; interlace; titubate, hesitate; titubation, hitchiness; altern, interlaced
words.translation: 蹒跚；使交错；使犹豫；交错安排；交错的；错开的；犹豫

examples.en: He managed to stagger home.
examples.zh: 他好不容易才蹒跚着走回家。

examples.en: She staggered back a step.
examples.zh: 她踉跄着后退了一步。

examples.en: The old man staggered drunkenly to his feet.
examples.zh: 老汉醉醺醺地踉跄着站了起来。

words.definition: the number 19
words.translation: 十九

examples.en: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
examples.zh: 当时是7点19分。

examples.en: I was only nineteen (= 19 years old ).
examples.zh: 我当时只有19岁。

words.definition: a player or team in a competition that is given a particular position, according to how likely they are to win; to remove seeds from fruit or vegetables; foundation, child; sow, gather head; sow
words.translation: 种子；根据；精液；萌芽；子孙；原由；播种；结实；成熟；去…籽；[植]种子；（植物）结实

examples.en: He’s been top seed for the past two years.
examples.zh: 他在过去两年中一直是头号种子选手。

words.definition: relating to space or the universe; universal, mundane
words.translation: 宇宙的（等于cosmical）

examples.en: ...the cosmic laws governing our world.
examples.zh: …主宰我们世界的宇宙法则。

words.definition: more than enough in quantity; abundant, numerous, multiple, many, full
words.translation: 丰富的；许多的；丰饶的；众多的

examples.en: a plentiful supply of food
examples.zh: 食物的大量供应

words.definition: a flat piece of plastic, metal etc with a row of thin teeth on one side, used for making your hair tidy; to make hair look tidy using a comb; crista galli, cockscomb; upsurge
words.translation: 梳子；蜂巢；鸡冠；梳头发；梳毛；（浪）涌起
